jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
*INTUITIVE®* is a nationally recognized Best Place to Work that provides solutions from design through production to sustainment by delivering targeted results. Our approach couples the latest technology with engineering expertise and analytical proficiency while remaining true to genuine customer relationships and a culture that fosters growth and opportunity. Our diverse portfolio of capabilities and extensive customer base allows our employees countless opportunities to pursue their passions and support our nation’s Warfighters. Join our team that encourages creativity, welcomes initiative, and seeks excellence. Start Building Your Future today!

We are seeking an experienced Embedded Software Engineer to join our multi‑disciplinary engineering team. In this role, you will contribute to ongoing programs within the Design & Engineering division and participate across the full software development lifecycle, including requirements interpretation, architecture design, implementation, integration, testing, and system troubleshooting.

This position involves a broad range of embedded software tasks such as microcontroller programming, interfacing with data acquisition (DAQ) systems, implementing communication protocols, and developing firmware as well as integrating embedded systems with external services or host applications. The role requires strong communication skills to effectively collaborate with cross‑functional engineering teams and clearly convey technical concepts to stakeholders.

**Required**

* ABET accredited BS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline
* 5 years of relevant technical experience
* Strong foundational knowledge of embedded systems, microcontrollers, and low-level software development
* Proficiency in C/C++ and Python with the ability to work with additional languages as needed
* Experience with communication protocols (e.g., UART, RS-232, RS-422, RS-485, Modbus, SPI, I2C, CAN, TCP/IP)
* Familiarity with reading schematics and understanding digital/analog circuitry
* Experience working in Linux environments
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a security clearance

**Desired**

* Familiarity with hardware description languages (e.g, Verilog, VHDL)
* Experience with hardware‑in‑the‑loop or system‑integration test environments
* Experience with Git/GitLab, including CI/CD pipelines and SAST/DAST security tooling
* Experience working with APIs (e.g., REST, SOAP, gRPC, WebSocket)
* Knowledge of working in containerized environments (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
* Experience with MATLAB/Simulink
* Knowledge of Agile methodologies

If you have any difficulty using our online system and you need an accommodation due to a disability, you may use the following alternative email address or phone number to contact us about your interest in employment at *INTUITIVE* hr@irtc-hq.com or 256-922-9300. Our process is to respond and to work with the requestor to identify a workable accommodation to the application process.

jobs.description:
**Description**

  
  
Job Description

Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?

At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainable. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

**Your greatest work is ahead!**

The **Leidos Defense Electrical Systems Department** is seeking a talented **Lead Electrical Engineer** to join an experienced, high performing, multidisciplinary team to create unique solutions to complex engineering challenges in our Huntsville, AL location. The Electrical Systems Department is a design-focused group specializing in advanced hardware products. The individual selected for this position will be an electrical engineer with project engineering, design engineering, and production skillsets. The individual must be a self-starter with experience working with inter-disciplinary teams to solve challenging technical problems. The engineer will work closely with hardware integrated into a diverse range of aerospace and military systems including manned/unmanned ground/air vehicles, missiles, radars, and space systems.

The selected candidate will be expected to execute in a fast-paced, small team environment through all phases of the hardware life cycle from conceptual development and detailed design through manufacturing, qualification testing, and post-delivery support. With a product focus, the individual is also expected to actively partner with other engineers, project managers, technicians, and customers to develop solutions that adhere to a diverse set of requirements. The ideal candidate will thrive in a learning environment that encourages leadership and technical growth.

**If you are up for the challenge of joining this team, then apply today to be considered.**

**Leidos Defense Systems Sector** provides a diverse portfolio of systems, solutions, and services covering land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace for customers worldwide. Solutions for Defense include enterprise and mission IT, large-scale intelligence systems, command and control, geospatial and data analytics, cybersecurity, logistics, training, and intelligence analysis and operations support. Our team is solving the world’s toughest security challenges for customers with “can’t fail” missions. To explore and learn more, click here!

* Leading Failure Review and Corrective Action committees for critical component failures
* Presenting to program leadership and customers in weekly meetings, quarterly IPRs, and CDRs
* Integrating LRUs into larger systems by collaborating with system design teams on design updates
* Coordinating with line management and program management to identify staffing opportunities and accelerate schedules

**Basic Qualifications**

* Candidate must possess a Bachelor's of Science in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or equivalent degree from an ABET-accredited institution.
* Candidate must have at least twelve (12) years of experience in the design and test of electronics or ten (10) years with MS degree.
* Candidate must demonstrate experience in the design, test, and manufacture of analog/mixed-signal PCBs or integrated RF/microwave assemblies.
* Candidate must have demonstrated experience leading engineering teams through production transitions from LRIP to full-rate production
* Candidate must demonstrate proficiency in engineering leadership and team management
* Candidate must have hands-on laboratory experience with instrumentation, test equipment, and debug/test methods including use of network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, oscilloscopes, signal generators, etc.
* Position requires candidates to be capable of performing in a collaborative engineering environment working closely with multi-disciplinary teams.

* Produce analysis results and inputs for official SEA test-report products and present findings during mission data reviews

* Support continuous improvement of analytical processes and mission assessment capabilities

jobs.description:
Overview:

i3 is seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to support the U.S. Army DEVCOM Aviation & Missile Center (AvMC) Air/Ground Integration and Interoperability Lab (AGIIL) in Huntsville, AL. AGIIL is a fast-paced, rapid prototyping and systems integration laboratory supporting a diverse range of Department of War customers and mission areas. The selected candidate will work with multidisciplinary teams to translate operational and customer needs into technical requirements and practical hardware and software engineering solutions. You will apply a comprehensive understanding of Systems Engineering principles to identify and derive requirements, support software and system architecture development, design, integrate, test, and verify complex systems in a fast-paced R&D environment, contributing independently while also collaborating closely with senior engineers and mentors.

Responsibilities:

* Analyze customer and operational needs and translate them into practical technical requirements, approaches, and engineering solutions.
* Support rapid prototyping, software development, system integration, troubleshooting, laboratory and field testing, demonstrations, and evaluation activities.
* Develop system concepts, architectures, interface definitions, functional/data flows, mockups, and other engineering products used to communicate and mature solutions.
* Coordinate with software developers and other engineering disciplines to refine system behavior, interfaces, and implementation approaches.
* Work with software, hardware, network, test, and integration engineers to develop, evaluate, and improve integrated system solutions.
* Perform technical assessments, trade studies, and gap analyses; document findings, test results, risks, and recommended courses of action for internal and Government customers.
* Reviewing test plans, procedures, and verification and validation activities.
* Independently manage assigned technical tasks and priorities while coordinating with Government customers, internal teams, vendors, and external organizations as required.
* Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in an engineering, technical, or related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 10 years of relevant Systems Engineering, systems integration, or related technical experience.
* Experience supporting the development, integration, and testing of hardware and software systems, including software-intensive or networked solutions.
* Experience working with a multidisciplinary teams providing systems engineering support to develop practical engineering solutions.
* Ability to analyze technical problems, troubleshoot integration issues, and support software/system verification and validation activities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to work independently with general guidance as part of a multidisciplinary team.
* Active DoD Secret security clearance required to start.
* U.S. Citizenship required.
* Ability to lift 50lbs.
* 10% Travel.

Preferred:

* Experience with DoDAF architectures, UML/Object-Oriented Design, data flows, interface diagrams, or similar system modeling methods.
* Familiarity with DevSecOps environments and tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Experience supporting DoD/Army rapid prototyping, tactical networking, system integration, laboratory, or test environments.

Knowledge/Skills

* Knowledge of office administration and procedures.
* Exceptional judgment capabilities and relationship management skills.
* Excellent communication, teamwork, and client service skills; ability to clearly communicate in discussions and written documents, and to deliver feedback clearly and tactfully.
* Interact with a diverse array of customers and staff in a professional and courteous manner.
* Work independently with accountability for accurate and complete results.
* Be extremely organized and exceptionally detail oriented.
* Work well both independently and in a team environment.
* Be energized by a fast-paced work environment.
* Must be able to communicate with others effectively.
* Analyze information and respond appropriately.
* Manage time wisely and prioritize tasks.
* Provide superior customer service.
* Multi-task in a pleasant manner.
* Work well under pressure.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

* The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand; walk; handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms.
* The employee is occasionally required to sit; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.
* Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.
* Regular i3 hours are 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m. Monday-Friday, however, additional hours may be required on occasion. Regular and punctual attendance is required.

Founded in 2007, Integration Innovation, Inc. (i3) is headquartered in Huntsville, AL, with additional offices in Orlando, FL, and the National Capital Region. i3 team members operate at the leading edge of national defense across a broad range of technical disciplines, from systems and software engineering to modeling, simulation, and training solutions to cybersecurity, digital engineering, and enterprise IT. We also take products from prototype through production, bringing that same engineering rigor to manufacturing and delivering hardware at scale. For candidates, that means a rare opportunity:

Overview:

We are seeking a Systems Engineer III to lead technical execution across multiple complex military aviation programs, spanning both rotary-wing and fixed-wing platforms. You will serve as a primary customer interface, lead Integrated Product Teams (IPTs), and steer major design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR). This role oversees requirements, architecture, risk, scheduling, and system testing while collaborating closely with engineering, operations, integration, and MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul) teams.

* Customer Interface: Serve as the principal technical point of contact for military customers, sub-contractors, and external stakeholders.
* IPT Leadership: Lead multi-disciplinary Integrated Product Teams (IPTs) to drive technical execution and program alignment.
* Design Reviews: Plan, lead, and successfully execute formal aviation milestones including System Requirements Reviews (SRR), Preliminary Design Reviews (PDR), and Critical Design Reviews (CDR).

* Architecture & Digital Engineering: Define, develop, and maintain robust system architectures using Cameo and 3DExperience platforms.
* Requirements & Risk: Oversee the decomposition, traceability, and validation of complex requirements while managing technical risks and schedule milestones.
* Lifecycle Testing: Drive system integration, verification, and validation (V&V) planning, including defining test cases, managing test execution, and analyzing flight or laboratory data.
* Cross-Functional Interface: Serve as the primary technical bridge between engineering, program management, quality, manufacturing, and operations, organizations to ensure seamless design-to-sustainment transitions.

Qualifications:

* **Experience:** Minimum of 12 years of progressive systems engineering experience in the military aerospace or defense industry.
* Leadership & Communication: Proven success leading IPTs and presenting complex engineering data directly to military customers.
* Platform Expertise: Proven background supporting both rotary-wing and fixed-wing aircraft development or modification programs.
* Testing & Integration: Demonstrated experience in hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing, system integration labs (SIL), and formal qualification testing (QT).
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering.

**Preferred Skills**

* Advanced, hands-on experience using Cameo Simulation Toolkit and the 3DExperience ecosystem for Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE).
* Strong knowledge of military airworthiness certification processes (e.g., MIL-HDBK-516C, AR 70-62).
* Strong knowledge of military safety (e.g. MIL-STD-882E, SAE ARP 4754/4761)
* Strong Knowledge of Design Assurance Guidelines for hardware and software (RTCA DO-254, RTCA DO-178C)
* Team Leadership: experience formally leading, mentoring, and direct-tasking a team of engineers.

We are hands-on, designing with the latest technology and tools, and integrate state of the art test solutions with the most advanced engineering systems in the world.

**This role is 100% onsite in our Tucson, AZ Location.**

  

As a Test Systems Engineer II, you will work with multiple engineering teams to define, design, and document Test Environment capabilities and requirements. You must be a systems thinker, able to see the “big picture”, and be open to growth to understand how prime hardware should be tested at every (from component to All-Up-Round) to ensure robustness and efficiency.

**What You Will Do**

* You will apply your knowledge of the subsystem and collaborate with other Engineering disciplines to develop and implement the subsystem model using Model Based System Engineering tools and methods.

* Communicate test equipment needs and requirements to Test Equipment designers.
* Manage requirements and traceability.
* Leverage and apply reuse of Test Environment requirements and models to promote efficiency in test design and development.

**Qualifications You Must Have**

* Bachelor’s in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) with a minimum of two (2) years of experience directly related engineering experience (or a STEM Masters in lieu of experience)
* Systems Engineering experience in test requirements development, test planning, test techniques, test methodologies, embedded functional test, and integration, verification, and validation for test
* Experience demonstrating a systems engineering approach for test-related activities within the product lifecycle.
* The ability to obtain and maintain a US security clearance prior to the start date. U.S. citizenship is required as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance

**Qualifications We Prefer**

* Experience with Agile processes and techniques.
* Experience with Dynamic Object-Oriented Requirements System (DOORS).
* Experience with development, environmental, qualification, production, manufacturing and operations testing
* Experience problem solving and debugging.
* Experience with Model Based Engineering processes, techniques, and tools (Rhapsody and IBM Rational Model Manager and/or Cameo Systems Modeler/Enterprise Architect and Teamwork Cloud preferred, with understanding of Systems Modeling Language (SysML), and/or Unified Modeling Language (UML).
* Experience working cross-functionally, within and outside your own team, to support the development and growth of work tasks
* Experience in developing, decomposing, and managing systems requirements
* Experience recognizing areas of improvement or customer needs and relaying them to senior staff as business development possibilities.
* Experience demonstrating a sense of urgency, prudent risk-taking and adaptive response to challenges.

**What We Offer**

Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or minimum of 8 years of qualified work experience may be substituted.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in R&D or design of low voltage and/or medium voltage power systems.
* Strong background in control system design using SolidWorks Electrical.
* Proven track record in designing and testing electrical components such as transformers, switchgear, or power distribution systems.

* Strong understanding of power system components, including circuit breakers, relays, and busbars.
* Familiarity with industry standards (e.g., IEEE, IEC, UL, NEC).

* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong communication and teamwork abilities.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Master’s degree is preferred.
* Experience with renewable energy integration (e.g., solar, wind, energy storage, microgrids) into LV/MV systems.
* Familiarity with smart grid technologies or IoT applications in power systems.

* Must be able to lift up to 40 pounds at a time.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

  

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

*The Anduril Rocket Motor Systems (RMS) team is on a mission to build next generation solid rocket motors for a safer, more connected world. To achieve our vision of becoming a large-volume provider of tactical rocket motors, we will develop differentiated products and services that maximize our customers' capabilities, and we will establish and maintain a reputation of Quality and Reliability.*  
  
**ABOUT THE JOB**  
  
As the Sr. Electrical Engineer, you will specify, design, develop and install devices used to collect data on solid rocket motor burn performance. Additionally, you will design custom electronic solutions—including PCBs, firmware, and FPGA code—needed to manufacture and test solid rocket motors, which will include working with integrated safety-critical designs. This position also requires the ability to configure data collection systems and develop software applications used to collect the data. It is expected that you may oversee technicians during the instrumentation installation and during rocket motor testing/development. The right person for this role has direct, hands-on experience with the design, development, and installation of sensors used to collect a variety of metrics related to testing of solid rocket motors. If you are a hands-on leader, have an entrepreneurial spirit, and enjoy being the point person for collecting valuable performance data, then this role is for you. You will assist in the testing solid rocket motors which will include working with integrated safety designs used to initiate the motor.

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Collaborates with other engineers to develop accurate, efficient equipment and instrumentation in accordance with safety and usability standards and client expectations.
* Collaborates with other electrical engineers to execute the safe arming and initiation of rocket motors under test.
* Designs PCBA and electrical system components with hands on testing and rework as necessary
* Creates detailed schematics and simulated models to test designs; optimizes designs for performance, reliability, and cost.
* Oversees the implementation of new measuring devices and control systems, ensuring devices are correctly installed and properly tested.
* Acts as project engineer for design, prototype fabrication, and manufacturing development.
* Develops required cable drawings to interface to various low- and high-voltage systems
* Drafts and presents formal technical documents, reports, and testing results to manager for approval.
* Provides training related to devices to employees and/or customers.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Proven experience in safety-critical hardware design, incorporating multi-fault tolerance, arm/fire inhibits, safe bleed-down circuits, and inadvertent initiation mitigation.
* Experience in high-voltage PCB layout and circuit design for motor initiation, including capacitor charging/discharge circuits, high peak-current switching, and creepage/clearance management
* Experience with the design, development, and installation of sensors employed to collect data on system performance.
* NI Labview or NI DAQmx experience or familiar with other COTS data acquisition systems
* Thorough understanding of signal conditioning for data acquisition, i.e. analog circuit design
* Intimate knowledge of the analog to digital conversion process, i.e. digital circuit design
* Understand Computer controlled data acquisition and able to develop computer applications for data collection.
* Able to select the correct sensors and design the placement of them to acquire the needed solid rocket motor performance metrics.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite and proficient with computer-aided design software.
* Ability to write and understand Python
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

#### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Advanced degree in engineering
* Experience with circuit simulation tools (spice)
* Experience using EDA tools such as Altium/Or CAD
* Familiar with real-time computer architectures and their OS's

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

**Job Title:** Automation Controls Engineer (Commissioning)

**Reports To:** Controls Engineering Manager

**Location / Travel:** Hackett, AR with travel

**Position Summary:**

We are seeking an Automation Controls Engineer to join our Mission Critical Commissioning team. In this role, you will participate in the design, programming, checkout, and startup of automation control systems with an emphasis on mission critical power or HVAC infrastructure. This position offers significant hands-on field experience validating complex control systems in high-reliability environments.

**Key Responsibilities:**

· Assist in developing and modifying PLC logic, HMI/SCADA screens, and device configurations.

· Review electrical schematics, P&IDs, panel layouts, and sequence of operations (SOO) to verify system intent.

· Perform point-to-point electrical checkouts, instrument calibration, and loop checks.

· Support on-site startup, functional testing, troubleshooting, and integrated system commissioning alongside contractors and field engineers.

· Coordinate with field electricians and engineering staff to verify field wiring by specifications.

· Diagnose and troubleshoot electrical wiring.

· Diagnose and troubleshoot PLC and HMI logic/programs.

· Assist in procurement and tracking of control hardware, field instrumentation, and spare parts.

· Prioritize updates to documents; field modifications (redlines), test results, tasks list, and commissioning reports on a daily basis.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

· Education & Experience (one of the following):

Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, or related technical field.

Associate Degree in Industrial Automation, Electronics, Mechatronics, or related discipline with 1–2+ years of hands-on experience.

Equivalent military or trade experience (e.g., industrial electrician, Navy nuclear/electrical, certified instrumentation tech).

· Foundational understanding of PLC ladder logic or basic control loops.

· Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics.

· Hands-on aptitude with basic electrical testing tools, for example multimeters.

· Strong problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills.

· Proficiency with standard office tools (Microsoft Office Suite, PDF markup).

· Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel to client job sites.

**Preferred / Beneficial Qualifications:**

(Candidates with experience in ANY of the following areas are encouraged to apply):

Industrial Automation & Software:

· Experience programming or troubleshooting Rockwell/Allen-Bradley (Studio 5000 / RSLogix), or similar platforms.

· Experience developing or modifying HMI/SCADA systems (Inductive Automation Ignition, FactoryTalk View).

· Understanding of industrial networking and protocols (EtherNet/IP, Modbus RTU/TCP, Serial).

Power Systems / EPMS:

· Experience with Electrical Power Management Systems (EPMS) or Substation Automation.

· Familiarity with low/medium voltage switchgear, Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS), Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS), or emergency diesel generators.

· Exposure to protective relays (SEL, Schneider, Basler) and power meters.

HVAC / BMS:

· Experience with Building Management Systems (BMS) and protocols (BACnet IP/MSTP, LonWorks).

· Understanding of central cooling and heating systems: chillers, cooling towers, pumps, and air handling units (AHUs).

· Knowledge of sequence of operations for environmental control: differential pressure control, humidity control, and economizer cycles.

* Competitive Salary

* Bonus Opportunity
* Cell Phone
* Computer
* Travel Reimbursement, mileage, meal, and hotel costs as detailed in company policy

**Summary**  
  
The **Senior Software Engineer (Embedded)** has the opportunity to develop a variety of innovative unmanned and robotic systems for multiple defense and commercial applications. The Embedded Software Engineer writes functional software for deployment on embedded devices and systems like aircraft and payloads and have the opportunity to test out those devices in flight test environments. This requires the engineer to design, develop, code, test and debug system software as well as analyze and enhance efficiency, stability and scalability of the software on particular devices. jobs.title: Senior Staff Hardware Engineer - Optical
jobs.description:
**About Marvell**

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

**Your Team, Your Impact**

AI’s next breakthrough depends on more than compute—it depends on how efficiently data moves. As AI clusters scale out across racks and data centers, optical connectivity becomes essential to delivering the bandwidth, power efficiency, and performance these systems demand.  
  
Join Marvell’s Optics team and help engineer the hardware that makes that connectivity possible. Our platforms bring together high-speed silicon photonics, transmit and receive amplifiers, controller ASICs, Marvell digital signal processors, and embedded firmware to create highly integrated optical solutions.  
  
Our team owns the design, verification, and validation of these components, including system-level testing of hardware, firmware, and control loops across operating conditions. You will work alongside specialists across these disciplines and carry products from initial concept through new product introduction.

**What You Can Expect**

As a Senior Staff Hardware Engineer, you will lead hardware platform development for integrated optical transceiver engines supporting high-speed fiber-optic communications.

jobs.title: Senior Controls Engineer, Automation
jobs.description:
**Senior Controls Engineer, Automation**

**About the role**

Spring is a nonprofit venture platform building and backing companies that improve animal welfare at scale.

Spring Works, Spring's in-house technology group, designs, prototypes, and welfare-validates the devices the ecosystem needs but no vendor supplies. These technologies are then handed off to our incubated companies for deployment.

The equipment you build is the foundation of better welfare for billions of animals. These machines will be placed on farms, at fisheries, at aquaculture sites, in land-based processing plants, and on boats at sea. Equipment you might work on includes stunning systems for fish and crustaceans, aquaculture water quality and actuation systems, and farm robots, with new categories added as the ecosystem presents a need.

Spring Works products have to run reliably in wet, corrosive, moving environments, often thousands of miles from our shop. Some will run standalone and others in conjunction with equipment already on site. They have to be safe for the people operating them, who may have had minimal training. We design in remote diagnostics and instrumentation from the start. What we hand over to an incubated company is a field-deployable prototype, built to survive real production conditions and to return evidence of how it performed.

We’re hiring a Senior Controls Engineer to lead the controls system architecture and oversee the delegation of all related tasks within our team. This will start with defining the operations of the machine from a controls perspective very early on, scaffolding the machine logic, and providing the mechanical engineering side of the team with the specifications and components they need to incorporate during the concept phase of machine design. You will specify and source controls and electrical related components, design the schematics, program the machine including PCs/microcontrollers, PLCs, motion controllers, and HMI, and be hands-on during machine build with leading the wiring and panel builds. You will be responsible for running the machine during testing and debug, and solving whatever controls issues arise.

This is a full-scope controls role at a machine builder: architecture, code, electrical design package, panel, safety, and commissioning. It is not a maintenance or sustaining role, and it is not PLC programming inside someone else's electrical design.

You should be able to operate without oversight from management, and to judge when to seek input and when to decide on your own, as well as to delegate effectively to junior engineers. You must have a collaborative mindset and demonstrate sound decision-making and judgment.

**What you'll do**

**Scaffold the controls architecture**

* Develop the sequence of operations and control architecture during machine concepting, well before the mechanical design is frozen.
* Develop the I/O list, network architecture, and control philosophy, and drive them through design reviews with mechanical and mechatronics.
* Identify control-side risk early: cycle-time feasibility, sensing ambiguity, safe-state definition, and recovery from fault.

**Own the electrical design package**

* Produce the complete electrical design package: schematics, panel layouts, wiring and interconnect diagrams, I/O layouts, and electrical BOMs.
* Select and specify control components, including PLCs and I/O, drives, safety relays and safety controllers, sensors, contactors, breakers and circuit protection, power supplies, and networking hardware.
* Work with the mechanical design team to give them clear deliverables on which controls components they need to accommodate in the CAD design.
* Lead the machine wiring, including panel build, I/O and sensor wiring, and crimping and connectorizing, either hands-on or by directing a panel shop and wiring technicians. You should be able to build a panel yourself and be credible telling someone else how.
* Source electrical components and manage the vendors who supply them.

**Safety and compliance**

* Design the machine's safety system: E-stop circuits, safety relays or safety PLC, light curtains, interlocks, guard monitoring, and safe-state behavior.
* Perform and document risk assessments, and specify to the required performance level.
* Design to the applicable codes: NFPA 79, NEC/NFPA 70, UL 508A for panels, ISO 13849 or IEC 62061 for functional safety, and ANSI/RIA 15.06 where robots are in the cell.

**Program the machines**

* Program the PCs and microcontrollers, PLCs, and motion controllers for multi-station, multi-axis machinery.
* Write code that is structured, documented, maintainable, and reusable. Build and maintain libraries and standard blocks rather than re-deriving each machine from scratch.
* Configure and tune servo drives and VFDs, and implement coordinated multi-axis motion and robot integration where required.
* Develop HMI interfaces for operation, diagnostics, and maintenance that are robust, easy to operate, and documented in an operations manual.
* Implement machine data collection and any required MES, database, or SCADA integration.
* Work with embedded systems engineers or consultants to connect machine data to ancillary telemetry systems.

**Commission and ship**

* Lead power-on, bring-up, controls debug, and tuning. Own the machine's first run alongside the mechanical team lead.
* Run FAT and support SAT, installation, startup, and production release at customer sites.
* Produce the documentation the customer actually needs: as-built schematics, sequence of operations, alarm lists, operator and maintenance procedures, and code backups.
* Support machines in the field after they ship.

**Raise the bar around you**

* Set and maintain controls standards, including code structure, tag naming, library management, panel conventions, and revision control.
* Set the controls standards now, mentor junior controls engineers as the team grows.
* Be a credible technical voice

jobs.description:
**GROW WITH US AND STAY EXTRAORDINARY:**  
Launch your career to new heights with Innoflight—one of San Diego’s fastest-growing Aerospace and Defense innovators. Here, visionary minds engineer the future of space technology through pioneering, compact, and cyber-secure solutions. From software-defined radios to cutting-edge cryptographic systems and avionics, everything we build powers the next era of New Space. Join our small, agile, and mission-driven team where your work has real impact and your growth has no limits. We’re not just reaching for the stars—we’re engineering them. Let’s innovate the infinite, together.  
  
**A DAY IN THE LIFE:**  
The **Embedded Software Engineer III** plays a key role in developing software solutions for satellite avionics and payload data processing systems. This position involves creating real-time system monitoring and power management software, preparing Linux board support packages for customer flight applications, and working with a variety of embedded systems, sensors, communication buses, radios, and communications security (COMSEC) equipment. Close collaboration with hardware and FPGA engineers is essential to deliver rugged, reliable, and integrated Low-Size, Weight, and Power (Low-SWaP) products to aerospace customers.  
  
**Active U.S. Security Clearance is required.**  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* **Develop Embedded Software Systems:** Design and implement embedded C/C++ software for multi-core processors and FPGA-integrated systems (Xilinx, Microchip, Vorago), targeting ARM Cortex and RISC-V architectures.
* **Build and Customize Linux Platforms:** Configure Linux systems including kernel and bootloader (U-Boot, GRUB) modifications to support flight applications and mission requirements.
* **Implement Secure Communications:** Develop networking and cryptographic functionality (e.g., IP, TLS, IPsec, AES, RSA, ECDSA) and interface with buses and protocols like SPI, I2C, UART, PCIe, SpaceWire, and Ethernet.
* **Drive End-to-End Development:** Translate customer and system-level requirements into robust software solutions, participating in design, documentation, integration, validation, and testing.
* **Collaborate and Present:** Work closely with cross-functional teams, support system integration, debug software/hardware issues, and present technical updates to both internal and external stakeholders.
* **Manage Development Lifecycle:** Track features, bugs, and build processes using industry-standard tools for version control and release management.

**YOU’RE AWESOME AT:**

* **Embedded Software Development:** Expertise in embedded software design and implementation, particularly within aerospace applications.
* **Complex Document Analysis:** Ability to read, interpret, and analyze complex technical documents and specifications.
* **Cybersecurity and Encryption:** Familiarity with writing embedded C code that incorporates cybersecurity and encryption measures to ensure secure communications.

**WHAT YOU’LL NEED:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* 5 or more years of professional experience developing embedded software in C/C++ for Linux and/or RTOS-based systems.
* Deep knowledge of embedded platforms, multi-core processors, and interfacing standards (SPI, I2C, UART, PCIe, etc.).
* Experience configuring bootloaders (U-Boot, GRUB) and customizing Linux kernels for application-specific needs.
* Proficient with networking protocols (IP, TLS, IPsec) and cryptographic systems (AES, RSA, ECDSA, ECDH).
* Familiarity with version control and task tracking systems (e.g., Git, Jira) and modern software development workflows.
* Strong technical communication skills and ability to present designs and progress to both engineers and stakeholders.
* Experience with OpenCL, CUDA, or other parallel-processing frameworks is a plus.
* Prior work with aerospace or defense systems and knowledge of COMSEC requirements highly desirable.
* **Active U.S. Security Clearance is required.**

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:**  
The starting base salary for this position ranges from **$125,000 to $150,000 per year**, depending on the candidate’s job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to a competitive base salary, Innoflight offers a well-rounded compensation package that includes a Profit-Sharing Bonus and a Cash Performance Bonus to reward both individual and company performance. Additional benefits include:

* 401(k) with 3% company match (automatic enrollment)
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, HSA & life insurance
* 10 paid holidays + 120 hours PTO (starting in year one)
* Access to ancillary benefits such as critical illness, accident, disability, legal and pet insurance.

**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE:**

* **Flexible Work-Life Balance:** Enjoy a 9/80 work schedule with every other Friday off—whether you use it to recharge, work on a passion project, or spend time with family, the choice is yours.
* **Continuous Learning & Development:** We’re serious about professional development. From tuition reimbursement to internal "Ask Me Anything" sessions and weekly “Lunch & Learns,” we make learning a core part of the job.
* **Mission-Driven Culture:** We aren’t just building tech—we’re enabling the next era of space exploration. Our Culture Ambassadors help lead initiatives around inclusion, positivity, recognition, and transparency. Here, your voice is heard, your work is respected, and your individuality is celebrated.

**BE YOU, WITH US:**  
At Innoflight, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable workplace where everyone belongs. We recognize that great talent comes in many forms, and you don’t need to meet every requirement to bring value to our team. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t check every box.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Cloud Availability Platform
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**Build the operating system for the AI datacenter**
----------------------------------------------------

Crusoe operates one of the world's largest managed GPU fleets, and it is growing fast. A fleet at this scale cannot be run the way GPU clouds have traditionally been run: runbooks, war rooms, and heroics. It has to be run by a unified platform that senses, reasons about, and acts on the entire fleet, so infrastructure that used to take a team to operate takes a service instead. That is what our cloud platform team builds. You will work on the control plane for one of the largest AI fleets in the world, at a point where fleet autonomy is still an open problem: nobody has fully solved this at this scale, in this market.

**A true platform, not internal tooling:** We want to be explicit about that heading, because it is the thing most infrastructure roles get wrong. Everything we build ships as a product, fleet engineers, SREs, and product teams across Crusoe build their own services and workflows on top of what we ship. A platform team does not scale by doing everyone's work; it scales by making everyone's work self-serve. Concretely:

* **API-first.** Every capability is exposed through well-designed, versioned APIs behind a single gateway. If it isn't an API, it doesn't exist. No side doors, including for us.
* **SDKs and paved paths.** First-class client libraries, workflow templates, and golden paths so a fleet or SRE engineer can ship a new remediation or lifecycle workflow in days without asking the platform team.
* **Micro frontends and a self-serve portal.** Teams plug their own UI surfaces into one developer portal instead of building one-off dashboards. One console for the fleet, extensible by every team.
* **Platform as product.** Internal teams are customers. We own contracts, versioning, deprecation policy, quotas, documentation, and support. Adoption is our success metric: the platform wins when other teams choose it because it is the fastest path, not because it is mandated.

**What this platform is**
-------------------------

Four layers, built as one system:

* **Agents** on every site and host that collect telemetry and execute commands.
* **A distributed infra graph**: Models system connections down to the rack, fabric, power, and cooling layers. By integrating these connections with telemetry signals, the platform can precisely trace events to identify their blast radius and root cause.
* **A reconciliation core**: workflow engine, policy engine, and state reconciler that continuously close the gap between intended state and reality, exposed through the API gateway.
* **Domain services**: Services spanning provisioning, firmware upgrade, validation, deployment, repair and RMA, capacity, power and thermal, and Day-2 operations. Built once, run fleet-wide, consumable by any team through APIs and SDKs.

We operate on a continuous autonomy loop—sense, correlate, reason, act, learn—incorporating guardrails that evolve from recommendation to full automation. We treat every recurring manual intervention as a signal to engineer the next automation.

**You'll thrive here if you**
-----------------------------

* Want to build a platform, not integrate one. This is core distributed-systems engineering: event buses, graph models, reconciliation loops, policy evaluation.
* Treat internal engineers as customers and sweat API ergonomics, docs, and onboarding the way product teams sweat UX.
* Like owning a hard abstraction and defending it as ten teams build on top of you.
* Believe the interesting problems are where physical infrastructure meets software: a firmware counter, a thermal event, and a scheduling decision are one problem, not three.
* Measure yourself by what stops paging humans, and by how fast another team ships on your platform.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Design and build core platform services: RBAC, tenancy, the workflow engine, policy engine, and state reconciler that drive fleet actions safely at scale.
* Design the public face of the platform: the API gateway, resource model, and versioned API contracts that fleet, SRE, and product teams build against.
* Build SDKs, workflow templates, and golden paths that make the platform self-serve, plus the developer portal and micro frontend framework that let teams bring their own UI surfaces.
* Build the inventory and topology graph as the fleet's source of intended truth, and the pipelines that keep it honest against reality (metadata drift is one of our top verified incident root causes; you will kill it).
* Build site, GPU, and network agents and the event bus that moves fleet telemetry and commands reliably.
* Deliver the platform roadmap: pilot site on the foundation layer, first site deployed entirely through the platform, zero-downtime f

**Title: Electrical Engineer III — Analog, Digital & Power Electronics**

**Department: Engineering**  
**Reports To: Electrical Engineering Manager**  
**Location: Irvine, CA**  
**Employment Type: Full-Time**  
**FLSA Status: Exempt**

**POSITION SUMMARY**

Design electronics for demanding space and tactical applications. As an Electrical Engineer III, you will take ownership of hardware development from requirements and circuit design through board bring-up, integration, and verification.

Depending on your strengths and project needs, you will develop cryocooler control electronics, FPIE electronics for space applications, or power management electronics for tactical systems. We are seeking an engineer with strong analog and/or digital design skills who enjoys solving challenging technical problems and turning designs into reliable, tested hardware.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own circuit and board-level designs, including requirements definition, architecture, schematic development, component selection, and PCB layout guidance.
* Design analog, digital, mixed-signal, and/or power circuitry aligned with your expertise and assigned products.
* Perform circuit simulations and design analyses to verify performance, margins, and reliability.
* Lead hands-on board bring-up, troubleshooting, integration, and design verification.
* Develop test procedures and document results demonstrating compliance with product requirements.
* Prepare and present technical analyses, design review packages, and engineering recommendations.
* Collaborate with mechanical, firmware/software, systems, manufacturing, and quality teams to deliver producible, reliable hardware.
* Support qualification, production transition, and resolution of hardware issues.

  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
* Typically 7+ years of relevant electronic hardware design experience.
* Demonstrated strength in at least one area: analog/mixed-signal design, digital hardware design, or power electronics.
* Experience taking circuit or PCB designs from concept through prototype bring-up and verification.
* Proficiency with schematic capture, circuit analysis or simulation, and laboratory test equipment.
* Strong hands-on troubleshooting skills and the ability to identify and resolve hardware design issues.
* Ability to work independently on assigned designs and communicate technical decisions clearly across engineering disciplines.

  

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES**

* Strong understanding of electrical and electronic engineering principles.
* Ability to evaluate electrical systems, components, materials, and applications.
* Ability to develop practical, efficient, and cost-effective engineering solutions.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet established deadlines.
* Ability to communicate technical information effectively to internal teams and customers.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers and other cross-functional team members.

* FPIE electronics, precision analog signal conditioning, or high-speed low-noise mixed-signal design.
* FPGA-based digital hardware, embedded processor interfaces, or high-speed digital design.
* DC/DC conversion, power distribution, protection circuitry, or power sequencing.
* Worst-case analysis, component derating, radiation effects, or high-reliability component selection.
* EMI/EMC design, environmental qualification, or hardware qualification testing.

  

**WORK ENVIRONMENT / PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

This role may require working with electronic hardware, test equipment, and engineering documentation in an office, laboratory, and/or manufacturing environment. Additional physical, environmental, travel, or schedule requirements may apply based on project and business needs.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer — SubSystem Integration Test (SSIT)
jobs.description:
**Company:**
------------

Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.

**Job Area:**
-------------

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering

**General Summary:**

As part of the AISW engineering team at Qualcomm, you will be the software system integration test (SSIT) engineer for the Delegates portfolio — ONNX Runtime (QNN Execution Provider), ExecuTorch (HTP/QNN backend), and TFLite / LiteRT. You will own subsystem-level validation at the feature development stage — working side-by-side with software engineers to define test strategy early, build targeted test content, and ensure each feature is solid before it transitions to QA and System Integration Test (SIT). This is a shift-left quality role: you are a co-owner of feature quality from inception, not a downstream gatekeeper.

  
  

**What You'll Do**

Feature-Level Test Strategy & Planning

* Partner with delegate engineers from feature inception to define testability requirements, acceptance criteria, and subsystem test plans covering ORT QNN-EP, ExecuTorch HTP backend, and LiteRT delegate
* Own SSIT test strategy per feature: scope, entry/exit criteria, coverage targets, and risk-based prioritization — aligned with the development team before implementation begins
* Embed in sprint planning, design reviews, and code reviews to ensure features are architected for testability from day one
  

  

Test Content Development & Execution

* Develop and maintain automated test content targeting the subsystem boundary: op and feature coverage, numerical accuracy, model-level functional correctness, and backend interface contracts
* Validate on-device behavior on Snapdragon SoCs using HIL infrastructure, covering functional correctness, latency, and memory under real hardware conditions
* Build Python/PyTest-based test suites integrated into the Delegates CI pipeline; ensure SSIT gates are enforced on every code change
* Develop and leverage AI-assisted tooling and agentic workflows (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate test content generation, coverage analysis, and failure triage
  

  

Defect Triage & Root Cause Analysis

Triage failures and isolate root causes across the delegate stack — ML framework QNN runtime

* HTP hardware — and drive resolution with development owners
* Flag integration risks early during feature development; distinguish subsystem-level issues from upstream framework bugs and downstream backend or system integration issues
  

  

QA & SIT Handoff

* Define and own handoff criteria from SSIT to QA and SIT: documented test results, known issues, coverage gaps, and risk summaries that give downstream teams a clear picture of feature readiness
* Serve as the primary technical liaison between the Delegates development team and QA/SIT — translating feature context into actionable test guidance for downstream teams
* Maintain traceability between SSIT artifacts and QA/SIT test plans via JIRA; feed defects found in QA/SIT that trace to subsystem gaps back into SSIT coverage

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

OR
  
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
  
OR
  
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
  
  

* 2+ years of work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's + 8 years or Master's + 6 years in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or related field
* Strong Python; proven hands-on experience building automated test frameworks (PyTest or equivalent)
* C/C++ reading proficiency sufficient to debug delegate and runtime issues at the source level
* Demonstrated experience in subsystem or integration testing within a hardware/software product development cycle
* Experience with CI/CD platforms (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or equivalent) and integrating test automation into build pipelines
* Strong analytical and debugging skills with ability to isolate failures across multi-layer software stacks
* Experience validating ML inference frameworks — ONNX Runtime, ExecuTorch, TFLite / LiteRT, or equivalent
* Hands-on experience with Qualcomm QNN, HTP/DSP, or Snapdragon SoC-based on-device validation
* Familiarity with model accuracy validation: quantization correctness, op-level numerical comparison, and tolerance analysis
* C/C++ proficiency for development and debug of ORT unit tests
* Cross-platform test experience: Linux, Android, and Windows (ARM64 or x86)
* Experience with JIRA defect tracking and Agile/scrum development practices
  

  

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Sets the SSIT quality strategy and test architecture for the full Delegates portfolio at Staff level — operates independently with minimal direction
* Co-owns feature quality from day one alongside development engineers; defines what 'done' means from a subsystem validation standpoint before handoff to QA
* Primary technical bridge between the Delegates development team and downstream QA/SIT — owns the clarity and completeness of that interface
* Mentors junior and senior SSIT engineers; establishes team norms for test coverage, triage discipline, and handoff documentation standards
* Collaborates with CI/Build/Release engineers to ensure SSIT automation is embedded in the delivery pipeline and readiness signals are visible to Program Management

Qualcomm is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Electrical Engineer, PCB Design and Hardware
jobs.description:
We are looking for a mid-level Electrical Engineer to support the development of battery-electric vehicle systems. This hands-on role will focus on PCB design, board bring-up, hardware testing, troubleshooting, and system integration.

The engineer will work from schematic design through prototype builds, validation, and design updates while collaborating with mechanical, software, controls, and manufacturing teams.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop schematics and PCB layouts for control, sensing, communication, and power-distribution systems.
* Select components and maintain bills of materials and design documentation.
* Perform board bring-up, soldering, rework, testing, debugging, and failure analysis.
* Integrate PCBs with controllers, sensors, wiring harnesses, communication networks, and power-electronics components.
* Support CAN Bus, Ethernet, Modbus, I2C, and SPI interfaces.
* Support STM32 and other embedded-controller hardware.
* Develop test procedures and document results, corrective actions, and design changes.
* Apply grounding, shielding, and EMI/EMC practices for high-voltage and harsh operating environments.
* Coordinate with PCB suppliers and contract manufacturers on prototype and production issues.
* Support system-level testing during prototype and vehicle builds.

  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field.

jobs.title: Sr. Embedded Firmware Engineer, Robotics
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon is seeking exceptional talent to help develop the next generation of advanced robotics systems that will transform automation at Amazon's scale. We're building revolutionary robotic systems that combine AI, sophisticated control systems, and advanced electromechanical design to create adaptable automation solutions capable of working safely alongside humans in dynamic environments. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of robotics and automation at an unprecedented scale, working with world-class teams pushing the boundaries of what's possible in robotic manipulation.
  
  
Amazon is seeking a talented and motivated Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer to design, implement, and launch firmware for highly dexterous robotic end effectors. In this role you will own firmware sub-domains independently. The ideal candidate has extensive experience writing firmware to process a wide variety of sensors, control electric motors, and communicate with the larger system, and can work well both independently and in a multidisciplinary team setting.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Drive communication interface integration at the firmware layer, ensuring robust, deterministic communication between the end effector and the larger robotic system.
* Review vendor firmware deliverables, provide technical direction, and hold vendors to Amazon's quality, coding, and integration standards.
* Author functional requirements, design verification plans, and test procedures; execute designs that meet those requirements.
* Build and test firmware for electromechanical subsystem prototypes and integrated systems, covering sensor processing, motor control, and system communication.
* Support product releases to manufacturing and customer deployments, including production firmware bring-up and validation, working efficiently to support fast-paced development schedules.

  
A day in the life  
Your morning starts with a new sensor module on your desk: the latest prototype from a manufacturing partner overseas. You jump on a call with the vendor's engineering team to walk through their test results, flag an issue you spotted in the data, and agree on a firmware fix they'll turn around overnight. Getting fast iteration cycles on hardware is how this team operates: you don't wait for perfect specs, you get hardware moving and learn from what it tells you.
  
  
By mid-morning you're designing the control interface for the end effector: defining how it talks to the rest of the system, what data it exposes, and how it fits into the real-time communication architecture. You sketch the firmware-side changes, then switch to the simulation environment to update the corresponding ROS model so the controls engineer you're working with can test policies against it before hardware arrives. Making things work in sim and on your dev kit in the same day is normal here: the hardware hasn't shipped yet, but that doesn't stop you.
  
  
After lunch you pick up a code review from another team. They're building the actuator control framework that your end effector integrates with, and their latest change surfaces a new set of requirements you hadn't considered. You leave substantive feedback, and it reshapes how you're thinking about your own interface design.
  
  
You close the day with a quick chat with a teammate on the mechanical design side who's working on a physical sensor model. They want help writing custom firmware to characterize the sim-to-real gap, and you realize it connects directly to the simulation change you made that morning. What started as two separate threads becomes a collaboration. You open a shared design doc and start outlining the approach together.
  
  
About the team  
We're developing next-generation robotic manipulation capabilities for highly dexterous multi-finger grippers and hands. Our firmware work spans motor control, sensor processing, tactile sensing production firmware, and the tight integration of the robotic end effector with the larger robotic platform. We build the embedded systems that bring capable, reliable robotic hardware to life.

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* 5+ years of professional software development in C or C++ for embedded systems 5+ years of full embedded software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
* 5+ years developing embedded C applications that use an RTOS (such as FreeRTOS, uC-OS, Zephyr, VxWorks) or embedded Linux environments
* 3+ years of development experience with some aspect of robotic systems, including direct, hands-on experience designing, developing, and debugging one of: consumer electronics, medical devices, automotive systems, avionics, industrial, or telecommunications products
* Experience with at least two communication protocols at the firmware layer (e.g., EtherCAT, CAN/CAN-FD, SPI, I2C, RS-485, Ethernet/UDP)
* Experience debugging firmware/hardware integration issues with lab equipment (JTAG/SWD, logic analyzer, oscilloscope)

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Hands-on experience with motor control firmware (BLDC/FOC, current sensing, commutation, torque/velocity/position control loops)

* Experience with Ethernet/UDP protocol des

The Hardware Design, Rack-scale Technology and Platforms (HDRTP) engineering team designs, develops, validates, and delivers the hardware platforms that power Meta's AI and HPC infrastructure, deployed in data centers worldwide. * Experience defining design automation and verification flows (Python, SKILL/LISP, or equivalent) adopted beyond their own program

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

  

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

*The Anduril Rocket Motor Systems (RMS) team is on a mission to build next generation solid rocket motors for a safer, more connected world. To achieve our vision of becoming a large-volume provider of tactical rocket motors, we will develop differentiated products and services that maximize our customers' capabilities, and we will establish and maintain a reputation of Quality and Reliability.*  
  
**ABOUT THE JOB**  
  
As the Electrical Engineer, you will specify, design, develop and install devices used to collect data on solid rocket motor burn performance. Additionally, you will design custom electronic solutions—including PCBs, firmware, and FPGA code—needed to manufacture and test solid rocket motors, which will include working with integrated safety-critical designs. This position also requires the ability to configure data collection systems and develop software applications used to collect the data. It is expected that you may oversee technicians during the instrumentation installation and during rocket motor testing/development. The right person for this role has direct, hands-on experience with the design, development, and installation of sensors used to collect a variety of metrics related to testing of solid rocket motors. If you are a hands-on leader, have an entrepreneurial spirit, and enjoy being the point person for collecting valuable performance data, then this role is for you. You will assist in the testing solid rocket motors which will include working with integrated safety designs used to initiate the motor.

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Collaborates with other engineers to develop accurate, efficient equipment and instrumentation in accordance with safety and usability standards and client expectations.
* Collaborates with other electrical engineers to execute the safe arming and initiation of rocket motors under test.
* Designs PCBA and electrical system components with hands on testing and rework as necessary
* Creates detailed schematics and simulated models to test designs; optimizes designs for performance, reliability, and cost.
* Oversees the implementation of new measuring devices and control systems, ensuring devices are correctly installed and properly tested.
* Acts as project engineer for design, prototype fabrication, and manufacturing development.
* Develops required cable drawings to interface to various low- and high-voltage systems
* Drafts and presents formal technical documents, reports, and testing results to manager for approval.
* Provides training related to devices to employees and/or customers.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Proven experience in safety-critical hardware design, incorporating multi-fault tolerance, arm/fire inhibits, safe bleed-down circuits, and inadvertent initiation mitigation.
* Experience in high-voltage PCB layout and circuit design for motor initiation, including capacitor charging/discharge circuits, high peak-current switching, and creepage/clearance management
* Experience with the design, development, and installation of sensors employed to collect data on system performance.
* NI Labview or NI DAQmx experience or familiar with other COTS data acquisition systems
* Thorough understanding of signal conditioning for data acquisition, i.e. analog circuit design
* Intimate knowledge of the analog to digital conversion process, i.e. digital circuit design
* Understand Computer controlled data acquisition and able to develop computer applications for data collection.
* Able to select the correct sensors and design the placement of them to acquire the needed solid rocket motor performance metrics.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite and proficient with computer-aided design software.
* Ability to write and understand Python
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

#### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Advanced degree in engineering
* Experience with circuit simulation tools (spice)
* Experience using EDA tools such as Altium/Or CAD
* Familiar with real-time computer architectures and their OS's

jobs.title: VP of Software Engineering
jobs.description:
**About the Company**
---------------------

Luxer One is the technology platform behind a growing portfolio of intelligent locker, access control, smart lock, and connected security solutions — serving multifamily communities, commercial enterprises, retail, manufacturing, and specialty deployments. A division of ASSA ABLOY — the world's leading access solutions company — we process nearly 100 million transactions per year across thousands of locations worldwide. Our customers include Amazon, DoorDash, Walmart, Google, and hundreds of leading multifamily communities.

We are at an inflection point: expanding our product portfolio into access control, smart locks, and commercial security; integrating acquired technologies; embedding AI across the business; and scaling our platform with the world's largest logistics, retail, and real estate enterprises. We're building the executive team to take us there.

**Position Overview**
---------------------

The VP of Software Engineering is the technology executive for the Luxer One division — responsible for software engineering, cloud architecture, infrastructure/DevOps, firmware and embedded systems integration, and the systems that connect our growing product portfolio to the world.

As the division expands beyond package management into access control, smart locks, sensors, and commercial security products, this role will be central to integrating acquired technologies, consolidating platforms across brands, and executing the division's IP and technology strategy. Reporting directly to the Division President and seated on the executive leadership team, this is a business leadership role as much as a technical one — designed for an engineering executive who can design an organization, develop leaders, drive architectural evolution, and help the business make better decisions through clear technical judgment.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

### **Technology Strategy, Architecture & IP**

* Set the engineering direction for Luxer One's technology platform across all product lines, brands, and market segments — including access control, smart locks, sensors, and emerging commercial security products.
* Own architecture decisions for cloud infrastructure, SaaS platforms, APIs, integrations, mobile applications, firmware/embedded systems, and connected product technology.
* Lead technology consolidation across acquired and legacy platforms — identifying redundancy, rationalizing the stack, and driving toward a coherent, scalable architecture.
* Partner with business and legal leadership to develop and execute the division's IP strategy — protecting proprietary technology, supporting patent development, and informing licensing and platform decisions.
* Lead the engineering organization's AI strategy, from developer productivity tooling to application-layer AI capabilities embedded in our products.

### **Portfolio Expansion & M&A Integration**

* Evaluate acquired and partner technology platforms for architectural fit, integration complexity, and consolidation path.
* Lead the technical integration of acquisitions — absorbing platforms, teams, and codebases in a way that protects customer continuity and accelerates time-to-value.
* Make well-grounded build / buy / partner / consolidate decisions that balance near-term business priorities with long-term platform health.
* Drive platform evolution to support a growing and diversifying product portfolio — from package lockers to access control to commercial security.

### **Engineering Organization & Leadership Development**

* Build, develop, and scale a high-performing engineering organization across multiple product lines, brands, and teams.
* Build the management layer beneath you. Recruit, develop, and hold accountable Engineering Managers, Directors, and senior technical leads — creating organizational capacity that does not depend on individual heroics.
* Establish clear roles, accountability, and a delivery culture that consistently ships with quality and predictability.
* Champion engineering culture: craft, ownership, accountability, psychological safety, and continuous improvement.
* Measure and improve performance against meaningful engineering metrics and use them to drive accountability — not just report on activity.

### **Platform, Delivery & Executive Leadership**

* Own the scalability, availability, reliability, and performance of Luxer One's SaaS platforms — handling nearly 100 million transactions per year across thousands of locations.
* Improve development, testing, deployment, and incident management practices to increase speed, quality, and system reliability.
* Establish device fleet management and MDM capabilities for a deployed fleet of 55,000+ connected devices.
* Own the security, compliance, disaster recovery, and PCI/PII posture of the engineering organization.
* Serve as a full member of the executive leadership team — participating in QBRs, planning sessions, and ASSA ABLOY leadership conversations, with P&L-aware accountability and a mandate to operate as a company-level leader, not just the head of a function.

Nidec Genmark Automation is looking for an experienced **Electrical Engineer** to support the design, development, testing, and maintenance of electrical systems used in our semiconductor automation and robotic equipment.

The Electrical Engineer will work closely with mechanical, software, controls, manufacturing, and field service teams to develop reliable equipment and resolve technical issues from design through production and customer installation.

Responsibilities

* Design and develop electrical systems for semiconductor automation and robotic equipment.
* Develop electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, cable assemblies, and electrical documentation.
* Select electrical components, sensors, motors, drives, power supplies, controllers, and related hardware.
* Support integration of electrical, motion control, and automation systems.
* Work with controls and software engineers to troubleshoot equipment and system-level issues.
* Perform electrical testing, debugging, validation, and qualification of new and existing equipment.
* Support prototype builds and transition designs into manufacturing.
* Troubleshoot electrical and control issues during production, installation, and customer support.
* Work with manufacturing and suppliers on electrical components, assemblies, and design changes.
* Review and maintain BOMs, drawings, specifications, and engineering documentation.
* Participate in design reviews and recommend improvements related to performance, reliability, cost, and manufacturability.
* Support engineering change orders and product improvements.

* Follow applicable electrical safety, equipment, and industry standards.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives within the Engineering organization.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, or a related field.
