* Strong understanding of electrical schematics, wiring, sensors, motors, motion systems, and control hardware.
* Experience with AC/DC power systems, electrical panels, power distribution, and industrial controls.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings and technical specifications.

* Strong troubleshooting and problem solving skills.

* Vision insurance

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Infrastructure
jobs.description:
About Flexion

At Flexion, we are building the autonomy stack for humanoid robots. Our mission is to spearhead the transition from fragile prototypes to real-world humanoid deployment. We are founded by leading scientists in robot reinforcement learning (ex-Nvidia, ex-ETH Zürich) and backed by leading international VC firms. In just months, we went from our first line of code to deploying real humanoid capabilities with our customers, leveraging simulation and reinforcement learning. Today, we are rapidly expanding the capabilities of our autonomy stack and are growing our customer base and team faster than ever.

The role

As a Software Engineer in Flexion’s experienced infrastructure team you will build the platforms, tooling and infrastructure that power Flexion’s AI stack. This is a senior role with significant scope and ownership. You will work on a range of topics, taking projects from inception to completion, with collaboration and influence across the company. The infrastructure team owns Flexion’s state-of-the-art platforms, spanning in-house robotics frameworks for deployment, orchestration and networking, customer-facing applications, telemetry, SDKs, ML and data infrastructure, AI productivity tooling, and more. A core responsibility of this specific opening is to enable the growing scale and scope of our deployments by expanding our internal robot deployment tooling as well as our customer-facing tools and platforms.

Key responsibilities

* Build out Flexion’s tooling and platforms for a fast-growing number of robots and real-world deployments, including the applications, APIs and SDKs that customers use to manage, monitor, and integrate with Flexion.
* Lead projects end-to-end, from scoping and technical design through implementation, rollout, and long-term ownership.
* Shape technical direction and architecture decisions across teams through design reviews and code reviews.
* Partner with research, robotics, and deployment teams to understand their needs and translate them into reliable platforms and tools.
* Raise the bar on engineering practices, including testing, code quality, documentation, and system reliability.
* Help define and spread AI-assisted development practices across the company and contribute to Flexion’s AI development tooling.

  
**Requirements**  

* Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or Software Engineering (or equivalent practical experience) plus significant professional software engineering experience.
* Experience working at a senior scope: owning production software projects end-to-end and influencing technical decisions across teams. Strong track record of delivering complex projects with significant impact.
* Proficiency in Python and significant experience with at least one compiled language (e.g., C++, Go, Rust).
* Strong software architecture skills: designing modular, testable, maintainable systems with clean interfaces, considering performance and scalability. Solid grasp of data structures and algorithms.
* Solid experience building and operating production backend systems: APIs, cloud infrastructure and databases.
* Strong engineering practices and tooling: Git/GitHub, CI/CD, Docker, automated testing, code review, etc.
* Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, etc.) Good judgement with respect to their limitations.

**One or more of the following skills are a plus**

* Experience developing software for sophisticated hardware systems (e.g., robotics, AR/VR, drones, vehicles)
* Understanding of networking and/or distributed systems concepts (e.g. pub/sub, message queues, distributed computing, etc.).
* Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and full-stack web development.

  
**Benefits**  

* Competitive Compensation
* Joining a leading robotics team & exposure to never-done-before research
* Energetic, collaborative culture with a bias for action and regular community events

Zurich

* Enhanced pension plan
* Relocation & permit sponsorship
* Enhanced holiday & paid leave perks
* Central Zürich office with top-tier robotics testing facilities and infrastructure

San Franciso

* 401(k) with company contributions
* Health, dental & vision coverage with the flexibility to choose your own plan
* Open PTO policy & paid company holidays

jobs.title: Automation Controls Engineer, Manufacturing Automation Design & Engineering
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services' Hardware Engineering team is looking for experienced professionals to help build the world's premier cloud computing platform. The Manufacturing Automation Design & Engineering team designs, validates, and deploys automation solutions, including robotics, cobots, vision inspection, AI-powered quality systems, and automated assembly workflows, across contract manufacturer sites worldwide.  
  
About the Role: You will define the controls and electrical systems architecture for all automated assembly lines, creating the standard control platform that scales across all platforms and all contract manufacturer sites. You own PLC programming standards, HMI development frameworks, safety system architecture, and industrial network design. You define how automated cells communicate with each other, with MES, and with data collection systems. You are the architect of the nervous system that connects every robot, sensor, actuator, and inspection system into a coordinated, data-generating production line. You establish reusable control system templates that ensure consistency and reduce deployment time globally.  
  
The scope covers all server and rack assembly across all architectures and platforms, including compute, AI/ML accelerators, storage, and networking. The team designs intelligent, predictive-analytics-driven production systems where every station is sensor-driven, AI-optimized, and self-correcting, turning assembly lines into programmable, data-generating platforms that scale capacity without scaling headcount. This role requires the engineer to operate in a fast-paced, multi-platform international manufacturing environment with travel to contract manufacturer sites (up to 25-30% travel anticipated).  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Define controls systems architecture: PLC programming standards, HMI frameworks, safety system design, network topology
* Design and program PLC-based control systems for automated assembly lines
* Develop standardized HMI interfaces for operator interaction and production monitoring
* Architect industrial network infrastructure (e.g., EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, EtherCAT) for automated lines
* Design safety system architecture per ISO 13849 and IEC 62443 (functional safety and cybersecurity)
* Create reusable control system templates and code libraries for global deployment standardization
* Define MES integration specifications and data exchange protocols between automation cells and enterprise systems
* Lead controls architecture reviews for automation projects and vendor-supplied systems

  
About the team  
About the team: The Manufacturing Automation Design & Engineering team is building a centralized automation Center of Excellence that owns the process specification and IP for how AWS hardware gets assembled. The team is responsible for engineering, defining automated process requirements, designing and proving solutions at proof-of-concept, and maintaining AWS-owned intellectual property that scales globally. The team works within a collaborative framework across Hardware Engineering (product design for automation), Manufacturing Automation Design & Engineering (process specification and validation), and Manufacturing Operations (deployment and scaling), ensuring automation is engineered once, proven once, and deployed everywhere.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent
* 7+ years designing industrial control systems for automated manufacturing
* Proficiency in PLC programming (e.g., Siemens TIA Portal, Allen-Bradley Studio 5000, Beckhoff TwinCAT)
* Experience with industrial safety system design (e.g., ISO 13849, safety PLCs, safety networks)
* Experience with industrial network protocols (e.g., EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, EtherCAT, OPC-UA)
* Track record of defining control system standards for multi-site deployment

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with MES integration and manufacturing data exchange
* HMI/SCADA development experience (e.g., Ignition, WinCC, FactoryTalk)
* Industrial cybersecurity knowledge (e.g., IEC 62443)
* Experience with servo motion control and multi-axis coordination
* Electronics, server, or precision hardware manufacturing environment
* Experience leading controls design reviews for third-party automation systems
* Lean Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or higher)

  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/ac

### **Position Description & Qualifications**

  
  

**Lead Systems Engineer – Navy Security Systems / Force Protection and Anti-Terrorism Hardware and Software**

If you seek a rewarding, high profile and challenging position supporting the U.S. Navy, Serco has a great opportunity for you! As the Lead Systems Engineer supporting our Navy Physical Security Systems work, you will be part of a dynamic team providing systems engineering, configuration management, technology refresh, and mission support for Navy physical and electronic security supporting force protection and anti-terrorism systems.

Bring your expertise and collaborative skills to make an impact on the safety and security of our sailors, installations, and mission-critical Navy assets. In this role, you will lead technical planning, system baseline management, RDT&E coordination, configuration database development, dashboard reporting, and cross-functional engineering support to help ensure Navy physical security systems remain reliable, modernized, supportable, and aligned with customer requirements.

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead systems engineering activities supporting Navy physical and electronic security for force protection and anti-terrorism systems. Systems include (but not limited to) Access Control, Surveillance, Intrusion Detection, Perimeter & Infrastructure, and Command & Control.
* Lead and manage RDT&E efforts, including evaluation of emerging technologies, technology refresh planning, prototype assessment, integration analysis, and transition support.
* Support test and evaluation planning, technology demonstrations, system assessments, engineering reviews, and fielding readiness activities.
* Manage system hardware and software baselines, including configuration identification, change control, status accounting, and configuration verification activities.
* Develop, maintain, and manage a systems configuration database for Navy physical and electronic security systems, including hardware, software, interfaces, site information, lifecycle status, and configuration relationships, for drawings, HW and SW system versions, end of life/end of support tracking, and technical refresh/reset timelines and rollouts.
* Develop and manage a status dashboard to provide visibility into system configuration, modernization status, operational readiness, technology refresh priorities, risks, issues, and customer decision points.
* Perform technical planning, system integration, verification and validation, risk analysis, supportability analysis, and effectiveness analysis for total systems.
* Translate customer requirements, operational needs, and technical constraints into integrated systems engineering solutions that balance performance, schedule, cost, cybersecurity, and sustainment considerations.
* Coordinate with Navy customers, program stakeholders, vendors, field activities, cybersecurity teams, logisticians, and engineering staff to support system modernization, sustainment, and issue resolution.
* Review engineering deliverables, technical documentation, test artifacts, configuration records, and status reports to ensure alignment with customer requirements and program expectations.
* Identify technical risks, configuration gaps, obsolescence concerns, and system performance issues; recommend corrective actions and modernization priorities.
* Prepare and present technical summaries, dashboards, engineering recommendations, and decision-support products for program leadership and Navy stakeholders.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and task coordination for systems engineers and other technical team members supporting the PS2 contract.

**To be successful in this role, you will have:**

* U.S. Citizenship.
* Active or current DoD Secret clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret Clearance.
* Bachelor’s degree in systems engineering. A degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field maybe substituted provided all other requirements have been met.
* 10 or more years of relevant systems engineering experience supporting Department of War (DoW) contracts, in force protection, physical security, electronic security, command and control, communications, sensors, or related mission systems.
* Strong understanding of systems engineering principles, requirements management, interface coordination, integration, verification and validation, risk management, and lifecycle sustainment.
* Experience supporting RDT&E, technology assessment, technology refresh, prototype integration, system modernization, or fielding activities.
* Experience managing hardware and software baselines, configuration management processes, engineering change control, configuration status accounting, and associated technical documentation.
* Experience developing or managing technical databases, configuration repositories, dashboards, status trackers, or decision-support tools.
* Ability to communicate effectively with government customers, technical teams, vendors, and program leadership.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office products, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.
* Ability to travel as needed to support customer meetings, engineering reviews, field activities, or site assessments. (up to 25%)

**Additional desired experience and skills:**

* Master’s degree in systems engineering or other related engineering field.
* Experience supporting Navy physical security, electronic security, access control, intrusion detection, video surveillance, perimeter security, and force protection systems.
* Knowledge of Navy or DoD acquisition,

**Hyve Company Overview**
-------------------------

Hyve Solutions transforms complex engineering challenges into production reality for technology innovators building AI, cloud, and connected infrastructure. As a US-based manufacturing partner, the company rapidly delivers fast, agile execution through dep technical partnerships and co-innovation, and supply chain clarity. Hyve’s integrated ODM, CM, and SI capabilities eliminate vendor complexity while accelerating time-to-market with single-partner accountability from design through scale. The company co-innovates with deep engineering expertise, treating customer success as its own while building tomorrow's digital infrastructure.

  
  

Job Description

Hyve Solutions is a leader in the data center solutions industry, designing, manufacturing, and delivering custom Server, Storage, and Networking Solutions to the world’s largest Cloud, social media, and Enterprise companies. We pride ourselves on collaboration, innovation and thought leadership. Our team consists of diverse, forward-thinking individuals who dare to challenge the status quo, while working with many of the world’s biggest customers. Hyve Solutions is a part of TD Synnex Corporation, a Fortune 500 company. Become part of a team that thrives on excellence in a fast-changing, high-growth technology environment!

Hyve Solutions is looking for a detail-oriented, hands-on, results-driven individual with proven communication skills and a strong work ethic to work in a challenging, fast-paced, energetic environment.

**What You’ll Do**

As a Hardware Engineer, you’ll play a critical role in configuring, validating, and optimizing hardware solutions tailored to customer needs. You’ll collaborate with engineering, sales, and supply chain teams to bring cutting-edge data center hardware from concept to production.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review and provide feedback on customers’ design and technical requirements
* Collaborate with Sales and Field Engineering on server, rack, and networking integration at the BOM level.
* Lead first article builds and manages production documentation (BOM validation, hardware optimization, engineering instructions).
* Provide technical input to designers, engineering, and other team members to help drive compelling new ideas forward.
* Work closely with Engineering, Technical Program Management, Supply Chain and Purchasing to ensure a smooth transition from NPI to mass production products.
* Coordinate ECN/ECO processes in internal and external PLM systems.
* Maintain strong relationships with vendors and cross-functional teams.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Industrial, Manufacturing, or Mechanical preferred) or equivalent experience.

* 3+ years of working experience as a Hardware Engineer with deep understanding of rack architecture, network gear (switches, optics, cables), and power/cooling technologies.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a continuous improvement mindset.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint).

jobs.title: Senior / Staff Software Engineer, Product Infrastructure
jobs.description:
**About Prometheus**

Prometheus is building AI systems for engineering in the physical world. Behind them sits a platform that runs large, long-lived computational workloads: fleets of agents and numerical solvers, very large binary artifacts, and results that have to be correct because real hardware depends on them.

**The role**

You will build the infrastructure this platform runs on. It is a small set of hard, coupled systems, and you will own one or more of them end to end: design, implementation, operations, and on-call.

* **Durable orchestration.** Workloads run for days across thousands of tasks. They must survive failure, checkpoint, resume, and stay steerable by humans and agents mid-flight.
* **Versioned artifact storage.** Git-style semantics (branch, diff, merge) over large binary artifacts, on content-addressed storage with aggressive deduplication, at terabyte-to-petabyte scale.
* **CI and validation pipelines.** Merge queues where the gates are expensive computed checks, not just unit tests, and a change is validated by actually running it.
* **Compute execution fabric.** Scheduling heterogeneous workloads, many on GPUs, across cloud fleets: batching, prioritization, budget enforcement, and streaming results back in real time.
* **Agent harness.** Sandboxed, reproducible, observable execution for long-running autonomous agents that write code, run tools, and spend real compute.

**You might be a fit if**

* You have 5+ years building and operating distributed systems in production; for the Staff level, 10+ years and a system you are known for.
* You have seen real scale and carry the scars: at a database, streaming, or orchestration company; a multiplayer game backend; internet-scale media storage; a simulation or GPU-compute platform; or a build/CI system serving thousands of engineers.
* You have gone deep in at least one of: durable workflow engines, storage engines or content-addressed storage, high-throughput schedulers, or build/merge systems.
* You write production systems code (Go, Rust, or C++) and are effective in Python.
* You have carried a pager for stateful systems in production.
* You want your work to matter in the physical world.

**Strong pluses**

* GPU scheduling or HPC job orchestration (Slurm, Ray, Kubernetes batch).
* Deterministic simulation testing or serious correctness culture (FoundationDB, TigerBeetle, Jepsen lineage).
* Exposure to scientific or geometric computing. Not required; we will teach you the domain.
* Experience building infrastructure for AI agents: sandboxing, session persistence, tool execution.

We are growing our team to build next-generation ADAS and autonomous driving platforms, and we are looking for senior electrical and system integration engineers to define, build, and scale our vehicle platform hardware.

 **Job Description**

As a **Senior Vehicle Hardware Engineer (Electrical & System Integration)**, you will serve as the technical lead for electrical architecture, power distribution, in-vehicle networking, and system-level hardware bring-up across our ADAS and autonomous test vehicle fleets. You will translate high-level software and perception requirements into reliable, automotive-grade electrical architectures and wire harness solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Electrical Architecture & Power Design:** Design low-voltage power distribution systems, including power sequencing, circuit protection, and battery backup solutions for high-performance compute nodes and sensor payloads.
* **Harness & Interconnect Engineering:** Design and oversee fabrication of automotive-grade wire harnesses, sensor cabling, and custom interconnect assemblies.
* **Vehicle Networking & Synchronization:** Integrate automotive communication buses (CAN-FD, Automotive Ethernet, LIN) and high-speed sensor data links (GMSL2/3, FPD-Link) with hardware-level time synchronization (PTP/IEEE 802.1AS, PPS).
* **System Bring-Up & Diagnostics:** Lead electrical bring-up, signal integrity testing, bus analysis, and fault diagnosis on prototype vehicles using standard lab and automotive diagnostic equipment.
* **Cross-Functional System Collaboration:** Work with perception, compute software, and safety engineering teams to define physical interfaces, power budgets, and sensor pinouts.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Preferred Master's degree.
* **Experience:** 5+ years of experience in automotive electrical engineering, electrical harness design, or system-level hardware integration for ADAS/AV systems.
* **Electrical & Bus Protocols:** Deep understanding of automotive power electronics, relay/fuse box design, and vehicle networks (CAN, CAN-FD, Automotive Ethernet).
* **Hardware Diagnostics:** Hands-on proficiency with tools such as Vector CANoe/CANalyzer, Wireshark, digital oscilloscopes, multimeters, and logic analyzers.
* **Component Knowledge:** Experience selecting automotive-grade connectors (TE Connectivity, Molex, Amphenol), fused protection, and high-speed serialization hardware.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proficiency with schematic capture and harness design tools (e.g., E3.series, PCAD, Altium, or Vector Architecture tools).
* Familiarity with automotive EMC/EMI mitigation techniques and ISO 26262 functional safety considerations for power delivery.
* Hands-on experience working in automotive workshop or prototype vehicle garage environments.

jobs.title: Staff Instrumentation & Controls Engineer – Nuclear
jobs.description:
**About Valar Atomics**

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable—unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

**The Team**

As part of the Engineering organization, Instrumentations & Controls designs the systems that monitor, automate, and protect Valar's facilities and reactor technologies. The team develops reliable control architectures that enable safe and efficient operations.

**The Role**

You will serve as a senior technical authority for nuclear instrumentation and controls (I&C) systems with a focus on neutron detection, detector signal processing electronics, and radiation monitoring equipment. This role supports reactor design, test operations, and safety-significant monitoring systems, ensuring compliance with nuclear industry codes and standards. You will lead design efforts, system integration, vendor oversight, safety evaluations, and commissioning activities for reactor protection and radiation monitoring systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Instrumentation & Detection Systems**

* Lead design, specification, selection, and integration of **neutron detectors** (e.g., fission chambers, boron-lined detectors) and associated **signal conditioning electronics** (wide-range, source range channels).
* Design and validate **radiation monitoring systems** including area monitors, process radiation monitors, stack monitors, and coolant activity systems.
* Oversee detector placement, shielding design, and response characterization (in-core and ex-core).
* Perform calibration strategies and uncertainty analyses for neutron flux power range, intermediate range, and startup-range instrumentation.

**I&C Engineering**

* Develop and maintain I&C architectures for safety-related and non-safety systems in accordance with **IEEE 603, IEC 61508, and DOE guidance**.
* Produce and review engineering deliverables: control logic, loop diagrams, instrument datasheets, architecture drawings, control narratives, and functional requirement specifications.
* Execute I&C system modeling, failure modes analysis, response time calculations, and SIL/Category/Level classification (per IEC/ISA standards).
* Design interfaces to PLCs, safety-significant controllers, distributed I/O, and high-reliability digital platforms.
* Guide system integration with reactor protection, and radiation monitoring systems.

**Testing, Validation, and Qualification**

* Lead **Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT)**, **Site Acceptance Tests (SAT)**, environmental qualification (EQ), and seismic qualification for sensitive instrumentation.
* Develop calibration, maintenance, and surveillance procedures for neutron and radiation detectors.
* Support performance testing, flux mapping, channel operability checks, trip setpoint verification, and acceptance criteria development.

**Regulatory & Standards Compliance**

* Ensure system designs adhere to nuclear regulatory requirements, including DOE Reg Guides, IEEE standards, IAEA SSG-39, and ANS/ANS-related instrumentation standards.
* Prepare and review technical documentation for licensing, safety basis, and hazard analysis activities.
* Participate in I&C-related inputs and support for deterministic safety analyses.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance across interdisciplinary teams.
* Collaborate with reactor physics, thermal-hydraulics, electrical engineering, and operations teams to meet program requirements.
* Interface with vendors, labs, and regulatory bodies on detector procurement, radiation monitoring equipment, and safety systems.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Nuclear Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or related discipline.
* **8+ years** of experience in nuclear I&C, radiation detection, reactor protection, or related areas.
* Hands-on experience with:
* Neutron detectors (fission chambers, B-10 proportional counters)
* Signal processing electronics (wide-range, source range channels)
* Area/process radiation monitors and environmental monitoring instrumentation
* Strong understanding of nuclear standards: IEEE 603, ANSI/ANS-specific radiation monitoring standards
* Experience with safety classification, SIL analysis, FMEA, and hazard analysis.
* Ability to lead technical projects and cross-functional engineering efforts.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Master's degree or Ph.D. in Nuclear Engineering or related field.
* Experience with HTGR, sodium-cooled, or research reactor designs.
* Experience with data acquisition systems, digital I&C platforms, and PLCs (e.g., Allen-Bradley).
* Familiarity with radiation transport modeling and detector response simulations.
* Experience with environmental qualification per IEEE 323 and seismic qualification per IEEE 344.
* Prior regulatory engagement (NRC, DOE, INL, ORNL, etc.).
* Experience writing safety basis documents, technical reports, or licensing submittals.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive base salary
* Equity ownership in a rapidly growing advanced energy company
* Comprehensive medical benefits
* Unlimited PTO
* Free daily lunch and dinner provided onsite
* Generous PPE stipend
* High-impact startup environment with significant ownership and autonomy
* Opportunities for rapid career growth and internal advancement
* Direct collaboration with experienced operators, engineers, and industry leaders
* The opportunity to help build and scale transformative energy technology from the ground up

**Equal Employment

**Overview**
------------

You’ll lead architecture and delivery across Tonal’s device, app, and cloud systems: turn business priorities into technical direction, own initiatives that span teams, and grow senior engineers into technical leaders. You report to engineering leadership and stay hands-on from design through production. Success means shipped outcomes, stronger systems, and teams that move faster.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Set 6–12 month technical direction across device, app, and cloud. Turn product priorities into architecture, ownership, and delivery plans.
* Lead a few cross-team initiatives from problem definition to launch and adoption. Settle tradeoffs with team leads; flag priority and resource conflicts early.
* Write critical-path code, build prototypes, guide migrations, and debug hard production issues. Own how your architecture decisions play out in practice.
* Simplify shared systems and interfaces. Improve reliability, observability, security, and developer workflow so teams need less coordination to ship.
* Mentor senior and Staff engineers through design, pairing, and shared delivery. Set up lightweight decision practices so teams can act on their own.
* Use AI-assisted engineering tools where they improve delivery or quality. Partner with Data Science, AI, and platform owners on production integrations.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* You’ve led architecture and delivery across multiple teams at Senior Staff or Principal scope, with measurable results.
* You have deep backend, distributed systems, and cloud expertise and reason well across device, mobile, data, and service boundaries.
* You still build and operate production software. You’ve owned hard integrations or migrations and made pragmatic tradeoffs between speed, reliability, security, cost, and maintainability.
* You turn ambiguity into focused plans and get alignment from technical and nontechnical partners.
* You’ve made other senior engineers stronger technical leaders and can show how your work improved teams beyond your own.

**Extra Credit**
----------------

* Connected devices, consumer subscriptions, fitness, or digital health. Healthcare integrations and sensitive-data systems.
* AI in production products or engineering workflows, with clear quality, delivery, or cost gains.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* 90 days: Set technical priorities. Ship or materially de-risk one important cross-team initiative.
* Six months: Adoption across multiple teams. Measurable gains in delivery speed, reliability, cost, or integration effort.
* Ongoing: Independent technical leaders, fewer recurring cross-team blockers, more engineering-leadership capacity for org priorities.

The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

**Role Overview:**

* Design, build, and own the tools and services that pull data from dispersed production sources, organize it into a cohesive system, and make it usable across the factory.
* Work across manufacturing areas, talking to machines and systems on different networks.
* Turn one-off operational asks into durable software other people can actually use.
* Write Python services against the existing codebase, deploy them in containers, and help set engineering practices for a growing manufacturing software team.
* Operate as a high-ownership, on-site engineer in Los Angeles, CA, partnering closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Engineering, and IT.

**Responsibilities:**

**Data Services & Systems Integration**

* Design and build Python services that ingest, organize, and store manufacturing data from dispersed shop-floor, test, and enterprise sources in mixed formats, then present it as a coherent system others can rely on.
* Integrate manufacturing software with the broader systems ecosystem (MES, ERP, QMS, PLM, and data platforms) so production data is trustworthy, queryable, and usable end to end.

**Tooling & Adoption**

* Turn ad-hoc production and operations requests into reusable tools with clear interfaces, documentation, and a path to adoption — not one-off scripts.
* Design systems that can scale with production growth and are straightforward for operators, technicians, and engineers to adopt.

**Factory Networks & Device Connectivity**

* Write software that communicates with devices and services across factory networks, including multiple subnets and VLANs.
* Debug connectivity, routing, and interface issues when they arise.

**Infrastructure & Deployment**

* Containerize services with Docker (or equivalent), run your own code in containers, and integrate with software already running in containerized environments.
* Deploy and operate services in a major cloud environment (Azure, AWS, or equivalent), including the networking, storage, and runtime pieces those systems depend on.

**Engineering Practice & Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Establish practical engineering standards for the manufacturing software team: system design, code quality, CI/CD, and maintainability.
* Partner with manufacturing, quality, and production engineering to understand how data is generated on the floor and how it should flow into downstream tools.

* Strong Python software development experience.
* Hands-on experience building and operating software in a major cloud environment (Azure, AWS, or equivalent).
* Demonstrated system design skills: you plan beyond the immediate ask and ship tools that scale and get adopted.
* Experience organizing data from multiple sources and formats into a usable storage, access, and application layer.
* Working knowledge of computer networking fundamentals as they apply to software you write — IP addressing, routing, subnetting, VLANs, and talking to devices across those networks.
* Practical Docker (or equivalent container) experience: packaging your own services and integrating with containerized runtimes.
* Working Linux fluency: enough to operate comfortably in a Linux environment day to day (command line, services, logs, permissions, basic networking).
* Familiarity with modern CI/CD practices and tooling such as Jenkins, Artifactory, or equivalent.
* Fluency with modern AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g. Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT) as part of day-to-day development.
* Ability to work across factory functions and communicate clearly with both engineers and non-engineers.
* U.S. citizenship is required: this role accesses export-controlled information and requires a U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) Secret security clearance — current, or the ability to obtain and maintain one.

**Preferred Requirements:**

* Experience in aerospace, defense, manufacturing, or a high-growth startup environment.

* Experience with production-level software development and deployment, including DevOps / DevSecOps practices.
* Experience supporting digital manufacturing, factory automation, or shop-floor / OT–IT systems.

jobs.title: Electrical Systems Engineer, Energy Products
jobs.description:
**Drive the Future with Xos**

**Xos** **(NASDAQ: XOS),** is a technology company and electric truck manufacturer on a mission to decarbonize commercial transportation. We design and build state-of-the-art electric vehicles, develop advanced fleet management software, and create charging solutions that make fleet electrification seamless and cost-efficient.  
  
At Xos, we're problem-solvers, innovators, and go-getters, working together to drive a cleaner, more sustainable future. Join us and be part of the movement shaping the next generation of commercial transportation.

**The Role**  
  
Xos is looking for an Electrical Systems Engineer to join our Engineering team, with a focus on the electrical design and deployment of our energy products, including the Xos Hub.  
  
In this role, you'll own the electrical design across the product lifecycle from understanding customer applications and developing system architecture to supporting production, commissioning, and deployed products in the field. You'll work across high and low-voltage systems, energy storage, power conversion, EV charging, controls, and communications while partnering closely with engineering, manufacturing, service, suppliers, and customers.  
  
This is a hands-on role for an engineer who enjoys taking ownership of complex electrical systems and seeing their designs move from schematics to real-world operation.

**\*\*This is an on-site position based at our Los Angeles, CA headquarters, with occasional travel required based on business and project needs.\*\***

  

**What You'll Do**

  

* Design and maintain electrical schematics, single-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, and harness designs for HV DC, LV AC, and 12/24V control systems.
* Develop electrical architectures for new Xos Hub configurations and customer-specific applications.
* Perform power and energy calculations, including load analysis, battery sizing, charging profiles, voltage drop, fault current, and short-circuit analysis.
* Evaluate grid power and interconnection requirements, including utility service configurations, grounding, bonding power, power quality, and power conversion.
* Size and select wiring, connectors, overcurrent protection, control devices, and other electrical components.
* Define electrical and communication interfaces across batteries/BMS, inverters/PCS, EVSE, generators, controllers, and telematics using hardwired I/O, CAN, and Ethernet.
* Create and maintain engineering documentation, including electrical drawings, E-BOMs, assembly packages, SOPs, and test and commissioning procedures.
* Support production builds, first article inspections, system testing, and commissioning at Xos facilities and customer locations, including travel as needed.
* Troubleshoot deployed systems using telematics data, logs, CAN traces, and other diagnostic tools; perform root cause analysis and translate findings into design and process improvements.
* Review customer applications, including vehicle and charging requirements, site power, load profiles, and duty cycles, to determine appropriate system configurations.
* Support product design and certification activities to applicable electrical, energy storage, and safety standards.
* Additional duties as assigned.

  

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field.
* 3-4+ years of electrical systems design experience in EV, energy storage, transportation, heavy equipment, rail, industrial power, or a related environment.
* Strong understanding of AC/DC electrical systems, single-and three-phase power, grounding, electrical protection, and power conversion.
* Experience creating electrical schematics and wiring diagrams using AutoCAD, AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN, CATIA Systems Schematic, or similar tools.
* Hands-on experience with load calculations, wire and overcurrent protection sizing, and electrical component selection.
* Experience producing release-ready engineering documentation, including schematics, wiring diagrams, BOMs, and engineering changes.
* Experience testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting electrical systems.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work across engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, customers, and field teams.
* Ability and willingness to travel occasionally based on business and project needs.

**Nice to Have**

Experience in one or more of the following areas is a plus:

* Battery energy storage systems (BESS), batteries/BMS, inverters/PCS, EV charging, or mobile power systems
* Wire harness design and harness supplier coordination
* CCS or NACS charging systems
* Microgrids, including grid-tied and islanded operation
* CAN communications and diagnostic tools such as CANalyzer, CANoe, or PCAN
* Interface Control Documents (ICDs), requirements traceability, FMECA, or EMC analysis
* PLM systems and 3D CAD tools such as Windchill, Creo, SolidWorks, or CATIA
* UL, NFPA, NEC, IEEE, or IEC standards related to energy storage and EV charging
* EIT certification or PE licensure
* Startup or high-growth manufacturing environments
  

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is may be required to stand, walk, reach, bend, and use hands to handle tools, equipment, or components, and lift and/or move up to 25lbs. The employee may also be required to perform hands-on work on or around energy products, including the Xos Hub, while using appropriate personal protective equipment in manufacturing, testing, and field environments.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer - Linux Kernel, AWS Hardware Engineering
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Application deadline: Oct 12, 2026  
  
Join AWS Hardware Engineering to design the servers powering the world's leading cloud platform and AI/ML infrastructure. We're seeking an exceptional Linux Kernel Engineer to accelerate critical kernel initiatives across millions of servers worldwide.  
  
We are seeking an exceptional Linux Kernel Engineer to join our server firmware team. In this role, you will lead Linux kernel patching, code development, and version adoption for our server management controllers across a massive global fleet. You will ensure our kernel remains current, secure, and compliant with strict patching service-level agreements that directly impact AWS infrastructure reliability. Your work will power the backbone of AWS compute infrastructure, including the servers that enable AI/ML workloads for customers worldwide.  
  
The ideal candidate will be an innovative self-starter with deep expertise in Linux kernel internals, device driver development, and embedded Linux systems. You will gain comprehensive understanding of our server firmware kernel stack and analyze it in both current and future contexts. Using your systems knowledge, you will architect solutions to complex multi-factor problems, including kernel upgrade strategies that minimize customer impact, address security vulnerabilities rapidly, and optimize operational efficiency across millions of servers supporting diverse workloads from traditional compute to advanced machine learning applications.  
  
You will collaborate with engineers across AWS and external partners, leading development efforts that span kernel security, hardware enablement, and platform services teams. Your work will directly contribute to critical initiatives that keep our infrastructure patched, secure, and operationally excellent—ensuring the foundation for tomorrow's AI/ML innovations remains robust and scalable.  
  
AWS Engineers are shaping the way people use computers and designing the future of cloud computing technology – come help us make history!  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Design and develop firmware solutions for AWS servers, contributing to server designs that power millions of customer workloads.  
Lead the complete development lifecycle from initial conception through production deployment, ensuring robust and scalable firmware implementations across our massive server fleet.  
Architect and implement firmware deployment strategies that minimize customer impact while maintaining the highest standards of security and operational excellence.  
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including hardware engineers, validation teams, software services to optimize functionality and performance.  
Explore and evaluate emerging technologies and their potential impact on AWS infrastructure, making recommendations for adoption and integration into our firmware stack.  
Drive technical solutions for problems, balancing security requirements, operational efficiency, and system reliability.  
Tailor firmware solutions specifically for the AWS environment, ensuring seamless integration with our unique infrastructure requirements and operational workflows.  
Mentor team members and contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes, tools, and best practices.  
  
A day in the life  
Most mornings, you'll dive into code—whether that's developing new security features, optimizing firmware deployment strategies, or debugging a tricky issue that's affecting a subset of servers.  
You'll collaborate a lot. Maybe it's a quick sync with platform teams about an upcoming deployment, or a deeper technical discussion with hardware engineers about a new server design. You might work with internal customers to understand their requirements.  
Some days you'll be architecting solutions to complex problems. Other days you might be mentoring a teammate through a code review or exploring a new technology that could improve our firmware stack.

------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

jobs.title: Senior Information Systems Engineer (ISSO)
jobs.description:
Overview:

FTI is a defense technology company seeking an Information Systems Security Officer (ISSO) to support the security of information systems used in defense missions. You will work with technical teams and program stakeholders to maintain security requirements, address risks, and protect the systems and information our customers depend on. You’ll join a team guided by FTI’s 4C’s: Core Values, Commitment, Compassion, and Charity. The ideal candidate brings technical knowledge, attention to detail, and a collaborative approach to supporting secure operations while meeting mission needs.

This position is based at the ENSCO location in Colorado Springs, CO. An active DoD Top Secret clearance with SCI access is required.

Responsibilities:

The Information Systems Security Officer (ISSO) will work on Defensive Cyber Operations for *Space* (*DCO*-*S*) providing expertise and support in network security engineering and/or integration of security products. This is a fast-paced and highly challenging position where you will be a member of a team. The ISSO is responsible for ensuring the appropriate operational security posture is maintained for the assigned IT. This includes the following activities related to maintaining situational awareness and initiating actions to improve or restore cybersecurity posture.

The ISSO:

* Implements and enforce all AF cybersecurity policies, procedures, and countermeasures.
* Completes and maintains required cybersecurity certification IAW AFMAN 17-1303 Individuals in this position must be U.S. citizens.
* Ensure all users have the requisite security clearances and need-to-know, complete annual cybersecurity training, and are aware of their responsibilities before being granted access to IT according to AFMAN 17-1301.
* Maintains all authorized user access control documentation IAW the applicable AF Records Information Management System.
* Ensures software, hardware, and firmware comply with appropriate security configuration guidelines (e.g., security technical implementation guides /security requirement guides).
* Ensure proper configuration management procedures are followed prior to implementation and contingent upon necessary approval.
* Coordinate changes or modifications with the system-level ISSM, SCA, and/or the Wing Cybersecurity office.
* Initiate protective or corrective measures, in coordination with the ISSM, when a security incident or vulnerability is discovered.
* Reports security incidents or vulnerabilities to the system-level ISSM and wing cybersecurity office according to AFI 17-203, Cyber Incident Handling.
* Initiates exceptions, deviations, or waivers to cybersecurity requirement.
* Ability to travel up to 10%.

Education/Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, Engineering, Mathematics or a related technical field is desired.
* 6+ years of relevant experience
* **Top Secret/SCI clearance required.**
* Sec+ required
* Experience working with DoD and/or Intelligence Community (IC) space system acquisition programs.
* Understanding of Risk Management Framework (RMF) and DoD / IC cybersecurity requirements, policies and best practices.
* Experience with IT Security including requirements, architecture and design.

For this role, the annual compensation range for candidates in Colorado is $100K-$163K. Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications & experience. FTI has a location-based compensation structure; there may be a different range for candidates in other locations.

jobs.description:
Pay Range: $30.00-$34.50/hour

This position is located in Pueblo, CO

Summary of Role

The Automation Engineering Technician will apply electronic theory, electrical principles, engineering mathematics, computer programming, and troubleshooting expertise to build, test, calibrate, repair, and modify electronic and electro-mechanical systems. This position is responsible for assembling and wiring electrical control systems, programming and troubleshooting automation equipment, supporting prototype development, and assisting with the installation and commissioning of new equipment.

The ideal candidate will possess strong experience in industrial automation, electronic troubleshooting, PLC programming, and machine controls, with hands-on knowledge of Beckhoff, WAGO, and Allen-Bradley control platforms. This role requires close collaboration with engineering, manufacturing, and field service teams to ensure reliable, high-quality equipment performance.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

* Assemble, wire, and test electronic circuit boards, control panels, and electrical systems using hand tools, diagnostic equipment, and surface mount technology.
* Interpret and work from electronic schematics, electrical drawings, wiring diagrams, mechanical drawings, assembly drawings, and Bills of Materials (BOMs).
* Troubleshoot electronic, electrical, and electro-mechanical system failures by analyzing circuit boards, wiring systems, motors, drives, and machine components to efficiently identify and resolve issues.
* Work safely with AC and DC electrical systems, motors, drives, controllers, and power distribution equipment up to 480V.
* Program, configure, modify, and troubleshoot PLCs, stepper motors, servo drives, motion control systems, and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs).
* Configure, modify, and troubleshoot Human-Machine Interfaces (HMIs), including operator screens, alarms, recipes, trends, user access levels, and machine status displays.
* Perform functional testing, calibration, validation, and troubleshooting of electrical assemblies, control systems, and automation equipment.
* Identify assembly, wiring, programming, and operational issues while providing feedback and recommendations for design and process improvements.
* Support prototype development, machine builds, and transition of products into production-ready systems.
* Solder electronic components and assemblies in accordance with quality standards and manufacturing requirements.
* Install, configure, and support machine software, equipment programming, network connectivity, field hardware, and peripheral devices.
* Work onsite with the Lead Engineer to support installation, commissioning, startup, testing, troubleshooting, and optimization of new machine builds and automated systems.
* Assist with system integration, field modifications, customer acceptance testing, and the resolution of technical issues during equipment deployment.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on equipment reliability, quality, productivity, and safety.
* Maintain accurate records of troubleshooting activities, modifications, testing results, and commissioning documentation.
* Adhere to all company safety, quality, and regulatory requirements.

Required Qualifications

* Minimum of 5 years of experience in an Electronics Technician, Electrical Technician, Controls Technician, or similar role.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience programming, testing, and troubleshooting control systems and automation equipment.
* Strong understanding of electrical systems, industrial controls, and wiring standards.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, blueprints, wiring diagrams, and BOMs.
* Proficiency in electrical board assembly, soldering, repair, and diagnostics.
* Strong troubleshooting skills for electronic, electrical, and electro-mechanical systems.

* Experience programming, configuring, and troubleshooting PLCs, HMIs, stepper motors, servo drives, motion control systems, and VFDs.
* Hands-on experience developing and supporting HMI applications for industrial automation systems, including screen navigation, alarm management, operator controls, data display, and basic troubleshooting.

* Experience using automation software including:
* Beckhoff TwinCAT
* WAGO CODESYS
* Allen-Bradley Studio 5000 and RSLogix
* Working knowledge of industrial communication protocols including:
* EtherCAT
* Ethernet/IP
* Modbus TCP
* Profinet
* TwinCAT
* Basic understanding of AC and DC circuits, motors, drives, and controllers operating up to 480V.
* Competent knowledge of CE and UL requirements and industrial safety standards.
* Familiarity with hydraulics and pneumatics.
* Experience supporting prototype builds, machine commissioning, and equipment startup activities.
* Strong computer and networking skills with the ability to diagnose communication and software-related issues.
* Ability to travel as needed to support machine installations, commissioning, and customer startup activities.
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree or technical certification in Electronics Technology, Electrical Engineering Technology, Industrial Automation, Mechatronics, or a related field.
* Experience with HMI development, industrial networking, and operator interface design.

* Experience commissioning automated manufacturing equipment.
* Knowledge of machine safety systems and risk assessment practices.
* Familiarity with vision systems, sensors, and industrial robotics.
* Experience in a manufacturing or OEM machine-building environment.

Physical Requirements

* Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
* Ability to stand, walk, bend, climb, and work in industrial environments for extended periods.

jobs.description:

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. **Job Summary:** As the Senior RF Communications Systems Engineer and **TT&C Technical Lead** , you will have primary technical responsibility for the architecture, design, development, integration, verification, and operation of the spacecraft Telemetry, Tracking, and Command (TT&C) communications subsystem.

You will lead the development of the **end-to-end TT&C architecture** , translate mission and spacecraft requirements into subsystem requirements and interfaces, and lead the RF communications engineering team responsible for delivering the subsystem. This role requires a combination of strong RF/microwave technical expertise, spacecraft communications systems engineering, architectural thinking, and technical leadership.

The successful candidate will work closely with spacecraft systems, avionics, GNC, flight software, power, thermal, ground systems, and mission operations teams to develop a robust, reliable, and scalable TT&C solution from concept through on-orbit operations for a large scale constellation.

**Responsibilities**

* **Own and lead the TT&C subsystem architecture** , including RF communications, antennas, transceivers, amplifiers, filters, frequency conversion, interfaces, and ground-system connectivity.
* Define the **end-to-end TT&C communications architecture** based on mission requirements, spacecraft operational concepts, link availability, data rates, coverage, reliability, Swap-C, and risk.
* Lead development and allocation of **TT&C subsystem requirements** , including performance, interface, environmental, reliability, and verification requirements.
* Develop TT&C **CONOPS and communication scenarios** , including command, telemetry, tracking, acquisition, safe modes, nominal operations, contingencies, and ground-station interactions.
* Lead **RF communications architecture and technology trade studies** , evaluating alternative architectures and technologies against mission requirements and system-level constraints.
* Lead end-to-end **RF link budget and communications performance analysis** , including transmit power, antenna gain, path loss, atmospheric losses, noise temperature, receiver sensitivity, link margin, data rate, and availability.
* Lead RF cascade analysis, including gain, noise figure, dynamic range, compression, phase noise, spurious performance, and intermodulation products.
* Define and manage **RF and TT&C interfaces** with the spacecraft bus, avionics, flight software, GNC, power, thermal, and ground systems.
* **Lead and mentor the RF communications engineering team** , establishing technical direction, priorities, development plans, and engineering processes.
* Provide technical direction for the design and development of RF/microwave hardware, including amplifiers, filters, frequency converters, receivers, transmitters.
* Review and approve RF designs, analyses, simulations, test plans, and verification results.
* Lead the development and execution of **TT&C integration and verification plans** , including component, subsystem, spacecraft-level, and end-to-end testing.
* Support spacecraft integration, test, troubleshooting, launch readiness, commissioning, and **on-orbit TT&C operations** .
* Lead resolution of complex RF and communications system issues and coordinate technical decisions across engineering disciplines.
* Establish and maintain TT&C architecture documentation, requirements, interface control documents, link budgets, CONOPS, trade studies, test plans, and verification matrices.
* Identify technical risks and develop mitigation strategies throughout the TT&C development lifecycle.
* Work with program and systems engineering leadership to establish **team staffing, technical capabilities, and resource requirements** for the RF/TT&C organization.
* Mentor engineers and develop the technical capabilities of the RF communications team.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, RF/Microwave Engineering, or a related discipline.
* **10+ years of professional experience in RF communications systems engineering, RF/microwave engineering, or a related field.**
* Demonstrated experience leading or owning the **architecture of RF communications or TT&C systems** .
* Demonstrated experience developing **end-to-end RF communications architectures and link budgets** .
* Experience defining, allocating, and verifying **system and subsystem requirements** .
* Strong experience with RF/microwave systems, including antennas, transmitters, receivers, amplifiers, filters, frequency conversion, and analog signal chains.
* Strong understanding of antennas, RF propagation, microwave engineering, and communications systems.
* Experience with RF simulation and analysis tools such as Keysight ADS, AWR Microwave Office, or similar.
* Experience with RF test equipment, including VNAs, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and power meters.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

* **Be the offset.** We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.
* **What would it take?** We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.
* **It’s the people.** Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

BENEFITS & PERKS\*

* **Best-in-class healthcare:** 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, with HSA/HRA options
* **Generous time off:** Flexible Time Off (FTO) for exempt employees, accrued PTO of up to 25 days for non-exempt employees, plus 12 paid holidays; Parental Leave; Sick Leave
* **Fuel for your day:** Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks for in-office employees
* **And more:** 401(k) retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, and Dog Fridays
* **Equity participation:** Equity is included as part of our total compensation package, giving you an opportunity to share in the company’s success.

* Build and ship full-stack applications end to end — data model, services and APIs, workflow, and web user interface — and operate them in production.

* Plan and execute migrations from off-the-shelf tools to in-house software: data migration, parallel operation, and cutover, without breaking traceability.

* Build in observability, auditability, sync health, and data-quality checks as first-class features.

* Set and uphold engineering standards — code quality, testing, reviews, and technical documentation.

* Mentor senior and early-career engineers and raise the technical bar across the team.

* **Best-in-class healthcare:** 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, with HSA/HRA options
* **Generous time off:** Flexible Time Off (FTO) for exempt employees, accrued PTO of up to 25 days for non-exempt employees, plus 12 paid holidays; Parental Leave; Sick Leave

**OUR MISSION**

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

**OUR VALUES**

* Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.

* What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.

* It's the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

**YOUR MISSION**

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Digital Engineering team, you will build and own major parts of the in-house software behind our digital thread — full-stack applications that become our systems of record for product, manufacturing, and operations data, and the services and integrations that connect them across the product lifecycle. You will take features and services from design to production, lead projects end to end, and help shape the patterns the rest of the team builds on.

Integrations bridge the off-the-shelf systems we run today; the larger job is building the software that takes their place. You will work directly with the engineers, buyers, and technicians who use what you build, turning real workflows into software they would rather use — while keeping product data authoritative and traceable.

This is an ideal role for an experienced full-stack engineer who wants real ownership, enjoys working close to users, and wants to help build a new software team in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment. You'll work in an AI-native environment where using AI to accelerate your impact is expected.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Design & Build**

* Design and build full-stack features and services end to end — data model, services and APIs, workflow, and web user interface — and operate them in production.

* Model domain data for systems of record — parts, revisions, BOMs, change orders, and as-built records — with lifecycle states and traceability.

* Build integrations and event-driven data flows between our software and the off-the-shelf tools it works alongside.

* Write technical designs for your projects and drive them through review.

**Delivery & Operations**

* Lead projects from scoping through delivery, breaking down work and keeping it moving.

* Carry out parts of migrations from off-the-shelf tools to in-house software, including data migration, parallel operation, and cutover.

* Build observability, auditability, and data-quality checks into what you ship, and help run it in production.

* Uphold engineering standards through code review, testing, and technical documentation.

**Collaboration & Mentorship**

* Mentor early-career engineers through pairing, code review, and design feedback.

* Work directly with engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing users to understand real workflows and ship software that fits them.

* Work with the teams that own today's engineering and business systems to design integrations that respect how those systems are run.

* 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record shipping and operating production applications and services.

* Experience building user-facing web applications end to end — from data model and APIs to a modern front end (e.g., TypeScript, React).

jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

Plans, conducts, and coordinates software development activities. Designs, develops, documents, tests, and debugs software that contains logical and mathematical solutions to business/mission problems or questions in computer language for solutions by means of data processing equipment. Applies the appropriate standards, processes, procedures, and tools throughout the development life cycle. Applies knowledge of computer hardware and software, subject matter to be programmed in business/mission applications, information processing techniques used, and information gathered from system users to develop software. Corrects program errors, prepares operating instructions, compiles documentation of program development, and analyzes system capabilities to resolve questions of program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques, and controls. Ensures software standards are met.

**Innovate & Design Automation Solutions**

* Architect and develop new automated test scripts, frameworks, and reusable libraries (PowerShell, Bash, Python, Java) that support end to end execution of C2BMC scenarios on Windows/Linux hosts.
* Design CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar) that integrate automated builds, test execution, result collection, and reporting.
* Create proof of concept prototypes for emerging automation concepts (e.g., container based test environments, model based test generation, AI assisted test case generation).

**Lead Implementation & Execution**

* Own the end to end delivery of automation features from requirements through design, development, testing, and deployment.
* Execute and monitor automated test suites, analyze results, identify root causes of failures, and drive corrective actions.

**Ensure Compliance & Quality**

* Apply Information Assurance (IA) policies to all automation assets; run IA scans, remediate findings, and maintain continuous compliance.
* Produce clear, concise documentation (design documents, runbooks, API guides) that enable reuse and knowledge transfer.

**Mentorship & Collaboration**

* Provide technical guidance and code review to senior engineers; conduct knowledge sharing sessions on scripting and CI/CD topics.
* Partner with software developers, system administrators, test leads, and IA officers to refine test requirements and resolve integration issues.
* Represent the automation team in program level meetings, presenting progress, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership and customer stakeholders.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify bottlenecks in the test lifecycle and propose innovative solutions (e.g., parallel test execution, test environment automation, automated environment provisioning).
* Stay current with industry trends, DoD automation initiatives, and emerging tools; evaluate and recommend adoption where appropriate.
* Support occasional travel to customer sites for installation, validation, or hand over activities; adapt to flexible work hours as mission demands dictate.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Hands on experience developing, maintaining, and deploying automation scripts or test frameworks in a DoD or similarly regulated environment.
* Current DoD 8570 compliant certification
* A Final DoD Secret security clearance is required
* Proficiency with Linux command line administration and shell scripting (Bash, Zsh, etc.).

jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

The Robotics Software Engineer develops and maintains software for GPSI autonomous underwater vehicle systems. The position supports a ROS2-based software stack running on embedded Linux, with responsibilities spanning navigation, state estimation, sensor integration, deployment infrastructure, autonomy, and mission software. The role works across software and hardware boundaries and supports development through in-water testing and field deployment.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in robotics, computer science, engineering, or a related field.
* One to seven years of professional experience, or equivalent graduate research, working with physical robotic systems.
* Professional or research experience developing software in C++ and Python within a ROS or ROS2 environment.
* Experience working with embedded Linux and debugging software-to-hardware interfaces.
* **Must be a United States citizen.**

**Primary Job Duties**

**Navigation & State Estimation:**

* Develop, evaluate, and maintain algorithms for sensor fusion and coordinate-frame management across a multi-sensor suite operating in GPS-denied environments.
* Support evaluation and troubleshooting of navigation, state-estimation, and controls behavior using test data and physical vehicle results.

**Sensor Integration:**

* Develop and maintain driver-level software for vehicle sensors and embedded communication interfaces.
* Diagnose integration issues across application software, operating-system services, firmware interfaces, and connected hardware.
* Collaborate with cross-domain personnel to incorporate physical design changes and new sensors into the software stack.

**Systems & Infrastructure:**

* Build and maintain development and deployment tooling for a multi-vehicle fleet, including build pipelines, containerized development environments, device provisioning, and process management on embedded targets.
* Support repeatable software configuration, deployment, and troubleshooting across development and fielded systems.

**Autonomy & Mission Software:**

* Contribute to higher-level software governing mission execution, vehicle safety protocols, and communication with operators.
* Support autonomy architectures, mission planning, simulation, and vehicle-behavior testing as assigned.

**Required Knowledge and Skills**

* Proficiency in C++ and Python in a ROS or ROS2 environment.
* Firm grasp of state estimation, sensor fusion, or controls and the ability to reason about system behavior from first principles.
* Experience working with embedded Linux and comfort operating at the OS level.
* Ability to debug problems that cross abstraction layers, from algorithms to hardware communication.
* Self-directed and comfortable working in a small team with significant individual responsibility.
* Clear technical communication and documentation skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with marine, underwater, or field robotics.
* Familiarity with inertial navigation, acoustic sensing, or subsea communication systems.
* Experience with simulation frameworks for robotic vehicles.
* Background in autonomy architectures, behavior trees, or mission-planning systems.
* Experience with cross-compilation, containerized workflows, or CI/CD for embedded targets.
