jobs.title: Principal Digital/Embedded Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
**Description**

The Defense Systems Group at Leidos has an immediate opening for a Principal Digital Firmware Design Engineer at our St. Petersburg, FL facility. This position supports the development of advanced, mission-critical military communications systems and involves the design, integration, testing, and optimization of secure, ruggedized electronic hardware and firmware for defense applications.

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in FPGA-based digital design and hands-on experience with integrating hardware and firmware within complex embedded systems. This individual will have a demonstrated track record supporting defense programs across the full product lifecycle—from requirements development and architectural design through integration, qualification testing, and transition to production.

The Leidos St. Petersburg facility specializes in the design, development, modeling and simulation, analysis, prototyping, and testing of advanced electronic systems. Our primary focus areas include embedded communications systems, Software Defined Radios (SDR), and Phased Array Antenna Systems supporting Department of Defense and commercial customers.

Primary Responsibilities:

  

* Participate in a multi-disciplinary engineering team developing secure, high-performance military communications hardware and firmware.
* Analyze and decompose system-level requirements into detailed hardware design specifications with full traceability.
* Perform Logic Design; write VHDL code, perform synthesis, logic simulation, test bench generation, functional testing and hardware debugging of designs within FPGA/CPLD devices.
* Architect, implement and test embedded firmware /software within FPGA-based digital designs including signal processing, control logic, and high-speed interfaces on a variety of platforms (FPGAs, microcontrollers, microprocessors, and mixed signal designs).
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex hardware, firmware / software and integration issues across prototype and production phases.
* Support design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR), technical documentation, and configuration management processes.
* Provide technical input for cost estimates, schedules, and risk assessments.
* Collaborate closely with Firmware, Software, RF, systems, and test engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle.

Clearance Requirements:

  

* U.S. Citizen required.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret Security Clearance.
* Active Secret clearance preferred.
* Ability to obtain Top Secret clearance preferred.

Required Qualifications:

  

* BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
* 8+ years of experience in embedded hardware and digital design (10+ preferred for Senior level).
* Experience supporting full product development lifecycle including:
  + Requirements analysis, System design and hardware implementation, Integration and test
  + Firmware/software architecture development for embedded systems, including FPGAs and SoCs
  + Technical documentation and formal design reviews
* Strong VHDL, FPGA/SoC design and implementation experience:
  + Digital logic design using VHDL/Verilog with System-On-Chip devices (SoC’s), FPGA’s, CPLD/s, and/or Microcontrollers.
  + Modern vendor design tools (IDE’s) such as Xilinx Vivado, Vitis, STM, Libero SoC, Lattice Diamond
  + Simulation and Testbench generation (Xilinx simulator, Aldec Active HDL, Riveria Pro, Modelsim, or similar)
  + RISC microprocessors architectures (ARM Cortex, Microblaze, PowerPC, RISC-V)
  + C/C++ language software development for embedded, real-time systems.
* Experience with one or more of the following:
  + Integrating and troubleshooting digital subsystems within embedded systems.
  + Digital interfaces such as I2C, SPI, RS-232/422, USB, Ethernet
  + ADC/DAC devices and understanding performance characteristics.
  + Hands-on lab experience debugging hardware using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and related tools
* Understand trade-offs of embedded system targets (FPGA, SoC, microcontroller, RTOS, bare-metal) for developing best cost/option architectures

Preferred Qualifications:

  

* Active Secret or Top Secret clearance.
* Proven experience in full-stack FPGA development for Xilinx UltraScale/UltraScale+ architectures, spanning RTL design (VHDL/Verilog) and embedded C/C++ development for bare-metal, FreeRTOS, or embedded Linux environments (PetaLinux, etc).
* Experience with one or more of the following:
  + Design and development with other FPGA/CPLD vendors such as Microsemi, ST-Micro, Lattice, etc
  + High-speed interfaces/protocols such as PCIe, JESD204B, LVDS, and SERDES
  + Simulation and modeling tools (MATLAB, Python, LabVIEW)
  + Implementing signal processing concepts such as digital filters, digital modulation, up/down conversion within HDL designs
  + IP cores and modern processor interfaces (Xilinx IP Cores, AXI4, AXI-Stream or similar)
  + Design, integration and testing electronic circuits within embedded systems, including digital, analog and radio frequency (RF) subsystems.
* Experience developing ruggedized or military communication systems
* Experience with the Cooperative Engagement Capability Naval communications system.

* Experience transitioning prototype designs into production hardware
* Familiar with schematic capture design tools (Altium, Cadence Allegro/OrCAD, Ki-CAD or equivalent)

jobs.description:
Orlando, Florida, US, 32837

Category: Engineering

Job ID: 34440

widget: Full-Time

Requires the ability to obtain a TS/SCI and SAP/SAR.

Other

No - Teleworking not available for this position

### **Position Description & Qualifications**

  
  

Serco seeks a **Simulation Systems and Test Engineer** for its Combat Air Force Distributed Mission Operations (CAF DMO) 3.0 program in Orlando, FL. The CAF DMO 3.0 program, via its Distributed Mission Operations Network (DMON), provides world-class integration training in large force and small team formats to combat units around the globe against cutting-edge threats in a boundless virtual battlespace. The U.S. Air Force can only utilize its full capability against modern threats in a virtual environment. Be a part of that environment and continue to make the USAF the best air force in the world.

You will be part of a focused team of engineers to perform test, integration, and evaluation of disparate M&S systems and applications to support 5th and 6th generation training interoperability.

The team will work closely with the DoD customer and other Serco teams at Langley AFB and Orlando, FL to deliver quality test services.

**In this role, you will:**

* Support military simulation system and application integration, evaluation, and interoperability test to support DMON and JSE training operations.
* Use industry-standard tools for simulation test and evaluation to include Wireshark, simulation protocol analysis, and GFE and Commercial Computer Generated Forces (CGFs).
* Assist in detailed analysis of network and computational system performance including latency, bandwidth, jitter, and system occupancy measures.
* Help develop and maintain test plans and procedures to document and drive test activities.
* Draft comprehensive test reports based on completed integration, test, evaluation, and verification tasks performed.
* Assist in the development of CONOPS and multiple COAs for implementation and deployment of the evaluated simulation capabilities.
* Contribute to other areas of the engineering life cycle to include requirements review and assessment, training operations support, and basic system administration functions.
* Produce well-defined, concise, and directed test procedures and test cases under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Support program and team processes by using tools from the Atlassian Suite of products to include JIRA, Confluence, Bitbucket, Bamboo, and X-Ray.
* Participate in peer reviews, test bed maintenance and updates, and programming, testing, and debugging activities.
* Write and maintain scripts and support application (PowerShell, Cygwin, VBasic, etc.) programs, to enable efficiencies in test artifact creation and task execution.
* Help identify production and non-production application issues, assist in developing solutions, and implement necessary changes.

  

**To be successful in this role, you will have:**

* A bachelor’s degree in an applicable STEM curriculum (e.g., Data Analysis, System Engineering, Math, Computer Science, Physics, etc.) or similar.
* 8 years of engineering experience performing test, integration, SW development, or embedded systems engineering activities.
* Experience with military simulation integration test DIS IEEE1278.1 or HLA IEEE 1516 protocols, or similar communications or data protocols (SIP, VOIP, JREAP, etc).

* The ability to obtain a TS/SCI and SAP/SAR.

* Experience supporting DoD customers and personnel in a technical capacity.
* Familiarity or experience with development, test and evaluation of military simulation training or operational systems.
* Must possess, or obtain within six months, a DoD 8140 IAT Level II or higher (i.e. Security+, CySA+, CISSP)
* Up to 10% travel

  

**This position is contingent upon your ability to obtain/maintain/transfer your Secret clearance.**

**Additional desired experience and skills:**

* An active DoD Secret Clearance with ability to obtain TS/SCI and SAP/SAR.
* Familiarity with tactical Military training systems, products, and capabilities.
* Exposure to or experience in M&S development, test, and integration for constructive simulation systems and models.
* Knowledge of or experience with the Joint Simulation Environment (JSE).
* Possess or obtain within six months, a Linux OS certification (i.e., Linux+, RHCSA etc.).
  

  

### **Company Overview**

  
  

Serco Inc. (Serco) is the Americas division of Serco Group, plc. In North America, Serco’s 9,000+ employees strive to make an impact every day across 100+ sites in the areas of Defense, Citizen Services, and Transportation. We help our clients deliver vital services more efficiently while increasing the satisfaction of their end customers. Serco serves every branch of the U.S. military, numerous U.S. Federal civilian agencies, the Intelligence Community, the Canadian government, state, provincial and local governments, and commercial clients. While your place may look a little different depending on your role, we know you will find yours here. Wherever you work and whatever you do, we invite you to discover your place in our world. Serco is a place you can count on and where you can make an impact because every contribution matters.
  
  
To review Serco benefits please visit: https://careers.serco-na.com/us/en/what-we-offer. If you require an accommodation with the application process please email: careers@serco-na.com or call the HR Service Desk at 800-628-6458, option 1. Please note, due to EEOC/OFCCP compliance, Serco is unable to accept resumes by email.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. The Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) team are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all of the robotics and material handling equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!  
  
About the Role:  
As an Automation Engineer, you will play a crucial role in maximizing equipment reliability and operational performance in our fulfillment centers by providing proactive controls automation and technical support. Your expertise will be essential in troubleshooting complex control systems, analyzing performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize material handling equipment (MHE) systems and implement innovative projects. You'll work with state-of-the-art technology, including conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, and SCADA devices and programs. Through your efforts, you'll directly contribute to ensuring our customers receive their orders with Amazon's signature speed and accuracy.  
  
What Do We Offer?  
Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there’s more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  

* You will serve as the site expert for maintaining the automation systems that are critical for operations
* You will understand, maintain and troubleshoot material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers and industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems
* You will monitor MHE metrics and partner with maintenance/operations to address system performance issues and provide analysis across all operations
* You will provide first-level escalation support for site technicians, both locally and remotely
* You will perform and analyze building System Assessments to enhance material handling system performance

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 2+ years of PLC programming or automation engineering experience
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 2+ years of process or production environment related PLC-controlled automation and issue diagnosis experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 2+ years of robotics work cells and control systems experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 2+ years of electrical theory, robotics, controls components, and automated equipment experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 2+ years of Ladder Logic and structured programming from Siemens, Allen-Bradley, or Codesys PLCs experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with HMI and control network components, including maintenance, troubleshooting, programming and design
* Experience identifying, maintaining, troubleshooting, and modifying Motor Controls including motor starters, Variable Frequency Drives, DC drives, and standard electrical components
* Experience with preventive maintenance procedures, industrial electrical, industrial controls, and industrial electronics & robotics
* Experience interpreting and modifying mechanical and electrical drawings
* Experience programming with RSLogix5000, Studio 5000, FT View, and other controls software platforms

  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

jobs.title: Sr Lunar Systems Engineer, Engines Integration Lead
jobs.description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of the Lunar Permanence business unit, which develops Blue Origin’s Blue Moon landers and related products. To further Blue Origin's mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth, we are building sustainable infrastructure for our transport of crew and cargo from Earth to the lunar surface.

We are a team of collaborators, doers, and problem-solvers who are dedicated to a culture of safety. This role plays a crucial role in the history of space exploration and demands a dedication and meticulous focus on safe and repeatable spaceflight. Come onboard as we work towards reducing the cost of space access and realizing Blue Origin's goal of having millions of people living and working in space for the betterment of Earth. As a stride towards this objective, Blue Origin is developing the next generation of lunar landers.

Join the Lunar Permanence team of engineers responsible for integrating interfaces across our lunar vehicles, including New Glenn, NASA vehicles, and our Engines business unit.

As a Systems Engineer on the Lunar Cross Program Integration team, you will lead the integration and technical oversight of critical propulsion hardware, including the BE-7 engines, across multiple lunar landers. You will shape technical content, manage propulsion system performance parameters, drive issue resolution, and coordinate with cross-functional teams and NASA to ensure compliance with design and construction standards. This role is pivotal to the successful development of the lunar transportation system and the certification of the Human-class Delivery Lander, enabling humanity's sustained presence on the Moon.

We're looking for someone who brings technical expertise, strong leadership, and an unwavering commitment to quality and safe human spaceflight. A passion for our mission and vision is essential.

  

**Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

* Ensure BE-7 hardware and related common components are integrated across lunar landers
* Define technical content for BE-7 Statements of Work (SOW)
* Serve as accountable owner for the BE-7 integration forum across Lunar, as well as program-specific integration forums as needed
* Drive top issues to closure with a strong bias for action; ensure Engines top issues are reflected in Program top issues
* Own program-level Engines risks; create and elevate decisions to the HLS board as needed
* Manage Engines Technical Performance Parameters (TPMs)
* Manage HLS performance requirements and provide them to the Engines team during Requirements Definition

The Boeing Defense (BDS), Security, Space, Intelligence & Weapons Systems (SI&WS) is seeking multiple **Senior Systems Engineers** to join our Experimental Systems Group (ESG) at **Kennedy Space Center, FL**.

* Lead rapid root-cause analysis (RCA), failure investigation, and multi-system troubleshooting to diagnose complex operational anomalies and flight hardware defects
* Identify, develop, and deploy continuous upgrades to test infrastructure, instrumentation setups, and operational processes to improve test cadence, reliability, and mission throughput

* Active U.S. Top Secret / SCI security clearance (investigation active or open within the past 24 months; U.S. citizenship required)
* 7+ years of experience in an engineering role
* Ability to analyze and interpret engineering drawings, schematics, wiring diagrams, and parts lists
* Strong skills in engineering analysis, requirements tracing, and technical communication

* Refined cross-functional leadership skills and experience working with multi-disciplined teams
* Expert in aerospace avionics, electrical systems, and RF equipment
* Subject matter expert for approved repair and testing techniques for electronics and components
* Experience with hardware and software requirements verification using tools like DOORS

jobs.title: Instrumentation & Controls Engineer I
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we're building rockets to serve today's needs and tomorrow's breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that's just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

**About the Team:**

The Launch team operates at the intersection of every major aspect of Terran R, from stages and payloads to ground systems, launch, landing, and refurbishment. The Cape is the only place where you see it all come together, offering a level of exposure and responsibility unmatched elsewhere in the program. This is where first flights happen, where history is built on top of history, and where the scale of what's underway is unlike anything in modern aerospace. The mission stays the same, but the work evolves with every milestone: from first launch to reuse, high-cadence operations, and beyond. If you're looking to define what's next in space launch and write a new playbook, not just repeat what's already been done, this is where it happens.

**About the Role:**

* Design, develop, test, integrate, and operate launch control and acquisition hardware, instrumentation, and cameras used to support and control the Terran R rocket.
* Work with Beckhoff PLCs or similar systems.
* Support high-speed data acquisition.
* Work with instrumentation including pressure, temperature, flow, level, accelerometers, solenoid valves, VFDs, and heaters.
* Integrate and operate IP, SDI, and CoaXPress high-speed cameras.
* Assist in the design of electrical systems for use in hazardous areas.
* Collaborate with other groups to gather requirements, plan schedules, and coordinate work.
* Plan, install, and operate wiring and hardware in access-limited areas such as launch mounts and transport erectors.

**About You:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or another related STEM discipline.
* Exposure to data acquisition hardware, PLC-based control systems, complex camera systems, and instrumentation selection and troubleshooting.
* Ability to work with multidisciplinary groups in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

**Nice to haves but not required:**

* Experience with the design and operation of spacecraft and launch vehicle infrastructure.
* Experience working at a rocket launch site.
* Proficiency with electrical schematic design software such as AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN, or Zuken E3.

**Successful candidates must clear a background check administered by the US government to obtain clearance for on-site work at our government partner location in Cape Canaveral, Florida.**

**We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.**

***If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at*** ***accommodations@relativityspace.com******.***

***Please note: Relativity Space does not accept unsolicited resumes, candidate profiles, or referrals from recruitment agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited submission - via email, our website, social media, or directly to an employee - will be deemed the property of Relativity Space, and no fee will be owed absent a current, fully executed agreement with Talent Acquisition that specifically authorizes submissions for the applicable role.***

jobs.title: Electronics Engineer Sr Stf - E5
jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

**Introduction**  
We are looking for a Lead Electronics Engineer to join an exciting and dynamic team in designing, developing, fabricating, testing, and troubleshooting Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE) used to integrate and test the Orion spacecraft for NASA’s Artemis missions.

**Location:**  
This position does not support teleworking. You will need to live near our Lockheed Martin Space facility in Littleton Colorado and be expected to work a flexible 9x80 schedule in the office full-time.

**What does this role look like?**  
The focus for this role is to work as an experienced responsible engineer, ensuring the technical integrity of your products and leading a small engineering team responsible for the design, drawings, documentation, and support of ground electronic test systems, primarily racks of equipment designed to test the Orion spacecraft as it is manufactured at Kennedy Space Center. The EGSE team is responsible for the design of a wide variety of test equipment, including low voltage AC/DC power, batteries, analog and digital signals, telemetry systems, RF electronics, audio & video, computer systems, vehicle emulators, cabling, and networking equipment that is used to interface with, test, and monitor spacecraft vehicles and other flight hardware.

**Key activities you will accomplish in this role:**  

* Lead a small team of 3 to 4 engineers in designing, manufacturing, testing and supporting a suite of EGSE end item designs and racks that all test unique subsystems of the Orion spacecraft
* Review and update engineering drawings and documentation created by your team for test equipment racks, chassis, cables and other assemblies to ensure their technical integrity
* Support manufacturing during procurement, build and modification of EGSE equipment
* Perform testing of ground support equipment for a variety of electronic component assemblies
* Support EGSE during usage testing the Orion spacecraft, assisting users and troubleshooting anomalies
* Certify that the final EGSE products meet all requirements and that engineering drawings, documents and paperwork accurately represent the as-built product

By prioritizing relentless hardware iteration, we deliver high-speed systems at the pace of the modern battlefield. We work with the Department of War to provide the high-speed capabilities our nation and its allies need to maintain a durable, asymmetric advantage.

**About The Role:**  

We are seeking a Software Engineer to join our Command & Control team in Atlanta. The team is responsible for the design, development, integration, testing, and delivery of software supporting Human Machine Interfaces (HMI), Pilot Vehicle Interfaces (PVI), Command & Control (C2), telemetry, and vehicle communications.

This role will focus primarily on the embedded flight software and networking that enable communication between our aircraft and ground control systems. You will develop software supporting command and control, telemetry, network management, RF communications, and vehicle data links while working closely with avionics, RF, flight software, and ground systems engineers.

This is not a traditional voice communications role. You will work on the software and network infrastructure that allow an air vehicle and ground control station to reliably exchange commands, telemetry, and other mission-critical data.

The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between embedded C/C++ development, network and communications system design, and hands-on testing with target hardware. You will have ownership across both the vehicle and ground sides of the communications network and will help take systems from initial architecture through integration and flight operations.

* Write efficient, maintainable, well-documented software that meets performance and safety requirements.

* Own technical schedules and roadmaps for assigned software and communications capabilities.

jobs.description:
Apply today to join Coreforce, where your Engineering expertise makes a real impact.

**Join Our Team as an** **Embedded Engineer II**

**Company:** Coreforce  
**Location:** Atlanta (Hybrid)  
**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Salary:** **$100,000 – $110,000 annually, based on experience**

**Company Overview:**  
Coreforce is an innovative technology company providing public safety organizations a comprehensive technology suite from dispatch to the courtroom. Coreforce delivers integrated technology designed to support public safety entities, regardless of organizational size. Our products - body cameras, in-car videos, mobile routers, and digital evidence systems- help public safety officers and first responders save lives, strengthen community trust, and enhance accountability.

**Embedded Engineer II****-** Build Your Career with Purpose

Join Coreforce and use your engineering skills to support innovative technology that strengthens communities.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here:**

* Flexible hybrid schedule.
* Free chef-inspired lunch Monday–Thursday.
* 15 PTO days + floating holiday.
* Competitive benefits: medical, dental, vision, 401(k). We provide 401(k) matching per the terms of the 401(k) plan.
* Annual bonus.
* Tuition reimbursement.
* Career growth in a fast-growing, mission-driven company.
* Collaborative, purpose-driven culture.

**Responsibilities:**

* Design, implement, and deliver firmware features end-to-end in C/C++ for bare-metal and embedded Linux platforms with limited supervision.
* Own small firmware subsystems or components — including their testing, documentation, and maintenance.
* Develop, integrate, and debug device drivers for peripherals such as sensors, radios, storage, and communication interfaces (I²C, SPI, UART, USB, CAN, Ethernet).
* Perform board bring-up tasks independently — including bootloader configuration, peripheral initialization, and hardware validation for known platform variants.
* Implement and tune interrupt handlers, timers, and low-level scheduling mechanisms to achieve reliable, deterministic behavior. Use debugging and measurement tools — oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG/SWD, protocol analyzers — to diagnose and resolve hardware/firmware interaction issues independently. Collaborate with hardware engineers to review schematics and identify firmware-relevant design considerations.
* Contribute to board support packages (BSPs), bootloader configuration, and OS integration for embedded Linux and RTOS-based systems.
* Implement error handling, logging, and diagnostic capabilities for field debugging.
* Write and maintain unit and integration tests for owned components, using test harnesses and hardware-in-the-loop setups where appropriate.
* Participate actively in design discussions — proposing approaches, identifying tradeoffs, and asking clarifying questions.
* Conduct peer code reviews with attention to correctness, performance, maintainability, and adherence to team standards.
* Break down requirements into technical tasks and estimate work for sprint planning.
* Participate fully in Scrum ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement of team processes.

**Mandatory Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities)**
---------------------------------------------------------------

* Professional experience developing embedded firmware for production or near-production hardware platforms.
* Solid proficiency in C/C++ for embedded systems, including practical understanding of memory management, concurrency, and real-time constraints.
* Experience developing and debugging device drivers for common embedded interfaces (GPIO, I²C, SPI, UART, USB).
* Hands-on experience with at least one microcontroller family (ARM Cortex-M, RISC-V, etc.) and familiarity with bare-metal development patterns.
* Exposure to an RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, ThreadX) or embedded Linux distribution (Yocto, Buildroot).
* Practical experience with low-level debugging tools — oscilloscopes, logic analyzers,JTAG/SWD debuggers.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and understand hardware behavior relevant to firmware development.
* Understanding of real-time systems concepts including interrupt handling, priority inversion, and timing constraints.
* Experience with Git-based workflows, code review practices, and CI/CD tooling for firmware builds.
* Experience working in an agile/Scrum environment as part of a cross-functional team.
* Good written and verbal communication skills for design discussions, documentation, and code reviews.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with wireless communication stacks (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, LTE, proprietary RF) in an embedded context.
* Experience with Nordic Semiconductor BLE devices and SDK, or similar BLE chipset development environments.
* Familiarity with Android debugging tools (ADB, logcat) for cross-device BLE communication debugging; exposure to Android NDK for native- layer integration.
* Exposure to secure boot, cryptographic libraries, or secure firmware update mechanisms.
* Experience developing firmware for battery-powered or low-power devices, including basic power state management.
* Familiarity with manufacturing test, factory programming, or calibration processes.
* Experience with scripting (Python) for test automation, tooling, or build orchestration.
* Exposure to embedded audio/video capture or camera subsystems.
* Experience integrating embedded devices with cloud services via MQTT, HTTP, or gRPC.
* Experience with rugged, field-deployed hardware or public-safety devices.
* Familiarity with Java or JVM-based languages for companion services, device management applications, or test automation tooling.

**Coreforce is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion.**

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier.

At Automated Logic, we've been developing and supporting intelligent building solutions that have helped customers, including small businesses to Fortune 500 corporations, operate their buildings more efficiently for over 40 years. Our products help reduce energy consumption, lower utility, operating and maintenance costs, and improve indoor air quality, occupant comfort, and productivity. Technology that supports the buildings and industry of today and tomorrow requires a wide range of talents and skill sets.

**About this role:**

As an Associate Controls Engineer, you will be crucial to ALC’s business through the designing of building automation systems created specifically for each individual customer. We are looking for someone who works well in a team and has excellent problem-solving, time management, and multi-tasking skills. You will work to build new skills and advance existing skills while completing smaller projects on your own.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and program building automation systems, site-specific configuration of control system, and control algorithms.
* Adhere to project requirements and company and customer standards of design, programming, and implementation.
* Create a clear design document for project teams with technical information.
* Document and communicate the building automation system design and revisions.
* Develop graphical and text-based interfaces for building automation systems.
* Test programming and interfaces prior to implementation.
* Provide technical support to sales representatives to ensure customers’ needs are met.
* Identify and communicate project opportunities and risks.
* Support functional testing for building systems.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Associate or Bachelor’s Degree

OR

* High School Diploma / GED with 2+ years of HVAC/BMS experience
* Must have unrestricted authorization to work in the USA. No visa sponsoring available.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Basic knowledge of primary functions of building automation system software and associated engineering tools, Automated Logic suites preferred.
* Basic knowledge of Automated Logic software, peripherals, add-ons, services, or hardware design.
* Understanding and/or experience with IP networks
* Understanding and/or experience with Microsoft Visio and/or similar software.
* Ability to understand written sequences of operations, diagrammatic depictions of systems.
* Familiar with third-party communication protocols used in building automation, such as BACnet, Modbus, SNMP, LON, N2, etc.
* Able to translate technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Capable of climbing ladders or using other lift equipment over 8 feet above grade, and capable of lifting items up to 50lbs.

**Pay Range**

The annual salary for this position is between $53,000.00 - $106,000.00 annually. * **Time off and Leave**: Paid vacation days, up to 15 days; paid sick days, up to 5 days; paid personal leave, up to 5 days; paid holidays, up to 13 days; birth and adoption leave; parental leave; family and medical leave; bereavement leave; jury duty leave; military leave; purchased vacation

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
If you thrive in fast paced environments, enjoy hands-on problem solving, and want to make a measurable impact while working with modern automation and control systems, this role offers the challenge, autonomy, and growth opportunities to take your engineering career to the next level.

In this role, you won’t just maintain systems—you’ll continuously improve them. You’ll apply your controls and automation knowledge to optimize preventive maintenance strategies, diagnose sophisticated issues, and enhance the performance of industry leading technologies such as conveyors, sortation systems, PLCs, scanners, vision systems, print

‑and

‑apply equipment, and SCADA platforms. Your work will directly influence uptime, safety, and operational excellence across mission critical facilities.

What You’ll Do

* Promote a safe working environment by complying with all applicable codes, regulations, governmental agencies, and company directives related to system operations and work safety.
* Troubleshoot and modify software programs for material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers, Allen Bradley Controllogix/Compactlogix PLC platform and RSLogix 5000 software package.
* Act as first level escalation in troubleshooting support, both on-site and remotely, as well as during and after business hours, to repair all MHE controls software systems. Respond quickly to emergency situations, summoning assistance as needed.
* Inspect systems to ensure the operation of equipment is within design capabilities and achieve operational conditions prescribed by the client.
* Oversee scope of development, work request initiation, scheduling, and inspection of work performed by outside contractors, which includes proprietary work, licensed installations, upgrades, and maintenance and inspection of specialized systems.
* Engineer process solutions and reliability improvement from concept to network implementation.
* Monitor Industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, AS-I, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems.
* Monitor material handling equipment metrics and partner with site team to resolve equipment electrical problems that create performance deficiencies.
* Proactively and effectively communicate with multiple stakeholders including, but not limited to, leadership, operations and the maintenance team on technical issues and project timelines and production impacts.
* Facilitate analysis and reviews of failures and processes to provide recommendations to implement improvements or retraining to avoid future incidents.
* Perform controls systems assessments to maintain and improve equipment reliability.
* Clearly communicate technical issues, project timelines, and product impacts with site leadership, operations and maintenance teams.
* Cultivate positive working relationships with our Client and the Operations Maintenance team members.
* Perform other job-related duties as needed or assigned.

What You’ll Need

* Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.
* Bachelor's Degree preferred with 2-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education may be considered.
* Experience in at least two engineering design cycles including specification, component selection and programming.
* 2+ years of experience working with PLC programming, robotics system components and controls, and SCADA-based monitoring and control systems.
* Ability to be available and work in a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays.
* Ability to independently solve problems and carry out general instructions in standard situations with limited to no oversight.
* Meet the physical requirements of this role including stooping, standing, walking, climbing stairs/ladders, and the ability to lift/carry heavy loads of 50 lbs. or more.
* Ability to guide the exchange of sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations, and handle problems.

Preferred Qualifications

* 2+ years apprenticeship or equivalent experience in Control Systems troubleshooting/ programming.
* Experience supporting a range of different conveyors and sortation systems.
* Experience with robotic maintenance.
* In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Extensive organizational skills with a strong inquisitive mindset.
* Advanced math skills. Ability to calculate difficult figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial-related calculations.

You should be proficient in:

* PLC Programming Experience
* SCADA Experience

Machines & technologies you'll use:

* Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) (Allen Bradley)

jobs.description:
Aviture provides custom software solutions for clients, acting as a business partner and technical advisor – sharing and contributing to our client’s vision. We provide full lifecycle software services from concept, implementation and first delivery on to continued maintenance, analysis, and continued adaption to user needs and market forces.

At Aviture we treat our employees as people, not resources. We value their personal & professional growth believing that stronger and healthier individuals are good for both our employees and our clients.

Using our principle of ‘cross pollination’ – we actively share problems & solutions between our project teams and provide ample opportunities for employees to advance to different teams at opportune moments to grow and mentor. The exposure to multiple industries and aspects of technology presents an ideal environment in which you can continue to master your trade skills, as well as be exposed to many developing technologies & interesting problem spaces.

Additionally, we encourage the inter-communication and mingling of our employees – to include company sponsored vacations, quarterly ‘cast away’ weeks where we co-locate our employees to further collaborate, and many social functions and internal interest groups.

* Deliver solutions to complex technical challenges both independently and as a part of a cross-functional team.
* Communicate clearly in a timely manner in both verbal and written forms.
* Actively participate in all aspects of our agile development process.
* Assist in establishing and enforcing coding standards within their team.
* Work with project stakeholders to decompose complex requirements into smaller sets of iterative deliverables.
* Recognize and recommend design patterns for developing reliable, highly available, scalable and performant software solutions.
* Identify opportunities to improve upon engineering processes within their team.
* Provide technical mentorship and direction to peers.
* Utilize effective debugging techniques to identify and resolve software defects.
* Look beyond the immediate needs of a product and help consider longer-term concerns and/or opportunities for impact from our products.
* Continuously keep themselves up to date on changes in technology, with an emphasis on the tech stacks being used by your team.

  
**Requirements**  

* BS degree in Software Engineering related degree, similar technical field of study or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of professional software development experience building and shipping production grade software or services.
* Advanced knowledge of software testing tools, frameworks, and techniques.
* Proficient in at least two modern programming languages (React, React Native, C#, and .NET).
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Able to respectfully challenge the status quo.
* Experience developing and deploying cloud native software on the AWS cloud.
* Experience with UI development using ReactJS and/or React Native.
* Gets excited by the challenge of complex technical problems.
* Competent with relational databases and SQL.
* Excellent grasp of computer science concepts, data structures, algorithms, and design patterns.
* Ability to design and provide solutions to complex business problems.
* Strong working knowledge of Agile development processes.
* Passionate about mentoring and training junior software engineers.
* High personal standards for code quality, maintainability, and performance.

  
**Benefits**  

* PPO or a High Deductible Health Plan, HSA eligible plan, Dental, Vision, and Supplemental Life.
* Generous paid time off that starts accruing on day one.
* Quarterly Castaway Week events in the Omaha HQ Office, all expenses paid, from across the country to participate in team-building, collaboration, and fun events.

jobs.title: Senior Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Location 9529 - IRIS Automation, Illinois, 60502 Category Engineering JR105451 Automation 9050 Olympus Controls Corp. Regular Job Type Full time

  

Primary functions include specifying a single product, developing a concept, programming, or designing a complete industrial control package. This role will work independently and as a team member to evaluate applications, design control systems, and generate system proposals or project specifications.

All engineering team members may also be responsible for managing projects through the production process and taking necessary steps to maintain schedules. The project management tasks include regular updates to management or customers, daily guidance to assembly technicians, participation in the final inspection, and testing completed systems.

**Essential Job Functions:**

* Apply Gibson Engineering's products and technologies to automate client processes and solve their challenges
* Develop, review, and maintain drawings, BOMs, project specifications, and engineering change documentation
* Generate quotations for projects that include cable assemblies, control panels, turnkey systems, and programming services.
* Complete feasibility studies with industrial automation equipment such as machine vision systems, robotics, HMI, or PLCs to specify hardware and software required to solve new applications.
* Design control systems. This includes electrical schematics, component selection, and industrial control panel layouts.
* Configure, program, test, and debug various automation equipment and systems. This includes but is not limited to PLCs, HMIs, motion controls (Servo, Stepper, VFD), robots, data collection, and vision systems.
* Manage engineering or application evaluation projects and regularly communicate status and expectations to management, salespeople, or end customers as required.
* Provide customer education one-on-one, to a small group, or as a subject matter expert in a classroom environment.
* Contribute to continuous improvement and documentation of internal engineering and production processes.
* Communicate project status and expectations to management, sales, and clients.
* Provide technical support and training to colleagues and customers

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical, computer or other relevant engineering disciplines
* Prefer 3-5 years of relevant experience in engineering
* Familiarity with industrial control systems, including but not limited to PLC, HMI, Machine Vision and Motion Control Products, is a plus.
* Working knowledge of AutoCAD Electrical is preferred
* Ability to break down, organize, and manage complex projects
* Strong multitasking, prioritization, and time management skills
* Ability to retain technical details & excellent attention to detail
* Ability to effectively communicate with customers in person, as well as over the phone, email and video calls

Founded in 1923, Applied Industrial Technologies (NYSE: AIT) is a leading value-added distributor and technical solutions provider of industrial motion, fluid power, flow control, automation technologies, and related maintenance supplies. **Applied Industrial Technologies is built on a philosophy that puts people first. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to a workforce in which we enforce fair treatment and provide growth opportunities for everyone. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.**

This is a role well suited for an ambitious engineering professional looking to take the next step in their career. As a Systems Engineer, you will play an important role in the development and delivery of advanced medical imaging systems, working across engineering disciplines and with clinical, product, manufacturing, service, and other stakeholders.

You will take ownership of new system functionality throughout the development lifecycle—from requirements definition and technical risk management through integration, verification, and validation.

* Translating and decomposing user and system-level requirements into detailed, complete, and testable technical specifications.
* Developing and maintaining system technical performance requirements and specifications.
* Reviewing and assessing emerging technologies for potential incorporation into current and future products.
* Developing algorithms and executing testing to assess system performance and image quality.
* Developing and executing system-level verification and validation strategies.
* Analyzing test results and preparing clear, comprehensive technical reports documenting system performance.
* Investigating and resolving customer issues related to system performance and image quality.
* Identifying, quantifying, and communicating technical risks and driving mitigation strategies affecting projects and products.
* Championing product quality through rigorous functional verification and clinical validation.
* Translating cutting-edge technologies into commercially viable solutions that advance medical care for customers and patients.
* Ensuring seamless integration of complex hardware and software subsystems designed and manufactured across multiple global locations.

**This position may suit you best if:**

* Have demonstrated knowledge of medical imaging use cases and clinical workflows.
* Have experience applying engineering principles within diagnostic or medical imaging environments.
* Understand system performance testing and validation.
* Have knowledge of key medical imaging technologies and how they apply to clinical imaging systems.
* Are comfortable managing changing priorities and technical challenges in a rapidly evolving environment.
* Can effectively bridge communication between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Have experience working with 510(k) medical devices or within another highly regulated product-development environment.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 1–2 years of experience in diagnostics, medical imaging, medical devices, or a related engineering field; medical imaging experience is preferred.
* Experience developing and executing system-level verification tests.
* Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts to diverse audiences, including engineers, product management, clinical stakeholders, and international teams across the U.S., Germany, China, and India.
* Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively as part of a cross-functional team while also operating independently.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven product development environment.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally on an occasional basis (less than 5%).

For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

Using the latest and greatest technologies and solutions, you will support the client’s innovation by following a set of standards and best practices in a rapidly evolving technology landscape.

jobs.title: Robotics & Automation Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
##### **Job Description**

The Robotics and Automation Systems Engineer supports and helps drive the robotics and autonomy work behind automation deployments across the organization. This role spans a broad range of robotics and automation projects, including fixed/stationary robotic systems (e.g., robotic arms, cobots), mobile/autonomous systems (e.g., AGVs/AMRs, autonomous forklifts, and navigation), palletizing and material-handling applications, and adjacent technologies.

This role assesses sites, programs and integrates robotic systems, commissions systems in live warehouse environments, and troubleshoots deployed automation in production. This role supports robotics and autonomy work from assessment through resolution, and works closely with the Controls & Mechatronics Engineer, operations leadership, and robot OEMs or system integrators to keep robotic and autonomous systems running reliably in a live, production-critical environment.

  

##### **Duties and Responsibilities**

* Program, integrate, and commission robotic systems — including industrial robot arms (e.g., FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Rokae, Universal Robots) and mobile/autonomous platforms — for palletizing, material handling, and related applications.
* Own perception, localization, and navigation for autonomous systems, including LiDAR, SLAM, path planning, and obstacle avoidance.
* Integrate sensors (LiDAR, cameras, IMU) and apply sensor fusion as needed across robotic platforms.
* Integrate robotic and autonomous systems with PLCs, safety systems, conveyors, WCS/WES/WMS, or fleet-management platforms, coordinating with the Controls & Mechatronics Engineer and other automation team members on shared electrical and controls interfaces.
* Develop and maintain production-quality robotics software (C++/Python) following standard engineering practices (version control, code review, and testing), and support fleet/robot diagnostics and telemetry.
* Support the application of physical AI techniques — machine learning-driven perception, decision-making, and adaptive robot behavior — to real-world automation problems where practical, in coordination with more specialized resources as needed.
* Support site assessments, commissioning, acceptance testing, and production troubleshooting, prioritizing minimal disruption to live operations and supporting equipment-uptime and service-level targets.
* Document system architecture, safety assumptions, and standard operating procedures for deployed systems.
* Coordinate with robot OEMs and system integrators throughout deployment, commissioning, and warranty periods, including holding vendors accountable to timelines and performance specifications
* Communicate technical progress, system performance, and project status clearly to operations leadership and other non-technical stakeholders
* Stay current on and help evaluate emerging automation and robotics technologies.

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 3+ years of combined hands-on experience with industrial robotics/fixed robotic systems (programming and cell integration) and/or autonomous mobile robotics (AGVs/AMRs, perception, and localization, e.g., LiDAR/SLAM, ROS 2/Nav2 or equivalent); strong depth in at least one domain is required, with working knowledge of the other
* Strong C++/Python skills and Linux experience
* Practical understanding of industrial safety principles for human-robot shared environments, including familiarity with relevant robot/mobile-robot safety standards (e.g., ANSI/A3 R15.06, ISO 3691-4, or equivalent)
* Experience in logistics, warehousing, or industrial automation environments.
* Travel expected to assess robotics and automation opportunities and support initiatives and projects across the organization.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on experience applying physical AI — machine learning-based perception (e.g., OpenCV, PyTorch), decision-making, or adaptive control — to real-world robotic or automation systems.
* Experience with robot fleet management (e.g., Locus, 6 River, Fetch, Geek+), WCS/WES/WMS integration, or industrial networking (EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, etc.)
* OSHA 10/30 or equivalent safety certification
* Experience with dedicated 3D or machine-vision systems (e.g., Cognex, Keyence, Photoneo) for robotic guidance, picking, or inspection applications, beyond general camera integration
* Experience with robot simulation or offline programming tools (e.g., RoboDK, RobotStudio, Process Simulate, Gazebo, NVIDIA Isaac Sim) for cell design, testing, or validation prior to live commissioning
* Experience with telemetry, data pipelines, or observability tooling (e.g., time-series databases, dashboards such as Grafana) supporting robot or fleet diagnostics

  

**Location:** Mount Vernon/Evansville, IN or Greenville, SC

Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Controls & Electrical/Mechatronics Engineer
jobs.description:
##### **Job Description**

The Controls & Electrical/Mechatronics Engineer is responsible for owning the physical integration, machine controls, electrical systems, and mechatronic implementation of automation and robotic systems across the organization. This role supports a broad range of automation projects, including conveyors, sensors, cameras, robotic systems, material-handling equipment, safety systems, and custom fixtures or mechanisms.

This role assesses applications and sites, designs and integrates equipment, programs and troubleshoots controls, commissions systems in live warehouse environments, and supports deployed automation throughout its lifecycle. This role is expected to own projects and equipment issues from assessment through resolution with minimal oversight, and to work closely with operations leadership, OEMs, and integration partners to keep automated systems running reliably in a live, production-critical environment.

##### **Duties and Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and document electrical systems for automation and robotic equipment, including control panels, field wiring, I/O architecture, power distribution, grounding, and equipment interfaces

**Preferred**

* VFDs, servo drives, motion control, encoders, positioning, and coordinated machine motion

Collins Aerospace, an RTX company, is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Do you want to be part of a team that expects to win every time we take to the air? The Joint Precision Approach and Landing Systems (JPALS) group, working on every aspect of guiding airplanes safely to the deck, is looking for a **Senior Systems Engineer** with a passion for engineering and the desire to join the JPALS team within Precision Navigation.

This engineer will be asked to contribute to a variety of components including, but not limited to: datalink/communications, Position and Time sensors, Navigation Algorithms, Modeling, Antennas, etc. The possible activities may span the entirety of Engineering Development Lifecycle, including Design, Requirements, Validation & Verification, and Integration. A large portion of the day will be spent in the lab with hands-on equipment. With the full array of Precision Landing- enabling functionalities, the team is responsible for architecting, designing, and developing systems and producing products that serve the Land, Sea and Airborne domains. Datalinks, Airborne computing, data processing and GPS Sensor Systems are just some of the sub-products that make up the product line.

**What You Will Do**  

* Be involved in the design of brand-new Precision Approach and Landing equipment
* Perform hands-on testing in a lab environment
* Ability to create, analyze, and review mechanical drawings and schematics
* Debug Real Time Operating System Software
* Assist in performing analysis at all levels of the total system product including concept, design, fabrication, modeling, test, installation, operation, maintenance and disposal
* Help perform technical planning, system integration, verification and validation, cost and risk, and supportability and effectiveness analyses for total systems
* Assist with managing configuration process, perform functional analysis, timeline analysis, detail trade studies, requirements allocation and interface definition studies to translate customer requirements into hardware and software specifications
* Assist with decomposing customer specifications and system level requirements into sub-system and piece part requirements and generates verification criteria and plans for the requirements
* Ability to create, analyze, and review mechanical drawings and schematics
* Coordinate with cross-functional team members to complete assignments & projects as defined and on schedule

**Qualifications You Must Have**  

* Working knowledge of the Systems Engineering Discipline
* Knowledge of testing GPS functionality
* Familiarity with radio transceiver architecture/design, basic radio functional component blocks, performance specifications, and test methodologies
* Knowledge of high-assurance documentation
* Experience troubleshooting lab failures
* Experience investigating product defects, including those on the advanced radio communications equipment and avionics LRUs
* Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and minimum 5 years prior relevant experience or an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 3 years of experience

**Qualifications We Prefer**  

* Ability to read and debug low level software code
* Novice abilities in MATLAB, Simulink, or other Model Based Systems Engineering toolset

**What We Offer**  

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Three weeks of vacation for newly hired employees
* Generous 401(k) plan that includes employer matching funds and separate employer retirement contribution, including a Lifetime Income Strategy option
* Tuition reimbursement program
* Student Loan Repayment Program
* Life insurance and disability coverage
* Optional coverages you can buy pet insurance, home and auto insurance, additional life and accident insurance, critical illness insurance, group legal, ID theft protection
* Birth, adoption, parental leave benefits
* Ovia Health, fertility, and family planning
* Adoption Assistance
* Autism Benefit
* Employee Assistance Plan, including up to 10 free counseling sessions
* Healthy You Incentives, wellness rewards program
* Doctor on Demand, virtual doctor visits
* Bright Horizons, child and elder care services
* Teladoc Medical Experts, second opinion program
* **This position is eligible for relocation assistance**
* And more!

We are seeking a full-time **Software Engineer 2** at Garmin's U.S. headquarters in the Greater Kansas City area. In this role, you will help our team advance the frontier of our activity recording technologies that power Outdoor and Fitness wearables and products. You’ll be focused on both adding and updating functionality and features to support their ubiquitous use in Garmin Fitness and Outdoor devices. Success in this role requires strong software engineering skills, enthusiasm for solving difficult technical problems, and a passion for building reliable products used by millions of Garmin customers worldwide.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer (Engineer II)
jobs.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.  

**JOB SUMMARY**  
Designs, fabricates, modifies, evaluates and documents assembly processes, components, and automated systems to produce or improve company products and facilitate manufacturing operations. Develops data and makes preliminary sketches, lay-outs and notes required to present design proposals. Researches basic design factors such as ease of manufacture and availability of materials and equipment. Works with other organizations impacted by design development.

Responsible for the design, integration, and deployment of automation systems supporting high-level assembly and integration of advanced compute and AI-based server rack products at Jabil’s Florence, KY facility. This position requires application of industrial engineering, mechatronics, robotics automation principles to develop automated manufacturing solutions that improve throughput, yield, and process stability. The role involves end-to-end system integration of automated robotics, vision system implementation, controls configuration, and automation validation.

May perform work in a specific sub-specialty such as Design, Automation, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Technical Project Management, and/or Process Improvement. Please see addendum for specific sub-specialty requirements. This description is designed to capture the general elements of Engineering work in a manufacturing setting.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Design and develops complex assembly processes, initiates process improvement initiatives for server rack assembly and integration, system level validation, and packaging as assigned.

jobs.description:
**Description**

Are you interested in hypersonic and reentry system design and prototyping?

Do you want to make contributions that accelerate the readiness of our Nation’s defenses to support next generation hypersonic and reentry systems?

If so, we are seeking a highly technical senior systems engineer to help assess, design, and prototype next generation hypersonic, reentry systems and enabling technologies. As a member of our team, you’ll be making critical contributions to develop these next generation systems, ensuring the enduring effectiveness of our Nation’s strategic deterrent. You will be joining a complementary team of engineers who work together to provide impactful solutions to system level objectives and challenges. We are passionate about innovation and our team is committed to providing engaging challenging work and supporting continued learning and development.

**As a Senior Systems Engineer you will…**

* Provide systems engineering expertise and leadership to assess weapon system capabilities and support/lead the development of next generation reentry systems, hypersonic systems, and enabling technologies.
* Collaborate and engage with multi-disciplinary project engineering teams within APL, government sponsors, military personnel, and industry partners to develop innovative solutions.
* You will prepare for and participate in major design and requirements reviews.
* Participate in government working groups and/or integrated product teams to evaluate industry concepts, designs, and proposals to provide technical recommendations to government sponsors.
* Engage with senior government, industry, and national laboratory leadership on fast-paced, high-visibility defense programs.
* Produce reports and presentations to communicate analysis results, concepts, proposals and recommendations to leadership, external organization partners, and government sponsors.

  
**Qualifications**

**You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you...**

* Have a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related discipline.
* Have minimum 10 years of relevant experience.
* Have experience with complex hardware / software prototype development.
* Have experience leading highly technical cross-functional teams of engineers.
* Have experience in early concept development efforts to include gap assessments, design trade studies, requirements analysis, and risk assessment.
* Have demonstrated ability to interact effectively with and lead multidisciplinary teams, including industry and government sponsors.
* Have initiative and drive to make meaningful contributions to an important mission.
* Hold an active Secret security clearance and can ultimately obtain Top Secret level clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

**You'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you...**

* Have a Master's degree in Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Aerospace Engineering.
* Have experience in the design or development of reentry, hypersonic, or space systems and relevant technologies.
* Have experience engaging with high level government and/or defense industry leadership on highly technical topics.
* Have experience preparing for and participating in major design reviews such as System Requirements Review (SRR), Preliminary Design Review (PDR), Critical Design Review (CDR), and Test Readiness Review (TRR).
* Have knowledge of the Navy Trident II Strategic Weapon System and/or Air Force ICBM System.
* Hold an active Secret or higher level clearance.

  
**About Us**

**Why Work at APL?**

The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) brings world-class expertise to our nation’s most critical defense, security, space and science challenges. While we are dedicated to solving complex challenges and pioneering new technologies, what makes us truly outstanding is our culture. We offer a vibrant, welcoming atmosphere where you can bring your authentic self to work, continue to grow, and build strong connections with inspiring teammates.

This opportunity resides with **Warfare Systems (WS)**, a business group within HII’s Mission Technologies division. Warfare Systems comprises cyber and mission IT; electronic warfare; and C5ISR systems.

HII works within our nation’s intelligence and cyber operations communities to defend our interests in cyberspace and anticipate emerging threats. Our capabilities in cybersecurity, network architecture, reverse engineering, software and hardware development uniquely enable us to support sensitive missions for the U.S. military and federal agency partners.

  

**Leadership Mindset at HII – Mission Technologies**

Leadership at HII is a mindset, not a title. Through our Leadership Capability Framework, we define how every team member contributes to our mission and culture:

* **Know & Grow Your People** – Commit to learning and supporting team success.
* **Build Relationships** – Communicate openly, collaborate well, and build trust.
* **Take Ownership** – Deliver on commitments and take pride in your work.
* **Customer First** – Focus on the mission and those we serve.
* **Shape the Future** – Bring ideas, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
* **Act with Urgency** – Take initiative and follow through with purpose.

These capabilities guide how all employees contribute to our shared success across Mission Technologies.

**Job Description**
-------------------

Warfare Systems (WS), a division of HII Mission Technologies provides full-spectrum cyber, EW, and space capabilities that address today’s rapidly changing, multi-domain global security threats, and anticipate emerging threats. We are a diverse organization offering competitive and challenging opportunities to highly motivated and talented individuals.

WS is seeking multiple Software Engineers (Levels 0–2) to design, develop, maintain, and enhance complex software systems, including data‑intensive analytics, novel algorithms, large‑scale data processing, real‑time applications, and business information systems.

Engineers will work independently or as part of a team to implement requirements, review and test software components for compliance with design specifications, and document test results. They will troubleshoot and resolve software issues, apply development and design methodologies appropriate to the environment, and support system‑level design by evaluating hardware/software tradeoffs, promoting software reuse, and assessing COTS/GOTS solutions. Responsibilities also include participating in requirements analysis and translating system‑level needs into implementable software components.

  

**This posting is to collect applications for current and future openings for HII Mission Technologies. Candidates will be screened as opportunities come available and selected candidates will be contacted about an opportunity.**

  

**We are hiring across multiple levels with a range of professional experience. Salary ranges below:**

* Software Engineer 1: $105,000 - $145,000
* Software Engineer 2: $135,000 - $175,000

**Essential Job Responsibilities**
----------------------------------

* Analyze user and system requirements to define software design, performance needs, and technical constraints.
* Design, develop, modify, and integrate software solutions, including new features and adaptations for new environments or hardware.
* Debug and troubleshoot software defects, ensuring functionality, performance, and reliability.
* Develop and implement algorithms and database interfaces/queries, ranging from simple to highly complex.
* Conduct system and data flow analysis to support solution design and performance optimization.
* Create, review, and improve software and system documentation, development processes, and standards.
* Collaborate with system engineers, hardware engineers, and users to refine requirements and resolve technical challenges.
* Assist in developing and executing test procedures, performing quality control, and validating software functionality.
* Coordinate software installations, monitor system performance, and ensure operational compliance.
* Recommend and evaluate new technologies, tools, and development processes for complex software projects.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

**Software Engineer 1**

* BS in Computer Science, Information Systems, Network Engineering or related field and nine (9) years relevant experience.
* Two (2) additional years of relevant Software Engineering experience may be substituted for a bachelor's degree.
* Two (2) years of experience programming in Linux/Windows environments and working with DevOps CI/CD pipelines.

**Software Engineer 2**

* BS in Computer Science, Information Systems, Network Engineering or related field and fifteen (15) years relevant experience.
* Three (3) additional years of relevant Software Engineering experience may be substituted for a bachelor's degree.
* Six (6) years of experience programming in Linux/Windows environments and working with DevOps CI/CD pipelines.

***TS/SCI w/ Poly required for consideration***

The listed salary range for this role is intended as a good faith estimate based on the role's location, expectations, and responsibilities. When extending an offer, HII's Mission Technologies division takes a variety of factors into consideration which include, but are not limited to, the role's function and a candidate's education or training, work experience, and key skills.

Our team of more than 7,000 professionals worldwide delivers all-domain expertise and advanced technologies in service of mission partner
