jobs.description:
**Description**

Do you love diving deep into multi-physics calculations, exploring design limits, and technical trade space to verify whether an integrated system will perform in a complex operational environment?

Are you searching for technically challenging work that directly bolsters the credibility of our nation's strategic deterrent? Are you passionate about first-principles engineering analysis over routine process management?

If so, we're looking for someone like you to join our team at APL.

We are seeking a Multidisciplinary Systems Engineer (Systems Design Analysis focus) to help us ensure the physical realization, operational durability, and technical credibility of strategic weapon systems. Based within the System Realization and Resilience Group in the Force Projection Sector's Strategic Deterrence Mission Area, you will be joining a dedicated team of engineers and scientists addressing complex, multidisciplinary defense challenges. Our team is committed to delivering objective technical insights that influence the physical design and specialty engineering integration of strategic platforms. We value intellectual candor, technical depth, and collaborative teamwork focused on solving critical engineering problems.

As a Physical Systems Design Analysis Engineer...

* Your primary responsibility will be to perform first-principles engineering calculations and detailed physical design analyses across integrated mechanical, electrical, thermal, nuclear, or fluid subsystems.
* You will execute quantitative trade studies, sensitivity analyses, and margin evaluations to assess physical system behavior under harsh operational and threat environments.
* You will identify systemic design vulnerabilities and cross-discipline interface conflicts, providing data-driven recommendations to guide system design and hardware realization.
* You will link physical analysis results and design constraints back into the digital engineering baseline, collaborating with systems engineers utilizing Cameo Enterprise Architect / MagicDraw.

  
  
**Qualifications**

You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you...

* Possess a BS in Aerospace, Electrical, Mechanical, Nuclear, Chemical Engineering, or a closely related physical engineering discipline.
* Have 2+ years of professional experience performing hands-on engineering design analysis, numerical modeling, or multi-physics calculations on complex physical systems.
* Are skilled in analyzing system engineering technical trade space, interface tolerances, and environmental survivability parameters.
* Have a working knowledge of Systems Engineering methods and practical familiarity with MBSE principles and Cameo Enterprise Architect / MagicDraw.
* Are willing and able to travel periodically (approximately 5–10%), including visits to sponsor sites, test ranges, and contractor facilities.

If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

* Have 5+ years of professional experience performing hands-on engineering design analysis, numerical modeling, or multi-physics calculations on complex physical systems.

* Hold an active Top Secret security clearance or TS/SCI.
* Have experience with reliability engineering, nuclear surety, or specialty engineering disciplines applied to strategic missiles, reentry systems, or launch platforms.
* Have experience supporting Navy Strategic Systems Programs (such as Trident II D5) or Air Force strategic deterrent programs.

At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP believes in the power of humans to transform how they feel, perform and age; we serve the aspiring!

WHOOP is hiring an Electrical Engineer II to help accelerate the development of the next generation of WHOOP wearable technology and supporting hardware. As a member of the Hardware Engineering team, you will play a highly hands-on role in the design, test, characterization, and tuning of electrical circuitry, using rapid experimentation to build a deep understanding of system performance and drive better engineering decisions. You will work closely with Electrical, Mechanical, Firmware, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Software teams to design and evaluate new hardware, investigate unexpected behavior, resolve complex technical challenges, and move products quickly from prototype to robust, production-ready solutions.

---------------------

* Design, test, characterize, debug, and tune low-power, mixed-signal electronic circuits and systems throughout the product development lifecycle
* Contribute to schematic design, component selection, PCB development, hardware prototyping, board bring-up, and design iteration
* Develop and execute electrical experiments and characterization plans to understand system behavior, evaluate performance, identify root causes, and guide design improvements
* Analyze test data and collaborate across Electrical, Firmware, Mechanical, and other engineering teams to optimize circuit performance, power consumption, signal integrity, reliability, and overall system performance

* 3+ years of relevant electrical engineering experience developing, testing, or debugging electronic hardware
* Strong understanding of electrical engineering fundamentals, including analog and digital circuit design, power management, signal integrity, and common communication interfaces

* Experience reading and developing schematics and working with ECAD tools such as Altium or equivalent

**General Summary:**

  

Vertex’s Automation of Machinery and Processes (AMP) Team is seeking a high-impact leader to develop cutting-edge manufacturing solutions for its Cell & Genetic Therapies programs. This pivotal role is at the forefront of automating complex processes in one of the most dynamic and rapidly evolving fields in biotechnology. You will work with a passionate team of engineers, scientists, and innovators united by a shared mission: to push the boundaries of what’s possible in Cell & Genetic Therapy. This critical position will lead an interdisciplinary engineering team in novel equipment & systems development, vendor selection, equipment qualification, technology transfer, and continuous improvement to deliver robust and reliable manufacturing systems.

  

**Key Duties and Responsibilities:**

  

* Lead a team of equipment and automation engineers involved in the design, development, deployment, and qualification of custom automation equipment and operation technology systems used for the development and manufacture of cell and genetic therapies.

* Lead Equipment, System, and Automaton Projects from concept through execution in a dynamic development environment. Ensures user requirements are clearly defined and translated into achievable and testable engineering requirements.

* Manage and execute the development of mechanical, electrical, and controls systems for capital equipment. Define automation execution strategy from concept feasibility through commercial deployment. Present to senior leadership as required.

* Responsible for active oversight of the equipment / system design and commissioning process. Collaborate with vendors to produce prototype and production parts. Perform engineering analyses and relevant physical testing on designs.

* Utilize operations simulation tools to identify and quantify automation opportunities.

* Ensures seamless integration of automation control systems into existing enterprise systems.

* Provide hands-on troubleshooting assistance to manufacturing in support of a rapid development cycle and manufacturing sustainability.

* Collaborates with manufacturing engineering to define, manage, and continuously improve equipment performance, preventative maintenance plans, and spare parts lists/inventory.

* Evaluate and recommend automation upgrades to existing equipment or systems. Prioritize projects and assign resources to complete projects on-time and within budget.

* Review and/or draft Equipment Drawings, Electrical Diagrams, System Manuals, Engineering Protocols and Reports, Validation Documentation, and other Quality System Documentation.

* Develop departmental procedures for development and documentation of automated systems, from specifications through operational procedures.

* Support Deviation Management, CAPA, and Change Control activities, as required. Serve as Automation SME to Quality, Manufacturing, and other Functions. Support manufacturing investigations, including OOSs, OOTs, RCAs, etc.

* Execute assigned duties on time and within budget; proactively telegraph delays and other issues to relevant stakeholders.

Comply with all regulatory, corporate, and Quality System policies and complete other projects and/or assignments as required.  



**Knowledge and Skills:**

  

* High degree of electromechanical aptitude with prior experience in designing and implementing automated precision manufacturing equipment, including integration of vision systems and robotics, in bioprocessing, medical device, pharmaceutical, automotive, semiconductor, or diagnostic systems.

* Ability to organize and grow a team through organizational change and personnel development.

* Experience with automation and equipment business case definition, vendor selection and management, automation and equipment design, development, commissioning, and validation. Experience developing and executing equipment strategy from concept to deployment.

* Experience working with a variety of automation hardware, software and applications including, but not limited to, custom-fabricated mechanical components and mechanisms, single-use bioreactors and bioprocessing instruments, vision systems, robotics, AMR and AGV, control systems (PLC, DeltaV, PC), AI-enabled systems, and related control system components, pneumatics, automated process instrumentation.

* Proficiency in AI tools and applications with experience developing for lab and manufacturing applications.

* Experience qualifying/validating/deploying manufacturing equipment and processes is required. Knowledge and experience in utilizing risk-based approaches to validation process development and validation are highly advantageous.

* Familiarity with ISO 13485, ISO 14971, 21 CFR 820, 21 CFR 211, and ICH Q7/8/9. Knowledge of global GMP requirements governing device or combination products.

* Familiarity with equipment safety standards and regulations including OSHA 19 CFR 1910, NFPA 70, NFPA 79, ISO 18849-1.

* Strong interpersonal, project management, technical writing and presentation skills required.

* Sense of urgency, ability to act/escalate promptly, and transparently communicate issues to involved stakeholders and management.

Want to discover just how far your intellectual curiosity can take you? You’re in the right place. For more than four decades, Axcelis Technologies has been at the forefront of innovation in semiconductor manufacturing technology. Chipmakers around the globe rely on our tools and process expertise to deliver the semiconductors that power modern life from smartphones and computers to cameras and cars. We have become a technology leader by providing the innovation necessary for business to thrive, quality of life to advance, and the environment to flourish—enabling a truly sustainable future.

Our influence is global, with more than 30 offices worldwide, an installed base of thousands worldwide and a customer list that includes the world’s largest semiconductor manufacturers. Our team is expanding, and we are currently hiring a **Senior Electrical Engineer** to work out of our corporate office in **Beverly, MA**.

**Responsibilities:**

* Designs, develops, modifies and evaluates electronic parts, components or integrated circuitry for electronic equipment, or other hardware systems and/or electrical engineering applications.
* Execute engineering projects and development of electromechanical systems including power distribution, vacuum systems, high voltage, control systems, robotics, safety interlocks and electro-static chuck technologies.
* Ensures adherence to the development process including requirements planning, schedule estimates, concept reviews, design reviews, verification, and validation test plans.
* Provide electrical engineering interface to the design services group and to offshore teams to deliver quality designs and on-time performance.
* Analyzes equipment to establish operating data, conducts experimental tests and evaluates results.
* Ensures designs meet design objectives as well as safety, industry (SEMI), and customer specific requirements.
* Selects components and equipment based on analysis of specifications and reliability.
* May also review vendor capability to support product development.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or related required.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience of electrical/electronic hardware design as an individual contributor.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Experience conducting technical design reviews with a larger group
* Experience working with engineering change notices in formal change process
* One or more of the following Experience: Systems engineering, High-voltage, RF power, PCB design, Power Distribution
* Design skills with Altium, PADS, PSpice
* Experience with Creo Schematic, Creo Cabling, AutoCad is a plus.
* Windchill experience a plus

Semiconductor capital equipment experience a plus

jobs.title: Sr Robotics Software Engineer, Amazon Robotics
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Robotics is building a brand-new robotics manipulation platform, and we need a versatile software engineer to help bring it to life. In this role, you will own critical software components spanning robotics middleware, health monitoring, and fleet management — systems that must work reliably for a single robot and scale to fleets of thousands. You will work across a broad technology stack, from real-time C++ on the robot to full-stack web applications on AWS, while applying generative AI to automate and streamline operational workflows.  
  
This is a greenfield opportunity where your architectural decisions will shape how Amazon's next generation of robotic systems operate. You will lead multi-engineer projects, influence technical direction across peer teams, and mentor junior engineers — all while writing exemplary code that sets the standard for your team. If you are a curious, adaptable engineer who thrives on solving hard problems across multiple technology domains, we would love to hear from you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design, build, and own software components for robotics middleware, health monitoring, and fleet management that scale from individual robots to fleets of thousands.
* Lead the technical design and architecture of systems on a new robotics manipulation platform, balancing real-time performance constraints with long-term extensibility and maintainability.
* Collaborate with peer robotics, hardware, and operations teams to define interfaces, resolve cross-team dependencies, and ensure successful end-to-end delivery of integrated robotic systems.
* Apply generative AI tools and techniques to automate workflows, improve developer productivity, and accelerate the team's ability to iterate on new capabilities.
* Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and hands-on guidance, raising the overall quality and engineering practices of the team.

  
A day in the life  
You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, owning your projects from concept through production deployment. On a given day you might be writing real-time C++ for robot control in the morning, reviewing a teammate's AWS service design after lunch, and prototyping a generative AI workflow automation by end of day. You will regularly connect with stakeholders across peer robotics and operations teams to align on priorities, unblock dependencies, and share technical insights — while also carving out focused time for deep, heads-down engineering work.  
  
Amazon offers a full range of benefits that assist you and eligible family members, including domestic partners. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
  
1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage  
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options  
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)  
4. 401(k) Plan
  
  
If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!  
  
About the team  
Our team is developing a new robotics manipulation platform at Amazon Robotics that aims to be as transformative as mobile robots have been for fulfillment operations. We are a 40+ person organization with a dedicated software group of 10+ engineers working alongside mechanical, electrical, and systems engineers. We value collaboration, technical rigor, and a willingness to experiment. As the platform grows, you will have the opportunity to scale systems that directly improve the customer experience and shape the future of robotic automation at Amazon.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Expert level skills in C++
* Experience working on software libraries and tools for building robot applications and/or communication middle-ware.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Experience with robotic motion control systems and algorithms.
* Experience with robotic operating environments like ROS.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer, Test Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form!

In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by *TIME* as a “Best Invention”, *MIT Technology Review* as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and *Fast Company* as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia.

Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing - might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.

**Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.**

**Role Description**
--------------------

Form Energy is hiring a Senior Electrical Engineer for the Test Infrastructure Team in Somerville, Massachusetts. In this role you will be responsible for the design and delivery of test equipment that enables the execution of critical tests across our iron-air battery systems and supporting hardware. The scope of your work will range from simple fixture development and material handling systems through complex verification test beds used in the evaluation of our battery systems.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the scaling of our battery technology and be part of the growth of a fast-moving company with breakthrough technology and an incredible mission!

*Relocation assistance is available.*

### **What you'll do:**

* Design, build, and deploy custom test equipment used in the electrical testing of battery hardware and software.
* Modify existing designs to accommodate new requirements and test objectives.
* Create electrical schematics to capture complex test system designs including the design of control panels, test racks, custom PCBAs, harnesses, etc.
* Collaborate with mechanical engineers on the physical form factor of test stands, optimizing for operability, maintenance and safety.
* Ensure electrical equipment designs meet safety, reliability, and compliance standards for high-power and hazardous systems.
* Document test system designs, usage guidelines, and validation procedures.
* Support troubleshooting, maintenance, and continuous improvement of deployed test infrastructure.

### **What you'll bring:**

* BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering or related field.
* 4+ years of experience in electrical design and/or test equipment development (battery or energy systems experience is a plus).
* Proficiency with eCAD tools (Altium, AutoCAD Electrical, E-Plan, etc.)
* Experience designing control panels adhering to UL508A standards.
* Experience specifying electronic test hardware (PLC IO cards, power supplies, circuit protection, etc).
* Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance speed, rigor, and safety.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment.

*#LI-Onsite*

*Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here.*

*When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed.*

*To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.*

*If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.*  
  
*Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will* ***never*** *solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.*

The Radar Analog and Power Department is seeking electrical engineers with knowledge of analog electronics, power electronics, power systems, and/or control systems. The ideal candidate possesses a strong combination of design experience, electronics knowledge, and hands-on laboratory skills.

The department is responsible for design engineering including the following areas:

  

* Power System Design - Power System Noise, System Simulation and Modeling, Solid State Transmitters, Tube Transmitters, High Voltage Design, Power Sources, Generators

* Control Systems – Servo Control Systems, Motor/Power/Process Control, Digital Feedback Systems, Command Generation, Inertial Stabilization, Navigation Algorithms

This position is an onsite role.

**What you will do**

  

* Work closely with a team of engineers to develop proven designs based on system performance and operational specifications.
* Design, analyze, simulate, test, and document power conversion (and related analog) circuitry.
* Resolve production issues related to existing product designs
* Work to further our department’s mastery of digital power conversion concepts and help develop related best practices.
* Perform design work within the bounds of a given schedule.
* Present reviews of technical data to program leadership, technical staff, and customer community. Manage related risk discussions.
* Lead small teams to success with schedule, budget, and technical execution
* Engage in personal technical growth and facilitate technical growth in peers and junior engineers. Help to understand what opportunities are needed to mature the organization on the technical front.
* Regular travel to Tewksbury, MA; Marlborough, MA; Andover, MA; Woburn, MA; and/or Pelham, NH may be required depending on the assignment.

**Qualifications you must have**

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) major.
* Minimum of 8+ years of design and/or production experience with power systems, power conversion, power distribution, power sub-system design and/or control systems
* Experience in modeling and simulation using PSPICE, MATLAB/Simulink, or similar computer-based tools.
* Experience with a schematic capture CAD package

**Qualifications we prefer**

  

* Advanced degree in Electrical Engineering
* Hardware development experience in the Department of Defense (DoD) environment
* Demonstrated ability to lead/manage a technical team to achieve schedule, budget, and technical commitments
* Experience generating technical documentation and reports
* Experience with requirements development and decomposition
* Knowledge of test and production methods for electronics/power system components
* Experience interfacing with procurement and manufacturing as well as external suppliers to ensure proper implementation of product designs
* Experience interfacing with DoD customer community
* Proposal development experience
* Experience with intellectual property generation (patents & publications)
* Existing security clearance
* Excellent written and verbal communication

* Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer – Hardware Obsolescence Management
jobs.description:
Basic Qualifications :

Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, or a related Science, Engineering or Mathematics field, plus a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree, plus 6 months of relevant experience.

**CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:**  
Department of Defense Secret security clearance is obtainable within a reasonable amount of time after hire. Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. Government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship is required.

Responsibilities for this Position:

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a Systems Engineer to support the long-term sustainment of a fire control system by identifying and mitigating hardware obsolescence risks. In this role, you will assess the system-level impact of unavailable or end-of-life components, evaluate replacement options, and help implement changes that preserve required performance, reliability, safety, and supportability.

**Responsibilities**

* Monitor hardware lifecycle status and identify components at risk of obsolescence.
* Maintain an obsolescence risk register covering affected parts, system configurations, inventory, projected demand, and decision timelines.
* Analyze how proposed substitutions or redesigns affect system requirements, interfaces, software dependencies, reliability, and maintainability.
* Develop and document mitigation options, such as qualified alternate parts, last-time buys, repair solutions, module redesigns, and planned technology refreshes.
* Lead or contribute to trade studies evaluating technical risk, cost, schedule, availability, and verification effort.
* Define requirements and verification approaches for replacement hardware.
* Coordinate with hardware and software engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, quality, reliability, and program management teams.
* Support configuration management and change-control activities, including updates to technical documentation and parts lists.
* Communicate risks, recommendations, and implementation status to program stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in systems engineering, hardware engineering, or product sustainment.
* Ability to analyze requirements, interfaces, and the system-level effects of hardware changes.
* Experience evaluating technical alternatives and documenting engineering decisions.
* Familiarity with configuration management, verification planning, and risk management.
* Strong written communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with hardware obsolescence or diminishing manufacturing sources and material shortages (DMSMS).
* Familiarity with electronic component lifecycles, bills of materials, supplier data, and product lifecycle management tools.
* Experience supporting complex, safety-critical, or long-life systems.
* Experience planning qualification activities for component substitutions or hardware redesigns.

**Workplace Options:**  
This position is fully on-site.  
While on-site, you will be a part of the FBM Sustainment Team in OP1 Pittsfield, MA.

jobs.title: IT Systems Engineer, Client Platform Engineer, macOS
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

The Endpoint team (Client Platform Engineering) treats Anthropic's device fleet as a platform we build and run. We run our own MDM as a production service and manage every piece of device configuration as code. Policies, configuration profiles, queries, remediation scripts, and software all ship through pull requests, CI, a staging environment, and a canary group before they reach the fleet. The fleet is mostly macOS, plus a small number of Linux machines and a growing mobile footprint.

You'll own that platform end to end: the infrastructure underneath the MDM, the configuration on top of it, the patching and software pipelines that keep thousands of devices patched and secure, and the telemetry that tells us what is actually true on every device. You'll also build automation that cuts down on manual operational work. You'll work with Security teams on hardening, compliance controls, and detection and response, and with developer and infrastructure teams to make sure those controls don't get in the way of their work. Your work will let us base access decisions on whether a device can be trusted.

We value people who double check a compliance report before they believe it. The team is deliberately lean and runs with high autonomy. You'll help define the endpoint roadmap, make architecture decisions, and own the platform every Anthropic employee's work runs on. You'll also help us meet the security standards our Responsible Scaling Policy requires as models advance.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own endpoint configuration as code: author, review, test, and progressively roll out MDM policies, configuration profiles, and remediation scripts across macOS and mobile, with canary stages and rollback built in
* Operate the MDM platform itself as a production service, including infrastructure as code, observability, upgrades, and incident response
* Build patch management automation with rapid enforcement timelines while maintaining good user experience
* Design zero touch provisioning that turns a sealed box into a productive machine on day one
* Support a small number of Linux machines alongside the Mac fleet
* Turn fleet telemetry into policy, dashboards, and early drift warnings, and use Claude to automate manual ops work
* Partner with Corporate Security on endpoint hardening, binary authorization, and compliance controls
* Take shifts on the team's rotation for incoming requests and escalations, and serve as the deep escalation tier for endpoint issues IT Operations can't resolve

**You may be a good fit if you**
--------------------------------

* Have 8+ years building secure IT systems in complex environments, including leading projects across multiple teams
* Have managed endpoint fleets of thousands of macOS devices through a modern MDM
* Treat endpoint configuration as code that is version controlled and peer reviewed, rather than clicking in consoles
* Go deep on macOS internals such as launchd, configuration profiles, TCC, and system extensions
* Write Python and shell scripts
* Write design docs and runbooks so teammates can review and support what you build

**Strong candidates may also have**
-----------------------------------

* Have operated an MDM or device management platform as a service, not only consumed one as SaaS
* Have worked with open source endpoint and device management tooling (Munki, osquery, AutoPkg)
* Have built automated, progressive rollout systems with promotion gated on telemetry
* Have experience running infrastructure as code in a public cloud
* Have working knowledge of Linux administration (packaging, systems, config management)
* Have used LLMs to automate ops work

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

$285,000 - $325,000 USD

jobs.description:
**Description**

Keeper Security is hiring a Senior Software Engineer, iOS to join our mobile engineering team and help build secure, high-performance iOS applications used by millions of customers worldwide. This is a 100% remote position, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the El Dorado Hills, CA or Chicago, IL metro areas.

Keeper's cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help architect and evolve the iOS experiences that support Keeper's security platform.

  

**About Keeper**

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.

==========================================================

**Job Summary**

In this role, you will design and deliver production automotive embedded software spanning microcontroller (MCU) and System-on-Chip (SoC) platforms. Your work will connect vehicle signals, sensors, and real-time controls to the services that power driver-facing alerts, controls, and situational-awareness experiences. jobs.title: Principal Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients— that is what Vantive aspires to deliver.

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.

**Your Role:**

As a Principal Controls Engineer supporting Vantive’s Acute Therapies portfolio, you will be a key contributor in the model-based development and verification of control algorithms for the PrisMax system. Your work will shape how the device interprets sensor inputs, controls electromechanical components, manages operating states, and supports safe, reliable therapy delivery.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for an engineer who can take a complex control problem from system behavior and requirements through algorithm design, simulation, embedded implementation, and verification. You partner with Systems, Software, Hardware, Quality, and V&V develop, verify, and document effective control solutions.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

**Control Algorithm Design and Model-Based Development**

* Take technical ownership of complex PrisMax control algorithms, from expected system behavior and requirements through model architecture, implementation, integration, and lifecycle changes.
* Develop and refine algorithms using MATLAB, Simulink, and Stateflow for functions involving sensors, pumps, motors, valves, alarms, and therapy-related calculations.
* Apply control theory, dynamic-system analysis, and sound engineering judgment to evaluate performance across intended operating conditions, component variation, and foreseeable faults.
* Produce model-generated code and partner with Software Engineering on interfaces, execution behavior, and integration into the device’s embedded software.

**Verify Control Algorithms**

* Define verification approaches for model-based algorithms, including model review, simulation, coverage analysis, interface testing, and testing of integrated software or device behavior.
* Develop and review test cases that challenge nominal, boundary, fault, and difficult-to-reproduce conditions; ensure expected results and acceptance criteria are clear.
* Lead the technical analysis of test results and discrepancies, distinguish model defects from interface or integration issues, and drive robust resolutions.
* Produce clear, traceable design and verification documentation that supports formal test execution, design reviews, and product development records.

**Advance Modeling and Simulation**

* Contribute to fit-for-purpose models of device components and system dynamics so control concepts can be evaluated before and alongside physical-device testing.
* Use model-in-the-loop, software-in-the-loop, and hardware-in-the-loop methods where appropriate to explore design tradeoffs, characterize performance, and expose integration risks.
* Document model assumptions, interfaces, limitations, and supporting evidence so simulation results can be interpreted and reused responsibly.

**Strengthen Controls Engineering**

* Lead reviews of algorithm designs and verification strategies, making tradeoffs and technical risks visible to cross-functional partners.
* Mentor engineers in model-based design, controls analysis, testability, and disciplined problem solving while remaining directly involved in critical technical work.
* Identify opportunities to improve the controls development practice by introducing reusable models, robust test techniques, and common design practices to enhance the quality and maintainability of control algorithms.

**What You’ll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Controls Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 6+ years of relevant engineering experience, including substantial hands-on development of control algorithms for embedded electromechanical products.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree or PhD in Controls, Electrical, Mechanical, Biomedical, Systems, or a related engineering discipline.
* Demonstrated experience designing and testing executable control models using MATLAB, Simulink, and Stateflow, or a closely comparable model-based development environment.
* Experience with model-generated code and its integration into real-time embedded software.
* Experience with plant modeling, physics-based simulation, and model-in-the-loop, software-in-the-loop, or hardware-in-the-loop testing.
* Ability to independently resolve complex technical problems, lead design reviews, and influence complex technical decision making when issues arise.
* Experience developing medical devices or other safety-critical products, including requirements traceability, risk-informed design, configuration control, and formal documentation.
* Experience modeling fluidic, thermal, electromechanical, or physiological-system behavior relevant.

jobs.description:
### **Description**

We’re SmartThings, one of the leading IoT ecosystems in the world, creating the most effortless way for anyone to create a smart home. We're a wholly owned subsidiary of Samsung with corporate offices in Minneapolis and the Bay Area.  
  
More than 430 million people worldwide use SmartThings to control and manage their connected life. SmartThings delivers simple, powerful experiences across Samsung’s leading portfolio of phones, TVs, and appliances. We also offer the most versatile smart home experience as an open platform with a rich partner ecosystem (think IKEA, SONOS, Honeywell, and so many more). As a founding member of Matter, we are a leader in the industry to help make smart homes more secure, reliable and seamless to use. Come be a part of the leading edge of IoT innovation!  
  
**About The Team:** The Hub Platform team owns foundational software, infrastructure, and operational practices that power SmartThings hubs in the field, and we're building the architecture that lets us support future hub platforms as they come online. The SmartThings Hub acts as a secure edge gateway that translates and bridges local, cross-protocol IoT devices to the SmartThings cloud, enabling centralized routing and execution across a unified ecosystem. We work across three pillars:

* Hub Systems & Architecture: the embedded Linux OS, secure boot chain, firmware rollout process, and hardware platform abstraction
* Hub to Cloud Connections & Attestation: secure hub-to-cloud connectivity, device claim, and attestation so every hub in the field is uniquely identified and trusted
* Hub Developer Operations: the CI/build infrastructure that keeps the entire hub engineering org shipping reliably and the tooling that keeps engineers developing efficiently

Our work sits at the intersection of embedded firmware and cloud services, and it directly determines the stability, security, and update reliability that millions of connected homes rely on every day.

**About The Role:** We're looking for a **Staff Software Engineer** to be a technical owner and leader for the Hub Platform team. You'll help drive long-term technical strategies for our core domains. You'll operate with autonomy to bring clarity to complex, cross-functional challenges. You’ll act as a go-to expert and point of contact for major initiatives, and partner closely with firmware, security, cloud, and product teams to shape how SmartThings hubs evolve. You'll also mentor engineers across the team, including senior engineers, and help guide how the team adopts AI-assisted development and operational practices.

This role is **hybrid, 3 days/week in our Minneapolis Office** (on iconic St Anthony Main across from Downtown...with paid attached parking!).

The pay range for this role is **$139,000 to $198,000,** with an annual bonus target of 20%.

### **Key Responsibilities**

This position is a hybrid role, based onsite 3 days a week at our office in Minneapolis, MN.  
  
In this role, your primary responsibilities will include the following:

* **Technical Strategy Ownership:** Define and drive long-term technical vision for one or more Hub Platform team domains so that our solutions scale to support future hub platforms.
* **Lead Complex Initiatives:** Act as a technical owner for large, complex, cross-functional projects, architecting scalable solutions for evolving domain needs.
* **Architect for Reliability & Security:** Guide architecture and design decisions for systems like the firmware update pipeline, hub OS platform abstraction, B2B partner integrations, or hub-to-cloud connectivity, with stability, security, and operational excellence as first-class concerns.
* **AI Practices & Vision Collaboration:** Help define how the team uses AI-assisted development and operational tooling, evaluating where AI can meaningfully improve velocity and quality, and set a forward-looking vision for responsible AI adoption in the organization.
* **Cross-Functional Partnership:** Collaborate with firmware, security, cloud infrastructure, and product management to keep technical direction aligned with product requirements and business needs.
* **Mentor & Elevate the Team:** Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers at every level, including senior engineers, and help build engineering practices that raise the bar across the org.
* **Operational Excellence & On-Call:** Participate in observability, incident response, and on-call rotations supporting the production firmware delivery, hub connectivity, and attestation services that the global hub fleet depends on.

### **Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**

* 8+ years of production software engineering experience, with a demonstrated track record operating at a Staff-level technical leadership capacity

**Job Title**
=============

Automation Engineer

**Job Description Summary**
===========================

**Job Description**
===================

At C&W Services, we live by the belief that “Better Never Settles.” We're dedicated to creating a positive impact globally and we're looking for talented individuals to join our team.

**C&W Services provides compelling benefits, including:**

* Weekly pay
* Comprehensive benefits starting on your first day
* Training, development, and advancement opportunities
* A clean and cutting-edge facility
* A safety-first culture

**About the Role:**

As an Automation Engineer (AE), you will support the site maintenance team to ensure operational performance and efficiency of Material Handling Equipment (MHE) control systems. You will partner with the maintenance team to troubleshoot and maintain equipment such as conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print-and-apply labeling systems, scales, HMI systems, control cabinets, and more. The AE provides support to the operations and maintenance teams by implementing solutions for complex problems and tracking related projects. You may lead and/or assist other technicians with their development through continuity of knowledge, all while working in a clean, climate-controlled, modern facility.

**Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

* Promoting a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
* Providing guidance on maintaining material handling control systems, industrial motor control systems, servo and frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems
* Using your technical expertise to provide support with troubleshooting and modifying software projects for material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers, Allen Bradley ControlLogix and CompactLogix PLC platform utilizing Rockwell’s software package, industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, AS-I, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems.
* Acting as the first level of escalation support for equipment automation issues and appropriately escalating downtime situations to vendors and/or network support teams to restore equipment operation.
* Applying subject matter expertise in material handling and electronic control systems to maximize building utilization of systems
* Monitoring MHE metrics and partnering with mechatronics technicians to resolve equipment electrical problems that create performance deficiencies, and performing control systems assessments to maintain and improve equipment reliability
* Partnering with facility Operations leadership, equipment vendors, and parts suppliers to plan and coordinate new technology installations, acting as the technical consultant for capital projects inside the building
* Communicating technical issues and project timelines with building leadership, operations, and the maintenance team, explaining production impacts and working closely with operations and engineering to ensure a thorough understanding of impact to systems

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of cumulative work experience in the following areas, or a relevant 2-year degree plus 1 year of work experience in the following areas:
  + Programming/commissioning of HMIs, PLCs, and VFDs
  + SCADA systems and KPIs
  + Interpreting and modifying mechanical and electrical drawings
  + Supporting a range of different conveyors and sortation systems
  + Equipment control components such as relays, motor starters, VFDs, HMIs, etc.
* High school or equivalent diploma
* Positive attitude and ability to effectively problem-solve

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Associate’s degree with a focus in Electronic Technology (or similar)
* Bachelor’s degree in a STEM-related field
* 4+ years of experience in the electrical field, or in control systems development, troubleshooting, and programming
* 4+ years of experience supporting advanced automation controls systems maintenance and development
* 3+ years of experience supporting a wide range of conveyors and sortation systems
* Leadership and project management experience

**Physical Demands:**

* Ability to reach overhead, kneel, squat, climb steps/ladders, use an aerial lift, and frequently lift a maximum of 50 lbs. of equipment
* Ability to perform tasks while wearing required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), which may include but is not limited to hard hat, face mask, face shield, and composite-toe shoes
* Regularly required to crouch or bend and reach to install/move equipment
* Movement between departments, floors, and properties to facilitate work, averaging 6 to 12 miles per day
* Work in a warehouse environment with fluctuating temperatures
* Regularly required to type on a computer for 1-2 hours per day

We're a global company with over 400 offices in 60 countries. We're proud of our diverse family of employees and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We're recognized by the Human Rights Foundation as a Best Place to Work for LGBTQI+ individuals and are dedicated to continuing to build a culture of inclusion and respect.

Ready to take the next steps in your career? Apply today and be part of a team that is making a difference!

**Hackettstown, New Jersey | 100% Onsite**

**Be the expert who thrives on solving complex technical challenges, mentoring engineers, and driving products from concept through production.**

**WHY WORK FOR ASTRODYNE TDI?**

Join an environment built for engineers who want to stay close to the technology, take ownership of complex designs, and see products move from concept through manufacturing. This is an opportunity to serve as a senior technical authority while collaborating with experienced colleagues to solve demanding switch-mode power challenges.

**Innovation:** Help shape advanced power solutions for complex, mission-critical applications.

**Visible impact:** Translate market needs into product strategy, roadmaps, pricing, and winning technical proposals.

**Cross-functional influence:** Work directly with sales, engineering, supply chain, customers, and manufacturing teams.

**Growth opportunity:** Build new business while strengthening Astrodyne TDI's competitive position in power electronics.

**ROLE** **OVERVIEW**

Astrodyne TDI is seeking a hands-on Principal Electrical Engineer to lead the design and delivery of advanced switch-mode power supply products. As a senior subject-matter expert, you will guide projects from conception through production, resolve difficult technical issues under demanding timelines, and communicate effectively with customers, stakeholders, program teams, and manufacturing partners. This role is ideal for an experienced power electronics engineer who enjoys remaining technically engaged while providing leadership and mentorship.

* Lead end -to-end electrical engineering projects from architecture and concept development through design, testing, compliance, manufacturing, and product release.

* Design advanced switch-mode power supplies with a focus on performance, reliability, testability, manufacturability, cost, and schedule.

* Apply deep knowledge of MOSFETs, power semiconductor components, high-frequency magnetics, analog circuitry, and power conversion topologies.

* Diagnose and resolve challenging technical problems, including root-cause analysis and EMC-related issues, within fast-paced development timelines.

* Collaborate with Program Management, R&D, manufacturing, purchasing, sales, marketing, and supply chain to deliver project objectives.

* Engineer-in-Training (EIT) certification or Professional Engineer (PE) license is a plus

**About Sandia**
----------------

  

Sandia National Laboratories is the nation’s premier science and engineering lab for national security and technology innovation, with teams of specialists focused on cutting-edge work in a broad array of areas. Some of the main reasons we love our jobs:

* Challenging work with amazing impact that contributes to security, peace, and freedom worldwide
* Extraordinary co-workers
* Some of the best tools, equipment, and research facilities in the world
* Career advancement and enrichment opportunities
* Flexible work arrangements for many positions include 9/80 (work 80 hours every two weeks, with every other Friday off) and 4/10 (work 4 ten-hour days each week) compressed workweeks, part-time work, and telecommuting (a mix of onsite work and working from home)
* Generous vacation, strong medical and other benefits, competitive 401k, learning opportunities, relocation assistance and amenities aimed at creating a solid work/life balance\*

World-changing technologies. Life-changing careers. Learn more about Sandia at: http://www.sandia.gov

  

* These benefits vary by job classification.

**What Your Job Will Be Like**
------------------------------

  

The Advanced RF Systems department (5365) is seeking a highly motivated FPGA design Engineer to join its team. This position focuses on providing specialized FPGA expertise to aid in the development and fielding of communications and electronic warfare systems. You will be joining a multi-disciplinary team focused on delivering solutions to national security challenges. The ideal candidate will possess strong teamwork skills and a background in hardware design languages (HDL).

On any given day, you may be called on to:

Develop and incorporate innovative technologies including efforts to:

* Design, simulate and implement synthesizable RTL for high performance FPGAs
* Create original designs as well as modify and improve existing FPGA designs
* Write simulation testbenches for functional verification
* Design embedded electronic subsystems
* Test and troubleshoot printed wiring assemblies (PWAs) in the lab using power supplies, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other lab equipment
* Create innovative solutions to difficult technical problems
* Working cooperatively with other internal organizations, as well as external production facilities and suppliers
* Troubleshoot problems and support anomaly resolution activities
* Support customer funded advanced development needs
* Provide engineering and programmatic documentation
* Apply knowledge and experience to evaluate and improve work quality, performance, and alignment of results with customer expectations.
* The position will require occasional travel.

----------------

  

$102,400 - $199,700

-----------------------------

* A Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or an equivalent combination of directly relevant education and engineering or scientific experience that demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and ability to perform independent research and development
* Ability to obtain and maintain a DOE Q and SCI clearance which may require a polygraph test.

* Graduate degree in Electrical Engineering or a highly related field where an independent research project was a graduation requirement (e.g., independent project, thesis, or dissertation).
* Ability to work independently and collaborate well in a multidisciplinary team of designers and test engineers.
* Outstanding verbal and written skills, including the ability to develop and present briefings that are clear and compelling.

* FPGA programming and verification experience
* Proficiency with Hardware Design Languages (Verilog, VHDL, etc.)
* 2 plus years of related experience in the following areas:
  + Development and verification of custom RTL for FPGA design (preferably VHDL)
  + Static Timing analysis
  + Development and use of testbench code for firmware validation
  + Troubleshooting of firmware using simulation software
  + Use of Microsemi Libero and/or Xilinx Vivado
  + Embedded system design
* Current DOE Q clearance
* Possess a strong dedication to positive teaming dynamic, strong written and verbal skills, detail oriented with a keen focus on customer service

------------------

  

As part of the Intelligent RF Communications group, we play a pivotal role in advancing the Nation's technological superiority. Our team is dedicated to delivering capabilities that ensure RF and spectral dominance, highly reliable communications, and groundbreaking advancements that fortify our future strength. We thrive in a dynamic environment where cross-department collaboration is key, enabling us to provide integrated engineering solutions that span from core research to prototype development and high-end, fielded products.

Our customers include a variety of government organizations including the U.S Armed Forces, the Intelligence Community, and those conducting special operations missions. Our staff members have a diverse skills set including microwave circuit design, antenna design, signal analysis, digital signal processing, and embedded software.

Overview:

**Job Title:** Radar System Engineer

**Location:** New Mexico: White Sands Missile Range, NM

**Job Family Code:** O - Engineering

**Function/Branch:** Engineering Resource Management

**Directorate:** Engineering & Tech Support

**Position Type:** **Regular** Full Time

**Pay Type:** Exempt

**Sponsorship:** Position Not Sponsored

**Grade:** L08 (OA0859) - L09 (OA0962)

**Salary Range or Starting Hourly Rate:** L08: $92,000 - $123,000; L09: $104,000 - $139,000/ per year

**Overview**

*Beyond New Horizons, LLC (BNH) has an exciting opportunity for a Radar System Engineer, supporting TOS II, at White Sands Missile Range, NM. Radar System Engineer will be working as a member of an integrated team responsible for operating and maintaining or supporting the United States Air Force Test Operations and Sustainment efforts.*

**Job Summary**

The Radar Systems Engineer reports directly to Engineer Manager to execute mission-critical specific radar systems equipment including design, development, tests, operation, maintenance, repair, and quality assurance. NRTF Radar Systems Engineer will work with a team of other engineers and technicians to create and improve radar systems, from the initial concept and design phase through the integration, testing, operations and maintenance phase. The NRTF Radar Systems Engineer will use a variety of tools and techniques to analyze and optimize radar performance, including computer simulations and mathematical models. The Radar Systems Engineer is also required to stay up to date with the latest advancements in radar technology and be knowledgeable about the laws and regulations that govern the use of radar systems. This position will require various shifts, weekends, and alternative work schedules for extended periods of time. Must be willing to work overtime when required. NRTF’s Radar Systems Engineers should have a solid understanding of radar principles and have experience with computer simulations, mathematical modeling, and programming. Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills are also essential.

**Job Duties:**

* Knowledge of modern radar, Instrumentation and constituent technologies.
* The applicant should be proficient in antenna and radar theory and associated hardware.
* Strong background in electrical engineering, physics, or related fields.
* Lead and advise in the acquisition and insertion of new capabilities into the NRTF enterprise.
* Train Operations personnel on new capabilities.
* Lead small development efforts, as well as rapid prototypes.
* Knowledge of RF components to allow for troubleshooting and new or modified design implementation.
* Must be able to work individually and as a team member, able to take direction but must also lead and direct the work of others.
* Knowledge of specification development for new system acquisitions.
* Researching and ordering replacement components and spare parts for radar system.
* Recommend improvements to maintenance methods, system and equipment performance as well as operational efficiencies.
* Train and mentor junior Radar Systems Engineers and technicians.
* Familiar with the System Engineering development process to include the ability to present/coordinate PDR’s, CDR’s, etc. and conduct FAT’s.
* Follows all OSHA safety regulations.
* Effective communication both verbally and written
* Project management skills with experience in the procurement, cost and budget process.
* Working knowledge of documentation and configuration control.
* It is a condition of employment to wear company issued PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) in accordance with supervisory direction and company policy.
* Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned by the Chief Scientist or Capabilities Manager as necessary to support contract/mission support requirements in job-related areas.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related scientific or engineering discipline
* A minimum of five (5) years of professional experience in radar system architecture, integration, verification, and validation.
* A minimum of two (2) years of programming experience utilizing MATLAB, MathCad, or Python.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain an active security clearance and maintain authorized user access to the AEDC local area network.
* S. Citizenship is required due to federal government contract compliance requirements and the necessity to access secure federal databases and networks.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Top Secret Security Clearance

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salaries
* Continuing education assistance
* Multiple healthcare benefits packages
* 401K with employer matching
* Paid time off (PTO) along with a federally recognized holiday schedule

**Who We Are**

Beyond New Horizons (BNH) is a fully populated joint venture of Astrion and Fluor Federal Services, Inc. formed to provide unmatched Test Operations and Sustainment services for the Arnold Engineering Development Complex.

We chose our name to serve as an enduring reminder of our commitment to AEDC’s rich aerospace research and development legacy anchored in AEDC’s Toward New Horizons founding study and the unprecedented opportunities to greatly expand AEDC’s capabilities and capacity Beyond those existing today. Leveraging the capabilities of our parent companies, BNH specializes in testing and evaluation for military and space systems combined with proven capability in large-scale Government program management, integration, engineering, and construction services for specialized and technically advanced high-hazard facilities.

**Join our Team!**

U.S. Citizenship is required. At this time BNH will not sponsor any applicants for employment authorization or offer any immigration related support for this position (i.e. H1b, F1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, J-1, E-2, E-3, L-1, or other forms of work authorization that require immigration support from an

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - FE
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

Intuit Mailchimp is a leading marketing platform for small businesses. We empower millions of customers around the world to build their brands and grow their companies with a suite of marketing automation, multichannel campaigns, CRM, and analytics tools.

Forms are where a huge share of that growth starts. Signup forms, embedded forms, landing page forms, and the pop-ups our customers put in front of their own audiences are the front door to list growth on Mailchimp, and they are rendered across an enormous surface area: inside our own app, and inside millions of third-party websites we do not control. We are looking for a Staff-level frontend engineer to set technical direction for that platform.

This role is about depth, not breadth of headcount. You will own the architecture of a schema-driven, micro-frontend-based forms platform: the contracts that describe a form, the runtime that renders it, the composition layer that lets independently deployed teams ship into a shared experience, and the operational discipline that keeps all of it fast and reliable on somebody else's page. You will do that alongside product, design, and engineers across the Forms, and you will be the person other engineers come to when a rendering, contract, or performance decision needs to be made well the first time.

  

**How you'll work**
-------------------

Our Core Leadership Behaviors are the observable and measurable leadership actions and skills that contribute to our effectiveness and success in our roles.

  

* **Thriving in Complexity:** You unravel and make sense of potentially sophisticated, incomplete, and contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
* **Nimble Learning:** You tackle problems with experimentation, using successes and failures to inform future decisions.
* **Expecting the Best:** You hold yourself and others accountable to meet commitments.
* **Collaborating Courageously:** You build partnerships across the company and work collaboratively with others to meet strategic goals.
* **Cultivating Candor:** You act with integrity and earn the confidence and trust of others through honesty and authenticity.
* **Inclusive Leadership:** You recognize the value diversity brings to our organization and leverage different perspectives to enhance organizational culture and drive performance.
* **Customer Obsessed:** You listen hard to customers, understand their challenges, develop relationships with them, and deliver products that remove their obstacles.
* **Action Oriented:** You initiate new opportunities and face tough challenges with a sense of energy, enthusiasm, and service.

**Responsibilities**

* Set the technical direction for the Mailchimp Forms frontend platform, micro-frontend boundaries, module federation and composition strategy, versioning and rollback, and the migration path off legacy rendering paths in the monolith.
* Own the schema contracts that drive our form experiences end to end: the schema definition, validation, versioning and backward-compatibility strategy, and the renderer that turns schema into accessible, performant UI without a code change per field type.
* Drive operational excellence as a first-class deliverable SLOs and error budgets for a client-side product, real-user performance monitoring, Core Web Vitals, structured client-side telemetry, alerting that pages on customer-visible degradation rather than noise, and blameless postmortems that actually change the system.
* Be the technical lead across the full lifecycle: scoping, design, implementation, testing, documentation, rollout, and long-term maintenance, including the unglamorous parts.
* Raise the bar for other engineers through design reviews, pairing, and written architecture guidance covering integration, performance, accessibility, and scalability and find the balance between writing code yourself and creating room for others to grow.
* Extend and contribute back to our design system: component APIs, design tokens, and theming that hold up when a customer embeds our form into their own brand and stylesheet.
* Own accessibility as a requirement, not a cleanup task — WCAG 2.2 AA conformance, keyboard and screen-reader behavior, and automated a11y checks wired into CI.
* Use AI coding agents and GenAI-assisted development as part of how you work, and help the team establish what good looks like: where agents accelerate us, where they need guardrails, and how review standards adapt.
* Share production ownership and on-call rotation with the rest of the team.

**Qualifications**

* You have significant experience designing and implementing frontend architectures at scale and writing code that is maintainable, performant, and observable, not just code that ships.
* You have built or substantially evolved a **micro-frontend architecture** in production: independently deployable frontends, shared dependency and runtime strategy, cross-team contracts, isolation and blast-radius control, and the versioning discipline that keeps it from turning into distributed spaghetti. You can speak candidly about what went wrong and what you would do differently.
* You have deep expertise in **schema-driven / config-driven UI;** JSON Schema or an equivalent contract language, dynamic form rendering, declarative validation, schema evolution and backward compatibility, and codegen from contracts. You understand where schema-driven design pays for itself and where it becomes an abstraction tax.
* You hold a high bar on **software engineering fundamentals and operational excellence**: testing strategy that gives real confidence, CI/CD and progressive delivery, feature flags, instrumentation and observability, incident response, and a track record of owning what you ship in production.
* You are fluent in modern JavaScript/TypeScript and a major component framework (React preferred), and you understand the browser deeply enough to reason about bundle size, hydration, rendering perf

The team is responsible for machine applications, automation and equipment interfaces, HMI and diagnostics, station data and logging, automated testing, and technical software release. This is the one role on the software team dedicated primarily to people leadership, and it is expected to stay hands-on technically alongside the team it leads.

  

**Why This Role Matters**

As this team grows toward its planned size, its long-term health depends on someone whose primary job is the people side of engineering, including coaching, honest performance conversations, hiring, and protecting the team's focus. Every other role on this team is primarily technical. This role is defined around people leadership instead.

  

**This role is based on-site in Rochester, NY. On-site presence is required, given the team's daily use of physical manufacturing and test hardware that cannot be fully replicated remotely, and the importance of in-person collaboration.**

**Job Requirements**
--------------------

**People Leadership**

* **Team Health & Growth:** Run regular, substantive 1-on-1s, career development plans, and honest, timely performance conversations for every engineer on the team.

* **Hiring & Staffing:** Own recruiting, interviewing, and staffing plans for the software team as it grows toward its planned size.

* **Culture & Process:** Establish and evolve team processes, including planning, ceremonies, and onboarding, appropriate to a growing engineering team.

* **Business Partnership:** Represent the software team's priorities, constraints, and needs to business leadership, MPDE, FDE mechanical/electrical/controls/vision disciplines, Operations/Site ME, and IT/OT counterparts.

  

**Hands-On Technical Contribution**

* **Technical Credibility:** Personally contribute code and technical work, up to roughly half your time depending on the phase the team is in. -------------------

**Eaton’s Aerospace division is seeking a Controls Engineer at the Middlesex, NC location.**
  
  
**Position Overview:**

Responsible for the design, specification and implementation of Eaton electrical systems to support production equipment and manufacturing processes. This includes machine guarding and controls, tooling, fixtures, gauges, material handling, and processing documentation. Support and provide production associates with the tools required to perform the job in a manner to meet all requirements.
  
  
Making what matters work at Eaton takes the passion of every employee around the world. We create an environment where creativity, invention, and discovery become reality, each and every day. It’s where bold, bright professionals like you can reach your full potential—and where you can help us reach ours.

* Standardization of electrical systems throughout Middlesex plant

* Define Safety (Mesh 8.0 “Machine & equipment safeguarding”) roll out plan

* Develop architecture for interconnection between machine and human

* PLC programming standards / error proofing strategy / industry 4.0

When we embrace the different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds that make each of us unique, we — as individuals and as a company — are stronger

* 1+ years experience programming PLC ‘s .
