jobs.title: Measurement Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Date:** Oct 7, 2026

  

**Location:** Wilmington, NC, US, 28405

  

**Company:** Corning

  

Requisition Number: 78739

  

**The company built on breakthroughs.**  
**Join us.**

Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.

How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.

At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.

Come break through with us.

  

Our Optical Communications segment has recently evolved from being a manufacturer of optical fiber and cable, hardware and equipment to being a comprehensive provider of industry-leading optical solutions across the broader communications industry.This segment is classified into two main product groupings – carrier network and enterprise network. The carrier network product group consists primarily of products and solutions for optical-based communications infrastructure for services such as video, data and voice communications. The enterprise network product group consists primarily of optical-based communication networks sold to businesses, governments and individuals for their own use.

**Scope of Role**
-----------------

Measurements Systems engineer is a technically diverse and challenging role that supports optical fiber manufacturing. The primary mission is to apply technical knowledge to advance manufacturing capabilities. Project assignments require a broad application of engineering skills with a specific focus on optical measurements. Primary objectives include process improvement, cost reduction, process and raw material optimization, engineered safety improvements, and ensuring manufacturing readiness for new processes. Comprehensive process understanding is an expectation and requirement for success.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Apply advanced measurement engineering concepts - including non-contact and optical methods

* - to drive capability advancements in glass manufacturing processes
* Lead cost reduction and process improvement projects with division-wide impact
* Partner with technology and plant manufacturing teams to ensure smooth deployment of new technologies, products, and processes; identify and lead implementation of required measurement capabilities
* Collaborate with global manufacturing sites to coordinate and resolve glassmaking-related technical issues with a focus on measurements
* Support and improve existing optical measurement systems

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

* **Location**: Wilmington, NC
* **Travel**: 5-10% travel, primarily within North Carolina; occasional international travel may be required
* **Work Schedule**: 40+ hours/week, typically M-F but may require weekends depending on travel schedules or job assignment.

**Experiences/Education - Required**
------------------------------------

* B.S. or M.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE), Physics, Optics or a related technology degree.
* 3+ years of engineering experience with a focus on measurement concepts.
* Strong data analysis skills, including proficiency in tools such as Access, Excel, Minitab, JMP, Databricks, or equivalent
* Experience collaborating across varied organizational levels and functions including manufacturing, technology, R&D, operations, procurement, IT, and supply chain

**Experiences/Education - Desired**
-----------------------------------

* Prior experience transitioning a new product or process from development into manufacturing
* Software development skills, with preference for .NET or Python

**This position does not support immigration sponsorship.**

  

The range for this position is $95,144.00 - $130,823.00 assuming full time status. Starting pay for the successful applicant is dependent on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education.

**A job that shapes a life.**

**Corning offers you the total package.**

  

Your well-being is our priority. Our compensation and benefits package supports your health and wellness, financial aspirations, and career from day one.

* Company-wide bonuses and long-term incentives align with key business results and ensure you are rewarded when the company performs well. When Corning wins, we all win.
* As part of our commitment to your financial well-being, we provide a 100% company-paid pension benefit with fixed contributions that grow throughout your career. Combined with matching contributions to your 401(k) savings plan, Corning’s total contributions to your retirement accounts can reach between 7% and 12% of your pay, depending on your age and years of service.
* Our health and well-being benefits include medical, dental, vision, paid parental leave, family building support, fitness, company-paid life insurance, disability, disease management programs, paid time off, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) to support you and your family.
* Getting paid for our work is important, but feeling appreciated and recognized for those contributions motivates us much more. That’s why Corning offers a recognition program to celebrate successes and reward colleagues who make exceptional contributions.

We prohibit discrimination on the basis of race, color, gender, age, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected status.

  

Corning is committed to providing equal employment opportunities

We are seeking a senior AI Platform Engineer to build, operate, and scale the infrastructure and tooling that power AI/ML and generative AI workloads. This role focuses on cloud platform engineering, CI/CD automation, and MLOps practices that enable reliable, secure, and scalable delivery of AI systems.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure on GCP to support AI/ML and application workloads

* Drive automation to reduce manual toil across build, test, deployment, and rollback processes
* Troubleshoot platform/infrastructure issues and drive root-cause resolution for production incidents

* 7+ years of experience in platform engineering, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering roles
* Strong hands-on expertise with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) — Vertex AI, GKE, Cloud Run, IAM, VPC/networking, BigQuery
* Deep experience designing and managing CI/CD pipelines (Cloud Build, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD)
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred)
* Strong scripting/programming skills (Python, Bash, or Go)
* Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Solid understanding of MLOps concepts and the ML lifecycle (training, versioning, deployment, monitoring)
* Experience with observability tooling (Cloud Monitoring, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK)
* Strong understanding of cloud security, IAM, and secrets management best practices

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* GCP Professional certifications (Cloud DevOps Engineer, Cloud Architect, or Machine Learning Engineer)
* Experience supporting generative AI / LLM platforms (Vertex AI, Gemini Enterprise, Model Garden)
* Experience with GitOps workflows (ArgoCD, Flux)
* Background working in regulated or enterprise-scale environments
* Familiarity with cost optimization and FinOps practices on GCP

* Support infrastructure dependencies for Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, Azure DevOps, application services, and data integration workloads.
* Monitor platform health, availability, performance, capacity, security, and cost and proactively identify operational issues.
* Troubleshoot and resolve Tier 3 incidents involving RHTP cloud infrastructure and platform services.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer - Industrial Controls
jobs.description:
Location Charlotte, North Carolina, 28273 Category Engineering JR105329 FCX 9290 FCX Performance, Inc. Regular Job Type Full time

  

**System Engineer – Industrial Controls**

**Position Overview**

FCX Performance, an Applied Industrial Technologies Company, is seeking a hands-on, mid-to-senior level **System Engineer** to deliver industrial and commercial control systems services to local customers. This is a field-heavy engineering role requiring physical site visits, tool utilization, and direct interaction with industrial machinery.

**Essential Functions & Responsibilities**

* **Field Engineering & Support:** Provide local industrial/commercial control systems engineering service for customers relating to SCADA Systems, PLC Programming, CAD Drawings, Industrial Networking, and Systems Calibration.
* **Technician Interfacing:** Support instrument technicians in the field with issues related to interfacing field devices to DCS & SCADA systems, special needs testing, and technical support.
* **Project & Contract Management:** Partner with fellow engineers to resolve project backlogs while maintaining excellent relationships with contract customers.
* **On-Site Upgrades:** Identify opportunities for system and hardware upgrades at customer facilities.
* **Documentation & Safety:** Report job activity and maintain detailed logs about service calls, parts, and orders. Fully comprehend and communicate safety protocols on active job sites.
* **Travel:** Safely operate a company vehicle to travel to and from local job sites daily.

**Required Education & Experience**

* **Experience:** **Minimum 5+ years of direct, hands-on industry experience** programming PLCs (Allen Bradley, Automation Direct, MOSCAD, etc.) and working with process/flow control systems.
* **HMI Proficiency:** 5+ years of experience with computer-based HMI software (Wonderware, VTSCADA, Lookout, etc.).
* **Education:** Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering (BSEE/BSEET), or an Associate Degree (ASEE) paired with extensive, verifiable field experience. *(Note: Advanced theoretical degrees like an MSEE are not required; this is a practical field engineering role).*
* **Driving Record:** Must possess a valid US driver's license with a clean driving record.
* **Work Authorization:** Must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Sponsorship will not be provided for this position

**Technical & Mental Requirements**

* Strong background in electrical/electronic engineering, process instrumentation, and process engineering.
* High energy, technically competent, resourceful, with extreme attention to detail.
* **Programming & CAD:** Strong skills in PLCs, Microsoft Visual Basic (or basic programming software) and AutoCAD/AutoCAD Electrical.
* **Industrial Networking:** Solid understanding of networks, network structures, radio-based communications, and industrial protocols.
* **Controls Mastery:** Deep understanding of industrial controls, process controls (including PID Loops and pump control), industrial instrument calibrations, and repairs.

**Job Description:**

At ITW Food Equipment Group, people and food are our passion. We believe great food brings people together, and the relationships we share feed our inspiration to be the best we can be for one another.

It is our mission to provide food equipment that foodservice and food retail professionals can trust to work hard and deliver quality, consistent results day in and day out, empowering them to focus on what they love most—creating great food for great people.

As one of the premium brands under the ITW Food Equipment Group umbrella, at **Vulcan**, we are dedicated to exceptional commercial cooking equipment. It’s all we do. Chefs and operators around the world recognize Vulcan as the best-in-class supplier for premier, energy-efficient foodservice equipment.

If you’re passionate about building relationships, driving growth, and representing trusted brands that help customers succeed every day — we want to meet you.

As CBI Electrical Engineer you will be part of the Vulcan New Product Development Team (COE) and the Troy-based technical team supporting Vulcan combi products. This role is responsible for electrical and controls development, including electrical system design, component selection and validation, troubleshooting, compliance testing, and support of new and existing products. The position will also serve as a key U.S. technical interface with global software-development teams, translating U.S. product requirements and field issues into clear software requirements and defect reports and tracking those items through resolution.

Strong electrical engineering fundamentals, systems-level problem solving, communication, and project-management skills are required. The successful candidate does not need to be a software developer but should be comfortable working with software-development processes, issue-tracking systems, and globally distributed development teams. Programming or embedded-controls experience is preferred.

**What You'll Do**

* Practicing the ITW corporate strategy, ITW Toolbox, ITW Core Values and Code of Conduct.
* Understanding and applying the importance of CBI – following the CBI New Product Development (Stage-Gate) Process.
* Pioneer new cooking technologies, including advanced controls and heating systems.
* Developing and maintaining software specifications in collaboration with an external vendor.
* Design, develop, test, and evaluate electrical and electromechanical devices and systems.
* Programming of PLC-controlled lab and test setups.
* Coordinate development efforts with internal teams and suppliers to ensure projects meet timeline and cost objectives
* Collaborate with design team members to develop written instructions incl. installation, setup and operation manuals
* Manage and continuously improve electrical in-house testing procedures to improve product quality and worker safety.
* Manage code compliance activities including UL, Energy Star and state level submissions and maintain documentation.
* As requested, work with and support other ITW FEG operations to develop and improve cooking technologies.
* Regular reports on the project progress to management.

**What you Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, 5 years’ work experience.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to work independently as well as within a team.
* Has an aggressive growth mindset.
* Builds strong customer and supplier relationships and effectively resolves conflicts.
* Schematic design and wiring diagram experience required in addition to familiarity with mechanical design practices.

While performing the duties of this Job, the employee:

### **Position Description & Qualifications**

  
  

If you want to work on cutting-edge DoD programs, Serco has a great opportunity for you! As a SME Software Engineer, you will be supporting the Special Programs Division (AFLCMC/WAG) at Wright Patterson AFB, OH.

**This position is contingent upon the ability to maintain/transfer active Department of War (DoW) Top Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain TS/SCI.**

The Fighters and Advanced Aircraft Directorate, Special Programs Division develops, tests, and rapidly fields classified USAF aeronautical capabilities. AFLCMC/WAG conducts studies to identify new capabilities; transitions laboratory technologies to operational platforms; executes demonstrations; and develops, tests, rapidly fields, sustains, and demilitarizes capabilities for the warfighter.

In this role, you will:

* Oversee software engineering architecture of prime DoD contractors that are implementing Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) for a software pipeline in the acquisition, development, and sustainment of prototypes, aircraft, subsystems, and/or support equipment

* Using DevSecOps, evaluate prime contractor proposed software design changes and solutions for aircraft/test equipment, perform systems analyses and technological/trade-off study assessments

* Assess the interfaces and interaction of a computer system’s software, firmware, and hardware

* Actively participate in software-centric technical reviews and transitioning efforts from traditional methodologies to CI/CD

* Using MBSE, translate operational user requirements into contract system requirements documents to improve traceability
* Analyze software performance deficiencies; make recommendations for corrective action

* Audit DoD contractors for software configuration and control measures and verify appropriate quality accreditation

* Review the system design software architecture and interoperability requirements

* Evaluate system software test plans and participate in the conduct of system, subsystem, and component testing; review and analyze test data; make recommendations

* Support development and review of program and contract technical documentation
* Provide technical and programmatic feedback, develop and present technical briefings, and develop engineering strategies/analyses
* Conduct technical evaluations of contractor proposals
* Interface with weapons system contractors, vendors, and Government representatives on software engineering activities; independently apply software and engineering principles to investigate, analyze, plan, oversee, and evaluate weapons system development and sustainment
* Assess AFRL technology initiatives to guide investments and shape transition strategies
* Assess contractor product capabilities in achieving system design requirements and specifications
* Perform technical risk assessments and develop mitigation plans
* Develop request for proposal (RFP) technical documents and conduct technical evaluations of contractor proposals to include software design feasibility and system compatibility

  

To be successful in this role, you will have:

* An active TOP-SECRET security clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) and access to Special Access Programs (SAP) and have a background investigation current within the past 5 years or under Continuous Vetting
* Masters Degree in an Engineering discipline with a minimum of 20 years relevant experience with the DoD, other government agency, or DoD contractor
* Minimum 3 years of SAP or SCI experience within the last 5 years
* Ability to travel up to 10% (CONUS)

  

Additional desired experience and skills:

* Bachelor’s or Masters Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering
* In-depth knowledge of DoD acquisition software engineering support to include software architecture, design, integration, configuration, test/evaluation, and certification
* Current knowledge of software development methodology and tools to include Agile and CI/CD
* Experienced with real-time operating systems, software languages, computer hardware platforms
* Experience in integrating DevSecOps, MBSE, and DoD cybersecurity considerations into software architectures
* In-depth knowledge of DoD acquisition engineering and test support

jobs.title: Lead Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
We're ALTEN Technology USA, an engineering company helping clients bring groundbreaking ideas to life—from advancing space exploration and life-saving medical devices to building autonomous electric vehicles. With 3,000+ experts across North America, we partner with leading companies in aerospace, medical devices, robotics, automotive, commercial vehicles, EVs, rail, and more.

As part of the global ALTEN Group—57,000+ engineers in 30 countries—we deliver across the entire product development cycle, from consulting to full project outsourcing.

When you join ALTEN Technology USA, you'll collaborate on some of the world's toughest engineering challenges, supported by mentorship, career growth opportunities, and comprehensive benefits. We take pride in fostering a culture where employees feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow.

  

As a **Lead Electrical Engineer** you will be responsible for;

* Leading the design, development, testing, and support of advanced RF-based electronic systems for medical imaging applications.
* Designing and analyzing analog and RF circuitry, including high-frequency electronics and signal transmission systems.
* Utilizing simulation, modeling, and CAD tools to develop and optimize electrical designs.
* Performing system integration activities to ensure compatibility and performance across complex electromechanical systems.
* Conducting validation, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and corrective action investigations for field and production issues.
* Collaborating with mechanical, systems, manufacturing, quality, and regulatory teams throughout the product lifecycle.
* Supporting compliance with applicable safety, performance, and regulatory standards.
* Leading technical reviews, driving engineering decisions, and mentoring junior engineers.
* Identifying opportunities for innovation, product enhancement, and continuous improvement.
* Managing multiple engineering initiatives while ensuring quality, schedule, and technical objectives are achieved.

**Qualifications;**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in electrical engineering, RF design, medical devices, medical imaging, or other highly regulated industries.
* Strong knowledge of analog and RF circuit design principles.
* Experience with electrical design, simulation, and modeling tools.
* Understanding of electromagnetic theory, transmission lines, antennas, amplifiers, oscillators, and related RF technologies.
* Experience with printed circuit board design, testing, validation, and troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of engineering product development processes and design verification practices.
* Ability to perform root cause analysis and drive effective corrective actions.
* Strong communication, leadership, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Experience within medical devices, healthcare technology, or regulated product development environments preferred.
* Knowledge of IEC standards, reliability engineering, Lean methodologies, or continuous improvement practices preferred.

  

**Location: Onsite in Aurora, OH**

**Salary Range: $80,000 0 $120,000**

The actual salary offered is dependent on various factors including, but not limited to, location, the candidate's combination of job-related knowledge, qualifications, skills, education, training, and experience

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or pregnancy.

***Please beware of job seeker scams and see this*** ***important notice*** ***on our careers page for more information about our recruiting process.***

**Compliance Notice:** Alten USA is a federal contractor subject to the requirements of the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act (VEVRAA) and Executive Order 11246. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

**Drug Screening Requirement:** As a federal contractor, Alten USA maintains a drug-free workplace. All candidates selected for employment will be required to successfully complete a pre-employment drug screening as a condition of hire.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
**1st Shift - Robotic/Controls Engineer**

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Approve process specification and design standards
* Develop and implement software changes to improve production capabilities.
* Design, and develop robots including computer software used to program robots.
* Have an understanding of manufacturing production requirements and how robots can be used in automated systems to achieve cost efficiency, productivity and quality.
* Assist in the Repair and maintenance of robots and robotic equipment.
* Train robotics operators in how to operate robots and related equipment and help establish basic maintenance and repair programs at new installations.
* Authorized to participate in the plants APQP process for new equipment and processes that require electrical and electronic circuitry.
* Provides electrical technical expertise in the trouble shooting and problem solving process of electrical and electronic circuits to minimize plant machine downtime and scrap.
* Provides, practices and maintains the safe and effective designs of machine controls and their auxiliary equipment used in the plant as required.
* Understands and effectively uses ladder-logic circuits to optimize manufacturing process that utilize controllers with safety as priority.
* Authorized to conduct tool shop buyoffs on new process and automation equipment for the plant. As it pertains to electric controls, poka-yoke, and special circuits, etc.
* Participates as team member in the plants poka-yoke team evaluation of processes.
* Is a resource for plant continuous improvement and self directed teams as pertaining to electric and electronic controls.
* Provides and participates in the design, installation, and maintenance of the plants electric power distribution system.
* Interfaces with the tool and die and maintenance activities to provide technical expertise and skills upon request.
* Works with AutoCad/CadKey Software to prepare and alter drawings/documents as required.
* Authorized to initiate action to prevent the occurrence of any nonconformities relatingto product, process, and quality system.
* Performs other essential job functions as assigned.

#### **Experience**

Required

* 5 year(s): Manufacturing Experience
* 5 year(s): Robotic/Controls Engineering Experience

#### **Education**

Required

* Bachelors or better in Controls Engineering or related field

Preferred

* Associates or better in Robotic Engineering or related field

#### **Skills**

Required

* Microsoft Project

* Microsoft Excel

Preferred

* Resistant Welding

Required

Required

* Goal Completion: Inspired to perform well by the completion of tasks

* Financial: Inspired to perform well by monetary reimbursement
* Ability to Make an Impact: Inspired to perform well by the ability to contribute to the success of a project or the organization

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
As an Amazon Critical Infrastructure Engineer, you will provide full life-cycle support to AWS Data Centers from design inception through site improvement and maintenance. You will be the ‘go to’ engineering resource for your region when technical advice is needed, and will use your subject matter expertise and engage with diverse teams to:  
  

* Troubleshoot, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site/equipment failures.

  

* Directly support operational issues with ad-hoc training, complex operating procedure reviews, including critical equipment, and event support.

  

* Own the conceptual design for existing data center upgrades and design-solutions, which add capacity, improve availability, increase efficiency and sustainability.

  

* Interface with internal data center operations team, data center design engineering team, server hardware team, environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered.

  

* Develop innovative solutions for AWS’s data centers.

  

* Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions.

  

* Initiate and lead engineering audits including on-site visits within Amazon’s data centers. Produce reports outlining risks with recommended mitigations and remediations.

  

* Act as resident engineer during new construction projects. Support construction, commissioning, and turnover.

  
Key job responsibilities  
Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. As an Amazon Critical Infrastructure Engineer, you will be leading projects to fit out our data centers to  
  
meet ever-evolving customer needs as we continue expanding our fleet to hyper-scale. As an ideal candidate you:  
  

* Possess Strong Engineering Judgement and are able to provide recommendations despite uncertainty/ambiguity.

  

* Are detail and data oriented.

  

* Have experience solving problems with engineered solutions.

  

* Have experience managing engineering projects and consultants.

  

* Build trust and relationships with different stakeholders (e.g., Operations, Controls, Construction, Design, Commissioning, Product Managers, Technical Program Managers, ).

  

* Are adaptable and inclined to get into the field to see things up close.

  

* Excited about a mix of office and field work.

  
A day in the life  
Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will prioritize your activities to support data center capacity availability and safety focusing on the actions that are most impactful. You will have the opportunity to work on projects locally and globally.  
  
About the team  
Why AWS  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Diverse Experiences  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
* Valid and active driver's license

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of electrical systems in critical Data Center operations that include but are not limited to utility substation feeds, transformers, switchgear, VFI Class UPS, DRUPS, PDUs, ATS, STS, SLA/VRLA batteries and associated systems, diesel/gas turbine generators and related fuel systems, Surge Suppression, Active Harmonic Filteri

### **Position Description & Qualifications**

  
  

If you want to work on cutting-edge DoD programs, Serco has a great opportunity for you! As a Senior Anti-Tamper Engineer specializing in systems engineering, you will be supporting the Special Programs Division, DoD Anti-Tamper (AT) Executive Agent Field Program Office (FPO) (AFLCMC/WAG-AT) at Wright Patterson AFB, OH.

**This position is contingent upon the ability to maintain/transfer active Department of War (DoW) Top Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain TS/SCI.**

WAG-AT conducts studies to identify new capabilities; matures laboratory technologies to be weapon system ready; and develops, tests, and rapidly fields new AT capabilities/products all which provide insight and foundational AT technology to seed DoD weapon system development programs. These are focused on reducing developmental risk and associated cost and schedule growth, ultimately ensuring AT architectures are developed, supporting protection of US warfighters against loss of life caused by technological exploitation of US weapons systems.

* Apply DoD systems engineering process, policy, and procedures in the acquisition, manufacturing, fielding, and sustainment, modernization and disposal of new, existing and future weapons systems and capabilities, with specific experience in weapon system Program Protection planning and anti-tamper methods
* Assess integrated circuitry, industry standard processors, and memory chips and determine methodologies for reverse engineering electronic systems and integrated circuitry
* Provide engineering support for technology and product acquisitions to include long-term planning, request for proposal (RFP) development, and technical oversight of ongoing projects
* Review and analyze proposals for design feasibility and system compatibility
* Assess acquired capabilities in achieving system design requirements and specifications
* For program protection, identify technologies and evaluate system/subsystem design functions and improvements to protect Critical Program Information (CPI)
* Develop plans to assess security features of Government Off-The-Shelf (GOTS) and Commercial Off-The Shelf (COTS) components for CPI susceptibility/vulnerability to exploitation and reverse engineering.
* Work with DoD Anti-Tamper Evaluation Teams to understand current designs and identify vulnerabilities to foreign and adversary exploitation
* Assist efforts to improve US weapons system anti-tamper/anti-exploitation design, development, manufacturing, training, and sustainment
* Evaluate system test plans and participate in conduct of system, subsystem, & component testing
* Conduct engineering performance, supportability, schedule, and risk assessments and scheduling trade off studies

To be successful in this role, you will have:

* An active TOP-SECRET security clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) and access to Special Access Programs (SAP) and have a background investigation current within the past 5 years or under Continuous Vetting
* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering with a minimum of 12 years experience in an engineering position with the DoD, other government agency, or DoD contractor
* Masters Degree in a relevant engineering discipline with a minimum of 10 years experience in an engineering position with the DoD, other government agency, or DoD contractor
* Minimum 3 years of SAP or SCI experience within the last 8 years
* Ability to travel up to 10% (CONUS)

Additional desired experience and skills:

* Experience with Program Protection planning and implementation in weapon system programs
* Experience evaluating current fielded weapons systems to determine anti-tamper and reverse engineering susceptibility based on vendor design
* Experience working with industry to assess tamper resistance of current weapons systems within the acquisition development cycle
* Experience working within the electronic exploitation lab environment to evaluate current and new processors, memory units, and electronic circuits to exploit weaknesses, identify improvements to design, and develop new standards to deter technological exploitation

jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

**The Boeing Company** has an exciting opportunity for an **Associate Software Engineer** to support the Guidance Repair Center in **Heath, OH.**

  
  

This engineering position will be responsible for the design, development, test, and sustainment of electrical, electronic, and electro-mechanical products and test equipment/software in support of the U.S. Strategic Deterrence Systems (U.S. Air Force Intercontinental Ballistic Missile, U.S. Air Force & U.S. Navy Guidance Systems and other military programs). In addition, this role will review test data, direct repairs, develop process improvements, capture process changes, and solve problems with new workloads and part obsolescence.

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Contributes to development and deployment of automated test equipment for lab and factory automation, including data processing and control algorithm development
* Works in small agile teams composed of diverse engineering skills
* Use your talents to tackle complex problems on a variety of programs
* Responsible for developing technical products, plans, documentation, and briefings supporting program requirements
  

  

**Security Clearance:**

This position requires the ability to obtain a U.S. Security Clearance for which the U.S. Government requires U.S. Citizenship. An interim and/or final U.S. Secret Clearance Post-Start is required.

  
  

**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):**

* Bachelor’s Degree or higher
* 1+ years of experience as a Software Engineer
* 1+ years of programming experience

You will gain comprehensive understanding of our server firmware kernel stack and analyze it in both current and future contexts. jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services is establishing a hardware engineering office in Portland, Oregon to accelerate server hardware development, manufacturing, and operations. The Portland site will become a center of excellence for electrical hardware engineering within AWS for board development, server power, system performance, silicon quality, and manufacturing. This is a greenfield site leadership role. The site leader will be the first hire and the single most important investment in the success of this office. You will not simply manage a team. You will own the culture, operational posture, recruiting velocity, and engineering output of the entire Portland site from day one.  
  
As the site leader, you will own the Portland office end to end. You will define the site's identity, set its operational cadence, and establish the cultural foundation before the organization scales. You will drive recruiting velocity across all Portland teams, partner with real estate and facilities to stand up lab-capable office space, and represent the Portland site in cross-site planning with Seattle, San Jose, and other AWS engineering locations. You will be the single point of accountability for the site's hiring trajectory, engineering output, and organizational health. Every team at the Portland site, whether in your direct reporting line or not, will look to you as the senior leader on the ground.  
  
As the functional engineering leader, you will hire, develop, and lead the managers who run each of the Portland engineering teams. Your direct reports will be the engineering managers who own board development, server power, and manufacturing test/quality, and validation of 3rd party silicon. You will be accountable for the output, hiring velocity, and technical judgment of each of those teams through the managers you put in place. You will lead board development managers, server power managers, electrical manufacturing test/quality, silicon qualification, and production yield. These are not adjacent teams doing similar work. You will be expected to set technical direction across all of them, make resourcing tradeoffs between them, calibrate talent across teams, and hold each manager and their team to a unified engineering bar. You will also carry coordination responsibility for firmware disciplines co-located at the site, including BIOS, BMC, and mechanical engineering teams.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The site leader owns all Portland site operations end to end. This includes defining and executing the recruiting strategy to hire and scale multiple engineering teams. You will lead the multiple engineer teams. You will establish and maintain Amazon's cultural standards at the site, operational rigor, and embody Amazon culture to scale the site.

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline
* 10 or more years of progressive experience in hardware engineering, including at least 5 years managing managers
* Demonstrated track record of building and scaling hardware engineering teams from the ground up, ideally in a greenfield or early-stage site context

jobs.description:
**About The Company**

As the Pacific Northwest’s leading contract packer and co-packer of ready-to-drink beverage products for nearly a century, Portland Bottling Company provides flexibility and responsiveness, with unmatched regional and national reach, as well as the scale to handle the needs of any and all customers. PBC offers 24/7, end-to-end solutions with state-of-the-art equipment, in-line monitoring, and automated technologies for next level quality, reliability, efficiency and yield.

Our mission at Portland Bottling Company is to act as one team, committed to providing real differentiated value to our customers’ business by delivering the most trusted and highest quality solutions in the industry. That comes from providing an environment for our employees that is safe and promotes growth, development, and success.

**Job Summary**

Interface with several PBC departments to troubleshoot, improve, upgrade and support manufacturing network systems. As a senior technical engineer, the Senior Robotics Engineer – Industrial Controls position will make hands-on contributions to the manufacturing information system software by editing and troubleshooting Programmable Logic Control (PLC) programming and data acquisition / formatting. The position will liaise with the Process Control Engineer in regard to software architecture design, development of software applications and their integration into enterprise systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build, configure, test and debug robotics applications, programs and software codes, such as PLC (AB & Siemens) and Human Machine Interface (HMI) software (Ignition) to support operational changes and improvements for the manufacturing operations.
* Develop, design, and write custom software programming, applications and interfaces to control and monitor systems, including both PLC code (ladder logic) and programming, HMI code and development,
* Install, commission, and deploy robotic programs, ensuring smooth integration with existing manufacturing infrastructure.
* Diagnose other robotic systems, such as advanced displays, advanced sensing, and robotic programs.
* Create detailed technical documentation and back ups of system architecture diagrams, PLC programs, and user manuals
* Implement advanced sensing and vision systems to enable robotics to perceive and interact with their environment autonomously. Maintaining calibration of the sensors
* Investigate mechanical failures and maintenance problems for root cause analysis, providing occasional afterhours remote support for 24/7 operation.
* Support Operations and Maintenance by implementing improvements, troubleshooting electronics and program failures
* Provide technical support for robotic systems. Continuously monitor and optimize the performance of robotic systems, troubleshooting issues and implementing improvements as needed.
* Provide training and support to production personnel on the operation and maintenance of systems and programs.
* Work with vendors and internal personnel on projects related to automated solutions to improve plant operations, increase safety, increase quality, reduce cost and increase efficiency.
* Engage in ongoing maintenance activities, supporting software upgrades, diagnostics and troubleshooting.
* Stay updated on the latest advancements in robotics technology and industry best practices to drive innovation and maintain a competitive edge.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Robotics Engineering or Controls Engineering.
* Seven years of experience maintaining and programming Krones can bottling and packaging machinery, including installation, commissioning, startup, overhaul, inspection, retrofit, and service.
* Seven years of experience programming and troubleshooting controller interfaces and PLCs using Allen-Bradley, Siemens Step 7, Siemens TIA Portal, ladder logic, SCL, and structured text; and programming HMIs using FactoryTalk, WinCC, TIA Portal, Zenon, and Inductive Automation Ignition.
* Seven years of experience with VODM fillers; CIP/SIP processes using phosphoric and caustic; Transmarket product-preparation equipment and processes; and adjusting blending, preparation, filling processes, and filling programs—including mechanical fillers, weight filling, and PFIR filling valves—to operational requirements.
* Seven years of experience with tray packers, palletizers, dry-end machinery, and peripherals, including Videojet tray coders, Nordson glue-injection systems, and Toledo weight checkers; and with can/bottle, case, and pallet conveyors, LCT4 systems, and bottle liners/separators.
* Seven years of electrical experience interpreting American and European (German) prints; and seven years of experience with Profibus, AS-i Bus, CAN bus, Ethernet, Powerlink, and Profinet networks; Danfoss, Allen-Bradley, and B&R frequency inverters, including model and brand conversions and upgrades; servo drives, stepper motors, and general motor control; and programming and addressing AS-i Bus and AS-i safety devices such as buttons and Evoguard, SPX, and Burkert valves.
* Seven years of experience with empty-can, full-can, tray-code, and vision inspection systems; and with Anton Paar equipment, including digital and analog sensors, flow meters, temperature and pressure transmitters, and mass flow meters.
* Seven years of mechanical experience performing major overhauls, replacing worn parts, and rebuilding filling valves, manifold distributors, filler main bearings, conveyor belts, and process valves—including flap, seat, double-seat, double-seal, diverting, shuttle, and sampling valves—and replacing and referencing servo motors.
* Seven years of experience with line control and balancing; adjusting can- and case-conveyor speeds to optimize motor use; and creating, adjusting, and tuning formats for new can sizes, can inspections, package arrangements, and pallet patterns.
* Seven years of experience developing SOPs for equipment upgrades and changes

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

  
  
  

**Group/Division**

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The SPTS division provides advanced wafer processing solutions—including etch, deposition and vapor-based technologies—designed for R&D through high-volume production. With a global presence and strong customer support network, SPTS helps manufacturers across industries improve performance, yield and cost-efficiency. It also offers comprehensive service and spare parts through a worldwide network of service centers and qualified local agents.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

  
  

At KLA, we develop industry-leading equipment and technologies that enable innovation across the semiconductor industry. Our teams solve complex engineering challenges that help customers manufacture faster, more powerful, and more efficient electronic devices.

  
  

We are seeking a hands-on position support multiple semiconductor process equipment platforms, including advanced etch and deposition systems. This role combines electrical system design, product safety, regulatory compliance, sustaining engineering, and new product development. The ideal candidate is a hands-on electrical engineer that has a strong interest in and willingness to lead product safety and compliance efforts.

  

**What You'll Do**

As a key member of the engineering team, you will be responsible for the electrical design, product & safety compliance, and long-term support of electrical systems in semiconductor manufacturing equipment.

  

**Electrical Systems Design & Sustaining**

* Design and sustain electrical systems for semiconductor process equipment
* Specify and integrate electrical components including power supplies, sensors, relays, circuit protection devices, heaters, temperature control hardware, and motion-control elements
* Develop equipment protection strategies and electrical safety functions such as emergency stops, safety interlocks, and grounding systems
* Evaluate new technologies and alternative components to improve product performance, reliability, manufacturability, and cost
* Support field electrical troubleshooting escalations when required
  

**Product Safety & Regulatory Compliance**

* Lead product safety and compliance initiatives across multiple equipment platforms
* Interpret and implement industry standards including SEMI, CE, IEC, NFPA, UL, and customer-specific requirements
* Conduct compliance assessments, design reviews, gap analyses, risk assessments, and hazard evaluations
* Partner with certification bodies and testing organizations to achieve product certifications and maintain compliance documentation
  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline
* 5+ years of experience designing electrical systems for semiconductor equipment, industrial automation, manufacturing equipment, or other similar electromechanical systems
* Demonstrated ability to assess and design electrical systems and equipment to regulatory standards (i.e., 60204-1, NFPA 79, UL 508A)
* Strong understanding of electrical design principles, power distribution, controls, and electrical safety
* Experience selecting, integrating, and troubleshooting electrical components and subsystems
* Travel requirement for 15 to 20%
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience as a liaison with 3rd party assessors to achieve and maintain equipment certifications (i.e., CE mark, EMC)
* Experience assessing and designing safety interlock circuits with performance levels required by ISO 13849
* Working knowledge of SEMI S2, CE, IEC, NFPA, UL, ISO 13849, and other product compliance standards
* Experience performing machine safety risk assessments and hazard analyses (i.e., 12100, FMEA)
* Experience using Sistema for Performance Level (PL) and functional safety evaluations
  

**Why Join KLA?**

This is an opportunity to have a direct impact on the safety, performance, and reliability of advanced semiconductor manufacturing systems used by leading technology companies worldwide. You'll work on challenging multidisciplinary engineering problems, collaborate with experts across KLA, and contribute to products that power the future of electronics.

**Minimum Qualifications**

Doctorate (Academic) Degree and 0 years related work experience; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 5 years

**About KLA**

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

  
  
  

**Total Rewards**

Base Pay Range: $100,100.00 -

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer, Power Electronics PCB Design
jobs.description:
Valinor is a new type of defense and government tech company focused on solving the problems others don't. Our unique model of centralized go-to-market and decentralized engineering allows us to move with unparalleled efficiency to identify unmet needs, build right-sized solutions, and get products where they matter most, in the hands of users. Unlike others in the space, who focus on the flashy problems, Valinor exists to solve the quiet, unaddressed problems, the small but significant ones that lead to cracks in the country's strength, stability, and security.

Backed by General Catalyst, Founders Fund, and Friends & Family Capital, Valinor was founded in 2024 and has established strategic partnerships with Palantir, Anduril, and Helsing. We are building the dream team, and we want you on it.

**About the Role**

**Valinor Dispatch** builds modular charging infrastructure that keeps unmanned systems (drones, ground robots, surface vessels) powered and operating autonomously in the field. We're seeking an **Electrical Engineer** specializing in power electronics and PCB design to own power flow for our AC/DC systems in low-voltage applications. This is a hands-on, on-site role for someone who can take a design from prototype and proof of concept through production-ready manufacturing, working directly with our engineering team to build rugged, high-reliability power systems for austere environments. You'll own the board-level design for DC/DC conversion, protection, and health monitoring, and set the standard for power electronics quality as the team scales.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* Own power flow for AC/DC systems and subsystems in low-voltage applications (<240VAC, <60VDC) across the power infrastructure for autonomous platforms including robots, drones, and surface vessels
* Design production-level PCBs for DC/DC converters, protection systems, and health monitoring built to survive austere environments
* Take designs from prototype and proof of concept through to production-ready manufacturing
* Design to EMI/EMC requirements for high-current, high-power systems (1kW to 50kW)
* Partner with mechanical, embedded, and systems engineers to integrate power electronics into complete autonomous charging platforms
* Build and validate prototypes, then drive the handoff to volume production

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

* 3+ years in power electronics or electrical engineering with hands-on, production-level PCB design
* Proven track record designing DC/DC converters, protection systems, and health monitoring from schematic through manufacturing
* Familiarity with EMI/EMC requirements for high-current, high-power designs (1kW to 50kW)
* Demonstrated ability to prototype, prove out a concept, and push it to production-ready manufacturing
* Experience with low-voltage AC/DC systems (<240VAC, <60VDC)
* Experience designing for austere or rugged environments (thermal, shock and vibration, ingress protection) strongly preferred
* Background in industrial, automotive, oil and gas, rail, or defense power systems preferred
* Proficiency with PCB design and simulation tools such as Altium Designer, LTSpice, or similar a plus
* Experience with wide-bandgap devices (SiC/GaN) and resonant topologies (LLC, dual active bridge) a plus

**What Valinor Offers**
=======================

* Competitive salary, equity packages, and benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance - fully covered for employees, 401(k), among others.
* Unlimited PTO and two-week company holiday at the end of every calendar year.
* We are a pro-mental health and pro-family company - we actually encourage employees to spend time with themselves and their families. Valinor also provides fertility benefits to those just beginning that journey.
* Fun work environment - we like to laugh and take care of each other, but we also deeply respect the mission in front of us.

*This role requires the candidate be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance. Active clearance preferred, but not required.*

Valinor is an equal-opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. The Valinor team is made up of incredibly talented and unique individuals, who together are disrupting industry norms by creating new paths towards the future of defense and government technology. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, Veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law, including those with a criminal history, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the CA Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance. We actively encourage members of recognized minorities, women, Veterans, and those with disabilities to apply, and we work to create a welcoming and supportive environment for all applicants throughout the interview process. If you are someone passionate about working on problems that have a real-world impact, we'd love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**D-Riven Engineered Solutions is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer to join the Industrial Engineering division. The appropriate candidate will be responsible forsupporting industrial power distribution designs, infrastructure assessments, and executing electrical system installations, modifications, and relocations in a manner consistent with D-Riven and Customer expectations and National Electrical Codes. Hiring this position for New Johnsonville, TN location.**

\*\*Essential Duties & Responsibilities

:

In this position, the employee will be responsible to:

\*\*

* Uphold D-Riven’s health and safety standards throughout the execution of a given project, along with ensuring compliance with customer safety rules and regulations
* Work with Electrification Team peers and other team members to conduct site surveys and generate power distribution system designs and installation plans
* Complete infrastructure evaluations of existing power systems to verify capacity, load, etc. and generate one-line drawings
* Support the lead designer in the development of industrial power distribution systems
* Research and adhere to all applicable electrical and building codes and accepted best practices
* Work with municipalities and inspectors on permitted projects
* Coordinate with internal and external customer management teams in support of electrical project costing, quoting, and planning activities
* Work with D-Riven’s operations team, and program managers to develop comprehensive timelines and resource plans prior to project kick-off
* Develop project level material lists and supply them to those responsible for purchasing
* Support the sourcing of technical system components and determine the compatibility of alternate options as dictated by project constraints
* Manage electrical superintendents, electricians, and subcontractors and provide direction regarding the execution of activities, and supervise their quality of work while on site
* Conduct and verify lock-out/tag-out (LOTO) of electrical sources prior to commencement of work
* Work with internal teams to disassemble electrical power distribution equipment, replace defective, worn, or failed system components, and reassemble
* Measure, cut, and bend EMT conduit, and thread rigid conduit in support of installations
* Field fit and install Unistrut frames and hangers, cable tray, and conduit piping
* Complete manual, and mechanically supported wire pulls and terminations
* Support field teams in the troubleshooting and correction of electrical system issues both remotely and on site
* Collaborate with low voltage/controls specialists to ensure the seamless integration of complex systems

* Perform other routine tasks and jobsite duties as directed by department management

* Middleware and data distribution (DDS, pub/sub architectures)
* Service-oriented and event-driven software design

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Project Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.  
  
In this role, you will develop software for the Leo Customer Terminal embedded systems engineering team. You will be responsible for the design, implementation, deployment and operations of the functions for Leo Customer Terminals.  
  
Export Control Requirement:  
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

* Development and testing with embedded Linux
* Develop embedded software functions for Customer Terminal devices within the Project Leo system
* Developing embedded software utilizing Rust, C++, C
* Participate in all phases of SDLC: requirements, design, coding, test, deployment and production system
* Development of software in a secure compute environment
* State machine design and analysis
* Support Customer Terminal deployments operations and debugging on production systems
* Technical writing of design specifications

  
  
A day in the life  
As part of our software engineering team, you will design, implement and debug software used to test and debug embedded software for Leo Customer Terminal platforms in R&D and commercial operation. You will work in a collaborative environment with teams in Leo Customer Terminal hardware development, software development and operations. You need to be flexible and responsive to fast changing priorities and issues. You will work on Customer Terminal issues on production system platforms.

The Leo Customer Terminal Software Team develops and supports the devices that connect Leo subscribers to the Leo network. We provide software for the Leo Customer Terminal platform, applications and underlying Linux system. We work hand in hand with hardware engineering, product, and operations teams to deliver commercial grade services for our Leo subscribers.

------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

jobs.title: RF / Microwave Electrical Engineer II -Onsite
jobs.description:
**Date Posted:**

2026-10-06

**Country:**

United States of America

**Location:**

US-TX-MCKINNEY-513WC ~ 2501 W University Dr ~ WING C BLDG

**Position Role Type:**

Onsite

**U.S. Citizen, U.S. Person, or Immigration Status Requirements:**

Active and transferable U.S. government issued security clearance is required prior to start date. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance

**Security Clearance Type:**

DoD Clearance: Secret

**Security Clearance Status:**

Ability to obtain INTERIM U.S. government issued security clearance is required prior to start date

At Raytheon, the foundation of everything we do is rooted in our values and a higher calling – to help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression. We bring the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. Our team solves tough, meaningful problems that create a safer, more secure world.

Join our RF/Microwave Engineering team at Raytheon and help develop mission-critical technologies that protect the U.S. and our international allies. In this role, you will design, develop, integrate, test, and/or support the manufacture of advanced RF and microwave hardware for radar and sensing applications.

You may work across a broad range of technologies, including RF circuit card assemblies (CCAs) and modules for receivers, exciters, and transmitters; antennas and radomes; semiconductor devices; microwave and millimeter-wave integrated circuits (MMICs); and phased-array hardware.

You will collaborate closely with multidisciplinary engineering, manufacturing, test, and program teams throughout the full hardware development lifecycle—from concept development and detailed design through integration, verification, and transition to production. This is an opportunity to solve challenging RF problems, work hands-on with advanced hardware, and contribute directly to some of Raytheon’s premier radar and sensing programs.

**What You Will Do**

* Design, simulate, and analyze RF/microwave components, MMICs, CCAs, and/or phased array module hardware.
* Perform assembly, testing and characterization, of RF, microwave, and millimeter-wave hardware and/or devices.
* Execute component-level and system-level integration and testing for digital, analog, and RF assemblies.
* Utilize automated test instrumentation and software (e.g., Python, MATLAB, LabVIEW) to control measurement systems, capture data, and evaluate test results.
* Characterize and test hardware using advanced laboratory equipment, including Vector Network Analyzers (VNAs), Signal Generators, Spectrum Analyzers, Phase Noise Analyzers, and Performance Network Analyzers (PNAs).
* Conduct circuit simulations, obsolescence trade assessments, hardware troubleshooting, and failure investigations to resolve performance issues.
* Partner with multi-discipline teams
* Participate in project design reviews, peer reviews, and briefings to internal program leadership and external customers

**What You Will Learn:**

* RF simulation and design processes
* RF hardware characterization techniques, including using spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, signal generators, phase noise analyzers, etc.
* Software such as Keysight ADS, HFSS, Cadence Virtuoso, MATLAB, CST, Mentor Graphics’ Expedition, Python, Labview

**Qualifications You Must Have:**

* Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, or related Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) discipline. Degree must be obtained by start date.
* Coursework in one or more of the following: RF Circuit Design, Microwave Circuits, Electromagnetics, Antenna Engineering, Microwave Measurements, RF Engineering, Radar Signal Processing, or Radar Design.
* Experience in at least one of the following technical domains:

* **RF/Microwave Design & Measurement:** Designing, fabricating, or bench-testing RF/microwave circuits or components (e.g., amplifiers, filters, mixers, couplers), including S-parameter or microwave measurements using network/spectrum analyzers.

* **Antennas & Applied Electromagnetics:** Modeling, simulating, or testing antennas or electromagnetic structures using computational tools (e.g., HFSS, CST Studio, ADS, FEKO) or anechoic chamber measurements.

* **Radar Architecture & Signal Processing:** Modeling or implementing radar signal processing algorithms (e.g., pulse compression, Doppler processing, beamforming, CFAR, waveform design) using simulation tools (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink, Python) or embedded hardware.

  

* Experience building, testing, or characterizing electronic hardware, RF circuits, or antenna systems using standard test benches or measurement facilities.
* Experience may be obtained through on-the-job experience, research, coursework, or projects.

**Qualifications We Prefer:**

* Hands-on laboratory experience specific to RF/microwave device or circuit characterization using VNAs, spectrum analyzers, and automated test environments.
* Proficiency with RF/electromagnetic design and analysis software such as Keysight ADS, ANSYS HFSS, CST Studio Suite, Microwave Office, Cadence Virtuoso, or MATLAB.
* Experience scripting and automating laboratory test equipment using Python, C++, or LabVIEW.
* Demonstrated leadership experience through student organizations, research projects, or engineering team initiatives.
* Strong collaborative, interpersonal, and technical communication skills working in multi-disciplinary engineering settings.

**What We Offer:**

* Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.
* Relocation Eligibility

**Learn More & Apply Now!**

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer - Special Programs
jobs.description:
Saronic Technologies is a leader in revolutionizing autonomy at sea, dedicated to developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance maritime operations through autonomous and intelligent platforms.

Saronic Special Programs is a small pathfinding team chartered to rapidly prototype new ideas. Special Programs is responsible for generating new ideas, building and testing physical prototypes, and validating future products which continue Saronic's mission to redefine maritime superiority.

**Job Overview**
================

We are seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer responsible for designing, building, and testing electrical systems on a variety of complex systems, including autonomous platforms and edge devices. You will work on a diverse range of technical challenges, including power management and distribution, embedded electronics, and integrating sensors, radios, actuators, and other components. You will collaborate with a small group of like-minded developers to solve robust problems with limited resources and time. You will explore the frontier of maritime technology.

**Responsibilities**
====================

* Design and integrate electrical systems, including power distribution, motor controllers, batteries, embedded systems, and sensors
* Develop low- and high-voltage electrical architectures for rapid prototypes
* Develop wiring diagrams, schematics, and harnesses using CAD tools (e.g., SolidWorks)
* Select and evaluate electrical components for reliability in harsh marine environments
* Work with vendors and manufacturing partners to source and assemble electrical components
* Support and participate in regular field testing and/or Government demonstrations

**Qualifications**
==================

* Experience building complex systems, including autonomous platforms and edge devices, with a focus on designing and supporting electrical systems
* Experience in marine, aerospace, robotics, or automotive hardware development is a plus
* Proficiency in power systems engineering
* Comfort working with embedded systems and microcontrollers
* Familiarity with high-voltage or high-current systems
* Familiarity with programming languages and software development practices is a plus
* Knowledge of EMI/EMC best practices and environmental ruggedization
* Experience with hardware-in-the-loop testing and embedded debugging
* Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment
* Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
* Comfort operating with high uncertainty, minimal resources, compressed timelines, and aggressive goals and schedules

**Physical Demands**
====================

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Occasional standing and walking within the office, lab, and prototype spaces.
* Manual dexterity to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment.
* Visual acuity to read screens, documents, and reports.
* Occasional reaching, bending, or stooping to access file drawers, cabinets, or office supplies.
* Lifting and carrying items up to 20 pounds occasionally (e.g., office supplies, packages).
* Occasional travel to field test sites and Government demonstrations.

**Benefits**
============

**Medical Insurance:** Comprehensive health insurance plans covering a range of services

Saronic pays 100% of the premium for employees and 80% for dependents

Saronic pays 100% of the premium under the basic plan for employees and 80% for dependents

**Time Off:** Generous PTO and Holidays

**Parental Leave:** Paid maternity and paternity leave to support new parents

**Competitive Salary:** Industry-standard salaries with opportunities for performance-based bonuses

**Retirement Plan:** 401(k) plan with company match

**Stock Options:** Equity options to give employees a stake in the company’s success

**Life and Disability Insurance:** Basic life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage

**Pet Insurance:** Discounted pet insurance options including 24/7 Telehealth helpline

**Additional Perks:** Free lunch benefit and unlimited free drinks and snacks in the office

jobs.title: Software Engineer Stf - E4
jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

This position is for a Mission Assurance Software Engineer Staff supporting Anti-Tamper software development for the F-35 Joint Strike Fighter (JSF) and Integrated Fighter Group (IFG) platforms. Opportunities to support other LM Aero platforms may become available as the candidate progresses in this role. Daily tasks include, but are not limited to, the following:

  

* Lead the development, maintenance, and execution of unit tests and requirements‑driven test suites for mission‑critical software components.
* Drive agile ceremonies (scrum, sprint planning, retrospectives) and coach the team on best-practice us of agile tools.
* Architect and implement software features in a Linux environment; own branching/merging strategies and code-review processes.
* Design and deliver middleware components that define integration interfaces across mission systems and hardware subsystems.
* Drive the optimization of CI/CD pipelines to improve build quality and delivery speed.
* Lead embedded software development, including memory‑mapped hardware access, bare‑metal coding, and real‑time operating system (RTOS) integration.
* Direct root‑cause investigations, fault isolation, debugging, and after‑action reporting.
* Collaborate with system engineers, hardware engineers, and test teams to ensure software meets interface, performance, and security requirements.
* Author and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, test procedures, and operational guidance.

The successful candidate plans, conducts, and coordinates software development activities. Designs, develops, documents, tests, and debugs software that contains logical and mathematical solutions to business/mission problems or questions in computer language for solutions by means of data processing equipment. Applies the appropriate standards, processes, procedures, and tools throughout the development life cycle. Applies knowledge of computer hardware and software, subject matter to be programmed in business/mission applications, information processing techniques used, and information gathered from system users to develop software. Corrects program errors, prepares operating instructions, compiles documentation of program development, and analyzes system capabilities to resolve questions of program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques, and controls. Ensures software standards are met.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Bachelor’s (or higher) degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum 8 + years of software‑development experience, including independent delivery of embedded or mission‑critical systems.
* Secret Clearance with ability to obtain Special Access Program (SAP) Clearance.

**Desired Skills**
------------------

* Expert-level C/C++ programming background; ability to design reusable libraries and frameworks.
* Extensive experience with GNU build tools (Make, CMake, etc.).
* Hands-on experience with AMD/Xilinx FPGA tools (Vitis, Vivado) and integration of FPGA-based IP.
* Extensive Linux development experience (user-space and kernel-level), including driver development and performance tuning.
* Advanced experience with memory-mapped hardware, practical FPGA integration, deep knowledge of RTOS (VxWorks, FreeRTOS) and bare-metal development, and proven ability to perform rate-monotonic scheduling analysis.
* Extensive experience with cryptographic libraries (OpenSSL, WolfSSL, etc.) and implementation of secure-coding best practices in mission-critical software.
