jobs.description:
**Firmware Engineer, BMC & BIOS**

**Location:** El Paso TX, 79927

**Reports To:**  
**Job Type:** Full-Time | Permanent | **Salary range: $**

**Schedule:** Mon.- Fri. **(Overtime may be required based on business needs).**

**Language:** English | Bilingual (preferred)

The **Firmware Engineer, BMC & BIOS** is responsible for supporting customer issue resolution involving server, storage, networking, and AI rack systems throughout New Product Introduction (NPI) and Mass Production (MP).

This position serves as the firmware subject-matter expert within the WYUS Forward Engineering Team, providing first-level technical triage, log analysis, firmware validation, issue reproduction, and cross-functional coordination for problems involving **BMC, BIOS/UEFI, NIC firmware, switch firmware, PCIe switches, and add-in cards**.

The Firmware Engineer works closely with factory teams, R&D engineering organizations, suppliers, and customers to collect complete technical data, narrow failure conditions, identify appropriate corrective actions, and drive issues through resolution and closure.

The position does not replace the responsibilities of product design, failure analysis, quality, or test ownership teams. Instead, the role ensures that firmware-related issues are properly characterized, supported with complete data, assigned to the appropriate technical owners, and driven toward timely resolution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Firmware Issue Investigation and Troubleshooting**

* Investigate customer, factory, and production issues involving BMC, BIOS/UEFI, NICs, switches, PCIe switches, and add-in cards.
* Collect, analyze, and interpret firmware and system logs to identify abnormal behavior and failure conditions.
* Review BMC event logs, Redfish, IPMI, BIOS/UEFI POST information, serial logs, network device logs, and other relevant diagnostic data.
* Reproduce firmware-related failures whenever possible and narrow issues to the appropriate firmware, hardware, configuration, or environmental condition.
* Verify firmware versions, configurations, settings, and release requirements against approved product baselines.
* Identify missing information and ensure appropriate diagnostic data is collected during the initial investigation.

**BMC and BIOS/UEFI Support**

* Provide technical support for BMC and BIOS/UEFI-related issues across server and rack-level systems.
* Troubleshoot issues involving system boot, POST, firmware configuration, hardware initialization, management interfaces, and system monitoring.
* Apply working knowledge of Open BMC, Redfish, IPMI, BIOS, UEFI, and PCIe architecture to support system-level troubleshooting.
* Coordinate firmware validation and issue reproduction with appropriate R&D teams.
* Support firmware release verification and configuration checks during NPI and MP.

**Networking and PCIe Firmware Support**

* Support technical investigations involving NIC firmware, network switches, PCIe switches, and add-in cards.
* Analyze logs and system behavior to determine whether an issue originates from firmware, configuration, hardware, or system integration.
* Coordinate with firmware development teams and external vendors to investigate and resolve component-level issues.
* Support configuration verification and firmware compatibility testing for integrated server and rack systems.

**Customer Issue Resolution**

* Act as the firmware subject-matter expert for customer escalations within the Forward Engineering organization.
* Participate in technical issue reviews with customers, management, business units, factory teams, and R&D organizations.
* Translate complex technical findings into clear and concise explanations for customers and non-firmware stakeholders.
* Provide accurate status updates, technical findings, next steps, owners, and estimated timelines.
* Maintain professional communication during high-priority and escalated customer issues.

**NPI and Mass Production Support**

* Provide firmware support throughout NPI phases, including EVT, DVT, and PVT, as well as Mass Production.
* Support factory builds, validation, production testing, and customer qualification activities.
* Work closely with Failure Analysis, Test Engineering, Manufacturing Test Engineering, Quality, and Manufacturing teams.
* Ensure firmware-related issues discovered during production are properly documented, investigated, and escalated.
* Support transition of recurring firmware issues into permanent corrective actions, test improvements, or design changes.

**R&D and Vendor Coordination**

* Work directly with R&D firmware organizations and component vendors to drive issue resolution.
* Provide complete logs, reproduction steps, system configurations, firmware versions, failure conditions, and other required technical information.
* Clearly define the technical problem and communicate the expected next action to the engineering team responsible.
* Track R&D and vendor actions to ensure issues continue progressing toward closure.
* Escalate unresolved issues when additional resources, management attention, or technical decisions are required.

**Debug Tools and Automation**

* Develop, improve, or introduce scripts and diagnostic tools that simplify firmware troubleshooting and data collection.
* Use Python, Bash, Linux command-line tools, or similar technologies to automate repetitive debug activities.
* Improve the consistency and completeness of log collection.
* Develop methods that allow factory teams to capture required information correctly during the first investigation.
* Share effective debug methods and tools with engineering and factory teams.

**Issue Tracking and Closure**

* Maintain ownership of assigned firmware issues from initial identification through resolution and closure.
* Track issue status, technical owners, action items, timelines, and required follow-up.
* Ensure open issues are reviewed regularly with factory and R&D teams.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Engineer, GPU RTL Firmware
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

Samsung, a world leader in advanced semiconductor technology, is founded on a simple philosophy – the endless pursuit of excellence will create a better world for all. At Samsung Austin Research and Development Center (SARC) and Advanced Computing Lab (ACL), we are building a center of excellence for Intellectual Property (IP) that is applied to high-performance computing devices (mobile, automotive, and other custom market segments) consumed by millions of people around the world. Come build with us!

**Role and Responsibilities**

As a Senior Staff GPU RTL Firmware Engineer, you will help shape the design and development of control firmware for Samsung’s next-generation mobile GPUs, shaping critical subsystems such as the Command Processor (CP) and RunList Controller (RLC) that orchestrate GPU execution, scheduling, and system control.

  

In this high-impact individual contributor role, you will collaborate with hardware and software teams to shape how GPU workloads are scheduled, managed, and brought to life in silicon. You will partner closely with architecture, RTL, software, and validation teams to help influence hardware–firmware interfaces, contribute to execution-control strategy, and ensure scalable, production-ready GPU IPs across multiple product generations and market segments.

  

* Leveraging your expertise in GPU control firmware (including CP and RLC architectures), you will help shape the definition, implementation, and evolution of firmware that orchestrates GPU execution, scheduling, context management, and system-level control across multiple GPU IP generations.
* You excel at contributing to the firmware lifecycle, driving firmware architecture, bring-up, debug, and validation while influencing RTL design decisions to ensure clean interfaces, functionality, and scalability across use cases.
* You ensure technical excellence through analysis and optimization of GPU execution and scheduling behavior by identifying performance, latency, and utilization bottlenecks across command processing, runlist management, preemption, and context switching.

* You help influence next-generation GPU architectures, contributing to CP and RLC evolution through RISC-V–based firmware development, architectural exploration, and early enablement of new scheduling, reliability, and power-aware execution features.
* You proactively collaborate with architecture, RTL, and software teams to align execution efficiency with system-level goals.
* You inspire high performance by mentoring junior engineers, contributing to a culture of ownership and innovation, and staying ahead of emerging GPU technologies and RTL firmware technologies.

**Skills and Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience with a Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science/Engineering, or 8+ years of experience with a Master’s Degree, or 6+ years of experience with a Ph.D.

* 8+ years of hands-on experience in firmware development, with strong proficiency in C/C++/ Assembly.
* Strong expertise in GPU or SoC architecture, including command processors, control logic, scheduling, and hardware–software interaction.
* Strong knowledge of RTL design, ASIC flows, Verilog/SystemVerilog.
* Working knowledge of GPU pipelines and graphics/compute APIs (Vulkan, OpenGL, Direct3D, OpenCL).
* Hands-on experience with RISC-V–based microprocessors, including firmware development, bring-up, and debug.
* Excellent debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with proven ability to identify bottlenecks, propose solutions and guide implementation.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and influence in a fast-paced, global team environment.  

  

**Our Team**

  

The GPU Project and RTL teams at SARC/ACL own the microarchitecture development of features for Samsung’s current and next-generation mobile GPU IPs. Our work spans core RTL design, front-end implementation, power and performance optimization, firmware enablement, and the infrastructure needed to deliver scalable, production-ready designs. Through cross-functional collaboration, we translate architectural concepts into high-quality RTL that delivers market-differentiating performance and energy efficiency. Our Xclipse GPU is the industry’s first mobile GPU with hardware ray tracing technology, enabling console-level graphics on Samsung Galaxy smartphones.

You will join a diverse, highly collaborative organization working across concurrent-development cycles, with direct impact on consumer technologies used worldwide. Here you’ll help build what’s next, experiment with new ideas and explore different GPU development verticals, broaden technical expertise, and solve impactful challenges in a supportive environment that values collaboration, continuous learning, and growth.

The base pay range for this role is between $180,200 and $270,400. Your actual base pay will depend on variables that may include your education skills, qualifications, experience, and work location.

---------------

AWS Hardware Engineering Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
In this org: Amazon Web Services (AWS) Scaled Compute is a fast growing and leading-edge research and development team that creates enterprise compute and storage server designs for our innovative web service and e-commerce technology platforms. Our designs are industry-leading in terms of performance, frugality and operational excellence, and are critical to the success of the AWS business and the hundreds of thousands of customers who use utility computing today. We are seeking an experienced Sr. Technical Program Manager (TPM) to define and build the next generation of our cloud platforms. Our success depends on our world-class server infrastructure; we’re handling massive scale and rapid integration of emergent technologies.  
  
The ideal TPM candidate will be an experienced program manager who is skilled in managing server hardware product development teams across several geographic regions using a variety of suppliers (CM, ODM/IHV). The successful candidate will be an innovative self-starter and leader. The candidate will be familiar with the cloud computing industry and AWS offerings and will be passionate about providing the best possible customer experience at the best cost. The candidate will have an obsession with data and precise analysis and will use these as inputs to make decisions.

This is a fast-paced, intellectually challenging position, and you’ll work with thought leaders in multiple technology areas. You’ll have high standards for yourself and everyone you work with, and you’ll be constantly looking for ways to improve your product’s performance, quality and cost. Using data and key metrics, you will also drive and measure process improvements that enhance our operational effectiveness. You will work independently in a dynamic, challenging, and fast-changing organization. We’re changing an industry, and we need individuals who are ready for this challenge and who want to reach beyond what is possible today.

You will have ownership and responsibility for defining and executing processes that deliver both savings and productivity for Amazon.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer - Research and Development
jobs.description:
Onsite:  
Travel: 20%

Join the Maverick Power Team!

At Maverick Power, we don’t just build power distribution solutions—we redefine industry standards. Recognized on the 2025 Inc. 5000 list as #16 in the U.S., #2 in Manufacturing, and #1 in Texas, we are committed to driving innovation, quality, and speed. With multiple manufacturing facilities across North Texas and Phoenix, we are expanding rapidly and looking for top talent to grow with us

If you are ready to be part of a high-energy, solutions-driven team where your work makes an impact, Maverick Power is the place for you.

What We Offer:

* Competitive Salary + Bonus Potential!
* Paid Time Off, 401K Matching, Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits!
* High-growth organization with advancement opportunities!
* Diverse, Collaborative, & Fun Work Environment!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated R&D Electrical Engineer with expertise in low voltage (LV) and medium voltage (MV) power systems to join our dynamic team. The successful candidate will drive the design, development, and testing of innovative power system solutions, contributing to the advancement of next-generation energy technologies. This role requires a strong foundation in electrical engineering principles, hands-on experience with LV/MV systems, and a passion for research and innovation.

Key Responsibilities:

* Design and Development: Design, simulate, and develop electrical systems and components for low voltage (up to 1kV) and medium voltage (1kV–38kV) applications, ensuring compliance with industry standards (e.g., IEEE, IEC, UL).
* Prototyping and Testing: Build and test prototypes of power system components, including transformers, switchgear, circuit breakers, and control systems, to validate performance and reliability.
* Research and Innovation: Conduct research to explore new technologies, materials, and methodologies to improve efficiency, safety, and sustainability of LV/MV power systems.
* Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including mechanical engineers, software engineers, and product managers, to integrate electrical systems into broader product designs.
* Documentation: Prepare technical reports, design specifications, and documentation to support product development, regulatory approvals, and intellectual property filings.
* Standards and Compliance: Ensure all designs and processes adhere to safety, environmental, and regulatory standards, including NEC, NEMA, and OSHA requirements.
* Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve technical issues in power systems during development, testing, and field implementation phases.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or minimum of 8 years of qualified work experience may be substituted.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in R&D or design of low voltage and/or medium voltage power systems.
* Strong background in control system design using SolidWorks Electrical.
* Proven track record in designing and testing electrical components such as transformers, switchgear, or power distribution systems.
* Experience with power electronics, protection systems, and control systems is a plus.
* Strong understanding of power system components, including circuit breakers, relays, and busbars.
* Familiarity with industry standards (e.g., IEEE, IEC, UL, NEC).
* Proficient in using CAD tools (SolidWorks Electrical) for wiring schematics and panel layout design.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong communication and teamwork abilities.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Master’s degree is preferred.
* Experience with renewable energy integration (e.g., solar, wind, energy storage, microgrids) into LV/MV systems.
* Familiarity with smart grid technologies or IoT applications in power systems.
* Professional Engineer (PE) license or equivalent certification.

Physical Requirements:

* Must be able to lift up to 40 pounds at a time.
* Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

Work Environment:  
May work in various settings at the Maverick Power facilities, in offices, in multiple shops, and in commercial buildings. Maintaining the same position or posture while performing tasks and sitting for prolonged periods. The above-noted job description is not intended to describe, in detail, the multitude of tasks that may be assigned but rather to give the applicant a general sense of the responsibilities and expectations of this position. As the nature of business demands change so, too, may the essential functions of the position.

EEO/AAP Statement  
We acknowledge and honor the fundamental value and dignity of all individuals. Maverick Power is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or physical requirements. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Develop applications for monitoring, telemetry, system status, and operational workflows
* Build user-facing applications using modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks
* Develop backend services and APIs that connect applications with physical systems and operational data

jobs.title: Senior Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**PLC /Senior Controls Engineer**   
**Job Listing**

***Veritas Automation Solutions is looking for a full-time Automation/Controls Engineer who is confident working hands-on in industrial environments and capable of taking ownership of PLC, HMI, and SCADA work from troubleshooting and improving existing systems to developing and commissioning new automation solutions.***

***We are looking for a self-motivated, adaptable engineer who approaches problems systematically, learns new technologies quickly, communicates clearly, and is comfortable working both independently and as part of a project team.***

***This role is ideal for someone who wants to expand their technical capabilities, take on increasing responsibility, and contribute directly to customer projects in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial automation company***

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Programming, modifying, debugging, and documenting PLC systems on multiple platforms
* Developing PLC applications using ladder logic, structured text (highly sought), and other programming methods, as appropriate
* Building, modifying, and supporting HMI/SCADA interfaces
* Evaluating existing systems, understanding how they operate, and developing practical solutions before making changes.
* Troubleshooting across a wide variety of equipment, technologies, and PLC platforms — both virtually and in live production environments
* Performing on‑site testing, startup, and commissioning
* Working directly with customer engineers, technicians, operators, and project managers to resolve technical problems and deliver effective automation solutions
* Taking ownership of defined controls work from requirements and development through testing, startup, commissioning, and customer turnover, including planning, communicating project status and technical risks, and escalating significant issues early.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Demonstrated communication, documentation, ownership, and follow-through habits
* Strong problem-solving mindset — able to diagnose issues, develop and implement solutions under pressure.
* 3+ years of relevant PLC, controls, or industrial automation experience, including experience with installing, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting PLC equipment, field devices, and associated wiring.
* Strong proficiency with at least one major PLC platform such as CODESYS, Bosch Rexroth ctrlX, Rockwell Automation, or Siemens, with the ability to learn unfamiliar platforms quickly.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, technical documentation, I/O information, and control-system documentation.
* Ability to independently manage defined engineering work while recognizing when technical, schedule, or customer issues should be escalated.
* Sound engineering judgment with consideration for reliability, maintainability, safety, schedule, and cost.

**Bonus Skills/Experience**

* EtherNet/IP, Node‑RED, OPC UA, Telegram, or other industrial communication technologies.
* Ignition or other SCADA platforms.
* Python or related software-development experience.
* Motion control or servo applications.
* Industrial robotics.
* Experience mentoring junior engineers
* Experience participating in technical/design reviews.

**Work Locations**

· Home / Remote Office and Customer Facilities.

· Travel required for commissioning, customer support, and field service work.

· Preference for individuals in the DFW & Austin Metropolitan area.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Competitive salary based on experience and demonstrated capability.
* Annual incentive compensation.
* Company profit-sharing opportunities.
* Retirement plan with company contributions.

Healthcare and other company benefits.

At Veritas Automation Solutions, we place a high value on engineers who do more than write code. We are looking for people who can understand the system, troubleshoot effectively, make sound technical decisions, and deliver successful results.

If you enjoy solving difficult automation problems, learning new technologies, working directly with industrial systems, and taking ownership of projects, we want to hear from you.

**How to Apply**

Apply via Indeed or directly at: www.veritasautomation.com

For more details, please contact us.

Kendra Snyder

Project Coordinator(682)564-2281

ksnyder@veritasautomation.com

jobs.description:

DAC Robotics designs and implements cutting-edge robotic automation systems across a broad group of manufacturing and logistics sectors. We are creative, fast paced, and solve some of the most challenging automation processes.

If you’re passionate about automation, robotics, and high-performance engineering, DAC Robotics is the place where your ideas can take shape and make an impact.

**Job Summary**

DAC Robotics is seeking a Controls Engineer I to join our team in Leander, TX. This role supports the electrical design, programming, and commissioning of custom industrial automation systems.

This is a hands-on engineering role working alongside experienced engineers to design, build, and integrate automation equipment including PLC-controlled systems and industrial robots.

This position is well suited for early-career engineers, electrical technicians, or automation technicians who want to grow into a full Controls Engineer role.

The ideal candidate is eager to learn, enjoys solving technical challenges, and is comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist in designing electrical and control systems for industrial automation equipment
* Support development and debugging of automation software including PLC, robots, HMIs, and motion systems
* Assist with electrical schematics, I/O lists, and system documentation

jobs.title: Automation Controls Engineer, Manufacturing Automation Design & Engineering
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services' Hardware Engineering team is looking for experienced professionals to help build the world's premier cloud computing platform. The Manufacturing Automation Design & Engineering team designs, validates, and deploys automation solutions, including robotics, cobots, vision inspection, AI-powered quality systems, and automated assembly workflows, across contract manufacturer sites worldwide.  
  
About the Role: You will define the controls and electrical systems architecture for all automated assembly lines, creating the standard control platform that scales across all platforms and all contract manufacturer sites. You own PLC programming standards, HMI development frameworks, safety system architecture, and industrial network design. You define how automated cells communicate with each other, with MES, and with data collection systems. You are the architect of the nervous system that connects every robot, sensor, actuator, and inspection system into a coordinated, data-generating production line. You establish reusable control system templates that ensure consistency and reduce deployment time globally.  
  
The scope covers all server and rack assembly across all architectures and platforms, including compute, AI/ML accelerators, storage, and networking. The team designs intelligent, predictive-analytics-driven production systems where every station is sensor-driven, AI-optimized, and self-correcting, turning assembly lines into programmable, data-generating platforms that scale capacity without scaling headcount. This role requires the engineer to operate in a fast-paced, multi-platform international manufacturing environment with travel to contract manufacturer sites (up to 25-30% travel anticipated).  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Define controls systems architecture: PLC programming standards, HMI frameworks, safety system design, network topology
* Design and program PLC-based control systems for automated assembly lines
* Develop standardized HMI interfaces for operator interaction and production monitoring
* Architect industrial network infrastructure (e.g., EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, EtherCAT) for automated lines
* Design safety system architecture per ISO 13849 and IEC 62443 (functional safety and cybersecurity)
* Create reusable control system templates and code libraries for global deployment standardization
* Define MES integration specifications and data exchange protocols between automation cells and enterprise systems
* Lead controls architecture reviews for automation projects and vendor-supplied systems

  
About the team  
About the team: The Manufacturing Automation Design & Engineering team is building a centralized automation Center of Excellence that owns the process specification and IP for how AWS hardware gets assembled. The team is responsible for engineering, defining automated process requirements, designing and proving solutions at proof-of-concept, and maintaining AWS-owned intellectual property that scales globally. The team works within a collaborative framework across Hardware Engineering (product design for automation), Manufacturing Automation Design & Engineering (process specification and validation), and Manufacturing Operations (deployment and scaling), ensuring automation is engineered once, proven once, and deployed everywhere.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent
* 7+ years designing industrial control systems for automated manufacturing
* Proficiency in PLC programming (e.g., Siemens TIA Portal, Allen-Bradley Studio 5000, Beckhoff TwinCAT)
* Experience with industrial safety system design (e.g., ISO 13849, safety PLCs, safety networks)
* Experience with industrial network protocols (e.g., EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, EtherCAT, OPC-UA)
* Track record of defining control system standards for multi-site deployment

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with MES integration and manufacturing data exchange
* HMI/SCADA development experience (e.g., Ignition, WinCC, FactoryTalk)
* Industrial cybersecurity knowledge (e.g., IEC 62443)
* Experience with servo motion control and multi-axis coordination
* Electronics, server, or precision hardware manufacturing environment
* Experience leading controls design reviews for third-party automation systems
* Lean Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or higher)

  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/ac

Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

**Job Description**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Administer, configure, tune, and troubleshoot **z/OS Communications Server**, including **VTAM, TCP/IP, and TN3270** environments to ensure high availability and optimal network performance.
* Install, maintain, test, document, and support **vendor-supplied mainframe software**, performing root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions.
* Manage and support the **TPX Session Manager** environment, including configuration, maintenance, performance optimization, and issue resolution.
* Install, configure, and support **Connect:Direct** and other enterprise file transfer solutions, ensuring secure and reliable data exchange across platforms.
* Support **GDPS network configurations**, disaster recovery readiness, business continuity planning, and network failover testing activities.
* Design, implement, and troubleshoot secure file transfer solutions including **FTP, SFTP, and FTP-ATTLS**, ensuring compliance with security standards.
* Participate in **network architecture, IP address design, and cross-platform integrations** between z/OS and distributed systems environments.
* Provide technical leadership through vendor product evaluations, configuration management, documentation, standards development, and participation in an on-call support rotation.

* Associate's degree or equivalent work experience

* Strong expertise in **IBM z/OS Systems Programming** with hands-on experience supporting enterprise mainframe networking environments.
* Advanced knowledge of **z/OS Communications Server**, including **VTAM, TCP/IP, TN3270, and network performance tuning**.
* Experience administering and supporting **TPX Session Manager** in large-scale production environments.
* Knowledge of **Connect:Direct**, secure file transfer technologies, and enterprise data exchange solutions.
* Experience with **GDPS**, contingency planning, disaster recovery, and resilient network design.

jobs.description:
Onsite:  
Travel: 20%

Join the Maverick Power Team!

At Maverick Power, we don’t just build power distribution solutions—we redefine industry standards. Recognized on the 2025 Inc. 5000 list as #16 in the U.S., #2 in Manufacturing, and #1 in Texas, we are committed to driving innovation, quality, and speed. With multiple manufacturing facilities across North Texas and Phoenix, we are expanding rapidly and looking for top talent to grow with us

If you are ready to be part of a high-energy, solutions-driven team where your work makes an impact, Maverick Power is the place for you.

What We Offer:

* Competitive Salary + Bonus Potential!
* Paid Time Off, 401K Matching, Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits!
* High-growth organization with advancement opportunities!
* Diverse, Collaborative, & Fun Work Environment!

About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Electrical Engineer to lead the design, development, and implementation of advanced DC power systems for critical infrastructure, including data centers, telecommunications, and renewable energy applications. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in electrical engineering, expertise in DC power distribution, and a proven track record of delivering reliable, efficient, and scalable power solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

* System Design & Development: Lead the design of high-efficiency DC power systems, including rectifiers, inverters, battery backup systems, and power distribution units (PDUs) for mission-critical applications.
* Technical Leadership: Provide technical guidance to junior engineers and cross-functional teams, ensuring compliance with industry standards (e.g., IEEE, UL, NEC).
* Project Management: Oversee end-to-end project lifecycles, from requirements gathering and system architecture to testing, commissioning, and maintenance.
* Performance Optimization: Analyze and optimize DC power systems for energy efficiency, reliability, and scalability, integrating renewable energy sources where applicable.
* Troubleshooting & Support: Diagnose and resolve complex power system issues, ensuring minimal downtime for critical operations.
* Vendor Collaboration: Work with suppliers to select and qualify power components, ensuring cost-effectiveness and compatibility with system requirements.
* Documentation: Create detailed technical documentation, including schematics, specifications, and operational manuals.
* Innovation: Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in DC power systems, contributing to R&D initiatives and patent filings as needed.
* Other duties as assigned by supervisor.

Qualifications:

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or related field; master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum of 7 years of experience in DC power systems engineering, with at least 3 years in a senior or lead role.
* Proven expertise in designing and deploying DC power systems for data centers, telecom, or renewable energy applications.
* Proficiency in DC power system design tools (e.g., AutoCAD Electrical, MATLAB, PSpice).
* Deep knowledge of power electronics, battery technologies (e.g., lithium-ion, VRLA), and energy storage systems.
* Familiarity with control systems, SCADA, and BMS for power monitoring and management.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and leadership abilities.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Certifications: PE license or relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, Six Sigma) preferred.
* Experience with high-voltage DC (HVDC) systems or microgrid integration.
* Knowledge of renewable energy systems (solar, wind) and their integration with DC power infrastructure.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity standards for power systems.

Physical Requirements:

* Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Must be able to lift up to twenty-five pounds at times.

Work Environment:  
May work in various settings at the Maverick Power facilities, in offices, in multiple shops, and in commercial buildings. Maintaining the same position or posture while performing tasks and sitting for prolonged periods. As the nature of business demands change so, too, may the essential functions of the position.

jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

As a Software Engineer III – MLOps at JPMorgan Chase as a part of Banking and Wealth Management Technology, you build and operate a machine learning operations (MLOps) platform on Amazon Web Services (AWS) that supports model development, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, and governance across multiple environments

We are building a secure, resilient machine learning delivery ecosystem that helps teams move faster without compromising controls. In this role, you will develop platform foundations—Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes patterns, multi-environment governance, and operational excellence—so product and data teams can deploy and operate models with confidence. You will collaborate across engineering, data, and risk partners to standardize best practices, strengthen reliability, and improve developer experience. The work spans build, run, and continuous improvement across multiple environments.

You will contribute to platform resiliency through high-availability designs, multi-Availability Zone patterns, capacity planning, and incident readiness. You will define observability standards to ensure services are measurable, diagnosable, and supportable in production. Your work will help teams deliver batch and online inference safely with standardized deployment and rollback approaches.

**Job responsibilities**

* Five years of experience in platform engineering, software engineering, or machine learning operations roles.
* Hands-on experience building and operating production platforms on AWS.
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, including Amazon EKS, Helm or Kustomize, ingress, autoscaling, and workload scheduling.
* Hands-on experience using Terraform for repeatable environment provisioning and controlled change management.
* Demonstrated experience using approved AI-assisted software development tools to support coding, code review, testing, troubleshooting, and documentation, with clear validation practices for correctness, performance, and security.
* Knowledge of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity awareness and secure handling of inputs and outputs.
* Experience implementing security controls for cloud and Kubernetes platforms (for example: identity and access management, role-based access control, secrets management, network policies, and vulnerability management).
* Experience designing and operating highly available systems, including on-call readiness, incident response, and post-incident reviews.
* Experience establishing or operating observability practices across metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerting, and service-level objectives (where defined).
* Experience building and operating streaming pipelines with Apache Kafka and Apache Flink.
* Proficiency in one or more programming languages used in platform or streaming engineering (for example: Python, Java, Scala, or Go), plus CI/CD automation experience.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills**

* 5+ years (or equivalent) in platform engineering, Java, or MLOps roles.
* Hands-on experience building production platforms on AWS.
* Strong Kubernetes experience, including Amazon EKS, Helm/Kustomize, ingress, autoscaling, and workload scheduling.
* Strong Terraform experience for repeatable environment provisioning and change management.
* Demonstrated experience leading effective use of approved AI-assisted software development tools (e.g., for coding, code review, test acceleration, troubleshooting) with the ability to set team expectations for validating AI outputs for correctness, performance, and security
* Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; experience coaching engineers on safe, compliant adoption within delivery practices
* Experience implementing security controls for cloud/Kubernetes platforms (IAM, RBAC, secrets, network policies, vulnerability management).
* Proven ability to deliver resilient, highly available systems and to operate them (on-call readiness, incident response, postmortems).
* Strong observability experience (metrics/logs/traces, dashboards, alerting, SLOs).
* Streaming experience with Kafka and real-time data processing; experience building/operating Flink pipelines is required.
* Solid programming/scripting skills (commonly Python, Java/Scala for Flink, and/or Go) and CI/CD automation experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience enabling GPU workloads on Kubernetes (for example: device plugins, node pools, scheduling, and performance tuning).
* Familiarity with machine learning platform components such as model registries, experiment tracking, feature stores, and artifact management.
* Experience with service mesh, policy as code, and container supply chain security.
* Experience integrating with data lake or data warehouse platforms and implementing data quality monitoring.
* Experience working in regulated environments with strong engineering governance.

We are seeking a highly independent Principal Software Engineer to design, develop, and operate large-scale broadband device management platforms supporting millions of connected devices in public cloud environments.

  

This role requires end-to-end ownership across architecture, development, deployment, and production operations, with deep expertise in broadband technologies such as TR-069 (CWMP) and TR-369 (USP). jobs.description:
Do you want to grow with us? At DXP we are passionate about what we do and driven to be the best solution for our industrial customers. Since 1908 DXP has been dedicated to the highest quality of customer service through our expertise of the products we distribute and the technical services we perform with a sense of individual pride and company spirit. Check out our many videos to learn more! http://www.dxpe.com/about-us/careers/

**Electrical Engineer**

**Position Summary**

The electrical engineer is responsible for developing and executing basic and detailed engineering for electrical systems applied to modular process packages and skids in the oil & gas, petrochemical, and power industries. The electrical engineer will combine strong technical electrical design fundamentals, in accordance with applicable international standards and company specifications, senior-level technical decision-making, and mentorship of junior engineers, with the ability to provide hands-on support during shop fabrication and in the field, including direct client interaction during commissioning and after-sales service.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the development and review of one-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, conduit/cable tray installation drawings, and hazardous area classification layouts.
* Perform and validate electrical load calculations, conductor sizing, voltage drop, short circuit, and protective device coordination studies, including review of calculations prepared by junior engineers or sub-contractors.
* Specify and select electrical equipment (transformers, MCCs, VFDs, motor starters, lighting, grounding systems) in accordance with client requirements and applicable standards (NEC, IEEE, NEMA, API RP 500/505).
* Prepare and approve technical specifications, equipment data sheets, and bid packages for electrical equipment and materials.
* Develop and validate hazardous area classifications (Class I Div. 1/2, Zone 1/2) per NEC Articles 500-505, ensuring all specified components meet the required classification.
* Review and approve vendor drawings for conformance with project specifications.
* Serve as the senior technical reference for complex electrical design questions within the team.
* Provide direct technical support to the shop during fabrication, wiring, and testing of skid-mounted electrical systems.
* Resolve field deviations and coordinate engineering changes (redlines/as-builts) during construction.
* Lead or participate in point-to-point checks, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), and continuity/insulation verification prior to shipment.
* Coordinate with the instrumentation, mechanical/piping, and structural teams to ensure proper integration of electrical systems within the skid.
* Provide on-site technical support during installation, commissioning, and start-up of supplied electrical systems.
* Diagnose and resolve complex field electrical issues (troubleshooting) on installed and operating equipment.
* Document field findings and provide feedback to the engineering team for continuous improvement of future designs.
* Train client personnel and junior team engineers on the operation and maintenance of supplied electrical systems.
* Review installation procedures, alignment methods, and start-up protocols.
* Interface with vendors and multidisciplinary teams (process, mechanical, piping, instrumentation and controls, rotating equipment, operations and maintenance teams).
* Develop and update internal specifications, guidelines, engineering standards and best practices related to rotating equipment.
* Maintain technical documentation and lessons learned from equipment operation and failures.
* Provide technical training and mentorship to junior engineers and maintenance staff.
* Issue BOMs and work instruction releases.
* Communicate effectively and consistently with internal and external clients.

**Qualifications**

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field.
* Minimum 5 years of electrical engineering experience in the oil & gas, petrochemical, or power generation industry, with a demonstrated track record of technical leadership on projects.
* Proven experience designing electrical systems for modular packages/skids.
* Experience with field support/commissioning at industrial sites.

**Technical Knowledge**

* Proficiency in applicable codes and standards: NEC (NFPA 70), IEEE, NEMA, API RP 500/505, IEC (for international projects), and hazardous area classification.
* Proficiency with electrical design tools (AutoCAD Electrical, SKM PowerTools, ETAP, or equivalent short-circuit/coordination software).
* Working knowledge of control systems (PLC/DCS), associated instrumentation, and their interface with electrical systems.

**Skills and Competencies**

* Ability to lead and work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams (process, mechanical, instrumentation, structural).
* Availability to work in the fabrication shop/site as needed (including possible on-site client support).
* Strong technical communication and reporting skills, both written and verbal, including direct senior-level client interaction.
* Practical orientation, independent technical judgment, and problem-solving ability under pressure, both in the office and in the shop/field.
* Ability to interact with vendors and multidisciplinary teams, and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

jobs.title: Facilities Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**Change the world. Love your job.**

Texas Instruments (TI) is looking for an experienced Electrical Engineer to join our Facilities Central Engineering Team. In this role you will drive continuous improvement and optimization of our electrical low-voltage switchgear, transformers, emergency power, and electrical distribution systems. You will leverage your technical expertise to advance process efficiency, ensure compliance, and support the strategic goals of our facility’s manufacturing operations. These systems are designed to run 24 hours a day, 365 days a year without interruption, creating a state of the art manufacturing environment. Facilities works closely with TI's manufacturing team to understand how the utility systems impact the process as well as how to reduce consumption.
  
  
Responsibilities include:

**Engineering & Technical Leadership**

* Make engineering decisions that balance safety, reliability, cost, capacity, and operational efficiency
* Lead the analysis, design, and continuous improvement of electrical systems (switchgear, transformers, UPS systems, emergency power, electrical panel distribution, and power monitoring)
* Provide engineering technical support for system operations, maintenance, troubleshooting, and incident response
* Develop and maintain key electrical documentation including one-line drawings, standard order of operations, standard operation procedures, and process documents
* Drive reliability and risk-based engineering through root cause analysis, FMEAs, system assessments, and improvement roadmaps
* Partner with operations, maintenance, manufacturing, EHS, and engineering teams to improve system performance and safe operation
* Mentor engineers, system specialists, and technicians while strengthening overall team technical capability
  

**Project Leadership & Execution**

* Lead capital and expense projects for system upgrades, expansions, and optimization initiatives from concept through startup and handoff
* Define project scope, priorities, schedules, resources, and success measures, and drive execution to plan
* Coordinate design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and startup activities to ensure systems perform as intended
* Develop scopes of work, bid packages, technical specifications, and construction documentation
* Facilitate alignment across engineering, operations, supply chain, and external partners throughout project execution
* Identify and manage project risks, change control, and implementation issues to minimize operational impact
* Report project progress, results, and lessons learned to leadership
  

***Texas Instruments will not sponsor job applicants for visas or work authorization for this position.***

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Minimum Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, ECE, or equivalent degree
* 5+ years of relevant engineering experience in electrical systems
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Capital or expense project leadership for electrical systems
* Strong background in electrical systems for semiconductor manufacturing including:
  + Low to high voltage (120V-138kV) electrical distribution
  + Emergency power (UPS systems, ATS/STS, generators, and battery systems)
  + Power System Analysis (load-flow, short-circuit, arc flash, & coordination study)
  + Power Monitoring/SCADA
  + IEEE, NFPA, NEC Electrical Standards
* Advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, FMEA, and reliability engineering experience
* Performance metrics, dashboards, and data analysis for system optimization
* Cross-functional partnership across facilities, manufacturing, EHS, process engineering, and maintenance

General Atomics (GA), and its affiliated companies, is one of the world’s leading resources for high-technology systems development ranging from the nuclear fuel cycle to remotely piloted aircraft, airborne sensors, and advanced electric, electronic, wireless and laser technologies. General Atomics Electromagnetic Systems (GA-EMS) designs and manufactures first-of-a-kind electromagnetic and electric power generation systems. GA-EMS' expanding portfolio of specialized products and integrated system solutions support critical fleet, space systems and satellites, missile defense, power and energy, and process and monitoring applications for defense, industrial, and commercial customers worldwide.

As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Anduril Intelligence Systems (AIS) is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of specialized engineering and products for Intelligence Community (IC) customers. We work within the IC to understand their requirements, shape their concepts of operation, and deliver exquisite capability across their problem set. We aim to develop and deploy critically needed capabilities that address our customers' most pressing national security requirements.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

Anduril's AIS team is seeking experienced Rust developers to build out the software ecosystem supporting next-generation hardware platforms powered by cutting edge System-on-Chip devices.

* Architect, maintain, and evolve complex software systems, refactoring existing codebases to improve performance, maintainability, and scalability.
* Develop high-performance Rust software for real-time systems, ranging from tactical implementations to simulation environments and decision support tools.
* Apply software design patterns and architectural best practices to manage technical debt and guide the evolution of production systems over time.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of production-grade Rust experience in a Linux development environment
* Experience building software solutions involving significant amounts of data processing and analysis
* Experience with network protocols and deeply familiar with networking fundamentals
* Ability to quickly understand and navigate complex systems and established code bases
* A desire to work on critical software that has a real-world impact
* Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance, at a minimum.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with embedded platforms
* Experience refactoring and modernizing Rust codebases in production environments.
* Track record of architectural decision-making and technical leadership on long-lived projects.
* Contributions to open-source Rust projects or the broader Rust ecosystem.
* Experience with concurrent and parallel programming patterns in Rust.

jobs.description:
**Position Title:** Electrical Engineering – Technical Fellow  
**Requisition ID:** 1890  
**Position Location:** Fairfax, VA  
**Position Reports To:** Senior Director, Hardware Engineering  
**Supervises Others**: No (technical leadership across matrixed teams)

At Trident Systems Space Electronic Systems (SES) division, we believe in the power of using strong engineering principles to drive innovation and solve complex problems. We foster a culture of rigorous engineering and continuous improvement, leveraging the full knowledge of our organization through collaborative product development processes that include design and peer reviews. We combine our expertise in space electronics with right-sized development processes to create innovative, high-performance space-based electronic systems that meet our customers' evolving needs.

We are a mission partner supporting DoD, Intelligence Community, and Civil space customers. We develop complex, radiation effects mitigated, designs that balance competing requirements in modern space programs, delivering cutting-edge solutions that enable our customers to achieve more in space.

**Position Summary**

The Electrical Engineering - Technical Fellow serves as a division-level technical leader within Trident Systems’ Space Electronic Systems (SES) division, responsible for architecting, developing, and guiding high-performance space computer and embedded hardware solutions for space and defense applications. This role provides deep, recognized subject matter expertise across the full space hardware development lifecycle, including power systems, internal spacecraft charging, radiation effects, and high-speed signaling—from requirements definition through design, integration, test, delivery, and on-orbit support—while ensuring designs meet stringent performance, reliability, and radiation-mitigation requirements. The Senior Principal Electrical Engineer partners closely with cross-functional engineering teams, executive and program leadership, and customers to solve complex technical challenges, support program execution and business development efforts, and set the long-term technology roadmap and technical strategy for the organization. As the division’s senior-most individual-contributor technical authority, the Senior Principal Electrical Engineer holds final design review and sign-off authority on complex, high-risk, or first-of-kind embedded hardware and space computer efforts, and mentors Principal-level engineers across the discipline.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Provide technical leadership and mentorship for discipline engineers, including Principal-level staff
* Subject matter expert for space electronics hardware engineering discipline, including power systems, internal spacecraft charging, radiation effects, and high-speed signaling; serves as final technical review and sign-off authority on complex, high-risk, or first-of-kind designs, ensuring designs meet Trident engineering standards prior to release
* Architect and lead the space computer hardware development process: requirements specification, characterization, simulation, high-speed digital and SerDes design (>10 Gbps), signal and power integrity, power system design, radiation-effects mitigation, signal processing, schematic capture, PCB layout and routing, PCA testing, and system integration
* Set the architecture for high-performance space computers, balancing processing performance, memory, interconnect, power, thermal, SWaP, reliability, and radiation tolerance
* Serve as the cognizant engineer for the power system across the hardware stack — power architecture, radiation-tolerant conversion and regulation, sequencing, protection, power integrity, and spacecraft bus interfaces — guiding design decisions, reviewing analyses and test results, and approving the design at each gate.
* Establish and enforce design practices for internal spacecraft charging mitigation, grounding, and EMI/EMC
* Manage radiation effects analysis and mitigation (TID, SEE, displacement damage), including radiation hardness assurance, parts selection and test strategy, and fault-tolerant design (e.g., EDAC, scrubbing, redundancy)
* Lead high-speed signaling design and analysis: SerDes links (>10 Gbps), channel modeling, signal integrity, jitter budgeting, and protocol implementation
* Chair design and peer reviews of design work and documentation, including PDR, CDR, and TRR milestones
* Provide technical direction to discipline team, other engineering teams, PMO, EGD and VP
* Provide hands-on technical leadership to programs as needed based on severity of resource demand and challenge of design, including design recovery and anomaly investigation
* Lead technical strategy and solution architecture for business development efforts, including proposals and capture
* Represent Trident Systems Engineering with customer, vendor, and industry interface as a recognized subject matter expert
* Define and drive the ES technology roadmap and IRAD investment priorities by identifying goals for department and plans for execution
* Ability to support travel or off-site work, as needed.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or related technical degree
* Demonstrated experience serving as final technical design authority / sign-off for complex or first-of-kind space flight hardware programs
* 15+ years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree OR 13+ years with a Master’s degree OR 10+ years with a doctorate, including at least 8 years designing space or aerospace electronics
* Experience with mixed-signal PCA development, utilizing High Density Interconnect (HDI) PCBs and high speed (> 10 GHz) and serial (SerDes) components/circuits operating at >10 Gbps
* Experience with FPGA and microprocessor development, including hardware descriptor languages (i.e. Verilog, VHDL)
* Experience with hardware integratio

jobs.title: Robotic Software Engineer- Perception and Autonomy
jobs.description:
Why This Role Is Critical:

As the need for nuclear energy grows, the future couldn’t be brighter. Join our vital mission to create lasting solutions for our planet’s greatest challenges. In this role, you are ready to shape the future of clean energy and make a long-lasting global impact. With us, anticipate engaging and challenging projects that deliver innovative solutions and value-added technologies helping power more than 38 million North American homes.

In this role you will build and test autonomy and perception features to enhance teleoperated mobile robots for non-destructive inspection. The role blends hands‑on software development with system integration while working closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams. You’ll own meaningful subsystems early on and gradually influence how future robots are designed, tested, and deployed.

For more on Framatome robotic solutions, visit https://www.framatome.com/solutions-portfolio/basket/robotics-for-safer-smarter-nuclear-inspection-and-maintenance-2/

What You’ll Do Day-To-Day:

* Independently design, debug, test, and review robotics systems, including hardware-in-the-loop and sim-to-real environments.
* Build, configure, and integrate subsystems responsible for sensor fusion, perception, and remote autonomous deployment.
* Prototype and mature robot localization and state estimation, including visual-inertial odometry and SLAM.
* Develop and tune trajectory planning solutions for mobile robots, leveraging cost maps, planners, and behavior trees.
* Diagnose and resolve issues related to sensor integration, timing, frame inconsistencies, and system failures.
* As you grow in the role, assume ownership of a specific application, including operational and strategic leadership, creating and defending system design, and technical leadership at the interface with internal and external partners.
* As you grow in your role, teach and provide guidance to less experienced software engineers.

What You'll Bring:

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. Equivalent work experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
* Minimum of 2 years of related experience.
* Hands-on experience developing and deploying robotics software on Windows and Linux, using Git, package management, logging, profiling, and containerized deployment. Experience with ROS2 is strongly preferred, although not required.
* Direct experience in mobile robotics and one or more of: robotic vision, state estimation and localization, sensor fusion. Other mechanical and electrical engineering experience, as relevant for robotics, is welcome, but not required.
* Excellent communication skills with ability to work effectively with all levels of staff and management.
* Ability to develop and maintain good interpersonal relationships; work collaboratively within a team environment.
* Aptitude to change priorities quickly, confront issues directly and work well as part of a team.

Total Rewards Package:

* **Salary:** $77,000- $100,000, and may also include annual incentives and performance bonuses. The base salary range is a guideline. Individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies and work location.
* **Health & Wellness:** Multiple medical plan options, dental & vision coverage, life insurance, long- and short-term disability, and optional supplemental plans (critical illness, accident, hospital indemnity, dependent life).
* **Retirement:** 401(k) with employer match.
* **Paid Time Off:** Up to 3 weeks of vacation, 8 sick days, and 13 paid holidays annually.
* **Extra Perks:** Lifestyle spending account, employer paid mental health support, education reimbursement, professional development opportunities, adoption assistance, parental leave, and employee assistance programs.

About Framatome:

Framatome has been shaping the future of nuclear energy in the U.S. for more than 60 years. Framatome Inc. is headquartered in Lynchburg, Virginia, with more than 2,400+ employees across North America supporting nearly every nuclear plant in the nation.

From our facilities in Virginia, Washington, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Massachusetts and beyond, we deliver outage services, advanced nuclear fuel technologies, and next-gen reactor innovations that keep the lights on.

At Framatome, you will join a global team committed to creating reliable, carbon-free energy. Here, you can:

* **Solve complex nuclear challenges** that directly impact the climate.
* **Build your career** through technical fellowships, leadership roles, and global opportunities.
* **Do your best work** in a culture that values safety, innovation, and well-being.

Framatome is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including Veterans, and Individuals with Disabilities.

Offers are contingent on background check and drug screen (where applicable). Positions may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control regulations; applicants must meet eligibility requirements (see DOE 810 Appendix A).

jobs.description:

**Description**
---------------

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Space Systems in Dulles, Virginia, is seeking an experienced Systems Engineer to join the rapidly growing Space Superiority Division. Space is no longer a sanctuary— it is increasingly contested and operationally complex, and the need for resilient, responsive spacecraft and mission capabilities has never been greater. This is a chance to work on some of the most consequential technical challenges in the space domain and to see your work fly.

You’ll join a cross-disciplinary team that develops, integrates, tests, and delivers advanced spacecraft and mission systems for space security missions, while building expertise in and contributing to Northrop Grumman’s rendezvous and proximity operations (RPO) capabilities. RPO is routine work for this team, backed by hands-on operational experience and a proven on-orbit track record. Northrop Grumman leads the industry in this capability, and joining this team means working alongside the people who helped make that true. As a Systems Engineer, you'll apply systems engineering principles across the full mission lifecycle, from early concept development and analysis through integration, test, launch, and on-orbit mission execution.

Prior space experience is not required, but demonstrated experience developing, integrating, testing, or operating complex technical systems is essential. Some of our strongest engineers came from naval systems, aircraft, missiles, electronics, autonomous vehicles, robotics, and other engineering fields. If you know how to make complex systems work and you want to apply those skills to one of the most important and fastest growing areas of national security, we want to hear from you.

**Primary responsibilities include:**

* Supporting major program milestones and readiness reviews by developing technical content and translating complex information into clear presentations for key stakeholders.
* Authoring and contributing to program data products, systems engineering artifacts, and other critical deliverables.
* Collaborating with mission partners to develop and mature the system with a focus on successful mission execution.
* Supporting the development of new spacecraft or modification of existing spacecraft to enable an accelerated path from concept to launch.
* Developing and applying an understanding of spacecraft operations and design reference missions, particularly missions involving RPO in a contested space domain.
* Developing analysis and modeling tools to evaluate mission concepts and spacecraft performance.
* Managing requirements, including decomposing mission-level objectives into system and subsystem requirements and maintaining traceability throughout the development lifecycle.
* Managing internal and external interfaces, particularly payloads, host vehicles, and RPO sensor suites.

This position is contingent upon the candidate obtaining final clearances and program access(es) within a reasonable period of time determined by the company.

This position is 100% on site.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field and 5 years of applicable experience, or a Master’s Degree and 3 years of applicable experience, or a PhD and 1 years of applicable experience
* Demonstrated experience applying systems engineering principles to the design, development, integration, test, or operation of complex aerospace, defense, or similarly complex technical systems.
* Experience collaborating across multiple engineering disciplines to resolve technical issues and develop integrated system solutions.
* Demonstrated experience performing one or more core systems-engineering functions, such as requirements development and management, interface definition and control, system architecture, mission analysis, mission operations, technical trade studies, or system verification and validation.
* **Requires an active U.S. Government Top Secret clearance at time of application.**

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* An active or current TS/SCI Clearance.

* Experience supporting the design, development, integration, test, or operation of spacecraft or related systems.
* Experience with system architecture and concept of operations (CONOP) development.
* Experience developing technical briefings and communicating complex engineering information to senior technical, program, customer, or executive stakeholders.
* Experience with model-based systems engineering (MBSE).
* Technical experience in one or more of the following areas: orbital mechanics, astrodynamics, or mission design; spacecraft guidance, navigation, and control; relative navigation, sensor fusion, or RPO sensing; spacecraft autonomy and fault management; mission operations, spacecraft operations, or ground systems; avionics, payloads, or digital electronics; RF communications or link analysis; spacecraft integration and test; launch and on-orbit operations; or other technical disciplines applicable to complex space missions.

jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**Build the operating system for the AI datacenter**
----------------------------------------------------

Crusoe operates one of the world's largest managed GPU fleets, and it is growing fast. A fleet at this scale cannot be run the way GPU clouds have traditionally been run: runbooks, war rooms, and heroics. It has to be run by a unified platform that senses, reasons about, and acts on the entire fleet, so infrastructure that used to take a team to operate takes a service instead. That is what our cloud platform team builds. You will work on the control plane for one of the largest AI fleets in the world, at a point where fleet autonomy is still an open problem: nobody has fully solved this at this scale, in this market.

**A true platform, not internal tooling:** We want to be explicit about that heading, because it is the thing most infrastructure roles get wrong. Everything we build ships as a product, fleet engineers, SREs, and product teams across Crusoe build their own services and workflows on top of what we ship. A platform team does not scale by doing everyone's work; it scales by making everyone's work self-serve. Concretely:

* **API-first.** Every capability is exposed through well-designed, versioned APIs behind a single gateway. If it isn't an API, it doesn't exist. No side doors, including for us.
* **SDKs and paved paths.** First-class client libraries, workflow templates, and golden paths so a fleet or SRE engineer can ship a new remediation or lifecycle workflow in days without asking the platform team.
* **Micro frontends and a self-serve portal.** Teams plug their own UI surfaces into one developer portal instead of building one-off dashboards. One console for the fleet, extensible by every team.
* **Platform as product.** Internal teams are customers. We own contracts, versioning, deprecation policy, quotas, documentation, and support. Adoption is our success metric: the platform wins when other teams choose it because it is the fastest path, not because it is mandated.

**What this platform is**
-------------------------

Four layers, built as one system:

* **Agents** on every site and host that collect telemetry and execute commands.
* **A distributed infra graph**: Models system connections down to the rack, fabric, power, and cooling layers. By integrating these connections with telemetry signals, the platform can precisely trace events to identify their blast radius and root cause.
* **A reconciliation core**: workflow engine, policy engine, and state reconciler that continuously close the gap between intended state and reality, exposed through the API gateway.
* **Domain services**: Services spanning provisioning, firmware upgrade, validation, deployment, repair and RMA, capacity, power and thermal, and Day-2 operations. Built once, run fleet-wide, consumable by any team through APIs and SDKs.

We operate on a continuous autonomy loop—sense, correlate, reason, act, learn—incorporating guardrails that evolve from recommendation to full automation. We treat every recurring manual intervention as a signal to engineer the next automation.

**You'll thrive here if you**
-----------------------------

* Want to build a platform, not integrate one. This is core distributed-systems engineering: event buses, graph models, reconciliation loops, policy evaluation.
* Treat internal engineers as customers and sweat API ergonomics, docs, and onboarding the way product teams sweat UX.
* Like owning a hard abstraction and defending it as ten teams build on top of you.
* Believe the interesting problems are where physical infrastructure meets software: a firmware counter, a thermal event, and a scheduling decision are one problem, not three.
* Measure yourself by what stops paging humans, and by how fast another team ships on your platform.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Design and build core platform services: RBAC, tenancy, the workflow engine, policy engine, and state reconciler that drive fleet actions safely at scale.
* Design the public face of the platform: the API gateway, resource model, and versioned API contracts that fleet, SRE, and product teams build against.
* Build SDKs, workflow templates, and golden paths that make the platform self-serve, plus the developer portal and micro frontend framework that let teams bring their own UI surfaces.
* Build the inventory and topology graph as the fleet's source of intended truth, and the pipelines that keep it honest against reality (metadata drift is one of our top verified incident root causes; you will kill it).
* Build site, GPU, and network agents and the event bus that moves fleet telemetry and commands reliably.
* Deliver the platform roadmap: pilot site on the foundation layer, first site deployed entirely through the platform, zero-downtime f
