new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon is seeking exceptional talent to help develop the next generation of advanced robotics systems that will transform automation at Amazon's scale. We're building revolutionary robotic systems that combine AI, sophisticated control systems, and advanced electromechanical design to create adaptable automation solutions capable of working safely alongside humans in dynamic environments. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of robotics and automation at an unprecedented scale, working with world-class teams pushing the boundaries of what's possible in robotic manipulation.
  
  
Amazon is seeking a talented and motivated Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer to design, implement, and launch firmware for highly dexterous robotic end effectors. In this role you will own firmware sub-domains independently. The ideal candidate has extensive experience writing firmware to process a wide variety of sensors, control electric motors, and communicate with the larger system, and can work well both independently and in a multidisciplinary team setting.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Drive communication interface integration at the firmware layer, ensuring robust, deterministic communication between the end effector and the larger robotic system.
* Review vendor firmware deliverables, provide technical direction, and hold vendors to Amazon's quality, coding, and integration standards.
* Author functional requirements, design verification plans, and test procedures; execute designs that meet those requirements.
* Build and test firmware for electromechanical subsystem prototypes and integrated systems, covering sensor processing, motor control, and system communication.
* Support product releases to manufacturing and customer deployments, including production firmware bring-up and validation, working efficiently to support fast-paced development schedules.

  
A day in the life  
Your morning starts with a new sensor module on your desk: the latest prototype from a manufacturing partner overseas. You jump on a call with the vendor's engineering team to walk through their test results, flag an issue you spotted in the data, and agree on a firmware fix they'll turn around overnight. Getting fast iteration cycles on hardware is how this team operates: you don't wait for perfect specs, you get hardware moving and learn from what it tells you.
  
  
By mid-morning you're designing the control interface for the end effector: defining how it talks to the rest of the system, what data it exposes, and how it fits into the real-time communication architecture. You sketch the firmware-side changes, then switch to the simulation environment to update the corresponding ROS model so the controls engineer you're working with can test policies against it before hardware arrives. Making things work in sim and on your dev kit in the same day is normal here: the hardware hasn't shipped yet, but that doesn't stop you.
  
  
After lunch you pick up a code review from another team. They're building the actuator control framework that your end effector integrates with, and their latest change surfaces a new set of requirements you hadn't considered. You leave substantive feedback, and it reshapes how you're thinking about your own interface design.
  
  
You close the day with a quick chat with a teammate on the mechanical design side who's working on a physical sensor model. They want help writing custom firmware to characterize the sim-to-real gap, and you realize it connects directly to the simulation change you made that morning. What started as two separate threads becomes a collaboration. You open a shared design doc and start outlining the approach together.
  
  
About the team  
We're developing next-generation robotic manipulation capabilities for highly dexterous multi-finger grippers and hands. Our firmware work spans motor control, sensor processing, tactile sensing production firmware, and the tight integration of the robotic end effector with the larger robotic platform. We build the embedded systems that bring capable, reliable robotic hardware to life.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* 5+ years of professional software development in C or C++ for embedded systems 5+ years of full embedded software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
* 5+ years developing embedded C applications that use an RTOS (such as FreeRTOS, uC-OS, Zephyr, VxWorks) or embedded Linux environments
* 3+ years of development experience with some aspect of robotic systems, including direct, hands-on experience designing, developing, and debugging one of: consumer electronics, medical devices, automotive systems, avionics, industrial, or telecommunications products
* Experience with at least two communication protocols at the firmware layer (e.g., EtherCAT, CAN/CAN-FD, SPI, I2C, RS-485, Ethernet/UDP)
* Experience debugging firmware/hardware integration issues with lab equipment (JTAG/SWD, logic analyzer, oscilloscope)

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or a related field
* 10+ years of full embedded software development life cycle experience
* Hands-on experience with motor control firmware (BLDC/FOC, current sensing, commutation, torque/velocity/position control loops)
* Experience with EtherCAT or other real-time industrial communication protocols at the firmware layer (CiA 402 / CANopen profiles)
* Experience with Ethernet/UDP protocol des

---------------

Join AWS Hardware Engineering to design the servers powering the world's leading cloud platform and AI/ML infrastructure. We're seeking an exceptional Linux Kernel Engineer to accelerate critical kernel initiatives across millions of servers worldwide.

In this role, you will lead Linux kernel patching, code development, and version adoption for our server management controllers across a massive global fleet. You will ensure our kernel remains current, secure, and compliant with strict patching service-level agreements that directly impact AWS infrastructure reliability. new_jobs.description:
The Hardware Design, Rack-scale Technology and Platforms (HDRTP) engineering team designs, develops, validates, and delivers the hardware platforms that power Meta's AI and HPC infrastructure, deployed in data centers worldwide. new_jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

  

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

*The Anduril Rocket Motor Systems (RMS) team is on a mission to build next generation solid rocket motors for a safer, more connected world. To achieve our vision of becoming a large-volume provider of tactical rocket motors, we will develop differentiated products and services that maximize our customers' capabilities, and we will establish and maintain a reputation of Quality and Reliability.*  
  
**ABOUT THE JOB**  
  
As the Electrical Engineer, you will specify, design, develop and install devices used to collect data on solid rocket motor burn performance. Additionally, you will design custom electronic solutions—including PCBs, firmware, and FPGA code—needed to manufacture and test solid rocket motors, which will include working with integrated safety-critical designs. This position also requires the ability to configure data collection systems and develop software applications used to collect the data. It is expected that you may oversee technicians during the instrumentation installation and during rocket motor testing/development. The right person for this role has direct, hands-on experience with the design, development, and installation of sensors used to collect a variety of metrics related to testing of solid rocket motors. If you are a hands-on leader, have an entrepreneurial spirit, and enjoy being the point person for collecting valuable performance data, then this role is for you. You will assist in the testing solid rocket motors which will include working with integrated safety designs used to initiate the motor.

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Collaborates with other engineers to develop accurate, efficient equipment and instrumentation in accordance with safety and usability standards and client expectations.
* Collaborates with other electrical engineers to execute the safe arming and initiation of rocket motors under test.
* Designs PCBA and electrical system components with hands on testing and rework as necessary
* Creates detailed schematics and simulated models to test designs; optimizes designs for performance, reliability, and cost.
* Oversees the implementation of new measuring devices and control systems, ensuring devices are correctly installed and properly tested.
* Acts as project engineer for design, prototype fabrication, and manufacturing development.
* Develops required cable drawings to interface to various low- and high-voltage systems
* Drafts and presents formal technical documents, reports, and testing results to manager for approval.
* Provides training related to devices to employees and/or customers.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Proven experience in safety-critical hardware design, incorporating multi-fault tolerance, arm/fire inhibits, safe bleed-down circuits, and inadvertent initiation mitigation.
* Experience in high-voltage PCB layout and circuit design for motor initiation, including capacitor charging/discharge circuits, high peak-current switching, and creepage/clearance management
* Experience with the design, development, and installation of sensors employed to collect data on system performance.
* NI Labview or NI DAQmx experience or familiar with other COTS data acquisition systems
* Thorough understanding of signal conditioning for data acquisition, i.e. analog circuit design
* Intimate knowledge of the analog to digital conversion process, i.e. digital circuit design
* Understand Computer controlled data acquisition and able to develop computer applications for data collection.
* Able to select the correct sensors and design the placement of them to acquire the needed solid rocket motor performance metrics.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite and proficient with computer-aided design software.
* Ability to write and understand Python
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

#### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Advanced degree in engineering
* Experience with circuit simulation tools (spice)
* Experience using EDA tools such as Altium/Or CAD
* Familiar with real-time computer architectures and their OS's

new_jobs.title: VP of Software Engineering
new_jobs.description:
**About the Company**
---------------------

Luxer One is the technology platform behind a growing portfolio of intelligent locker, access control, smart lock, and connected security solutions — serving multifamily communities, commercial enterprises, retail, manufacturing, and specialty deployments. A division of ASSA ABLOY — the world's leading access solutions company — we process nearly 100 million transactions per year across thousands of locations worldwide. Our customers include Amazon, DoorDash, Walmart, Google, and hundreds of leading multifamily communities.

We are at an inflection point: expanding our product portfolio into access control, smart locks, and commercial security; integrating acquired technologies; embedding AI across the business; and scaling our platform with the world's largest logistics, retail, and real estate enterprises. We're building the executive team to take us there.

**Position Overview**
---------------------

The VP of Software Engineering is the technology executive for the Luxer One division — responsible for software engineering, cloud architecture, infrastructure/DevOps, firmware and embedded systems integration, and the systems that connect our growing product portfolio to the world.

As the division expands beyond package management into access control, smart locks, sensors, and commercial security products, this role will be central to integrating acquired technologies, consolidating platforms across brands, and executing the division's IP and technology strategy. Reporting directly to the Division President and seated on the executive leadership team, this is a business leadership role as much as a technical one — designed for an engineering executive who can design an organization, develop leaders, drive architectural evolution, and help the business make better decisions through clear technical judgment.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

### **Technology Strategy, Architecture & IP**

* Set the engineering direction for Luxer One's technology platform across all product lines, brands, and market segments — including access control, smart locks, sensors, and emerging commercial security products.
* Own architecture decisions for cloud infrastructure, SaaS platforms, APIs, integrations, mobile applications, firmware/embedded systems, and connected product technology.
* Lead technology consolidation across acquired and legacy platforms — identifying redundancy, rationalizing the stack, and driving toward a coherent, scalable architecture.
* Partner with business and legal leadership to develop and execute the division's IP strategy — protecting proprietary technology, supporting patent development, and informing licensing and platform decisions.
* Lead the engineering organization's AI strategy, from developer productivity tooling to application-layer AI capabilities embedded in our products.

### **Portfolio Expansion & M&A Integration**

* Evaluate acquired and partner technology platforms for architectural fit, integration complexity, and consolidation path.
* Lead the technical integration of acquisitions — absorbing platforms, teams, and codebases in a way that protects customer continuity and accelerates time-to-value.
* Make well-grounded build / buy / partner / consolidate decisions that balance near-term business priorities with long-term platform health.
* Drive platform evolution to support a growing and diversifying product portfolio — from package lockers to access control to commercial security.

### **Engineering Organization & Leadership Development**

* Build, develop, and scale a high-performing engineering organization across multiple product lines, brands, and teams.
* Build the management layer beneath you. Recruit, develop, and hold accountable Engineering Managers, Directors, and senior technical leads — creating organizational capacity that does not depend on individual heroics.
* Establish clear roles, accountability, and a delivery culture that consistently ships with quality and predictability.
* Champion engineering culture: craft, ownership, accountability, psychological safety, and continuous improvement.
* Measure and improve performance against meaningful engineering metrics and use them to drive accountability — not just report on activity.

### **Platform, Delivery & Executive Leadership**

* Own the scalability, availability, reliability, and performance of Luxer One's SaaS platforms — handling nearly 100 million transactions per year across thousands of locations.
* Improve development, testing, deployment, and incident management practices to increase speed, quality, and system reliability.
* Establish device fleet management and MDM capabilities for a deployed fleet of 55,000+ connected devices.
* Own the security, compliance, disaster recovery, and PCI/PII posture of the engineering organization.
* Serve as a full member of the executive leadership team — participating in QBRs, planning sessions, and ASSA ABLOY leadership conversations, with P&L-aware accountability and a mandate to operate as a company-level leader, not just the head of a function.

### **Requirements**

**What You Need to Bring**
--------------------------

* 10+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience, including direct management of engineering managers and multidisciplinary teams.

new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services' Hardware Engineering team is looking for experienced professionals to help build the world's premier cloud computing platform. The Manufacturing Automation Design & Engineering team designs, validates, and deploys automation solutions, including robotics, cobots, vision inspection, AI-powered quality systems, and automated assembly workflows, across contract manufacturer sites worldwide.  
  
About the Role: You will define the controls and electrical systems architecture for all automated assembly lines, creating the standard control platform that scales across all platforms and all contract manufacturer sites. You own PLC programming standards, HMI development frameworks, safety system architecture, and industrial network design. You define how automated cells communicate with each other, with MES, and with data collection systems. You are the architect of the nervous system that connects every robot, sensor, actuator, and inspection system into a coordinated, data-generating production line. You establish reusable control system templates that ensure consistency and reduce deployment time globally.  
  
The scope covers all server and rack assembly across all architectures and platforms, including compute, AI/ML accelerators, storage, and networking. The team designs intelligent, predictive-analytics-driven production systems where every station is sensor-driven, AI-optimized, and self-correcting, turning assembly lines into programmable, data-generating platforms that scale capacity without scaling headcount. This role requires the engineer to operate in a fast-paced, multi-platform international manufacturing environment with travel to contract manufacturer sites (up to 25-30% travel anticipated).  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Define controls systems architecture: PLC programming standards, HMI frameworks, safety system design, network topology
* Design and program PLC-based control systems for automated assembly lines
* Develop standardized HMI interfaces for operator interaction and production monitoring
* Architect industrial network infrastructure (e.g., EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, EtherCAT) for automated lines

new_jobs.title: Senior / Staff Software Engineer, Product Infrastructure
new_jobs.description:
**About Prometheus**

Prometheus is building AI systems for engineering in the physical world. Behind them sits a platform that runs large, long-lived computational workloads: fleets of agents and numerical solvers, very large binary artifacts, and results that have to be correct because real hardware depends on them.

**The role**

You will build the infrastructure this platform runs on. It is a small set of hard, coupled systems, and you will own one or more of them end to end: design, implementation, operations, and on-call.

* **Durable orchestration.** Workloads run for days across thousands of tasks. They must survive failure, checkpoint, resume, and stay steerable by humans and agents mid-flight.
* **Versioned artifact storage.** Git-style semantics (branch, diff, merge) over large binary artifacts, on content-addressed storage with aggressive deduplication, at terabyte-to-petabyte scale.
* **CI and validation pipelines.** Merge queues where the gates are expensive computed checks, not just unit tests, and a change is validated by actually running it.
* **Compute execution fabric.** Scheduling heterogeneous workloads, many on GPUs, across cloud fleets: batching, prioritization, budget enforcement, and streaming results back in real time.
* **Agent harness.** Sandboxed, reproducible, observable execution for long-running autonomous agents that write code, run tools, and spend real compute.

**You might be a fit if**

* You have 5+ years building and operating distributed systems in production; for the Staff level, 10+ years and a system you are known for.
* You have seen real scale and carry the scars: at a database, streaming, or orchestration company; a multiplayer game backend; internet-scale media storage; a simulation or GPU-compute platform; or a build/CI system serving thousands of engineers.

 **Job Description**

As a **Senior Vehicle Hardware Engineer (Electrical & System Integration)**, you will serve as the technical lead for electrical architecture, power distribution, in-vehicle networking, and system-level hardware bring-up across our ADAS and autonomous test vehicle fleets. You will translate high-level software and perception requirements into reliable, automotive-grade electrical architectures and wire harness solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Electrical Architecture & Power Design:** Design low-voltage power distribution systems, including power sequencing, circuit protection, and battery backup solutions for high-performance compute nodes and sensor payloads.
* **Harness & Interconnect Engineering:** Design and oversee fabrication of automotive-grade wire harnesses, sensor cabling, and custom interconnect assemblies.
* **Vehicle Networking & Synchronization:** Integrate automotive communication buses (CAN-FD, Automotive Ethernet, LIN) and high-speed sensor data links (GMSL2/3, FPD-Link) with hardware-level time synchronization (PTP/IEEE 802.1AS, PPS).
* **System Bring-Up & Diagnostics:** Lead electrical bring-up, signal integrity testing, bus analysis, and fault diagnosis on prototype vehicles using standard lab and automotive diagnostic equipment.
* **Cross-Functional System Collaboration:** Work with perception, compute software, and safety engineering teams to define physical interfaces, power budgets, and sensor pinouts.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Preferred Master's degree.
* **Experience:** 5+ years of experience in automotive electrical engineering, electrical harness design, or system-level hardware integration for ADAS/AV systems.
* **Electrical & Bus Protocols:** Deep understanding of automotive power electronics, relay/fuse box design, and vehicle networks (CAN, CAN-FD, Automotive Ethernet).
* **Hardware Diagnostics:** Hands-on proficiency with tools such as Vector CANoe/CANalyzer, Wireshark, digital oscilloscopes, multimeters, and logic analyzers.
* **Component Knowledge:** Experience selecting automotive-grade connectors (TE Connectivity, Molex, Amphenol), fused protection, and high-speed serialization hardware.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proficiency with schematic capture and harness design tools (e.g., E3.series, PCAD, Altium, or Vector Architecture tools).
* Familiarity with automotive EMC/EMI mitigation techniques and ISO 26262 functional safety considerations for power delivery.
* Hands-on experience working in automotive workshop or prototype vehicle garage environments.

  
**Additional Information**

new_jobs.title: Staff Instrumentation & Controls Engineer – Nuclear
new_jobs.description:
**About Valar Atomics**

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable—unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

**The Team**

As part of the Engineering organization, Instrumentations & Controls designs the systems that monitor, automate, and protect Valar's facilities and reactor technologies. The team develops reliable control architectures that enable safe and efficient operations.

**The Role**

You will serve as a senior technical authority for nuclear instrumentation and controls (I&C) systems with a focus on neutron detection, detector signal processing electronics, and radiation monitoring equipment. This role supports reactor design, test operations, and safety-significant monitoring systems, ensuring compliance with nuclear industry codes and standards. You will lead design efforts, system integration, vendor oversight, safety evaluations, and commissioning activities for reactor protection and radiation monitoring systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Instrumentation & Detection Systems**

* Lead design, specification, selection, and integration of **neutron detectors** (e.g., fission chambers, boron-lined detectors) and associated **signal conditioning electronics** (wide-range, source range channels).
* Design and validate **radiation monitoring systems** including area monitors, process radiation monitors, stack monitors, and coolant activity systems.
* Oversee detector placement, shielding design, and response characterization (in-core and ex-core).
* Perform calibration strategies and uncertainty analyses for neutron flux power range, intermediate range, and startup-range instrumentation.

**I&C Engineering**

* Develop and maintain I&C architectures for safety-related and non-safety systems in accordance with **IEEE 603, IEC 61508, and DOE guidance**.
* Produce and review engineering deliverables: control logic, loop diagrams, instrument datasheets, architecture drawings, control narratives, and functional requirement specifications.
* Execute I&C system modeling, failure modes analysis, response time calculations, and SIL/Category/Level classification (per IEC/ISA standards).
* Design interfaces to PLCs, safety-significant controllers, distributed I/O, and high-reliability digital platforms.
* Guide system integration with reactor protection, and radiation monitoring systems.

**Testing, Validation, and Qualification**

* Lead **Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT)**, **Site Acceptance Tests (SAT)**, environmental qualification (EQ), and seismic qualification for sensitive instrumentation.
* Develop calibration, maintenance, and surveillance procedures for neutron and radiation detectors.
* Support performance testing, flux mapping, channel operability checks, trip setpoint verification, and acceptance criteria development.

**Regulatory & Standards Compliance**

* Ensure system designs adhere to nuclear regulatory requirements, including DOE Reg Guides, IEEE standards, IAEA SSG-39, and ANS/ANS-related instrumentation standards.
* Prepare and review technical documentation for licensing, safety basis, and hazard analysis activities.
* Participate in I&C-related inputs and support for deterministic safety analyses.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance across interdisciplinary teams.
* Collaborate with reactor physics, thermal-hydraulics, electrical engineering, and operations teams to meet program requirements.
* Interface with vendors, labs, and regulatory bodies on detector procurement, radiation monitoring equipment, and safety systems.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Nuclear Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or related discipline.
* **8+ years** of experience in nuclear I&C, radiation detection, reactor protection, or related areas.
* Hands-on experience with:

new_jobs.description:
**About Valar Atomics**

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable—unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

**The Team**

As part of the Engineering organization, Instrumentations & Controls designs the systems that monitor, automate, and protect Valar's facilities and reactor technologies. The team develops reliable control architectures that enable safe and efficient operations.

**The Role**

You will serve as a senior technical authority for nuclear instrumentation and controls (I&C) systems with a focus on neutron detection, detector signal processing electronics, and radiation monitoring equipment. This role supports reactor design, test operations, and safety-significant monitoring systems, ensuring compliance with nuclear industry codes and standards. You will lead design efforts, system integration, vendor oversight, safety evaluations, and commissioning activities for reactor protection and radiation monitoring systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Instrumentation & Detection Systems**

* Lead design, specification, selection, and integration of **neutron detectors** (e.g., fission chambers, boron-lined detectors) and associated **signal conditioning electronics** (wide-range, source range channels).
* Design and validate **radiation monitoring systems** including area monitors, process radiation monitors, stack monitors, and coolant activity systems.
* Oversee detector placement, shielding design, and response characterization (in-core and ex-core).
* Perform calibration strategies and uncertainty analyses for neutron flux power range, intermediate range, and startup-range instrumentation.

**I&C Engineering**

* Develop and maintain I&C architectures for safety-related and non-safety systems in accordance with **IEEE 603, IEC 61508, and DOE guidance**.
* Produce and review engineering deliverables: control logic, loop diagrams, instrument datasheets, architecture drawings, control narratives, and functional requirement specifications.
* Execute I&C system modeling, failure modes analysis, response time calculations, and SIL/Category/Level classification (per IEC/ISA standards).
* Design interfaces to PLCs, safety-significant controllers, distributed I/O, and high-reliability digital platforms.
* Guide system integration with reactor protection, and radiation monitoring systems.

**Testing, Validation, and Qualification**

* Lead **Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT)**, **Site Acceptance Tests (SAT)**, environmental qualification (EQ), and seismic qualification for sensitive instrumentation.
* Develop calibration, maintenance, and surveillance procedures for neutron and radiation detectors.
* Support performance testing, flux mapping, channel operability checks, trip setpoint verification, and acceptance criteria development.

**Regulatory & Standards Compliance**

* Ensure system designs adhere to nuclear regulatory requirements, including DOE Reg Guides, IEEE standards, IAEA SSG-39, and ANS/ANS-related instrumentation standards.
* Prepare and review technical documentation for licensing, safety basis, and hazard analysis activities.
* Participate in I&C-related inputs and support for deterministic safety analyses.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance across interdisciplinary teams.
* Collaborate with reactor physics, thermal-hydraulics, electrical engineering, and operations teams to meet program requirements.
* Interface with vendors, labs, and regulatory bodies on detector procurement, radiation monitoring equipment, and safety systems.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Nuclear Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or related discipline.
* **8+ years** of experience in nuclear I&C, radiation detection, reactor protection, or related areas.
* Hands-on experience with:
* Neutron detectors (fission chambers, B-10 proportional counters)
* Signal processing electronics (wide-range, source range channels)
* Area/process radiation monitors and environmental monitoring instrumentation
* Strong understanding of nuclear standards: IEEE 603, ANSI/ANS-specific radiation monitoring standards
* Experience with safety classification, SIL analysis, FMEA, and hazard analysis.
* Ability to lead technical projects and cross-functional engineering efforts.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Master's degree or Ph.D. in Nuclear Engineering or related field.
* Experience with HTGR, sodium-cooled, or research reactor designs.
* Experience with data acquisition systems, digital I&C platforms, and PLCs (e.g., Allen-Bradley).
* Familiarity with radiation transport modeling and detector response simulations.
* Experience with environmental qualification per IEEE 323 and seismic qualification per IEEE 344.
* Prior regulatory engagement (NRC, DOE, INL, ORNL, etc.).
* Experience writing safety basis documents, technical reports, or licensing submittals.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive base salary
* Equity ownership in a rapidly growing advanced energy company
* Comprehensive medical benefits
* Unlimited PTO
* Free daily lunch and dinner provided onsite
* Generous PPE stipend
* High-impact startup environment with significant ownership and autonomy

You’ll lead architecture and delivery across Tonal’s device, app, and cloud systems: turn business priorities into technical direction, own initiatives that span teams, and grow senior engineers into technical leaders. **Who You Are**

* You’ve led architecture and delivery across multiple teams at Senior Staff or Principal scope, with measurable results.

* You turn ambiguity into focused plans and get alignment from technical and nontechnical partners.
* You’ve made other senior engineers stronger technical leaders and can show how your work improved teams beyond your own.

new_jobs.title: Electrical Systems Engineer, Energy Products
new_jobs.description:
**Drive the Future with Xos**

**Xos** **(NASDAQ: XOS),** is a technology company and electric truck manufacturer on a mission to decarbonize commercial transportation. We design and build state-of-the-art electric vehicles, develop advanced fleet management software, and create charging solutions that make fleet electrification seamless and cost-efficient.  
  
At Xos, we're problem-solvers, innovators, and go-getters, working together to drive a cleaner, more sustainable future. Join us and be part of the movement shaping the next generation of commercial transportation.

**The Role**  
  
Xos is looking for an Electrical Systems Engineer to join our Engineering team, with a focus on the electrical design and deployment of our energy products, including the Xos Hub.  
  
In this role, you'll own the electrical design across the product lifecycle from understanding customer applications and developing system architecture to supporting production, commissioning, and deployed products in the field. You'll work across high and low-voltage systems, energy storage, power conversion, EV charging, controls, and communications while partnering closely with engineering, manufacturing, service, suppliers, and customers.  
  
This is a hands-on role for an engineer who enjoys taking ownership of complex electrical systems and seeing their designs move from schematics to real-world operation.

**\*\*This is an on-site position based at our Los Angeles, CA headquarters, with occasional travel required based on business and project needs.\*\***

  

**What You'll Do**

  

* Design and maintain electrical schematics, single-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, and harness designs for HV DC, LV AC, and 12/24V control systems.
* Develop electrical architectures for new Xos Hub configurations and customer-specific applications.
* Perform power and energy calculations, including load analysis, battery sizing, charging profiles, voltage drop, fault current, and short-circuit analysis.
* Evaluate grid power and interconnection requirements, including utility service configurations, grounding, bonding power, power quality, and power conversion.
* Size and select wiring, connectors, overcurrent protection, control devices, and other electrical components.
* Define electrical and communication interfaces across batteries/BMS, inverters/PCS, EVSE, generators, controllers, and telematics using hardwired I/O, CAN, and Ethernet.
* Create and maintain engineering documentation, including electrical drawings, E-BOMs, assembly packages, SOPs, and test and commissioning procedures.
* Support production builds, first article inspections, system testing, and commissioning at Xos facilities and customer locations, including travel as needed.
* Troubleshoot deployed systems using telematics data, logs, CAN traces, and other diagnostic tools; perform root cause analysis and translate findings into design and process improvements.
* Review customer applications, including vehicle and charging requirements, site power, load profiles, and duty cycles, to determine appropriate system configurations.
* Support product design and certification activities to applicable electrical, energy storage, and safety standards.
* Additional duties as assigned.

  

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field.
* 3-4+ years of electrical systems design experience in EV, energy storage, transportation, heavy equipment, rail, industrial power, or a related environment.
* Strong understanding of AC/DC electrical systems, single-and three-phase power, grounding, electrical protection, and power conversion.
* Experience creating electrical schematics and wiring diagrams using AutoCAD, AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN, CATIA Systems Schematic, or similar tools.
* Hands-on experience with load calculations, wire and overcurrent protection sizing, and electrical component selection.
* Experience producing release-ready engineering documentation, including schematics, wiring diagrams, BOMs, and engineering changes.
* Experience testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting electrical systems.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work across engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, customers, and field teams.
* Ability and willingness to travel occasionally based on business and project needs.

**Nice to Have**

Experience in one or more of the following areas is a plus:

* Battery energy storage systems (BESS), batteries/BMS, inverters/PCS, EV charging, or mobile power systems
* Wire harness design and harness supplier coordination
* CCS or NACS charging systems
* Microgrids, including grid-tied and islanded operation
* CAN communications and diagnostic tools such as CANalyzer, CANoe, or PCAN
* Interface Control Documents (ICDs), requirements traceability, FMECA, or EMC analysis
* PLM systems and 3D CAD tools such as Windchill, Creo, SolidWorks, or CATIA
* UL, NFPA, NEC, IEEE, or IEC standards related to energy storage and EV charging
* EIT certification or PE licensure
* Startup or high-growth manufacturing environments
  

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is may be required to stand, walk, reach, bend, and use hands to handle tools, equipment, or components, and lift and/or move up to 25lbs. The employee may also be required to perform hands-on work on or around energy products, including the Xos Hub, while using appropriate personal protective equipment in manufacturing, testing, and field environments.

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. These complex digital systems ensure that our antennas can meet high-rate processing needs no matter where they are deployed around the world. Our hardware team prioritizes excellent engineering, building end products that are known for their reliability, scalability, and cost.

* Drive electrical design for high-speed digital communication systems, implementing RF and mixed-signal designs in complex, multilayer PCBs

**Requirements**

**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

Space is a critical domain, connecting our technologies, our security and our humanity. While others view space as a destination, we see it as a realm of possibilities, where we can do more — we can innovate, invest, inspire and integrate our capabilities to transform the future.  
  
At Lockheed Martin Space, we aim to harness the full potential of space to cultivate innovation, reduce costs, and push the boundaries of what technology can achieve. We’re creating future-ready solutions, focusing on resiliency and urgency through our 21st Century Security® vision. We’re erasing boundaries and forming partnerships across industries and around the world. We’re advancing spacecraft and the workforce to fuel the next generation. And we’re reimagining how space can connect us, ensuring security and prosperity.  
  
Join us in shaping a new era in space and find a career that's built for you.

For over 70 years, the Fleet Ballistic Missile (FBM) team has supported the Navy’s mission to provide affordable and credible strategic defense. We offer unique career opportunities and challenges on a program with a rich history and exciting future. ---------------

Application deadline: Oct 12, 2026  
  
Join AWS Hardware Engineering to design the servers powering the world's leading cloud platform and AI/ML infrastructure. We're seeking an exceptional Linux Kernel Engineer to accelerate critical kernel initiatives across millions of servers worldwide.  
  
We are seeking an exceptional Linux Kernel Engineer to join our server firmware team. In this role, you will lead Linux kernel patching, code development, and version adoption for our server management controllers across a massive global fleet. You will ensure our kernel remains current, secure, and compliant with strict patching service-level agreements that directly impact AWS infrastructure reliability. Your work will power the backbone of AWS compute infrastructure, including the servers that enable AI/ML workloads for customers worldwide.  
  
The ideal candidate will be an innovative self-starter with deep expertise in Linux kernel internals, device driver development, and embedded Linux systems. You will gain comprehensive understanding of our server firmware kernel stack and analyze it in both current and future contexts. Using your systems knowledge, you will architect solutions to complex multi-factor problems, including kernel upgrade strategies that minimize customer impact, address security vulnerabilities rapidly, and optimize operational efficiency across millions of servers supporting diverse workloads from traditional compute to advanced machine learning applications.  
  
You will collaborate with engineers across AWS and external partners, leading development efforts that span kernel security, hardware enablement, and platform services teams. Your work will directly contribute to critical initiatives that keep our infrastructure patched, secure, and operationally excellent—ensuring the foundation for tomorrow's AI/ML innovations remains robust and scalable.  
  
AWS Engineers are shaping the way people use computers and designing the future of cloud computing technology – come help us make history!  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Design and develop firmware solutions for AWS servers, contributing to server designs that power millions of customer workloads.  
Lead the complete development lifecycle from initial conception through production deployment, ensuring robust and scalable firmware implementations across our massive server fleet.

Mentor team members and contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes, tools, and best practices.

Most mornings, you'll dive into code—whether that's developing new security features, optimizing firmware deployment strategies, or debugging a tricky issue that's affecting a subset of servers.

Overview:

FTI is a defense technology company seeking an Information Systems Security Officer (ISSO) to support the security of information systems used in defense missions. You will work with technical teams and program stakeholders to maintain security requirements, address risks, and protect the systems and information our customers depend on. You’ll join a team guided by FTI’s 4C’s: Core Values, Commitment, Compassion, and Charity. The ideal candidate brings technical knowledge, attention to detail, and a collaborative approach to supporting secure operations while meeting mission needs.

This position is based at the ENSCO location in Colorado Springs, CO. An active DoD Top Secret clearance with SCI access is required.

Responsibilities:

The Information Systems Security Officer (ISSO) will work on Defensive Cyber Operations for *Space* (*DCO*-*S*) providing expertise and support in network security engineering and/or integration of security products. This is a fast-paced and highly challenging position where you will be a member of a team. The ISSO is responsible for ensuring the appropriate operational security posture is maintained for the assigned IT. This includes the following activities related to maintaining situational awareness and initiating actions to improve or restore cybersecurity posture.

The ISSO:

* Implements and enforce all AF cybersecurity policies, procedures, and countermeasures.
* Completes and maintains required cybersecurity certification IAW AFMAN 17-1303 Individuals in this position must be U.S. citizens.
* Ensure all users have the requisite security clearances and need-to-know, complete annual cybersecurity training, and are aware of their responsibilities before being granted access to IT according to AFMAN 17-1301.
* Maintains all authorized user access control documentation IAW the applicable AF Records Information Management System.
* Ensures software, hardware, and firmware comply with appropriate security configuration guidelines (e.g., security technical implementation guides /security requirement guides).
* Ensure proper configuration management procedures are followed prior to implementation and contingent upon necessary approval.
* Coordinate changes or modifications with the system-level ISSM, SCA, and/or the Wing Cybersecurity office.
* Initiate protective or corrective measures, in coordination with the ISSM, when a security incident or vulnerability is discovered.
* Reports security incidents or vulnerabilities to the system-level ISSM and wing cybersecurity office according to AFI 17-203, Cyber Incident Handling.
* Initiates exceptions, deviations, or waivers to cybersecurity requirement.
* Ability to travel up to 10%.

Education/Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, Engineering, Mathematics or a related technical field is desired.
* 6+ years of relevant experience
* **Top Secret/SCI clearance required.**
* Sec+ required
* Experience working with DoD and/or Intelligence Community (IC) space system acquisition programs.
* Understanding of Risk Management Framework (RMF) and DoD / IC cybersecurity requirements, policies and best practices.
* Experience with IT Security including requirements, architecture and design.

For this role, the annual compensation range for candidates in Colorado is $100K-$163K. Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications & experience. new_jobs.description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Advanced Concepts and Enterprise Engineering (ACE), supporting Blue Origin’s mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. The team fosters innovation and drives engineering workflows of the future, shared solutions and standards, simplicity and lower costs, and manufacturable design.

*Join Blue Origin as we build infrastructure in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re developing a satellite constellation of orbital data centers, Sunrise, designed to transform how compute infrastructure is deployed and leveraged.*

As a Sr. Systems Engineer you will be a primary technical authority and change agent, leading the evolution of our systems engineering practices. You will champion and implement novel, model-based approaches, moving beyond traditional documentation-centric methods to embrace a more integrated, digital, and iterative workflow . You are a novel thinker who thrives in a fast-paced environment, capable of leading complex system development from concept through deployment with a focus on rapid iteration and continuous integration. This senior, hands-on role demands expert-level systems thinking and the ability to drive both technical execution and cultural change.

**Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

* Lead the development and maturation of the system's "digital twin" using Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) methodologies.
* Define, manage, and allocate system requirements, interfaces, and behaviors directly within a system model (e.g., using SysML)
* Facilitate and lead systems engineering execution, including rapid verification, validation, and flowing back lessons learned.
* Drive system-level trade studies and analyses using model-based simulations to inform design decisions rapidly and efficiently.
* Collaborate continuously with hardware, software, integration, and test teams to ensure tight alignment throughout the development lifecycle.
* Champion and define the verification and validation (V&V) strategy within a model-based framework, ensuring tests are directly linked to model elements and requirements.
* Develop and implement new and innovative systems engineering processes and tools that increase velocity and reduce ambiguity.
* Mentor other engineers across various disciplines on MBSE best practices and agile systems engineering principles.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in systems engineering for complex, multidisciplinary systems (e.g., aerospace, automotive, robotics, or data centers).
* Demonstrated expertise in the principles and application of Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE).
* Proven experience working within a fast, iterative development environment on hardware-centric projects.
* Strong fundamentals in requirements analysis, interface management, system integration, and verification.
* Proven ability to lead technical projects and influence cross-functional teams with minimal supervision.
* Experience bringing a commercialized product to market.
* Experience through a full program live cycle from design to verification and validation

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's or Ph.D. in a relevant engineering discipline.
* Expertise with MBSE tools such as Cameo Systems Modeler/MagicDraw, Sparx EA, or similar, and proficiency in languages like SysML or UAF.
* Direct experience operationalizing digital twins for verification, validation, and operations.
* Experience transitioning a team or program from traditional, document-based systems engineering to modern, model-based practices.
* Formal training or certification in agile methodologies (e.g., Certified ScrumMaster, SAFe Agilist).
* Experience serving as a Lead Systems Engineer, Product Owner , or Scrum Master in a technical engineering environment.
* Proficiency in scripting (e.g., Python, MATLAB) to automate analysis and connect models to other tools.
* Familiarity or fluency with AI tools and their application in systems modeling or requirements analysis.

**Additional Requirements:**

Must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or eligible for authorization under U.S. export regulations.  

  

Base Pay Range for:

CO applicants is $133,500.00 - $186,898.95
WA applicants is $145,188.00 - $203,263.20

**Other site ranges may differ**

  

**Culture Statement**

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. The ideal candidate will possess strong experience in industrial automation, electronic troubleshooting, PLC programming, and machine controls, with hands-on knowledge of Beckhoff, WAGO, and Allen-Bradley control platforms. * Experience with HMI development, industrial networking, and operator interface design.

* Experience commissioning automated manufacturing equipment.

new_jobs.description:

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Advanced Concepts and Enterprise Engineering (ACE), supporting Blue Origin’s mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. The team fosters innovation and drives engineering workflows of the future, shared solutions and standards, simplicity and lower costs, and manufacturable design.

*Join Blue Origin as we build infrastructure in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re developing a satellite constellation of orbital data centers, Sunrise, designed to transform how compute infrastructure is deployed and leveraged.*

**Job Summary:** As the Senior RF Communications Systems Engineer and **TT&C Technical Lead** , you will have primary technical responsibility for the architecture, design, development, integration, verification, and operation of the spacecraft Telemetry, Tracking, and Command (TT&C) communications subsystem.

You will lead the development of the **end-to-end TT&C architecture** , translate mission and spacecraft requirements into subsystem requirements and interfaces, and lead the RF communications engineering team responsible for delivering the subsystem. This role requires a combination of strong RF/microwave technical expertise, spacecraft communications systems engineering, architectural thinking, and technical leadership.

The successful candidate will work closely with spacecraft systems, avionics, GNC, flight software, power, thermal, ground systems, and mission operations teams to develop a robust, reliable, and scalable TT&C solution from concept through on-orbit operations for a large scale constellation.

* **Own and lead the TT&C subsystem architecture** , including RF communications, antennas, transceivers, amplifiers, filters, frequency conversion, interfaces, and ground-system connectivity.

* Lead development and allocation of **TT&C subsystem requirements** , including performance, interface, environmental, reliability, and verification requirements.
* Develop TT&C **CONOPS and communication scenarios** , including command, telemetry, tracking, acquisition, safe modes, nominal operations, contingencies, and ground-station interactions.
* Lead **RF communications architecture and technology trade studies** , evaluating alternative architectures and technologies against mission requirements and system-level constraints.
* Lead end-to-end **RF link budget and communications performance analysis** , including transmit power, antenna gain, path loss, atmospheric losses, noise temperature, receiver sensitivity, link margin, data rate, and availability.
* Lead RF cascade analysis, including gain, noise figure, dynamic range, compression, phase noise, spurious performance, and intermodulation products.
* Define and manage **RF and TT&C interfaces** with the spacecraft bus, avionics, flight software, GNC, power, thermal, and ground systems.
* **Lead and mentor the RF communications engineering team** , establishing technical direction, priorities, development plans, and engineering processes.

* Review and approve RF designs, analyses, simulations, test plans, and verification results.

* Support spacecraft integration, test, troubleshooting, launch readiness, commissioning, and **on-orbit TT&C operations** .
* Lead resolution of complex RF and communications system issues and coordinate technical decisions across engineering disciplines.
* Establish and maintain TT&C architecture documentation, requirements, interface control documents, link budgets, CONOPS, trade studies, test plans, and verification matrices.
* Identify technical risks and develop mitigation strategies throughout the TT&C development lifecycle.
* Work with program and systems engineering leadership to establish **team staffing, technical capabilities, and resource requirements** for the RF/TT&C organization.
* Mentor engineers and develop the technical capabilities of the RF communications team.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, RF/Microwave Engineering, or a related discipline.
* **10+ years of professional experience in RF communications systems engineering, RF/microwave engineering, or a related field.**
* Demonstrated experience leading or owning the **architecture of RF communications or TT&C systems** .
* Demonstrated experience developing **end-to-end RF communications architectures and link budgets** .
* Experience defining, allocating, and verifying **system and subsystem requirements** .
* Strong experience with RF/microwave systems, including antennas, transmitters, receivers, amplifiers, filters, frequency conversion, and analog signal chains.
* Strong understanding of antennas, RF propagation, microwave engineering, and communications systems.
* Experience with RF simulation and analysis tools such as Keysight ADS, AWR Microwave Office, or similar.

Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

* **Be the offset.** We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.
* **What would it take?** We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.
* **It’s the people.** Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

BENEFITS & PERKS\*

* **Best-in-class healthcare:** 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, with HSA/HRA options
* **Generous time off:** Flexible Time Off (FTO) for exempt employees, accrued PTO of up to 25 days for non-exempt employees, plus 12 paid holidays; Parental Leave; Sick Leave
* **Fuel for your day:** Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks for in-office employees
* **And more:** 401(k) retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, and Dog Fridays
* **Equity participation:** Equity is included as part of our total compensation package, giving you an opportunity to share in the company’s success.

**YOUR MISSION**

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Digital Engineering team, you will be the senior technical hand building the in-house software behind our digital thread — full-stack applications that become our systems of record for product, manufacturing, and operations data, and the services and integrations that connect them across the product lifecycle. You will set technical direction alongside the principal engineer, architect for scale, reliability, and security, and raise the engineering bar for a growing team while staying deep in the code.

The work goes well beyond connecting tools. Integrations bridge the off-the-shelf systems we run today; the larger job is building the software that takes their place. You will regularly face the question “How do we build software our engineers, buyers, and technicians would rather use — while keeping product data authoritative and traceable?” The data models, applications, and patterns you establish will define how product data is created, changed, and used across the company for years.

This is an ideal role for a senior full-stack engineer who wants deep ownership of foundational products and the platform beneath them, enjoys mentoring, and is energized by building something new in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment. * Design the domain data models and workflows for in-house systems of record — parts, revisions, BOMs, change orders, and as-built records — with lifecycle states and end-to-end traceability.

* Architect the services, APIs, integrations, and event-driven data flows that connect our applications with the off-the-shelf tools they work alongside and, over time, replace.

* Own significant parts of the network, infrastructure, and security design, including role-based access and audit for export-controlled data.

**Technical Execution**

* Build and ship full-stack applications end to end — data model, services and APIs, workflow, and web user interface — and operate them in production.

* Plan and execute migrations from off-the-shelf tools to in-house software: data migration, parallel operation, and cutover, without breaking traceability.

* Build in observability, auditability, sync health, and data-quality checks as first-class features.

* Set and uphold engineering standards — code quality, testing, reviews, and technical documentation.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Mentor senior and early-career engineers and raise the technical bar across the team.

* Work directly with engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing users to understand real workflows and ship software that fits them.

* Partner with the teams that own today's engineering and business systems to design integrations and plan migrations that respect how those systems are run.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 8+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record designing and shipping production applications, services, and system integrations.

* Experience building user-facing web applications end to end — from data model and APIs to a modern front end (e.g., TypeScript, React).

* Deep experience with API design, event-driven architectures, and reliably moving and transforming data between disparate systems.

* Strong grasp of domain data modeling for complex, versioned records, and of keeping data consistent and traceable across multiple systems of record.

* Experience building for observability, auditability, and data quality in production.

* Cloud and infrastructure fluency (e.g., AWS), plus strong fundamentals across networking, security, and CI/CD.

* Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages (e.g., Go, Python).

* Track record setting technical direction across multiple services or teams and mentoring other engineers, including senior engineers.

* U.S. Citizen or lawful permanent resident (U.S. Person) as required under ITAR.

* Experience migrating an organization from an off-the-shelf system to in-house software, including data migration and user adoption.

* Strong product sense and experience working directly with engineering, manufacturing, or operations users.

new_jobs.title: Interdisciplinary Systems Engineer, AWS Ground Station
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Application deadline: Oct 12, 2026  
  
Do you want to be part of the next generation of satellite ground stations? At AWS Ground Station we are changing the way the industry thinks about space to ground communication. Our service enables customers to connect to their on-orbit spacecraft in an on demand model that leverages all the benefits of the AWS network and infrastructure.  
  
We are growing our footprint and capabilities of satellite ground stations and are looking for an engineer to deeply own the technical challenges of delivering highly reliable space data from customers’ vehicles into the AWS cloud.  
  
Amazon’s vision is to be the world’s most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision as we redefine what it means to operate in space. As an ideal candidate, you:  
  

* Embrace continuous learning and are always working to eliminate knowledge gaps in relevant areas.
* Are experienced working in hardware-centric production environments.
* Are comfortable handling ambiguity and creating solutions that resolve it.
* Recognize and appreciate diversity of thought and perspectives.

  
This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen.  
  
A day in the life  
On our team you will:  
  

* Work with vendors and AWS engineering teams to discover and implement the latest technologies.

- Deeply own the deployment, operation, and maintenance of antenna systems around the world (- Identify gaps in functionality or capabilities and create solutions to solve them.  
- Participate in on-call rotation - ensuring our customers' needs are being met.  

* Educate your peers through mentorship and coaching to create lasting positive impact.

  
About the team  
About AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Why AWS?  
  
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.  
  
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)  
  
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
Diverse Experiences  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth

**Job Summary**

The Robotics Software Engineer develops and maintains software for GPSI autonomous underwater vehicle systems. The position supports a ROS2-based software stack running on embedded Linux, with responsibilities spanning navigation, state estimation, sensor integration, deployment infrastructure, autonomy, and mission software. The role works across software and hardware boundaries and supports development through in-water testing and field deployment.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in robotics, computer science, engineering, or a related field.
* One to seven years of professional experience, or equivalent graduate research, working with physical robotic systems.
* Professional or research experience developing software in C++ and Python within a ROS or ROS2 environment.
* Experience working with embedded Linux and debugging software-to-hardware interfaces.
* **Must be a United States citizen.**

**Primary Job Duties**

**Navigation & State Estimation:**

* Develop, evaluate, and maintain algorithms for sensor fusion and coordinate-frame management across a multi-sensor suite operating in GPS-denied environments.
* Support evaluation and troubleshooting of navigation, state-estimation, and controls behavior using test data and physical vehicle results.

**Sensor Integration:**

* Develop and maintain driver-level software for vehicle sensors and embedded communication interfaces.
* Diagnose integration issues across application software, operating-system services, firmware interfaces, and connected hardware.
* Collaborate with cross-domain personnel to incorporate physical design changes and new sensors into the software stack.

**Systems & Infrastructure:**

* Build and maintain development and deployment tooling for a multi-vehicle fleet, including build pipelines, containerized development environments, device provisioning, and process management on embedded targets.
* Support repeatable software configuration, deployment, and troubleshooting across development and fielded systems.

**Autonomy & Mission Software:**

* Contribute to higher-level software governing mission execution, vehicle safety protocols, and communication with operators.
* Support autonomy architectures, mission planning, simulation, and vehicle-behavior testing as assigned.

**Required Knowledge and Skills**

* Proficiency in C++ and Python in a ROS or ROS2 environment.
* Firm grasp of state estimation, sensor fusion, or controls and the ability to reason about system behavior from first principles.
* Experience working with embedded Linux and comfort operating at the OS level.
* Ability to debug problems that cross abstraction layers, from algorithms to hardware communication.
* Self-directed and comfortable working in a small team with significant individual responsibility.
* Clear technical communication and documentation skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with marine, underwater, or field robotics.
* Familiarity with inertial navigation, acoustic sensing, or subsea communication systems.

**Description**

The Defense Systems Group at Leidos has an immediate opening for a Principal Digital Firmware Design Engineer at our St. Petersburg, FL facility. This position supports the development of advanced, mission-critical military communications systems and involves the design, integration, testing, and optimization of secure, ruggedized electronic hardware and firmware for defense applications.

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in FPGA-based digital design and hands-on experience with integrating hardware and firmware within complex embedded systems. This individual will have a demonstrated track record supporting defense programs across the full product lifecycle—from requirements development and architectural design through integration, qualification testing, and transition to production.

The Leidos St. Petersburg facility specializes in the design, development, modeling and simulation, analysis, prototyping, and testing of advanced electronic systems. Our primary focus areas include embedded communications systems, Software Defined Radios (SDR), and Phased Array Antenna Systems supporting Department of Defense and commercial customers.

Primary Responsibilities:

  

* Participate in a multi-disciplinary engineering team developing secure, high-performance military communications hardware and firmware.
* Analyze and decompose system-level requirements into detailed hardware design specifications with full traceability.
* Perform Logic Design; write VHDL code, perform synthesis, logic simulation, test bench generation, functional testing and hardware debugging of designs within FPGA/CPLD devices.
* Architect, implement and test embedded firmware /software within FPGA-based digital designs including signal processing, control logic, and high-speed interfaces on a variety of platforms (FPGAs, microcontrollers, microprocessors, and mixed signal designs).
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex hardware, firmware / software and integration issues across prototype and production phases.
* Support design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR), technical documentation, and configuration management processes.
* Provide technical input for cost estimates, schedules, and risk assessments.
* Collaborate closely with Firmware, Software, RF, systems, and test engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle.

Clearance Requirements:

  

* U.S. Citizen required.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret Security Clearance.
* Active Secret clearance preferred.
* Ability to obtain Top Secret clearance preferred.

Required Qualifications:

  

* BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
* 8+ years of experience in embedded hardware and digital design (10+ preferred for Senior level).
* Experience supporting full product development lifecycle including:
  + Requirements analysis, System design and hardware implementation, Integration and test
  + Firmware/software architecture development for embedded systems, including FPGAs and SoCs
  + Technical documentation and formal design reviews
* Strong VHDL, FPGA/SoC design and implementation experience:
  + Digital logic design using VHDL/Verilog with System-On-Chip devices (SoC’s), FPGA’s, CPLD/s, and/or Microcontrollers.
  + Modern vendor design tools (IDE’s) such as Xilinx Vivado, Vitis, STM, Libero SoC, Lattice Diamond
  + Simulation and Testbench generation (Xilinx simulator, Aldec Active HDL, Riveria Pro, Modelsim, or similar)
  + RISC microprocessors architectures (ARM Cortex, Microblaze, PowerPC, RISC-V)
  + C/C++ language software development for embedded, real-time systems.
* Experience with one or more of the following:
  + Integrating and troubleshooting digital subsystems within embedded systems.
  + Digital interfaces such as I2C, SPI, RS-232/422, USB, Ethernet
  + ADC/DAC devices and understanding performance characteristics.
  + Hands-on lab experience debugging hardware using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and related tools
* Understand trade-offs of embedded system targets (FPGA, SoC, microcontroller, RTOS, bare-metal) for developing best cost/option architectures

Preferred Qualifications:

  

* Active Secret or Top Secret clearance.
* Proven experience in full-stack FPGA development for Xilinx UltraScale/UltraScale+ architectures, spanning RTL design (VHDL/Verilog) and embedded C/C++ development for bare-metal, FreeRTOS, or embedded Linux environments (PetaLinux, etc).
* Experience with one or more of the following:
  + Design and development with other FPGA/CPLD vendors such as Microsemi, ST-Micro, Lattice, etc
  + High-speed interfaces/protocols such as PCIe, JESD204B, LVDS, and SERDES
  + Simulation and modeling tools (MATLAB, Python, LabVIEW)
  + Implementing signal processing concepts such as digital filters, digital modulation, up/down conversion within HDL designs
  + IP cores and modern processor interfaces (Xilinx IP Cores, AXI4, AXI-Stream or similar)
  + Design, integration and testing electronic circuits within embedded systems, including digital, analog and radio frequency (RF) subsystems.
* Experience developing ruggedized or military communication systems
* Experience with the Cooperative Engagement Capability Naval communications system.

* Experience transitioning prototype designs into production hardware
* Familiar with schematic capture design tools (Altium, Cadence Allegro/OrCAD, Ki-CAD or equivalent)

widget: Full-Time

Other
