$103977.88-$173296.47

  

### **Position Description & Qualifications**

  
  

Serco seeks a **Simulation Systems and Test Engineer** for its Combat Air Force Distributed Mission Operations (CAF DMO) 3.0 program in Orlando, FL. The CAF DMO 3.0 program, via its Distributed Mission Operations Network (DMON), provides world-class integration training in large force and small team formats to combat units around the globe against cutting-edge threats in a boundless virtual battlespace. The U.S. Air Force can only utilize its full capability against modern threats in a virtual environment. Be a part of that environment and continue to make the USAF the best air force in the world.

You will be part of a focused team of engineers to perform test, integration, and evaluation of disparate M&S systems and applications to support 5th and 6th generation training interoperability.

The team will work closely with the DoD customer and other Serco teams at Langley AFB and Orlando, FL to deliver quality test services.

**In this role, you will:**

* Support military simulation system and application integration, evaluation, and interoperability test to support DMON and JSE training operations.
* Use industry-standard tools for simulation test and evaluation to include Wireshark, simulation protocol analysis, and GFE and Commercial Computer Generated Forces (CGFs).
* Assist in detailed analysis of network and computational system performance including latency, bandwidth, jitter, and system occupancy measures.
* Help develop and maintain test plans and procedures to document and drive test activities.
* Draft comprehensive test reports based on completed integration, test, evaluation, and verification tasks performed.
* Assist in the development of CONOPS and multiple COAs for implementation and deployment of the evaluated simulation capabilities.
* Contribute to other areas of the engineering life cycle to include requirements review and assessment, training operations support, and basic system administration functions.
* Produce well-defined, concise, and directed test procedures and test cases under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Support program and team processes by using tools from the Atlassian Suite of products to include JIRA, Confluence, Bitbucket, Bamboo, and X-Ray.
* Participate in peer reviews, test bed maintenance and updates, and programming, testing, and debugging activities.
* Write and maintain scripts and support application (PowerShell, Cygwin, VBasic, etc.) programs, to enable efficiencies in test artifact creation and task execution.
* Help identify production and non-production application issues, assist in developing solutions, and implement necessary changes.

  

**To be successful in this role, you will have:**

* A bachelor’s degree in an applicable STEM curriculum (e.g., Data Analysis, System Engineering, Math, Computer Science, Physics, etc.) or similar.
* 8 years of engineering experience performing test, integration, SW development, or embedded systems engineering activities.
* Experience with military simulation integration test DIS IEEE1278.1 or HLA IEEE 1516 protocols, or similar communications or data protocols (SIP, VOIP, JREAP, etc).

* The ability to obtain a TS/SCI and SAP/SAR.

* Experience supporting DoD customers and personnel in a technical capacity.
* Familiarity or experience with development, test and evaluation of military simulation training or operational systems.
* Must possess, or obtain within six months, a DoD 8140 IAT Level II or higher (i.e. Security+, CySA+, CISSP)
* Up to 10% travel

  

**This position is contingent upon your ability to obtain/maintain/transfer your Secret clearance.**

**Additional desired experience and skills:**

* An active DoD Secret Clearance with ability to obtain TS/SCI and SAP/SAR.
* Familiarity with tactical Military training systems, products, and capabilities.
* Exposure to or experience in M&S development, test, and integration for constructive simulation systems and models.
* Knowledge of or experience with the Joint Simulation Environment (JSE).
* Possess or obtain within six months, a Linux OS certification (i.e., Linux+, RHCSA etc.).
  

  

### **Company Overview**

  
  

Serco Inc. (Serco) is the Americas division of Serco Group, plc. In North America, Serco’s 9,000+ employees strive to make an impact every day across 100+ sites in the areas of Defense, Citizen Services, and Transportation. We help our clients deliver vital services more efficiently while increasing the satisfaction of their end customers. Serco serves every branch of the U.S. military, numerous U.S. Federal civilian agencies, the Intelligence Community, the Canadian government, state, provincial and local governments, and commercial clients. While your place may look a little different depending on your role, we know you will find yours here. Wherever you work and whatever you do, we invite you to discover your place in our world. Serco is a place you can count on and where you can make an impact because every contribution matters.
  
  
To review Serco benefits please visit: https://careers.serco-na.com/us/en/what-we-offer. If you require an accommodation with the application process please email: careers@serco-na.com or call the HR Service Desk at 800-628-6458, option 1. Please note, due to EEOC/OFCCP compliance, Serco is unable to accept resumes by email.
  
  
Candidates may be asked to present proof of identity during the selection process. If requested, this will require presentation of a government-issued I.D. (with photo) with name and address that match the information entered on the application. Serco will not take possession of or retain/store the information provided as proof of identity. new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. The Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) team are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all of the robotics and material handling equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!  
  
About the Role:  
As an Automation Engineer, you will play a crucial role in maximizing equipment reliability and operational performance in our fulfillment centers by providing proactive controls automation and technical support. Your expertise will be essential in troubleshooting complex control systems, analyzing performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize material handling equipment (MHE) systems and implement innovative projects. You'll work with state-of-the-art technology, including conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, and SCADA devices and programs. Through your efforts, you'll directly contribute to ensuring our customers receive their orders with Amazon's signature speed and accuracy.  
  
What Do We Offer?  
Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there’s more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  

* You will serve as the site expert for maintaining the automation systems that are critical for operations
* You will understand, maintain and troubleshoot material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers and industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems
* You will monitor MHE metrics and partner with maintenance/operations to address system performance issues and provide analysis across all operations
* You will provide first-level escalation support for site technicians, both locally and remotely
* You will perform and analyze building System Assessments to enhance material handling system performance

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 2+ years of PLC programming or automation engineering experience
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 2+ years of process or production environment related PLC-controlled automation and issue diagnosis experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 2+ years of robotics work cells and control systems experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 2+ years of electrical theory, robotics, controls components, and automated equipment experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 2+ years of Ladder Logic and structured programming from Siemens, Allen-Bradley, or Codesys PLCs experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with HMI and control network components, including maintenance, troubleshooting, programming and design
* Experience identifying, maintaining, troubleshooting, and modifying Motor Controls including motor starters, Variable Frequency Drives, DC drives, and standard electrical components
* Experience with preventive maintenance procedures, industrial electrical, industrial controls, and industrial electronics & robotics
* Experience interpreting and modifying mechanical and electrical drawings
* Experience programming with RSLogix5000, Studio 5000, FT View, and other controls software platforms

  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. new_jobs.description:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of the Lunar Permanence business unit, which develops Blue Origin’s Blue Moon landers and related products. To further Blue Origin's mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth, we are building sustainable infrastructure for our transport of crew and cargo from Earth to the lunar surface.

We are a team of collaborators, doers, and problem-solvers who are dedicated to a culture of safety. This role plays a crucial role in the history of space exploration and demands a dedication and meticulous focus on safe and repeatable spaceflight. Come onboard as we work towards reducing the cost of space access and realizing Blue Origin's goal of having millions of people living and working in space for the betterment of Earth. As a stride towards this objective, Blue Origin is developing the next generation of lunar landers.

Join the Lunar Permanence team of engineers responsible for integrating interfaces across our lunar vehicles, including New Glenn, NASA vehicles, and our Engines business unit.

As a Systems Engineer on the Lunar Cross Program Integration team, you will lead the integration and technical oversight of critical propulsion hardware, including the BE-7 engines, across multiple lunar landers. You will shape technical content, manage propulsion system performance parameters, drive issue resolution, and coordinate with cross-functional teams and NASA to ensure compliance with design and construction standards. This role is pivotal to the successful development of the lunar transportation system and the certification of the Human-class Delivery Lander, enabling humanity's sustained presence on the Moon.

We're looking for someone who brings technical expertise, strong leadership, and an unwavering commitment to quality and safe human spaceflight. A passion for our mission and vision is essential.

  

**Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

* Ensure BE-7 hardware and related common components are integrated across lunar landers
* Define technical content for BE-7 Statements of Work (SOW)
* Serve as accountable owner for the BE-7 integration forum across Lunar, as well as program-specific integration forums as needed

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or another technical field
* 10+ years of experience integrating complex hardware components across multiple space vehicles and platforms, particularly propulsion systems
* Experience in spacecraft development and/or testing
* Ability to coordinate across collaborators and experts from different engineering disciplines to support Mission ICD and Range product closure
* Strong leadership and facilitation skills to lead integration meetings, drive cross-functional collaboration, and ensure timely progress tracking and issue resolution

* In-depth ability to evaluate engine system analyses and designs against rigorous program requirements to ensure compliance and reliability
* Proven track record managing schedules and delivery dates, collaborating with program control functions, and maintaining clear, timely communication with external partners such as NASA
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate with internal and external teams to ensure compliance with rigorous design and construction standards

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  
  

* Experience developing and testing engines
* Experience with in-space combustion devices, particularly cryogenic and gaseous hydrogen/oxygen systems

* Proven ability to advance trade studies and drive critical decisions across multiple companies

* 7+ years of experience in an engineering role
* Ability to analyze and interpret engineering drawings, schematics, wiring diagrams, and parts lists

* Refined cross-functional leadership skills and experience working with multi-disciplined teams

* Subject matter expert for approved repair and testing techniques for electronics and components

new_jobs.title: Instrumentation & Controls Engineer I
new_jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we're building rockets to serve today's needs and tomorrow's breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that's just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

**About the Team:**

The Launch team operates at the intersection of every major aspect of Terran R, from stages and payloads to ground systems, launch, landing, and refurbishment. The Cape is the only place where you see it all come together, offering a level of exposure and responsibility unmatched elsewhere in the program. This is where first flights happen, where history is built on top of history, and where the scale of what's underway is unlike anything in modern aerospace. The mission stays the same, but the work evolves with every milestone: from first launch to reuse, high-cadence operations, and beyond. If you're looking to define what's next in space launch and write a new playbook, not just repeat what's already been done, this is where it happens.

**About the Role:**

* Design, develop, test, integrate, and operate launch control and acquisition hardware, instrumentation, and cameras used to support and control the Terran R rocket.
* Work with Beckhoff PLCs or similar systems.
* Support high-speed data acquisition.
* Work with instrumentation including pressure, temperature, flow, level, accelerometers, solenoid valves, VFDs, and heaters.
* Integrate and operate IP, SDI, and CoaXPress high-speed cameras.
* Assist in the design of electrical systems for use in hazardous areas.
* Collaborate with other groups to gather requirements, plan schedules, and coordinate work.
* Plan, install, and operate wiring and hardware in access-limited areas such as launch mounts and transport erectors.

**About You:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or another related STEM discipline.
* Exposure to data acquisition hardware, PLC-based control systems, complex camera systems, and instrumentation selection and troubleshooting.
* Ability to work with multidisciplinary groups in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

**Nice to haves but not required:**

* Experience with the design and operation of spacecraft and launch vehicle infrastructure.
* Experience working at a rocket launch site.
* Proficiency with electrical schematic design software such as AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN, or Zuken E3.

**Successful candidates must clear a background check administered by the US government to obtain clearance for on-site work at our government partner location in Cape Canaveral, Florida.**

**We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.**

***If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at*** ***accommodations@relativityspace.com******.***

***Please note: Relativity Space does not accept unsolicited resumes, candidate profiles, or referrals from recruitment agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited submission - via email, our website, social media, or directly to an employee - will be deemed the property of Relativity Space, and no fee will be owed absent a current, fully executed agreement with Talent Acquisition that specifically authorizes submissions for the applicable role.***

----------------------------

WHAT WE'RE DOING

Rotary and Mission Systems' Training, Logistics and Simulation (TLS) business is Lockheed Martin’s center of excellence for training and logistics products and services, serving the U.S. military and more than 65 international customers around the world. Based in Orlando, TLS develops programs that teach service men and women skills to accomplish their most challenging missions — flying the world’s most advanced fighter aircraft, navigating ships and driving armored vehicles.

TLS is the corporation’s hub for simulation, X reality, live-virtual-constructive capabilities, advanced training devices and full-service training programs. TLS also provides sustainment services such as supply chain and logistics IT solutions, spares and repairs, as well as automated test and support equipment.

THE WORK

This is a position for a Systems IT Engineer / Systems Administrator on F35 Software Development Enviroment (SDE) as part of the Pilot Training Devices (PTD) Development Enviroment (DE) Integrated Program Team (IPT).

As a key member of our Systems Engineering team, you will:

* Perform hardware and software diagnostics, troubleshooting, and maintenance on multiple IT components
* Manage system integrity, availability, and cyber compliance of networked systems
* Assist in the development of solutions across components of systems through design, integration, implementation and support
* Participate in phases of software and hardware development, leveraging our DevOps engineering processes and procedures while performing respective engineering activities
* Collaborate with other program personnel, participating in cross functional Agile teams

WHO WE ARE

The SDE team supports the development of flight simulators for the F35 fighter jet. The Development Enviroment Integrated Product Team is responsible for the infrastructure, third party software, and security policies across all our PTD products.

We create unparalleled readiness today and into the future, no matter what the mission may be here at Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems.

WHO YOU ARE

You thrive in a collaborative, multidisciplinary engineering environment and are committed to delivering best-in-class products and solutions.

This position will require the selected candidate to have or obtain an Interim Secret level U.S. government security clearance before starting with Lockheed Martin, as well as obtain a Special Access Program U.S. government security clearance within a reasonable time after starting the position. By prioritizing relentless hardware iteration, we deliver high-speed systems at the pace of the modern battlefield. We work with the Department of War to provide the high-speed capabilities our nation and its allies need to maintain a durable, asymmetric advantage.

**About The Role:**  

We are seeking a Software Engineer to join our Command & Control team in Atlanta. The team is responsible for the design, development, integration, testing, and delivery of software supporting Human Machine Interfaces (HMI), Pilot Vehicle Interfaces (PVI), Command & Control (C2), telemetry, and vehicle communications.

This role will focus primarily on the embedded flight software and networking that enable communication between our aircraft and ground control systems. You will develop software supporting command and control, telemetry, network management, RF communications, and vehicle data links while working closely with avionics, RF, flight software, and ground systems engineers.

This is not a traditional voice communications role. You will work on the software and network infrastructure that allow an air vehicle and ground control station to reliably exchange commands, telemetry, and other mission-critical data.

The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between embedded C/C++ development, network and communications system design, and hands-on testing with target hardware. You will have ownership across both the vehicle and ground sides of the communications network and will help take systems from initial architecture through integration and flight operations.

* Develop software interfaces for radios, transmitters, receivers, and other communications hardware.

* Support integration, troubleshooting, and testing of aircraft and ground station communications systems.

* Write efficient, maintainable, well-documented software that meets performance and safety requirements.

* Own technical schedules and roadmaps for assigned software and communications capabilities.

* Support flight test and range operations as required.

* Travel up to approximately 25% to support integration and test activities.

new_jobs.title: Associate Controls Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**About Carrier**

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier.

**About Automated Logic**

At Automated Logic, we've been developing and supporting intelligent building solutions that have helped customers, including small businesses to Fortune 500 corporations, operate their buildings more efficiently for over 40 years. Our products help reduce energy consumption, lower utility, operating and maintenance costs, and improve indoor air quality, occupant comfort, and productivity. Technology that supports the buildings and industry of today and tomorrow requires a wide range of talents and skill sets.

**About this role:**

As an Associate Controls Engineer, you will be crucial to ALC’s business through the designing of building automation systems created specifically for each individual customer. We are looking for someone who works well in a team and has excellent problem-solving, time management, and multi-tasking skills. You will work to build new skills and advance existing skills while completing smaller projects on your own.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and program building automation systems, site-specific configuration of control system, and control algorithms.
* Adhere to project requirements and company and customer standards of design, programming, and implementation.
* Create a clear design document for project teams with technical information.
* Document and communicate the building automation system design and revisions.
* Develop graphical and text-based interfaces for building automation systems.
* Test programming and interfaces prior to implementation.
* Provide technical support to sales representatives to ensure customers’ needs are met.
* Identify and communicate project opportunities and risks.
* Support functional testing for building systems.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Associate or Bachelor’s Degree

OR

* High School Diploma / GED with 2+ years of HVAC/BMS experience
* Must have unrestricted authorization to work in the USA. No visa sponsoring available.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Basic knowledge of primary functions of building automation system software and associated engineering tools, Automated Logic suites preferred.
* Basic knowledge of Automated Logic software, peripherals, add-ons, services, or hardware design.
* Understanding and/or experience with IP networks
* Understanding and/or experience with Microsoft Visio and/or similar software.
* Ability to understand written sequences of operations, diagrammatic depictions of systems.
* Familiar with third-party communication protocols used in building automation, such as BACnet, Modbus, SNMP, LON, N2, etc.
* Able to translate technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Capable of climbing ladders or using other lift equipment over 8 feet above grade, and capable of lifting items up to 50lbs.

**Pay Range**

The annual salary for this position is between $53,000.00 - $106,000.00 annually. Factors which may affect pay within this range include, but are not limited to, skills, education, experience, and other unique qualifications of the successful candidate. The pay range will not be below the minimum wage applicable to the jurisdiction in which the applicant is to be employed.

**Other Compensation**

This position may be entitled to short-term cash incentives, subject to plan requirements.

**Benefits**

Employees are eligible for benefits, including:

* **Health Care Benefits**: Medical, Dental, Vision; Wellness incentives
* **Retirement Benefits**
* **Time off and Leave**: Paid vacation days, up to 15 days; paid sick days, up to 5 days; paid personal leave, up to 5 days; paid holidays, up to 13 days; birth and adoption leave; parental leave; family and medical leave; bereavement leave; jury duty leave; military leave; purchased vacation
* **Disability**: Short-term and long-term disability
* **Life Insurance and Accidental Death and Dismemberment**
* **Tax-Advantaged Accounts:** Health Savings Account; Health Care Spending Account; Dependent Care Spending Account
* **Tuition Assistance**

**Job Description**
===================

CCI/SPEER is seeking an **Electrical Controls Engineer** to join the team. In this role you will be responsible for developing, implementing, and supporting technology to improve equipment, processes, and products. This is accomplished through design requirements, specifications, drawings, procurement of necessary materials and services, and coordination of installation and training for systems including new automation solutions. You will provide expertise in programming and designing industrial controls and interfaces for new and existing equipment and processes. Effectively communicate with team members at all levels of the organization to improve our workplace, manufacturing performance, and customer experience.

This position may be filled at the Engineer I, II, or III level based on education, experience, and demonstrated technical capability. *Equivalent combinations of education, technical training, apprenticeship experience, licensure, military experience, certifications, and directly related controls/automation experience will be considered.*

This position reports to the Manufacturing Engineering Manager and will be based out of our **Lewiston, Idaho** office.

**What you'll do:**

* Support the design, development, implementation, and continuous improvement of automated manufacturing systems.

* Design, program, troubleshoot, and commission PLC-based control systems using platforms such as Allen-Bradley, Omron, or similar technologies.

* Develop and maintain HMI and operator interface systems to improve equipment usability and diagnostics.

* Assist with or lead automation projects involving robotics, vision systems, servo motion, industrial networking, and process controls based on experience level.

* Design, implement, maintain, and improve electrical instruments, equipment, facilities, and systems within the manufacturing environment.

* Participate in capital projects including concept development, design, procurement, installation, startup, and project validation.

* Troubleshoot equipment and process issues using a structured root cause problem-solving approach, identifying underlying causes rather than simply replacing components.

* Collaborate with operations, maintenance, engineering, quality, and IT teams to develop practical and scalable manufacturing solutions.

* Support integration of machine data into manufacturing and business systems for improved reporting, traceability, and decision making.

* Ensure compliance with applicable electrical, safety, and regulatory standards including NEC, OSHA, and machine safety requirements.

* Create and maintain technical documentation, drawings, standards, and training materials.

Provide technical guidance and mentorship to team members as experience level and business needs dictate.  



**Experience you bring:**

* Associate's Degree (AAS) in a related technical discipline with 4-10 years of relevant controls, automation, or manufacturing experience; or Journeyman Electrician license with 4-10 years of relevant industrial controls experience.

* Internship, co-op, project, apprenticeship, or early-career experience with automation, controls, manufacturing equipment, or industrial systems.

* Equivalent combinations of education, technical training, apprenticeship experience, licensure, military experience, certifications, and directly related controls/automation experience will be considered.

* Foundational understanding of PLC programming, HMIs, electrical schematics, and industrial control systems.

Strong troubleshooting aptitude and desire to learn.

Primary functions include specifying a single product, developing a concept, programming, or designing a complete industrial control package. * Ability to break down, organize, and manage complex projects

new_jobs.description:
##### **Job Description**

The Robotics and Automation Systems Engineer supports and helps drive the robotics and autonomy work behind automation deployments across the organization. This role spans a broad range of robotics and automation projects, including fixed/stationary robotic systems (e.g., robotic arms, cobots), mobile/autonomous systems (e.g., AGVs/AMRs, autonomous forklifts, and navigation), palletizing and material-handling applications, and adjacent technologies.

This role assesses sites, programs and integrates robotic systems, commissions systems in live warehouse environments, and troubleshoots deployed automation in production. This role supports robotics and autonomy work from assessment through resolution, and works closely with the Controls & Mechatronics Engineer, operations leadership, and robot OEMs or system integrators to keep robotic and autonomous systems running reliably in a live, production-critical environment.

  

##### **Duties and Responsibilities**

* Program, integrate, and commission robotic systems — including industrial robot arms (e.g., FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Rokae, Universal Robots) and mobile/autonomous platforms — for palletizing, material handling, and related applications.
* Own perception, localization, and navigation for autonomous systems, including LiDAR, SLAM, path planning, and obstacle avoidance.
* Integrate sensors (LiDAR, cameras, IMU) and apply sensor fusion as needed across robotic platforms.
* Integrate robotic and autonomous systems with PLCs, safety systems, conveyors, WCS/WES/WMS, or fleet-management platforms, coordinating with the Controls & Mechatronics Engineer and other automation team members on shared electrical and controls interfaces.
* Develop and maintain production-quality robotics software (C++/Python) following standard engineering practices (version control, code review, and testing), and support fleet/robot diagnostics and telemetry.
* Support the application of physical AI techniques — machine learning-driven perception, decision-making, and adaptive robot behavior — to real-world automation problems where practical, in coordination with more specialized resources as needed.
* Support site assessments, commissioning, acceptance testing, and production troubleshooting, prioritizing minimal disruption to live operations and supporting equipment-uptime and service-level targets.
* Document system architecture, safety assumptions, and standard operating procedures for deployed systems.
* Coordinate with robot OEMs and system integrators throughout deployment, commissioning, and warranty periods, including holding vendors accountable to timelines and performance specifications
* Communicate technical progress, system performance, and project status clearly to operations leadership and other non-technical stakeholders
* Stay current on and help evaluate emerging automation and robotics technologies.

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 3+ years of combined hands-on experience with industrial robotics/fixed robotic systems (programming and cell integration) and/or autonomous mobile robotics (AGVs/AMRs, perception, and localization, e.g., LiDAR/SLAM, ROS 2/Nav2 or equivalent); strong depth in at least one domain is required, with working knowledge of the other
* Strong C++/Python skills and Linux experience
* Practical understanding of industrial safety principles for human-robot shared environments, including familiarity with relevant robot/mobile-robot safety standards (e.g., ANSI/A3 R15.06, ISO 3691-4, or equivalent)
* Experience in logistics, warehousing, or industrial automation environments.
* Travel expected to assess robotics and automation opportunities and support initiatives and projects across the organization.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on experience applying physical AI — machine learning-based perception (e.g., OpenCV, PyTorch), decision-making, or adaptive control — to real-world robotic or automation systems.
* Experience with robot fleet management (e.g., Locus, 6 River, Fetch, Geek+), WCS/WES/WMS integration, or industrial networking (EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, etc.)
* OSHA 10/30 or equivalent safety certification
* Experience with dedicated 3D or machine-vision systems (e.g., Cognex, Keyence, Photoneo) for robotic guidance, picking, or inspection applications, beyond general camera integration
* Experience with robot simulation or offline programming tools (e.g., RoboDK, RobotStudio, Process Simulate, Gazebo, NVIDIA Isaac Sim) for cell design, testing, or validation prior to live commissioning
* Experience with telemetry, data pipelines, or observability tooling (e.g., time-series databases, dashboards such as Grafana) supporting robot or fleet diagnostics

  

**Location:** Mount Vernon/Evansville, IN or Greenville, SC

The engineer that fills this role will work primarily on the avionics software for the E-2D platform and other fixed wing platforms. This is an onsite role in Cedar Rapids, Iowa.

Ready to put your experience to work on something that truly makes an impact? How about developing world-class Avionics platforms that are critical to aircraft flights and missions? We are looking for talented individuals that love to solve problems and have a desire to grow and gain exposure to new skills. If you're passionate about what you could accomplish here, we'd love to hear from you.

CAAS/Flight 2 Flight Management Solutions - Our signature products for Military Avionics and Helicopters as part of the Collins Integrated Avionics Systems, fielded on thousands of aircraft today, at this moment. * https://www.collinsaerospace.com/what-we-do/industries/helicopters/rotary-wing/common-avionics-architecture-system

* You will develop, capture, analyze, decompose, and trace System requirements for the addition of new and altered functionality for our fixed winged platforms.

* You will design requirements, software, and test verification, depending on program need.
* You will develop innovative design approaches that meet customer requirements, cost targets, and product line objectives.
* You will collaborate with your agile team members on the overall design process for your projects.
* You will support teams of software and systems engineers to develop, integrate and release FMS software products.
* You will communicate plans and status on your assigned stories to your agile team members
* You will coordinate with the platform engineering team and other software domain teams to identify and track dependencies for shared features.
* You will interact with a cross-functional team of (including, but not limited to) Engineers, Engineering leaders, Program Managers, Finance, Quality, and Production.
* You will champion knowledge sharing, elevating department expertise through both formal training and informal mentoring.
* You will have a willingness to travel (domestic and international <10%).

**What You Will Learn:**

* You will learn the technologies of today and tomorrow which we count on to maintain world leadership in the avionics industry.
* You will experience the full software development life cycle, taking programs from initial bidding activities through requirements to verification to production release.
* You will learn to manage the collaboration between multi-discipline engineering teams to create total system solutions, addressing our customer needs.
* You will deepen your expertise in cutting-edge avionic systems, positioning you as a subject matter expert in military software applications.
* You will expand your impact on the field of avionics, contributing to software solutions that increase the operational capabilities of aircraft worldwide.
* You will learn why people enjoy themselves and feel fulfilled by working in our industry.

**Qualifications You Must Have:**

* Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and minimum 2 years of prior relevant experience **or**an Advanced Degree in a related field.
* Experience with Python scripting.
* Experience in a systems/software engineering role.
* Experience developing, decomposing, and deriving requirements.

**Qualifications We Prefer:**

* Experience in developing avionics displays and/or Flight Management Systems (FMS).
* Experience with DO-178 or similar certification-based development processes.
* Familiarity with avionics data buses and protocols, including Arinc-429,

new_jobs.description:
**Join Vylor—Powering the Future of Agriculture**

At Vylor, we’re advancing agriculture through breakthrough science—combining elite germplasm, cutting-edge biotech, and next-generation expertise in gene editing and molecular breeding. Our portfolio includes trusted industry brands like Pioneer®, Brevant®, and Hoegemeyer®, delivering performance farmers rely on.

Join us to help scale innovation globally and shape what’s next in crop science.

We are seeking a **Senior Automation Engineer** in the Des Moines metro area. The Senior Automation Engineer delivers software solutions for equipment designed by our engineering teams.

**What You'll Do:**

As a member of the Research Engineering team, you will have opportunities to do the following:

* Design and maintain software solutions in collaboration with a team of engineers on custom R&D equipment for various areas such as greenhouses, laboratories, seed processing facilities, and in-field equipment.
* Design and maintain C++ and C# software for controlling imaging systems.
* Design and optimize automation workflows, integrating hyperspectral imaging with robotic or industrial systems.
* Work on a cross-functional project team to meet customer requirements and expectations.
* Develop, test, document, and maintain software solutions driven by a seasonal schedule.
* Develop an understanding of field and lab equipment for R&D.

**What You Need:**

* 10+ years of experience in the industrial automation field.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Agricultural, Biological, Mechanical, Software, or related discipline) or equivalent proven experience.
* Proficient in developing solutions in C++ or C# for the industrial automation field. [7 years of experience]
* Experience with industrial automation protocols (MQTT, MODBUS, EtherCAT etc).
* Ability to work safely around common shop equipment.
* A desire to do hands-on work directly with hardware and equipment for development and testing.
* Strong communication skills.
* Ability to work on projects from the specification to the deployment phases.
* Ability to work in the U.S. without restriction.
* Ability to work as a valued teammate, demonstrating respect for all people.
* Work legally and ethically.

The following skills would be a plus, but not required:

* Experience programming PLCs in Structured Text. (preferably Beckhoff). [7 years of experience]
* Experience developing solutions in Rust and Python
* Experience with EPSON robots (Epson RC+)
* Knowledge of design patterns and N-Tiered architecture.
* Desirable experience with CRUD database interaction.
* Understanding of synchronous programming concepts such as locking on shared resources, deadlock, and race conditions.
* Experience communicating with devices through: Serial communication: Modbus RTU, CAN protocol.Ethernet-based protocols: EtherCAT, PowerLink, EthernetIP, Modbus TCP.
* Experience delivering solutions within the agricultural industry.
  

  
  
  
  

**Benefits – How We’ll Support You:**

* Numerous development opportunities offered to build your skills
* Be part of a company with a higher purpose and contribute to making the world a better place
* Health benefits for you and your family on your first day of employment
* Four weeks of paid time off and two weeks of well-being pay per year, plus paid holidays
* Excellent parental leave which includes a minimum of 16 weeks for mother and father
* Future planning with our competitive retirement savings plan and tuition reimbursement program
* Learn more about our total rewards package here - Vylor Benefits
* Check out life at Vylor! https://www.linkedin.com/company/vylorgenetics/
  

Are you a good match? Apply today! We seek applicants from all backgrounds to ensure we get the best, most creative talent on our team.

  
  

### **Vylor is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing our differences to enrich lives, advance innovation, and boost company performance. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, military or veteran status, pregnancy related conditions (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), disability or any other protected status in accordance with federal, state, or local laws.**

new_jobs.description:

Onsite

The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance

**Security Clearance Type:**

DoD Clearance: Secret

**Security Clearance Status:**

Active and existing security clearance required after day 1

Collins Aerospace, an RTX company, is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Do you want to be part of a team that expects to win every time we take to the air? The Joint Precision Approach and Landing Systems (JPALS) group, working on every aspect of guiding airplanes safely to the deck, is looking for a **Senior Systems Engineer** with a passion for engineering and the desire to join the JPALS team within Precision Navigation.

This engineer will be asked to contribute to a variety of components including, but not limited to: datalink/communications, Position and Time sensors, Navigation Algorithms, Modeling, Antennas, etc. The possible activities may span the entirety of Engineering Development Lifecycle, including Design, Requirements, Validation & Verification, and Integration. A large portion of the day will be spent in the lab with hands-on equipment. With the full array of Precision Landing- enabling functionalities, the team is responsible for architecting, designing, and developing systems and producing products that serve the Land, Sea and Airborne domains. Datalinks, Airborne computing, data processing and GPS Sensor Systems are just some of the sub-products that make up the product line.

**What You Will Do**  

* Be involved in the design of brand-new Precision Approach and Landing equipment
* Perform hands-on testing in a lab environment
* Ability to create, analyze, and review mechanical drawings and schematics
* Debug Real Time Operating System Software
* Assist in performing analysis at all levels of the total system product including concept, design, fabrication, modeling, test, installation, operation, maintenance and disposal
* Help perform technical planning, system integration, verification and validation, cost and risk, and supportability and effectiveness analyses for total systems
* Assist with managing configuration process, perform functional analysis, timeline analysis, detail trade studies, requirements allocation and interface definition studies to translate customer requirements into hardware and software specifications
* Assist with decomposing customer specifications and system level requirements into sub-system and piece part requirements and generates verification criteria and plans for the requirements
* Ability to create, analyze, and review mechanical drawings and schematics
* Coordinate with cross-functional team members to complete assignments & projects as defined and on schedule

**Qualifications You Must Have**  

* Working knowledge of the Systems Engineering Discipline
* Knowledge of testing GPS functionality
* Familiarity with radio transceiver architecture/design, basic radio functional component blocks, performance specifications, and test methodologies
* Knowledge of high-assurance documentation
* Experience troubleshooting lab failures
* Experience investigating product defects, including those on the advanced radio communications equipment and avionics LRUs
* Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and minimum 5 years prior relevant experience or an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 3 years of experience

**Qualifications We Prefer**  

* Ability to read and debug low level software code
* Novice abilities in MATLAB, Simulink, or other Model Based Systems Engineering toolset

**What We Offer**  

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Three weeks of vacation for newly hired employees
* Generous 401(k) plan that includes employer matching funds and separate employer retirement contribution, including a Lifetime Income Strategy option
* Tuition reimbursement program
* Student Loan Repayment Program
* Life insurance and disability coverage
* Optional coverages you can buy pet insurance, home and auto insurance, additional life and accident insurance, critical illness insurance, group legal, ID theft protection
* Birth, adoption, parental leave benefits
* Ovia Health, fertility, and family planning
* Adoption Assistance
* Autism Benefit
* Employee Assistance Plan, including up to 10 free counseling sessions
* Healthy You Incentives, wellness rewards program
* Doctor on Demand, virtual doctor visits
* Bright Horizons, child and elder care services
* Teladoc Medical Experts, second opinion program
* **This position is eligible for relocation assistance**
* And more!

**Learn More & Apply Now!**

Do you want to be a part of something bigger? A team whose impact stretches across the world, and even beyond? At Collins Aerospace, our Mission Systems team helps civilian, military and government customers complete their most complex missions — whatever and wherever they may be. Our customers depend on us for intelligent and secure communications, missionized systems for specialized aircraft and spacecraft and collaborative space solutions. By joining our team, you’ll have your own critical part to play in ensuring our customer succeeds today while anticipating their needs for tomorrow. Are you up for the challenge? Join our mission today.

new_jobs.description:
Overview:

We are seeking a full-time **Software Engineer 2** at Garmin's U.S. headquarters in the Greater Kansas City area. In this role, you will help our team advance the frontier of our activity recording technologies that power Outdoor and Fitness wearables and products. You’ll be focused on both adding and updating functionality and features to support their ubiquitous use in Garmin Fitness and Outdoor devices. Success in this role requires strong software engineering skills, enthusiasm for solving difficult technical problems, and a passion for building reliable products used by millions of Garmin customers worldwide.

Responsibilities:

**Essential Functions**

* Use expertise in C++ and C to design, develop and maintain robust and reliable software to support activity recording, planning and training features, and file management technologies.
* Investigate and resolve complex software issues that span multiple teams and products, delivering reliable solutions to a wide range of difficult problems using sound problem solving techniques.
* Evolve shared technologies relied upon by Garmin Outdoor and Fitness product teams.
* Break down complex and ambiguous requirements into actionable plans, identifying dependencies and risks, and developing estimates, milestones and schedules.
* Provide technical assessments in areas of expertise, new technologies and software designs.
* Proactively identify and act on opportunities to improve performance.
* Expand and advocate for improvements to unit and automated testing to improve quality and reliability.
* Participate in project leadership and/or program planning including providing technical input to product development plans and concept documents.
* Make substantial contributions toward determination of project feasibility and exercise sound judgement in evaluating tradeoffs and risks.
* Mentor and provide guidance to less experienced Software Engineers

Qualifications:

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Math, Physics or related field **AND** a minimum of 1 year relevant experience **OR** an equivalent combination of education and experience
* Excellent academics (cumulative GPA greater than or equal to 3.0 as a general rule)
* Demonstrated proficiency and experience necessary to develop moderately complex software in C, C++, C#, Java, assembly language, or other selected languages
* Proficient knowledge, utilization and mastery of relevant software engineering tools (configuration management systems, build processes, debuggers, emulators, simulators and logic analyzers)

**Desired Qualifications**

* Outstanding academics (cumulative GPA greater than or equal to 3.5)
* Previous work or internship experience in design, particularly for consumer products

*Garmin International is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran’s status, age or disability.*

*This position is eligible for Garmin's benefit program. Details can be found here:* *Garmin Benefits*

new_jobs.title: Controls Engineer (Engineer II)
new_jobs.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.  

**JOB SUMMARY**  
Designs, fabricates, modifies, evaluates and documents assembly processes, components, and automated systems to produce or improve company products and facilitate manufacturing operations. Develops data and makes preliminary sketches, lay-outs and notes required to present design proposals. Researches basic design factors such as ease of manufacture and availability of materials and equipment. Works with other organizations impacted by design development.

Responsible for the design, integration, and deployment of automation systems supporting high-level assembly and integration of advanced compute and AI-based server rack products at Jabil’s Florence, KY facility. This position requires application of industrial engineering, mechatronics, robotics automation principles to develop automated manufacturing solutions that improve throughput, yield, and process stability. The role involves end-to-end system integration of automated robotics, vision system implementation, controls configuration, and automation validation.

May perform work in a specific sub-specialty such as Design, Automation, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Technical Project Management, and/or Process Improvement. Please see addendum for specific sub-specialty requirements. This description is designed to capture the general elements of Engineering work in a manufacturing setting.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Design and develops complex assembly processes, initiates process improvement initiatives for server rack assembly and integration, system level validation, and packaging as assigned.
* Support collaborative integration initiatives between Jabil and third-party automation providers for advanced server rack assembly automation.
* Participate in process improvement initiatives using Lean and data-driven methodologies to increase yield and throughput.
* Integrate machine vision systems (2D/3D cameras, OCR, barcode inspection) for automated quality validation and closed-loop feedback.
* Develops and implements changes to product design and/or the manufacturing process to achieve efficiency, quality, and/or cost improvements by participating in new product development programs.
* Develops requirement specifications, system concepts, CAD generated layouts, detailed drawings, BOM’s. Makes layouts of complex assemblies and details of parts of devices, mechanisms and structures.
* Generate system requirement specifications, automation layouts, electrical schematics, and functional documentation.
* Provides customer product design engineering for economic production; may participate in meetings with customers as needed.
* Assesses proper material, automation and equipment selection.
* Works with manufacturing to troubleshoot problems, improve yield, retrofits, set-ups, methods development, and the development of process parameters.
* Participates in product development meetings and may make recommendations to product design changes to enhance manufacturing and assembly.
* Conduct proof of concept experiments and design other testing requirements as needed.
* Research new technology or development tools to remain informed of current technology.
* Understanding of Lean Six Sigma tools, projects and processes and ability to incorporate these into assigned engineering projects.
* May assume lead role in small or sub-section of large project, as assigned.
* Reviews completed projects for accuracy, clarity and completeness.
* Ensures projects are compliant with all local, regional, and national regulatory requirements, codes and controls.
* Supports all company safety and quality programs and initiatives.
* May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Engineering Addendum**  
Automation :
  
Technical responsibility for design and development of automation requirement specification and systems concepts and installs automation and transfer automation programs to production in a smooth and timely manner.

Industrial Engineering / Process Improvement :

Apply Lean Six Sigma methodologies and industrial engineering principles for process improvement, yield optimization, and increase throughput of high-value deliverables.

CAD/CAE :
  
Technical responsibility for design and production of 2D and 3D representations of automated assembly layouts, procedures, products, and process improvements. May design and build prototypes as needed.

Mechanical :
  
Technical responsibility for a variety of engineering work in planning and design of products, processes, machines and other mechanically functioning equipment and mechanical industrial processes; oversees production, installation, operation, maintenance and repair of such equipment as needed.

Technical Project Management :

Facilitate a collaborative approach to high-level assembly and integration of advanced compute server racks for a joint-venture between Jabil and Bright Machines – to fully automate the assembly process (Bright Machines) prior to system level testing and validation (by Jabil).

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
KAIROS, Inc is searching for an energetic, experienced, and highly motivated Senior Software Engineer to join our team.

Established in July 2013, KAIROS, Inc. is a growing Woman Owned Small Business (WOSB) specializing in Life Cycle Program Management, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Logistics and Sustainment, Enterprise Platforms and AI, and Additive Manufacturing services focused on optimizing customers’ program performance and mission through proven methodologies and ethical practices. Our headquarters is in California, MD near Naval Air Station Patuxent River. We offer competitive salaries and benefits with outstanding growth potential.

This Senior Software Engineer serves as both a technical leader and requirements/tasking execution lead for a Prime engineering contract. In addition to serving as the senior technical lead for the contract, this position is expected to foster employee development, mentor technical staff, contribute to workforce planning initiatives, and help build a high-performing engineering organization capable of sustaining long-term program growth and success. The role combines advanced technical engineering responsibilities with oversight of team performance, resource management, and direct engagement with Government stakeholders.

**Primary Duties:**  

* Lead research, design, development, and enhancement of complex software/hardware/firmware

systems.  

* Integrate hardware and software systems in coordination with engineering teams.
* Serve as the primary interface and point of contact with Government technical representatives on all technical and schedule matters.
* Oversee Contractor execution (including subcontractors) of contract requirements and ensure

successful delivery of mission critical capabilities.  

* Lead and coordinate a multidisciplinary team of software, hardware, firmware, and test engineers.
* Analyze user needs and lead development of robust software/hardware/firmware solutions using

principles of computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis.  

* Lead the design, development, testing, and for mission critical applications.
* Lead the update or enhancement of existing software/hardware/firmware capabilities to improve

new_jobs.description:
**Description**

Are you interested in hypersonic and reentry system design and prototyping?

Do you want to make contributions that accelerate the readiness of our Nation’s defenses to support next generation hypersonic and reentry systems?

If so, we are seeking a highly technical senior systems engineer to help assess, design, and prototype next generation hypersonic, reentry systems and enabling technologies. As a member of our team, you’ll be making critical contributions to develop these next generation systems, ensuring the enduring effectiveness of our Nation’s strategic deterrent. You will be joining a complementary team of engineers who work together to provide impactful solutions to system level objectives and challenges. We are passionate about innovation and our team is committed to providing engaging challenging work and supporting continued learning and development.

**As a Senior Systems Engineer you will…**

* Provide systems engineering expertise and leadership to assess weapon system capabilities and support/lead the development of next generation reentry systems, hypersonic systems, and enabling technologies.
* Collaborate and engage with multi-disciplinary project engineering teams within APL, government sponsors, military personnel, and industry partners to develop innovative solutions.
* You will prepare for and participate in major design and requirements reviews.
* Participate in government working groups and/or integrated product teams to evaluate industry concepts, designs, and proposals to provide technical recommendations to government sponsors.
* Engage with senior government, industry, and national laboratory leadership on fast-paced, high-visibility defense programs.
* Produce reports and presentations to communicate analysis results, concepts, proposals and recommendations to leadership, external organization partners, and government sponsors.

  
**Qualifications**

**You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you...**

* Have a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related discipline.
* Have minimum 10 years of relevant experience.
* Have experience with complex hardware / software prototype development.
* Have experience leading highly technical cross-functional teams of engineers.
* Have experience in early concept development efforts to include gap assessments, design trade studies, requirements analysis, and risk assessment.
* Have demonstrated ability to interact effectively with and lead multidisciplinary teams, including industry and government sponsors.
* Have initiative and drive to make meaningful contributions to an important mission.
* Hold an active Secret security clearance and can ultimately obtain Top Secret level clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

**You'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you...**

new_jobs.description:
**Description**

Do you love diving deep into multi-physics calculations, exploring design limits, and technical trade space to verify whether an integrated system will perform in a complex operational environment?

Are you searching for technically challenging work that directly bolsters the credibility of our nation's strategic deterrent? Are you passionate about first-principles engineering analysis over routine process management?

If so, we're looking for someone like you to join our team at APL.

We are seeking a Multidisciplinary Systems Engineer (Systems Design Analysis focus) to help us ensure the physical realization, operational durability, and technical credibility of strategic weapon systems. Based within the System Realization and Resilience Group in the Force Projection Sector's Strategic Deterrence Mission Area, you will be joining a dedicated team of engineers and scientists addressing complex, multidisciplinary defense challenges. Our team is committed to delivering objective technical insights that influence the physical design and specialty engineering integration of strategic platforms. We value intellectual candor, technical depth, and collaborative teamwork focused on solving critical engineering problems.

As a Physical Systems Design Analysis Engineer...

* Your primary responsibility will be to perform first-principles engineering calculations and detailed physical design analyses across integrated mechanical, electrical, thermal, nuclear, or fluid subsystems.
* You will execute quantitative trade studies, sensitivity analyses, and margin evaluations to assess physical system behavior under harsh operational and threat environments.
* You will identify systemic design vulnerabilities and cross-discipline interface conflicts, providing data-driven recommendations to guide system design and hardware realization.
* You will link physical analysis results and design constraints back into the digital engineering baseline, collaborating with systems engineers utilizing Cameo Enterprise Architect / MagicDraw.

  
  
**Qualifications**

You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you...

* Possess a BS in Aerospace, Electrical, Mechanical, Nuclear, Chemical Engineering, or a closely related physical engineering discipline.
* Have 2+ years of professional experience performing hands-on engineering design analysis, numerical modeling, or multi-physics calculations on complex physical systems.
* Are skilled in analyzing system engineering technical trade space, interface tolerances, and environmental survivability parameters.
* Have a working knowledge of Systems Engineering methods and practical familiarity with MBSE principles and Cameo Enterprise Architect / MagicDraw.
* Are willing and able to travel periodically (approximately 5–10%), including visits to sponsor sites, test ranges, and contractor facilities.
* Hold an active Secret level security clearance by your start date and can ultimately obtain TS/SCI level clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

You'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you...

* Have 5+ years of professional experience performing hands-on engineering design analysis, numerical modeling, or multi-physics calculations on complex physical systems.
* Have an MS in a physical engineering discipline, maintaining an active, hands-on modeling and design analysis focus.
* Hold an active Top Secret security clearance or TS/SCI.
* Have experience with reliability engineering, nuclear surety, or specialty engineering disciplines applied to strategic missiles, reentry systems, or launch platforms.
* Have experience supporting Navy Strategic Systems Programs (such as Trident II D5) or Air Force strategic deterrent programs.

At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP believes in the power of humans to transform how they feel, perform and age; we serve the aspiring!

WHOOP is hiring an Electrical Engineer II to help accelerate the development of the next generation of WHOOP wearable technology and supporting hardware. As a member of the Hardware Engineering team, you will play a highly hands-on role in the design, test, characterization, and tuning of electrical circuitry, using rapid experimentation to build a deep understanding of system performance and drive better engineering decisions. You will work closely with Electrical, Mechanical, Firmware, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Software teams to design and evaluate new hardware, investigate unexpected behavior, resolve complex technical challenges, and move products quickly from prototype to robust, production-ready solutions.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**
---------------------

* Design, test, characterize, debug, and tune low-power, mixed-signal electronic circuits and systems throughout the product development lifecycle
* Contribute to schematic design, component selection, PCB development, hardware prototyping, board bring-up, and design iteration
* Develop and execute electrical experiments and characterization plans to understand system behavior, evaluate performance, identify root causes, and guide design improvements
* Analyze test data and collaborate across Electrical, Firmware, Mechanical, and other engineering teams to optimize circuit performance, power consumption, signal integrity, reliability, and overall system performance
* Support design verification, validation, and new product introduction (NPI), partnering with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, suppliers, and contract manufacturers to resolve technical issues and enable successful high-volume production
* Travel up to 15% domestically and internationally to collaborate with partners, suppliers, and contract manufacturers

-------------------

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 3+ years of relevant electrical engineering experience developing, testing, or debugging electronic hardware
* Strong understanding of electrical engineering fundamentals, including analog and digital circuit design, power management, signal integrity, and common communication interfaces
* Hands-on experience designing, prototyping, testing, characterizing, and debugging electrical circuits and systems
* Experience reading and developing schematics and working with ECAD tools such as Altium or equivalent
* Strong laboratory skills using oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, soldering equipment, and other electronic test and measurement tools

Brooks is a leading provider of automation solutions with over 40 years of experience in the semiconductor industry, offering precision robotics, integrated automation systems, and contamination control solutions that empower chip manufacturers worldwide. Our product portfolio includes a range of automation solutions, including robots, vacuum systems, and atmospheric robots for semiconductor manufacturing ( www.brooks.com ).

Are you looking for a place where you can be part of a transformation? Join us at Brooks Automation and be a part of a dynamic organization that is shaping the future of technology.

Controls Engineer

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Brooks is seeking qualified candidates to work with a team of talented controls engineers to develop industry leading, high performance robot control platforms for the semiconductor industry. The work is both technically challenging and hands-on with new, cutting edge robot arm designs and state of the art control software and electronics that push the envelope in semiconductor wafer handling.**

**What You'll Do:**

**Responsibilities: The candidate will apply digital filtering and control theory to design motion control algorithms and tune the feedback parameters on the robot hardware, characterize the dynamic performance, stability, throughput, payload vibration, design verification testing, software configuration, and documentation/release. The candidate will participate in diverse opportunities to apply the latest principals of robotics and control theory to push the boundaries of performance with tools such as MATLAB.**

**What You'll Bring:**

* **We are looking for an enthusiastic, hands-on engineer with a broad capability in electro mechanical systems who possesses:**
* **Knowledge of control theory, dynamic systems, robotics theory, vibration analysis, backend software development**
* **Including but not limited to related coursework, experience or research in controls, dynamic systems, or robotics**
* **The ability to learn complex systems quickly and create independently**
* **Good troubleshooting and problem solving skills**
* **Competency in MATLAB (controls toolboxes a plus, object–oriented and Java integration preferred)**
* **Excellent technical communication and presentation skill**
* **Skilled in C/C++ programming especially for real-time system**
* **Prior experience with multithreaded and interrupt driven programming preferred.**
* **Handy in the use of dynamic signal analyzers and general lab equipment**
* **BSEE or BSME with 3+ years’ experience or MSEE, MSME or Ph.D. with 1+ years’ experience**

**Compensation**

new_jobs.title: Sr Robotics Software Engineer, Amazon Robotics
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Robotics is building a brand-new robotics manipulation platform, and we need a versatile software engineer to help bring it to life. In this role, you will own critical software components spanning robotics middleware, health monitoring, and fleet management — systems that must work reliably for a single robot and scale to fleets of thousands. You will work across a broad technology stack, from real-time C++ on the robot to full-stack web applications on AWS, while applying generative AI to automate and streamline operational workflows.  
  
This is a greenfield opportunity where your architectural decisions will shape how Amazon's next generation of robotic systems operate. You will lead multi-engineer projects, influence technical direction across peer teams, and mentor junior engineers — all while writing exemplary code that sets the standard for your team. If you are a curious, adaptable engineer who thrives on solving hard problems across multiple technology domains, we would love to hear from you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design, build, and own software components for robotics middleware, health monitoring, and fleet management that scale from individual robots to fleets of thousands.
* Lead the technical design and architecture of systems on a new robotics manipulation platform, balancing real-time performance constraints with long-term extensibility and maintainability.
* Collaborate with peer robotics, hardware, and operations teams to define interfaces, resolve cross-team dependencies, and ensure successful end-to-end delivery of integrated robotic systems.
* Apply generative AI tools and techniques to automate workflows, improve developer productivity, and accelerate the team's ability to iterate on new capabilities.
* Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and hands-on guidance, raising the overall quality and engineering practices of the team.

  
A day in the life  
You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, owning your projects from concept through production deployment. On a given day you might be writing real-time C++ for robot control in the morning, reviewing a teammate's AWS service design after lunch, and prototyping a generative AI workflow automation by end of day. You will regularly connect with stakeholders across peer robotics and operations teams to align on priorities, unblock dependencies, and share technical insights — while also carving out focused time for deep, heads-down engineering work.  
  
Amazon offers a full range of benefits that assist you and eligible family members, including domestic partners. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
  
1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage  
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options  
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)  
4. 401(k) Plan
  
  
If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!  
  
About the team  
Our team is developing a new robotics manipulation platform at Amazon Robotics that aims to be as transformative as mobile robots have been for fulfillment operations. We are a 40+ person organization with a dedicated software group of 10+ engineers working alongside mechanical, electrical, and systems engineers. We value collaboration, technical rigor, and a willingness to experiment. As the platform grows, you will have the opportunity to scale systems that directly improve the customer experience and shape the future of robotic automation at Amazon.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Expert level skills in C++
* Experience working on software libraries and tools for building robot applications and/or communication middle-ware.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Experience with robotic motion control systems and algorithms.
* Experience with robotic operating environments like ROS.
