new_jobs.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form!

In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by *TIME* as a “Best Invention”, *MIT Technology Review* as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and *Fast Company* as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia.

Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing - might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.

**Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.**

**Role Description**
--------------------

Form Energy is hiring a Senior Electrical Engineer for the Test Infrastructure Team in Somerville, Massachusetts. In this role you will be responsible for the design and delivery of test equipment that enables the execution of critical tests across our iron-air battery systems and supporting hardware. The scope of your work will range from simple fixture development and material handling systems through complex verification test beds used in the evaluation of our battery systems.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the scaling of our battery technology and be part of the growth of a fast-moving company with breakthrough technology and an incredible mission!

*Relocation assistance is available.*

### **What you'll do:**

* Design, build, and deploy custom test equipment used in the electrical testing of battery hardware and software.
* Modify existing designs to accommodate new requirements and test objectives.
* Create electrical schematics to capture complex test system designs including the design of control panels, test racks, custom PCBAs, harnesses, etc.

Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, or a related Science, Engineering or Mathematics field, plus a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree, plus 6 months of relevant experience.

Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship is required.

Responsibilities for this Position:

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a Systems Engineer to support the long-term sustainment of a fire control system by identifying and mitigating hardware obsolescence risks. In this role, you will assess the system-level impact of unavailable or end-of-life components, evaluate replacement options, and help implement changes that preserve required performance, reliability, safety, and supportability.

**Responsibilities**

* Monitor hardware lifecycle status and identify components at risk of obsolescence.
* Maintain an obsolescence risk register covering affected parts, system configurations, inventory, projected demand, and decision timelines.
* Analyze how proposed substitutions or redesigns affect system requirements, interfaces, software dependencies, reliability, and maintainability.
* Develop and document mitigation options, such as qualified alternate parts, last-time buys, repair solutions, module redesigns, and planned technology refreshes.
* Lead or contribute to trade studies evaluating technical risk, cost, schedule, availability, and verification effort.
* Define requirements and verification approaches for replacement hardware.
* Coordinate with hardware and software engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, quality, reliability, and program management teams.
* Support configuration management and change-control activities, including updates to technical documentation and parts lists.
* Communicate risks, recommendations, and implementation status to program stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in systems engineering, hardware engineering, or product sustainment.
* Ability to analyze requirements, interfaces, and the system-level effects of hardware changes.
* Experience evaluating technical alternatives and documenting engineering decisions.
* Familiarity with configuration management, verification planning, and risk management.
* Strong written communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with hardware obsolescence or diminishing manufacturing sources and material shortages (DMSMS).
* Familiarity with electronic component lifecycles, bills of materials, supplier data, and product lifecycle management tools.
* Experience supporting complex, safety-critical, or long-life systems.
* Experience planning qualification activities for component substitutions or hardware redesigns.

**Workplace Options:**  
This position is fully on-site.

new_jobs.title: IT Systems Engineer, Client Platform Engineer, macOS
new_jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

The Endpoint team (Client Platform Engineering) treats Anthropic's device fleet as a platform we build and run. We run our own MDM as a production service and manage every piece of device configuration as code. Policies, configuration profiles, queries, remediation scripts, and software all ship through pull requests, CI, a staging environment, and a canary group before they reach the fleet. The fleet is mostly macOS, plus a small number of Linux machines and a growing mobile footprint.

You'll own that platform end to end: the infrastructure underneath the MDM, the configuration on top of it, the patching and software pipelines that keep thousands of devices patched and secure, and the telemetry that tells us what is actually true on every device. You'll also build automation that cuts down on manual operational work. You'll work with Security teams on hardening, compliance controls, and detection and response, and with developer and infrastructure teams to make sure those controls don't get in the way of their work. Your work will let us base access decisions on whether a device can be trusted.

We value people who double check a compliance report before they believe it. The team is deliberately lean and runs with high autonomy. You'll help define the endpoint roadmap, make architecture decisions, and own the platform every Anthropic employee's work runs on. You'll also help us meet the security standards our Responsible Scaling Policy requires as models advance.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own endpoint configuration as code: author, review, test, and progressively roll out MDM policies, configuration profiles, and remediation scripts across macOS and mobile, with canary stages and rollback built in
* Operate the MDM platform itself as a production service, including infrastructure as code, observability, upgrades, and incident response
* Build patch management automation with rapid enforcement timelines while maintaining good user experience
* Design zero touch provisioning that turns a sealed box into a productive machine on day one
* Support a small number of Linux machines alongside the Mac fleet
* Turn fleet telemetry into policy, dashboards, and early drift warnings, and use Claude to automate manual ops work
* Partner with Corporate Security on endpoint hardening, binary authorization, and compliance controls
* Take shifts on the team's rotation for incoming requests and escalations, and serve as the deep escalation tier for endpoint issues IT Operations can't resolve

**You may be a good fit if you**
--------------------------------

* Have 8+ years building secure IT systems in complex environments, including leading projects across multiple teams
* Have managed endpoint fleets of thousands of macOS devices through a modern MDM
* Treat endpoint configuration as code that is version controlled and peer reviewed, rather than clicking in consoles
* Go deep on macOS internals such as launchd, configuration profiles, TCC, and system extensions
* Write Python and shell scripts
* Write design docs and runbooks so teammates can review and support what you build

**Strong candidates may also have**
-----------------------------------

* Have operated an MDM or device management platform as a service, not only consumed one as SaaS
* Have worked with open source endpoint and device management tooling (Munki, osquery, AutoPkg)
* Have built automated, progressive rollout systems with promotion gated on telemetry
* Have experience running infrastructure as code in a public cloud
* Have working knowledge of Linux administration (packaging, systems, config management)
* Have used LLMs to automate ops work

As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.

**Your Role:**

As a Principal Controls Engineer supporting Vantive’s Acute Therapies portfolio, you will be a key contributor in the model-based development and verification of control algorithms for the PrisMax system. Your work will shape how the device interprets sensor inputs, controls electromechanical components, manages operating states, and supports safe, reliable therapy delivery.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for an engineer who can take a complex control problem from system behavior and requirements through algorithm design, simulation, embedded implementation, and verification. You partner with Systems, Software, Hardware, Quality, and V&V develop, verify, and document effective control solutions.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

**Control Algorithm Design and Model-Based Development**

* Take technical ownership of complex PrisMax control algorithms, from expected system behavior and requirements through model architecture, implementation, integration, and lifecycle changes.
* Develop and refine algorithms using MATLAB, Simulink, and Stateflow for functions involving sensors, pumps, motors, valves, alarms, and therapy-related calculations.
* Apply control theory, dynamic-system analysis, and sound engineering judgment to evaluate performance across intended operating conditions, component variation, and foreseeable faults.
* Produce model-generated code and partner with Software Engineering on interfaces, execution behavior, and integration into the device’s embedded software.

**Verify Control Algorithms**

* Define verification approaches for model-based algorithms, including model review, simulation, coverage analysis, interface testing, and testing of integrated software or device behavior.
* Develop and review test cases that challenge nominal, boundary, fault, and difficult-to-reproduce conditions; ensure expected results and acceptance criteria are clear.
* Lead the technical analysis of test results and discrepancies, distinguish model defects from interface or integration issues, and drive robust resolutions.
* Produce clear, traceable design and verification documentation that supports formal test execution, design reviews, and product development records.

**Advance Modeling and Simulation**

* Contribute to fit-for-purpose models of device components and system dynamics so control concepts can be evaluated before and alongside physical-device testing.
* Use model-in-the-loop, software-in-the-loop, and hardware-in-the-loop methods where appropriate to explore design tradeoffs, characterize performance, and expose integration risks.
* Document model assumptions, interfaces, limitations, and supporting evidence so simulation results can be interpreted and reused responsibly.

**Strengthen Controls Engineering**

* Lead reviews of algorithm designs and verification strategies, making tradeoffs and technical risks visible to cross-functional partners.
* Mentor engineers in model-based design, controls analysis, testability, and disciplined problem solving while remaining directly involved in critical technical work.
* Identify opportunities to improve the controls development practice by introducing reusable models, robust test techniques, and common design practices to enhance the quality and maintainability of control algorithms.

* Bachelor’s degree in Controls Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 6+ years of relevant engineering experience, including substantial hands-on development of control algorithms for embedded electromechanical products.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree or PhD in Controls, Electrical, Mechanical, Biomedical, Systems, or a related engineering discipline.
* Demonstrated experience designing and testing executable control models using MATLAB, Simulink, and Stateflow, or a closely comparable model-based development environment.
* Experience with model-generated code and its integration into real-time embedded software.
* Experience with plant modeling, physics-based simulation, and model-in-the-loop, software-in-the-loop, or hardware-in-the-loop testing.
* Ability to independently resolve complex technical problems, lead design reviews, and influence complex technical decision making when issues arise.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or other applicable technical field and two years of related experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

2 years of experience in a relevant technical industry.

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities**

* Experience with C, C++, Python, or PowerShell programming.
* Strong problem solving abilities.
* Meticulous, thorough, and detail oriented work style.
* Scripting or programming experience.
* Ability to maintain professionalism and courtesy with customers.
* Results driven approach to work.
* Ability to build positive partnerships and collaborate effectively with cross functional teams.

* Ability to read and use technical specifications.

**WHAT WE'RE DOING**  
By bringing together people that use their passion for purposeful innovation, at Lockheed Martin we keep people safe and solve the world's most complex challenges. Our people are some of the greatest minds in the industry and truly make Lockheed Martin a great place to work. With our employees as our priority, we provide diverse career opportunities designed to propel development and boost agility. Our flexible schedules, competitive pay, and comprehensive benefits enable our employees to live a healthy, fulfilling life at and outside of work. At Lockheed Martin, we place an emphasis on empowering our employees by fostering innovation, integrity, and exemplifying the epitome of corporate responsibility. Your Mission is Ours.

**THE WORK**  
Lockheed Martin has been embedded with the USSTRATCOM Nuclear Mission for 30+ years and has a track record of bringing innovative mission software solutions to this domain. Lockheed Martin Rotary & Mission Systems is seeking engineers to support our USSTRATCOM software teams which create Planning and Command and Control (C2) capabilities as part of the Strategic Mission Planning and Execution System (SMPES) in a DevSecOps environment.

In this role, you will help our team create modern Web-based, Java mission systems for the Nuclear community. The successful candidate will have experience with software systems built to exacting standards that are delivered on a DevSecOps cadence using Agile Scrum.

**WHO YOU ARE**  
Our team needs a full-time Cyber Software Engineer. In this role, you will help an Agile team deliver secure solutions by reviewing code, configuring cyber tooling embedded in pipelines, and coordinating with Government cybersecurity stakeholders. You will need to help design new secure patterns and be an advocate for cybersecurity.

Must be a US Citizen. This position will require a government security clearance.

**WHY JOIN US**  
Joining our team offers you the opportunity to support a join a company and a team where your contributions are valued and you can develop your skills and expertise.  
Our team also puts a high value on work-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren't focused on how many hours you spend at work or online.

Instead, we're happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well-balanced life both in and outside of work, along with competitive pay, and comprehensive benefits.

* Proven ability to review code for secure coding best practices
* Experience using Cyber DAST/SAST tooling
* Experience developing in Java / Typescript

**Job Title**
=============

Automation Engineer

**Job Description Summary**
===========================

**Job Description**
===================

At C&W Services, we live by the belief that “Better Never Settles.” We're dedicated to creating a positive impact globally and we're looking for talented individuals to join our team.

**C&W Services provides compelling benefits, including:**

* Weekly pay
* Comprehensive benefits starting on your first day
* Training, development, and advancement opportunities
* A clean and cutting-edge facility
* A safety-first culture

**About the Role:**

As an Automation Engineer (AE), you will support the site maintenance team to ensure operational performance and efficiency of Material Handling Equipment (MHE) control systems. You will partner with the maintenance team to troubleshoot and maintain equipment such as conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print-and-apply labeling systems, scales, HMI systems, control cabinets, and more. The AE provides support to the operations and maintenance teams by implementing solutions for complex problems and tracking related projects. You may lead and/or assist other technicians with their development through continuity of knowledge, all while working in a clean, climate-controlled, modern facility.

**Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

* Promoting a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
* Providing guidance on maintaining material handling control systems, industrial motor control systems, servo and frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems
* Using your technical expertise to provide support with troubleshooting and modifying software projects for material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers, Allen Bradley ControlLogix and CompactLogix PLC platform utilizing Rockwell’s software package, industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, AS-I, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems.
* Acting as the first level of escalation support for equipment automation issues and appropriately escalating downtime situations to vendors and/or network support teams to restore equipment operation.
* Applying subject matter expertise in material handling and electronic control systems to maximize building utilization of systems
* Monitoring MHE metrics and partnering with mechatronics technicians to resolve equipment electrical problems that create performance deficiencies, and performing control systems assessments to maintain and improve equipment reliability
* Partnering with facility Operations leadership, equipment vendors, and parts suppliers to plan and coordinate new technology installations, acting as the technical consultant for capital projects inside the building
* Communicating technical issues and project timelines with building leadership, operations, and the maintenance team, explaining production impacts and working closely with operations and engineering to ensure a thorough understanding of impact to systems

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of cumulative work experience in the following areas, or a relevant 2-year degree plus 1 year of work experience in the following areas:
  + Programming/commissioning of HMIs, PLCs, and VFDs
  + SCADA systems and KPIs
  + Interpreting and modifying mechanical and electrical drawings
  + Supporting a range of different conveyors and sortation systems
  + Equipment control components such as relays, motor starters, VFDs, HMIs, etc.
* High school or equivalent diploma
* Positive attitude and ability to effectively problem-solve

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Associate’s degree with a focus in Electronic Technology (or similar)
* Bachelor’s degree in a STEM-related field
* 4+ years of experience in the electrical field, or in control systems development, troubleshooting, and programming
* 4+ years of experience supporting advanced automation controls systems maintenance and development
* 3+ years of experience supporting a wide range of conveyors and sortation systems
* Leadership and project management experience

**Physical Demands:**

* Ability to reach overhead, kneel, squat, climb steps/ladders, use an aerial lift, and frequently lift a maximum of 50 lbs. of equipment
* Ability to perform tasks while wearing required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), which may include but is not limited to hard hat, face mask, face shield, and composite-toe shoes
* Regularly required to crouch or bend and reach to install/move equipment
* Movement between departments, floors, and properties to facilitate work, averaging 6 to 12 miles per day
* Work in a warehouse environment with fluctuating temperatures
* Regularly required to type on a computer for 1-2 hours per day

**Why C&W Services?**

We're a global company with over 400 offices in 60 countries. We're proud of our diverse family of employees and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We're recognized by the Human Rights Foundation as a Best Place to Work for LGBTQI+ individuals and are dedicated to continuing to build a culture of inclusion and respect.

**What’s Next?**

Ready to take the next steps in your career? Apply today and be part of a team that is making a difference!

**Be the expert who thrives on solving complex technical challenges, mentoring engineers, and driving products from concept through production.**

Join an environment built for engineers who want to stay close to the technology, take ownership of complex designs, and see products move from concept through manufacturing. This is an opportunity to serve as a senior technical authority while collaborating with experienced colleagues to solve demanding switch-mode power challenges.

**Innovation:** Help shape advanced power solutions for complex, mission-critical applications.

**Visible impact:** Translate market needs into product strategy, roadmaps, pricing, and winning technical proposals.

**Growth opportunity:** Build new business while strengthening Astrodyne TDI's competitive position in power electronics.

Electronic Power Designs (EPD), a Control Associates company, is seeking a skilled and motivated Senior Industrial Control Panel Electrical Engineer to join our growing engineering team in Bloomingdale, NJ. * Familiarity with UL 698 hazardous location panel requirements

* Knowledge of National Electrical Code (NEC) requirements

* Experience in custom engineered-to-order manufacturing environments

**About Sandia**
----------------

  

Sandia National Laboratories is the nation’s premier science and engineering lab for national security and technology innovation, with teams of specialists focused on cutting-edge work in a broad array of areas. Some of the main reasons we love our jobs:

* Challenging work with amazing impact that contributes to security, peace, and freedom worldwide
* Extraordinary co-workers
* Some of the best tools, equipment, and research facilities in the world
* Career advancement and enrichment opportunities
* Flexible work arrangements for many positions include 9/80 (work 80 hours every two weeks, with every other Friday off) and 4/10 (work 4 ten-hour days each week) compressed workweeks, part-time work, and telecommuting (a mix of onsite work and working from home)
* Generous vacation, strong medical and other benefits, competitive 401k, learning opportunities, relocation assistance and amenities aimed at creating a solid work/life balance\*

World-changing technologies. Life-changing careers. Learn more about Sandia at: http://www.sandia.gov

  

* These benefits vary by job classification.

**What Your Job Will Be Like**
------------------------------

  

The Advanced RF Systems department (5365) is seeking a highly motivated FPGA design Engineer to join its team. This position focuses on providing specialized FPGA expertise to aid in the development and fielding of communications and electronic warfare systems. You will be joining a multi-disciplinary team focused on delivering solutions to national security challenges. The ideal candidate will possess strong teamwork skills and a background in hardware design languages (HDL).

* Design, simulate and implement synthesizable RTL for high performance FPGAs
* Create original designs as well as modify and improve existing FPGA designs
* Write simulation testbenches for functional verification
* Design embedded electronic subsystems
* Test and troubleshoot printed wiring assemblies (PWAs) in the lab using power supplies, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other lab equipment
* Create innovative solutions to difficult technical problems
* Working cooperatively with other internal organizations, as well as external production facilities and suppliers
* Troubleshoot problems and support anomaly resolution activities
* Support customer funded advanced development needs
* Provide engineering and programmatic documentation
* Apply knowledge and experience to evaluate and improve work quality, performance, and alignment of results with customer expectations.
* The position will require occasional travel.

$102,400 - $199,700

* A Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or an equivalent combination of directly relevant education and engineering or scientific experience that demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and ability to perform independent research and development
* Ability to obtain and maintain a DOE Q and SCI clearance which may require a polygraph test.

* Graduate degree in Electrical Engineering or a highly related field where an independent research project was a graduation requirement (e.g., independent project, thesis, or dissertation).
* Ability to work independently and collaborate well in a multidisciplinary team of designers and test engineers.
* Outstanding verbal and written skills, including the ability to develop and present briefings that are clear and compelling.

Also, for this posting we are seeking individuals with the following experience:

* FPGA programming and verification experience
* Proficiency with Hardware Design Languages (Verilog, VHDL, etc.)
* 2 plus years of related experience in the following areas:
  + Development and verification of custom RTL for FPGA design (preferably VHDL)
  + Static Timing analysis
  + Development and use of testbench code for firmware validation
  + Troubleshooting of firmware using simulation software
  + Use of Microsemi Libero and/or Xilinx Vivado
  + Embedded system design
* Current DOE Q clearance
* Possess a strong dedication to positive teaming dynamic, strong written and verbal skills, detail oriented with a keen focus on customer service

**About Our Team**
------------------

  

As part of the Intelligent RF Communications group, we play a pivotal role in advancing the Nation's technological superiority. Our team is dedicated to delivering capabilities that ensure RF and spectral dominance, highly reliable communications, and groundbreaking advancements that fortify our future strength. We thrive in a dynamic environment where cross-department collaboration is key, enabling us to provide integrated engineering solutions that span from core research to prototype development and high-end, fielded products.

Our customers include a variety of government organizations including the U.S Armed Forces, the Intelligence Community, and those conducting special operations missions. Our staff members have a diverse skills set including microwave circuit design, antenna design, signal analysis, digital signal processing, and embedded software.

new_jobs.description:
Overview:

**Job Title:** Radar System Engineer

**Location:** New Mexico: White Sands Missile Range, NM

**Job Family Code:** O - Engineering

**Function/Branch:** Engineering Resource Management

**Directorate:** Engineering & Tech Support

**Position Type:** **Regular** Full Time

**Pay Type:** Exempt

**Sponsorship:** Position Not Sponsored

**Grade:** L08 (OA0859) - L09 (OA0962)

**Salary Range or Starting Hourly Rate:** L08: $92,000 - $123,000; L09: $104,000 - $139,000/ per year

**Overview**

*Beyond New Horizons, LLC (BNH) has an exciting opportunity for a Radar System Engineer, supporting TOS II, at White Sands Missile Range, NM. Radar System Engineer will be working as a member of an integrated team responsible for operating and maintaining or supporting the United States Air Force Test Operations and Sustainment efforts.*

**Job Summary**

The Radar Systems Engineer reports directly to Engineer Manager to execute mission-critical specific radar systems equipment including design, development, tests, operation, maintenance, repair, and quality assurance. NRTF Radar Systems Engineer will work with a team of other engineers and technicians to create and improve radar systems, from the initial concept and design phase through the integration, testing, operations and maintenance phase. The NRTF Radar Systems Engineer will use a variety of tools and techniques to analyze and optimize radar performance, including computer simulations and mathematical models. The Radar Systems Engineer is also required to stay up to date with the latest advancements in radar technology and be knowledgeable about the laws and regulations that govern the use of radar systems. This position will require various shifts, weekends, and alternative work schedules for extended periods of time. Must be willing to work overtime when required. NRTF’s Radar Systems Engineers should have a solid understanding of radar principles and have experience with computer simulations, mathematical modeling, and programming. Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills are also essential.

**Job Duties:**

* Knowledge of modern radar, Instrumentation and constituent technologies.
* The applicant should be proficient in antenna and radar theory and associated hardware.
* Strong background in electrical engineering, physics, or related fields.
* Lead and advise in the acquisition and insertion of new capabilities into the NRTF enterprise.
* Train Operations personnel on new capabilities.
* Lead small development efforts, as well as rapid prototypes.
* Knowledge of RF components to allow for troubleshooting and new or modified design implementation.
* Must be able to work individually and as a team member, able to take direction but must also lead and direct the work of others.
* Knowledge of specification development for new system acquisitions.
* Researching and ordering replacement components and spare parts for radar system.
* Recommend improvements to maintenance methods, system and equipment performance as well as operational efficiencies.
* Train and mentor junior Radar Systems Engineers and technicians.
* Familiar with the System Engineering development process to include the ability to present/coordinate PDR’s, CDR’s, etc. and conduct FAT’s.
* Follows all OSHA safety regulations.
* Effective communication both verbally and written
* Project management skills with experience in the procurement, cost and budget process.
* Working knowledge of documentation and configuration control.
* It is a condition of employment to wear company issued PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) in accordance with supervisory direction and company policy.
* Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned by the Chief Scientist or Capabilities Manager as necessary to support contract/mission support requirements in job-related areas.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related scientific or engineering discipline
* A minimum of five (5) years of professional experience in radar system architecture, integration, verification, and validation.
* A minimum of two (2) years of programming experience utilizing MATLAB, MathCad, or Python.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain an active security clearance and maintain authorized user access to the AEDC local area network.
* S. Citizenship is required due to federal government contract compliance requirements and the necessity to access secure federal databases and networks.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Top Secret Security Clearance

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salaries
* Continuing education assistance
* Multiple healthcare benefits packages
* 401K with employer matching
* Paid time off (PTO) along with a federally recognized holiday schedule

**Who We Are**

Beyond New Horizons (BNH) is a fully populated joint venture of Astrion and Fluor Federal Services, Inc. formed to provide unmatched Test Operations and Sustainment services for the Arnold Engineering Development Complex.

We chose our name to serve as an enduring reminder of our commitment to AEDC’s rich aerospace research and development legacy anchored in AEDC’s Toward New Horizons founding study and the unprecedented opportunities to greatly expand AEDC’s capabilities and capacity Beyond those existing today. Leveraging the capabilities of our parent companies, BNH specializes in testing and evaluation for military and space systems combined with proven capability in large-scale Government program management, integration, engineering, and construction services for specialized and technically advanced high-hazard facilities.

**Join our Team!**

U.S. Citizenship is required. new_jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Job Description
  
Gauge Engineering Services is seeking an Embedded Software Engineer to support the development of next-generation airborne mission computer systems used in military helicopter platforms. This role involves designing and developing embedded software for single board computers that integrate with avionics, mission, and weapons systems. The engineer will work on innovative internal research and development initiatives focused on proprietary technologies and emerging capabilities.The ideal candidate will have strong experience programming in C/C++, developing low-level software, and working within Linux and real-time operating system environments. Success in this role requires exceptional attention to detail and the ability to accurately execute software development tasks from written requirements, build sheets, and technical documentation.Responsibilities:
  
Develop embedded software in C and C++ for single board computer platforms supporting airborne mission computer systems.
  
Design, develop, and maintain device drivers that interface with electronic hardware and FPGA-based systems.
  
Work within Linux-based operating systems and real-time operating systems (RTOS) such as LynxOS, Integrity, or similar environments.
  
Participate in Agile development activities including sprint planning, story execution, testing, and delivery.
  
Interpret and execute technical requirements, data sheets, build instructions, and engineering documentation with a high degree of accuracy.
  
Integrate, troubleshoot, and validate software functionality with hardware subsystems.
  
Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to support the development of advanced avionics and mission system technologies.

new_jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - FE
new_jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

Intuit Mailchimp is a leading marketing platform for small businesses. We empower millions of customers around the world to build their brands and grow their companies with a suite of marketing automation, multichannel campaigns, CRM, and analytics tools.

Forms are where a huge share of that growth starts. Signup forms, embedded forms, landing page forms, and the pop-ups our customers put in front of their own audiences are the front door to list growth on Mailchimp, and they are rendered across an enormous surface area: inside our own app, and inside millions of third-party websites we do not control. We are looking for a Staff-level frontend engineer to set technical direction for that platform.

This role is about depth, not breadth of headcount. You will own the architecture of a schema-driven, micro-frontend-based forms platform: the contracts that describe a form, the runtime that renders it, the composition layer that lets independently deployed teams ship into a shared experience, and the operational discipline that keeps all of it fast and reliable on somebody else's page. You will do that alongside product, design, and engineers across the Forms, and you will be the person other engineers come to when a rendering, contract, or performance decision needs to be made well the first time.

  

**How you'll work**
-------------------

Our Core Leadership Behaviors are the observable and measurable leadership actions and skills that contribute to our effectiveness and success in our roles.

  

* **Thriving in Complexity:** You unravel and make sense of potentially sophisticated, incomplete, and contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
* **Nimble Learning:** You tackle problems with experimentation, using successes and failures to inform future decisions.
* **Expecting the Best:** You hold yourself and others accountable to meet commitments.
* **Collaborating Courageously:** You build partnerships across the company and work collaboratively with others to meet strategic goals.
* **Cultivating Candor:** You act with integrity and earn the confidence and trust of others through honesty and authenticity.
* **Inclusive Leadership:** You recognize the value diversity brings to our organization and leverage different perspectives to enhance organizational culture and drive performance.
* **Customer Obsessed:** You listen hard to customers, understand their challenges, develop relationships with them, and deliver products that remove their obstacles.
* **Action Oriented:** You initiate new opportunities and face tough challenges with a sense of energy, enthusiasm, and service.

**Responsibilities**

* Set the technical direction for the Mailchimp Forms frontend platform, micro-frontend boundaries, module federation and composition strategy, versioning and rollback, and the migration path off legacy rendering paths in the monolith.
* Own the schema contracts that drive our form experiences end to end: the schema definition, validation, versioning and backward-compatibility strategy, and the renderer that turns schema into accessible, performant UI without a code change per field type.
* Drive operational excellence as a first-class deliverable SLOs and error budgets for a client-side product, real-user performance monitoring, Core Web Vitals, structured client-side telemetry, alerting that pages on customer-visible degradation rather than noise, and blameless postmortems that actually change the system.
* Be the technical lead across the full lifecycle: scoping, design, implementation, testing, documentation, rollout, and long-term maintenance, including the unglamorous parts.
* Raise the bar for other engineers through design reviews, pairing, and written architecture guidance covering integration, performance, accessibility, and scalability and find the balance between writing code yourself and creating room for others to grow.
* Extend and contribute back to our design system: component APIs, design tokens, and theming that hold up when a customer embeds our form into their own brand and stylesheet.
* Own accessibility as a requirement, not a cleanup task — WCAG 2.2 AA conformance, keyboard and screen-reader behavior, and automated a11y checks wired into CI.
* Use AI coding agents and GenAI-assisted development as part of how you work, and help the team establish what good looks like: where agents accelerate us, where they need guardrails, and how review standards adapt.
* Share production ownership and on-call rotation with the rest of the team.

**Qualifications**

* You have significant experience designing and implementing frontend architectures at scale and writing code that is maintainable, performant, and observable, not just code that ships.
* You have built or substantially evolved a **micro-frontend architecture** in production: independently deployable frontends, shared dependency and runtime strategy, cross-team contracts, isolation and blast-radius control, and the versioning discipline that keeps it from turning into distributed spaghetti. You can speak candidly about what went wrong and what you would do differently.
* You have deep expertise in **schema-driven / config-driven UI;** JSON Schema or an equivalent contract language, dynamic form rendering, declarative validation, schema evolution and backward compatibility, and codegen from contracts. You understand where schema-driven design pays for itself and where it becomes an abstraction tax.
* You hold a high bar on **software engineering fundamentals and operational excellence**: testing strategy that gives real confidence, CI/CD and progressive delivery, feature flags, instrumentation and observability, incident response, and a track record of owning what you ship in production.
* You are fluent in modern JavaScript/TypeScript and a major component framework (React preferred), and you understand the browser deeply enough to reason about bundle size, hydration, rendering perf

new_jobs.title: Systems Engineer - Industrial Controls
new_jobs.description:
Location Charlotte, North Carolina, 28273 Category Engineering JR105329 FCX 9290 FCX Performance, Inc. Regular Job Type Full time

  

**System Engineer – Industrial Controls**

**Position Overview**

FCX Performance, an Applied Industrial Technologies Company, is seeking a hands-on, mid-to-senior level **System Engineer** to deliver industrial and commercial control systems services to local customers. This is a field-heavy engineering role requiring physical site visits, tool utilization, and direct interaction with industrial machinery.

**Essential Functions & Responsibilities**

* **Field Engineering & Support:** Provide local industrial/commercial control systems engineering service for customers relating to SCADA Systems, PLC Programming, CAD Drawings, Industrial Networking, and Systems Calibration.
* **Technician Interfacing:** Support instrument technicians in the field with issues related to interfacing field devices to DCS & SCADA systems, special needs testing, and technical support.
* **Project & Contract Management:** Partner with fellow engineers to resolve project backlogs while maintaining excellent relationships with contract customers.
* **On-Site Upgrades:** Identify opportunities for system and hardware upgrades at customer facilities.
* **Documentation & Safety:** Report job activity and maintain detailed logs about service calls, parts, and orders. Fully comprehend and communicate safety protocols on active job sites.
* **Travel:** Safely operate a company vehicle to travel to and from local job sites daily.

**Required Education & Experience**

* **Experience:** **Minimum 5+ years of direct, hands-on industry experience** programming PLCs (Allen Bradley, Automation Direct, MOSCAD, etc.) and working with process/flow control systems.
* **HMI Proficiency:** 5+ years of experience with computer-based HMI software (Wonderware, VTSCADA, Lookout, etc.).
* **Education:** Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering (BSEE/BSEET), or an Associate Degree (ASEE) paired with extensive, verifiable field experience. *(Note: Advanced theoretical degrees like an MSEE are not required; this is a practical field engineering role).*
* **Driving Record:** Must possess a valid US driver's license with a clean driving record.
* **Work Authorization:** Must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Sponsorship will not be provided for this position

**Technical & Mental Requirements**

* Strong background in electrical/electronic engineering, process instrumentation, and process engineering.
* High energy, technically competent, resourceful, with extreme attention to detail.
* **Programming & CAD:** Strong skills in PLCs, Microsoft Visual Basic (or basic programming software) and AutoCAD/AutoCAD Electrical.
* **Industrial Networking:** Solid understanding of networks, network structures, radio-based communications, and industrial protocols.
* **Controls Mastery:** Deep understanding of industrial controls, process controls (including PID Loops and pump control), industrial instrument calibrations, and repairs.
* **Electrical Knowledge:** Advanced understanding of analog current loops (4-20mAdc, 1-5Vdc, etc.), their PLC counterparts in numeric counts, and strict adherence to the National Electrical Code (NEC).
* **Tool Proficiency:** Competency with required physical equipment, including hand tools, volt-ohm meters, power tools, and instrument loops.
* **Growth Mindset:** While 5+ years of core experience is required, you will receive ongoing On-the-Job Training (OJT) for company-specific workflows. A willingness to learn daily and teach others is required.
* **Autonomy:** Must be highly self-motivated, self-driven, and able to manage daily schedules.

**Physical & Environmental Requirements**

* **Physical Strength:** Must be able to lift objects weighing up to 50 lbs regularly.
* **Mobility:** Must be able to stand, kneel, walk for long periods, and climb ladders or stairs.
* **Availability:** Available for occasional emergency call-ins and overnight travel to various customer sites based on business needs.
* **Environment:** Duties are performed indoors and outdoors with direct exposure to weather elements, heavy equipment, earth excavation, power tools, clean rooms, dirt, and noise.
* **National Travel:** Ability to travel nationally when required (infrequent).

Founded in 1923, Applied Industrial Technologies (NYSE: AIT) is a leading value-added distributor and technical solutions provider of industrial motion, fluid power, flow control, automation technologies, and related maintenance supplies. Our leading brands, specialized services, and comprehensive knowledge serve MRO and OEM end users in virtually all industrial markets through our multi-channel capabilities that provide choice, convenience, and expertise.

**Applied Industrial Technologies is built on a philosophy that puts people first. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to a workforce in which we enforce fair treatment and provide growth opportunities for everyone. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.**

new_jobs.title: Lead Electrical Engineer
new_jobs.description:
We're ALTEN Technology USA, an engineering company helping clients bring groundbreaking ideas to life—from advancing space exploration and life-saving medical devices to building autonomous electric vehicles. With 3,000+ experts across North America, we partner with leading companies in aerospace, medical devices, robotics, automotive, commercial vehicles, EVs, rail, and more.

As part of the global ALTEN Group—57,000+ engineers in 30 countries—we deliver across the entire product development cycle, from consulting to full project outsourcing.

When you join ALTEN Technology USA, you'll collaborate on some of the world's toughest engineering challenges, supported by mentorship, career growth opportunities, and comprehensive benefits. We take pride in fostering a culture where employees feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow.

  

As a **Lead Electrical Engineer** you will be responsible for;

* Leading the design, development, testing, and support of advanced RF-based electronic systems for medical imaging applications.
* Designing and analyzing analog and RF circuitry, including high-frequency electronics and signal transmission systems.
* Utilizing simulation, modeling, and CAD tools to develop and optimize electrical designs.
* Performing system integration activities to ensure compatibility and performance across complex electromechanical systems.
* Conducting validation, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and corrective action investigations for field and production issues.
* Collaborating with mechanical, systems, manufacturing, quality, and regulatory teams throughout the product lifecycle.
* Supporting compliance with applicable safety, performance, and regulatory standards.
* Leading technical reviews, driving engineering decisions, and mentoring junior engineers.
* Identifying opportunities for innovation, product enhancement, and continuous improvement.
* Managing multiple engineering initiatives while ensuring quality, schedule, and technical objectives are achieved.

**Qualifications;**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in electrical engineering, RF design, medical devices, medical imaging, or other highly regulated industries.
* Strong knowledge of analog and RF circuit design principles.
* Experience with electrical design, simulation, and modeling tools.
* Understanding of electromagnetic theory, transmission lines, antennas, amplifiers, oscillators, and related RF technologies.
* Experience with printed circuit board design, testing, validation, and troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of engineering product development processes and design verification practices.
* Ability to perform root cause analysis and drive effective corrective actions.
* Strong communication, leadership, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Experience within medical devices, healthcare technology, or regulated product development environments preferred.
* Knowledge of IEC standards, reliability engineering, Lean methodologies, or continuous improvement practices preferred.

  

**Location: Onsite in Aurora, OH**

**Salary Range: $80,000 0 $120,000**

The actual salary offered is dependent on various factors including, but not limited to, location, the candidate's combination of job-related knowledge, qualifications, skills, education, training, and experience

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or pregnancy.

***Please beware of job seeker scams and see this*** ***important notice*** ***on our careers page for more information about our recruiting process.***

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

**Drug Screening Requirement:** As a federal contractor, Alten USA maintains a drug-free workplace. All candidates selected for employment will be required to successfully complete a pre-employment drug screening as a condition of hire.

new_jobs.title: Critical Infrastructure Electrical Engineer, Field Engineering
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
As an Amazon Critical Infrastructure Engineer, you will provide full life-cycle support to AWS Data Centers from design inception through site improvement and maintenance. You will be the ‘go to’ engineering resource for your region when technical advice is needed, and will use your subject matter expertise and engage with diverse teams to:  
  

* Troubleshoot, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site/equipment failures.

  

* Directly support operational issues with ad-hoc training, complex operating procedure reviews, including critical equipment, and event support.

  

* Own the conceptual design for existing data center upgrades and design-solutions, which add capacity, improve availability, increase efficiency and sustainability.

  

* Interface with internal data center operations team, data center design engineering team, server hardware team, environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered.

  

* Develop innovative solutions for AWS’s data centers.

  

* Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions.

  

* Initiate and lead engineering audits including on-site visits within Amazon’s data centers. Produce reports outlining risks with recommended mitigations and remediations.

  

* Act as resident engineer during new construction projects. Support construction, commissioning, and turnover.

  
Key job responsibilities  
Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. As an Amazon Critical Infrastructure Engineer, you will be leading projects to fit out our data centers to  
  
meet ever-evolving customer needs as we continue expanding our fleet to hyper-scale. As an ideal candidate you:  
  

* Possess Strong Engineering Judgement and are able to provide recommendations despite uncertainty/ambiguity.

### **Position Description & Qualifications**

  
  

If you want to work on cutting-edge DoD programs, Serco has a great opportunity for you! As a Senior Anti-Tamper Engineer specializing in systems engineering, you will be supporting the Special Programs Division, DoD Anti-Tamper (AT) Executive Agent Field Program Office (FPO) (AFLCMC/WAG-AT) at Wright Patterson AFB, OH.

**This position is contingent upon the ability to maintain/transfer active Department of War (DoW) Top Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain TS/SCI.**

WAG-AT conducts studies to identify new capabilities; matures laboratory technologies to be weapon system ready; and develops, tests, and rapidly fields new AT capabilities/products all which provide insight and foundational AT technology to seed DoD weapon system development programs. These are focused on reducing developmental risk and associated cost and schedule growth, ultimately ensuring AT architectures are developed, supporting protection of US warfighters against loss of life caused by technological exploitation of US weapons systems.

* Apply DoD systems engineering process, policy, and procedures in the acquisition, manufacturing, fielding, and sustainment, modernization and disposal of new, existing and future weapons systems and capabilities, with specific experience in weapon system Program Protection planning and anti-tamper methods
* Assess integrated circuitry, industry standard processors, and memory chips and determine methodologies for reverse engineering electronic systems and integrated circuitry
* Provide engineering support for technology and product acquisitions to include long-term planning, request for proposal (RFP) development, and technical oversight of ongoing projects
* Review and analyze proposals for design feasibility and system compatibility
* Assess acquired capabilities in achieving system design requirements and specifications
* For program protection, identify technologies and evaluate system/subsystem design functions and improvements to protect Critical Program Information (CPI)
* Develop plans to assess security features of Government Off-The-Shelf (GOTS) and Commercial Off-The Shelf (COTS) components for CPI susceptibility/vulnerability to exploitation and reverse engineering.
* Work with DoD Anti-Tamper Evaluation Teams to understand current designs and identify vulnerabilities to foreign and adversary exploitation
* Assist efforts to improve US weapons system anti-tamper/anti-exploitation design, development, manufacturing, training, and sustainment
* Evaluate system test plans and participate in conduct of system, subsystem, & component testing
* Conduct engineering performance, supportability, schedule, and risk assessments and scheduling trade off studies

To be successful in this role, you will have:

* An active TOP-SECRET security clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) and access to Special Access Programs (SAP) and have a background investigation current within the past 5 years or under Continuous Vetting
* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering with a minimum of 12 years experience in an engineering position with the DoD, other government agency, or DoD contractor
* Masters Degree in a relevant engineering discipline with a minimum of 10 years experience in an engineering position with the DoD, other government agency, or DoD contractor
* Minimum 3 years of SAP or SCI experience within the last 8 years
* Ability to travel up to 10% (CONUS)

Additional desired experience and skills:

* Experience with Program Protection planning and implementation in weapon system programs
* Experience evaluating current fielded weapons systems to determine anti-tamper and reverse engineering susceptibility based on vendor design
* Experience working with industry to assess tamper resistance of current weapons systems within the acquisition development cycle
* Experience working within the electronic exploitation lab environment to evaluate current and new processors, memory units, and electronic circuits to exploit weaknesses, identify improvements to design, and develop new standards to deter technological exploitation

new_jobs.description:
At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

**The Boeing Company** has an exciting opportunity for an **Associate Software Engineer** to support the Guidance Repair Center in **Heath, OH.**

  
  

This engineering position will be responsible for the design, development, test, and sustainment of electrical, electronic, and electro-mechanical products and test equipment/software in support of the U.S. Strategic Deterrence Systems (U.S. Air Force Intercontinental Ballistic Missile, U.S. Air Force & U.S. Navy Guidance Systems and other military programs). In addition, this role will review test data, direct repairs, develop process improvements, capture process changes, and solve problems with new workloads and part obsolescence.

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Contributes to development and deployment of automated test equipment for lab and factory automation, including data processing and control algorithm development
* Works in small agile teams composed of diverse engineering skills
* Use your talents to tackle complex problems on a variety of programs
* Responsible for developing technical products, plans, documentation, and briefings supporting program requirements
  

  

**Security Clearance:**

This position requires the ability to obtain a U.S. Security Clearance for which the U.S. Government requires U.S. Citizenship. An interim and/or final U.S. Secret Clearance Post-Start is required.

  
  

**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):**

* Bachelor’s Degree or higher
* 1+ years of experience as a Software Engineer
* 1+ years of programming experience
* 1+ years’ experience programming in C, C++ or Ada

**Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):**

* Bachelor of Science degree from an accredited course of study in engineering, engineering technology (includes manufacturing engineering technology), chemistry, physics, mathematics, data science, or computer science and 2+ years of related work experience OR Bachelor’s Degree and 6+ years of directly related work experience OR 10+ years of related, relevant experience
* Experience incorporating modifications to legacy test equipment systems that have limited documentation
* Experience programming in C#
* Experience with Networking and Database
* Experience programming in Labview
* Experience with Microsoft Programming
* Experience with Data Analytics

**Conflict of Interest:**

Successful candidates for this job must satisfy the Company's Conflict of Interest (COI) assessment process.

**Work Location:**

This position is expected to be 100% onsite. The selected candidate will be required to work onsite at one of the listed location options.

  
  

**CodeVue Coding Challenge:**

To be considered for this position you will be required to complete a technical assessment as part of the selection process. Failure to complete the assessment will remove you from consideration.

  
  

**Drug Free Workplace:**

Boeing is a Drug Free Workplace where post offer applicants and employees are subject to testing for marijuana, cocaine, opioids, amphetamines, PCP, and alcohol when criteria is met as outlined in our policies*.*

**Total Rewards:**

At Boeing, we strive to deliver a Total Rewards package that will attract, engage and retain the top talent. Elements of the Total Rewards package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities.

The Boeing Company also provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work.

The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

Pay is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

Summary Pay Range: USD $99,450 – $134,550

new_jobs.title: Software Development Engineer - Linux Kernel, AWS Hardware Engineering
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Application deadline: Oct 12, 2026  
  
Join AWS Hardware Engineering to design the servers powering the world's leading cloud platform and AI/ML infrastructure. We're seeking an exceptional Linux Kernel Engineer to accelerate critical kernel initiatives across millions of servers worldwide.  
  
We are seeking an exceptional Linux Kernel Engineer to join our server firmware team. In this role, you will lead Linux kernel patching, code development, and version adoption for our server management controllers across a massive global fleet. You will ensure our kernel remains current, secure, and compliant with strict patching service-level agreements that directly impact AWS infrastructure reliability. Your work will power the backbone of AWS compute infrastructure, including the servers that enable AI/ML workloads for customers worldwide.  
  
The ideal candidate will be an innovative self-starter with deep expertise in Linux kernel internals, device driver development, and embedded Linux systems. You will gain comprehensive understanding of our server firmware kernel stack and analyze it in both current and future contexts. Using your systems knowledge, you will architect solutions to complex multi-factor problems, including kernel upgrade strategies that minimize customer impact, address security vulnerabilities rapidly, and optimize operational efficiency across millions of servers supporting diverse workloads from traditional compute to advanced machine learning applications.  
  
You will collaborate with engineers across AWS and external partners, leading development efforts that span kernel security, hardware enablement, and platform services teams. Your work will directly contribute to critical initiatives that keep our infrastructure patched, secure, and operationally excellent—ensuring the foundation for tomorrow's AI/ML innovations remains robust and scalable.  
  
AWS Engineers are shaping the way people use computers and designing the future of cloud computing technology – come help us make history!  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Design and develop firmware solutions for AWS servers, contributing to server designs that power millions of customer workloads.  
Lead the complete development lifecycle from initial conception through production deployment, ensuring robust and scalable firmware implementations across our massive server fleet.  
Architect and implement firmware deployment strategies that minimize customer impact while maintaining the highest standards of security and operational excellence.  
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including hardware engineers, validation teams, software services to optimize functionality and performance.  
Explore and evaluate emerging technologies and their potential impact on AWS infrastructure, making recommendations for adoption and integration into our firmware stack.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services is establishing a hardware engineering office in Portland, Oregon to accelerate server hardware development, manufacturing, and operations. The Portland site will become a center of excellence for electrical hardware engineering within AWS for board development, server power, system performance, silicon quality, and manufacturing. This is a greenfield site leadership role. The site leader will be the first hire and the single most important investment in the success of this office. You will not simply manage a team. You will own the culture, operational posture, recruiting velocity, and engineering output of the entire Portland site from day one.  
  
As the site leader, you will own the Portland office end to end. You will define the site's identity, set its operational cadence, and establish the cultural foundation before the organization scales. You will drive recruiting velocity across all Portland teams, partner with real estate and facilities to stand up lab-capable office space, and represent the Portland site in cross-site planning with Seattle, San Jose, and other AWS engineering locations. You will be the single point of accountability for the site's hiring trajectory, engineering output, and organizational health. Every team at the Portland site, whether in your direct reporting line or not, will look to you as the senior leader on the ground.  
  
As the functional engineering leader, you will hire, develop, and lead the managers who run each of the Portland engineering teams. Your direct reports will be the engineering managers who own board development, server power, and manufacturing test/quality, and validation of 3rd party silicon. You will be accountable for the output, hiring velocity, and technical judgment of each of those teams through the managers you put in place. You will lead board development managers, server power managers, electrical manufacturing test/quality, silicon qualification, and production yield. These are not adjacent teams doing similar work. You will be expected to set technical direction across all of them, make resourcing tradeoffs between them, calibrate talent across teams, and hold each manager and their team to a unified engineering bar. You will also carry coordination responsibility for firmware disciplines co-located at the site, including BIOS, BMC, and mechanical engineering teams.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The site leader owns all Portland site operations end to end. This includes defining and executing the recruiting strategy to hire and scale multiple engineering teams. You will lead the multiple engineer teams. You will establish and maintain Amazon's cultural standards at the site, operational rigor, and embody Amazon culture to scale the site.

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline
* 10 or more years of progressive experience in hardware engineering, including at least 5 years managing managers
* Demonstrated track record of building and scaling hardware engineering teams from the ground up, ideally in a greenfield or early-stage site context

* Bachelor’s degree in Robotics Engineering or Controls Engineering.

* Seven years of experience with empty-can, full-can, tray-code, and vision inspection systems; and with Anton Paar equipment, including digital and analog sensors, flow meters, temperature and pressure transmitters, and mass flow meters.
* Seven years of mechanical experience performing major overhauls, replacing worn parts, and rebuilding filling valves, manifold distributors, filler main bearings, conveyor belts, and process valves—including flap, seat, double-seat, double-seal, diverting, shuttle, and sampling valves—and replacing and referencing servo motors.

new_jobs.title: Senior Electrical Systems Engineer
new_jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

  
  
  

**Group/Division**

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The SPTS division provides advanced wafer processing solutions—including etch, deposition and vapor-based technologies—designed for R&D through high-volume production. With a global presence and strong customer support network, SPTS helps manufacturers across industries improve performance, yield and cost-efficiency. It also offers comprehensive service and spare parts through a worldwide network of service centers and qualified local agents.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

  
  

At KLA, we develop industry-leading equipment and technologies that enable innovation across the semiconductor industry. Our teams solve complex engineering challenges that help customers manufacture faster, more powerful, and more efficient electronic devices.

  
  

We are seeking a hands-on position support multiple semiconductor process equipment platforms, including advanced etch and deposition systems. This role combines electrical system design, product safety, regulatory compliance, sustaining engineering, and new product development. The ideal candidate is a hands-on electrical engineer that has a strong interest in and willingness to lead product safety and compliance efforts.

  

**What You'll Do**

As a key member of the engineering team, you will be responsible for the electrical design, product & safety compliance, and long-term support of electrical systems in semiconductor manufacturing equipment.

  

**Electrical Systems Design & Sustaining**

* Design and sustain electrical systems for semiconductor process equipment
* Specify and integrate electrical components including power supplies, sensors, relays, circuit protection devices, heaters, temperature control hardware, and motion-control elements
* Develop equipment protection strategies and electrical safety functions such as emergency stops, safety interlocks, and grounding systems
* Evaluate new technologies and alternative components to improve product performance, reliability, manufacturability, and cost
* Support field electrical troubleshooting escalations when required
  

**Product Safety & Regulatory Compliance**

* Lead product safety and compliance initiatives across multiple equipment platforms
* Interpret and implement industry standards including SEMI, CE, IEC, NFPA, UL, and customer-specific requirements
* Conduct compliance assessments, design reviews, gap analyses, risk assessments, and hazard evaluations
* Partner with certification bodies and testing organizations to achieve product certifications and maintain compliance documentation
  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline
* 5+ years of experience designing electrical systems for semiconductor equipment, industrial automation, manufacturing equipment, or other similar electromechanical systems
* Demonstrated ability to assess and design electrical systems and equipment to regulatory standards (i.e., 60204-1, NFPA 79, UL 508A)
* Strong understanding of electrical design principles, power distribution, controls, and electrical safety
* Experience selecting, integrating, and troubleshooting electrical components and subsystems
* Travel requirement for 15 to 20%
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience as a liaison with 3rd party assessors to achieve and maintain equipment certifications (i.e., CE mark, EMC)
* Experience assessing and designing safety interlock circuits with performance levels required by ISO 13849
* Working knowledge of SEMI S2, CE, IEC, NFPA, UL, ISO 13849, and other product compliance standards
* Experience performing machine safety risk assessments and hazard analyses (i.e., 12100, FMEA)
* Experience using Sistema for Performance Level (PL) and functional safety evaluations
  

**Why Join KLA?**

This is an opportunity to have a direct impact on the safety, performance, and reliability of advanced semiconductor manufacturing systems used by leading technology companies worldwide. You'll work on challenging multidisciplinary engineering problems, collaborate with experts across KLA, and contribute to products that power the future of electronics.

**Minimum Qualifications**

Doctorate (Academic) Degree and 0 years related work experience; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 5 years

**About KLA**

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

  
  
  

**Total Rewards**

Base Pay Range: $100,100.00 -
